sentences.en: A The story of tea began in ancient China over 5,000 years ago.
sentences.zh: 茶的故事始于五千多年前的古代中国。

sentences.en: According to legend, the Emperor Shen Nung was a skilled ruler, creative scientist and patron of the arts.
sentences.zh: 相传，神农帝是一位治国有方的君主、富有创造力的科学家，也是艺术的赞助者。

sentences.en: His far-sighted edicts required, among other things, that all drinking water be boiled as a hygienic precaution.
sentences.zh: 他颁布的一道颇有远见的法令规定，所有饮用水都必须煮沸，以作为一种卫生上的防范措施。

sentences.en: One summer day, while visiting a distant region of his realm, he and the court stopped to rest.
sentences.zh: 一个夏日，在巡视自己疆域中一处偏远地区时，他和随行的群臣停下休息。

sentences.en: In accordance with his ruling, the servants began to boil water for the court to drink.
sentences.zh: 按照他的法令，仆从们开始为群臣烧水饮用。

sentences.en: Dried leaves from a nearby bush fell into the boiling water, and as the leaves infused the water turned brown.
sentences.zh: 附近一丛灌木的几片干叶落进了沸水中，叶子浸泡之下，水变成了褐色。

sentences.en: As a scientist, the Emperor was intrigued by the new liquid, drank some, and found it very refreshing.
sentences.zh: 作为一位科学家，神农帝对这种新的液体颇感好奇，喝了一些，发现它十分提神。

sentences.en: And so, according to legend, tea was created.
sentences.zh: 于是，相传茶就这样诞生了。

sentences.en: B Tea consumption spread throughout Chinese culture, reaching into every aspect of society.
sentences.zh: 饮茶之风传遍了中国文化，渗透到社会的方方面面。

sentences.en: The first definitive book was written on tea – a book clearly reflecting Zen Buddhist philosophy – 1,200 years ago.
sentences.zh: 第一部论茶的权威著作写于一千二百年前——这部书明显反映出禅宗的哲学思想。

sentences.en: The first tea seeds were brought to Japan by a returning Buddhist priest, who had seen the value of tea in enhancing meditation in China.
sentences.zh: 第一批茶种是由一位归国的佛教僧人带到日本的，他在中国看到了茶在增进禅修方面的价值。

sentences.en: As a result, he is known as the “Father of Tea” in Japan.
sentences.zh: 因此，他在日本被称为“茶之父”。

sentences.en: Because of this early association, tea in Japan has always been linked with Zen Buddhism.
sentences.zh: 由于这种早期的渊源，茶在日本始终与禅宗联系在一起。

sentences.en: Tea received the Japanese Emperor’s support almost instantly and spread rapidly from the royal court and monasteries to other sections of society.
sentences.zh: 茶几乎立刻获得了日本天皇的支持，并迅速从宫廷和寺院传播到社会的其他阶层。

sentences.en: C Tea was elevated to an art form in the Japanese tea ceremony, in which supreme importance is given to making tea in the most perfect, most polite, most graceful, most charming manner possible.
sentences.zh: 在日本的茶道中，茶被提升为一种艺术形式，其中至关重要的是要以尽可能完美、尽可能恭谨、尽可能优雅、尽可能动人的方式来沏茶。

sentences.en: Such a purity of expression prompted the creation of a particular form of architecture for tea houses, duplicating the simplicity of a forest cottage.
sentences.zh: 这样一种纯粹的表达方式，促成了一种专门的茶室建筑形式的诞生，它再现了林间小屋的质朴。

sentences.en: The cultural/artistic hostesses of Japan, the geishas, began to specialise in the presentation of the tea ceremony.
sentences.zh: 日本兼具文化与艺术修养的女主人——艺伎，开始专门从事茶道的演示。

sentences.en: However, as more and more people became involved in the excitement surrounding tea, the purity of the original concept was lost, and for a period the tea ceremony became corrupted, boisterous and highly embellished.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着越来越多的人卷入围绕茶的热潮，最初理念的那份纯粹渐渐丧失，有一段时期，茶道变得堕落、喧闹而又过分雕饰。

sentences.en: Efforts were then made to return to the earlier simplicity, with the result that, in the 15th and 16th centuries, tea was viewed as the ultimate gift.
sentences.zh: 于是人们努力回归早先的质朴，结果在15世纪和16世纪，茶被视为至高无上的礼物。

sentences.en: Even warlords paused for tea before battles.
sentences.zh: 就连军阀也会在战前停下来饮一杯茶。

sentences.en: D While tea was at this high level of development in parts of Asia, information concerning the then-unknown beverage began to filter back to Europe.
sentences.zh: 正当茶在亚洲部分地区发展到这一高度之时，关于这种当时尚不为人知的饮品的信息，开始陆续传回欧洲。

sentences.en: Earlier traders had mentioned it, but were unclear as to whether tea should be eaten or drunk.
sentences.zh: 早先的商人曾提到过它，却不清楚茶究竟应该吃还是该喝。

sentences.en: The first European to personally encounter tea and write about it was Portuguese – Portugal, with her technologically advanced navy, had been successful in gaining the first right of trade with China.
sentences.zh: 第一个亲身接触茶并著文记述它的欧洲人是葡萄牙人——拥有技术先进的海军的葡萄牙，已成功取得了与中国通商的最初权利。

sentences.en: E Tea finally arrived in Europe in the 16th century, brought to Holland by the country’s navy, and became very fashionable in the Dutch capital, The Hague.
sentences.zh: 茶终于在16世纪传入欧洲，由荷兰海军带到荷兰，并在荷兰首都海牙大为流行。

sentences.en: This was due in part to tea being very expensive (over $100 per pound), which immediately made it the domain of the wealthy.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是因为茶非常昂贵（每磅100多美元），这使它一下子成了富人的专属之物。

sentences.en: Slowly, as the amount of tea imported increased, the price fell, and by 1675 it was available in common food shops throughout Holland.
sentences.zh: 随着进口茶叶数量的增加，茶价逐渐下跌，到1675年，荷兰各地普通的食品店里都能买到茶了。

sentences.en: F As the consumption of tea increased dramatically in Dutch society, doctors and university authorities in Holland argued as to its benefits or drawbacks.
sentences.zh: 随着茶在荷兰社会的消费量急剧上升，荷兰的医生和大学权威就茶的益处或害处展开了争论。

sentences.en: The public largely ignored the scholarly debate and continued to enjoy their new beverage, though the controversy lasted from 1635 to roughly 1657.
sentences.zh: 公众基本上无视这场学术争论，继续享用他们的新饮品，尽管这场争议从1635年一直持续到大约1657年。

sentences.en: Throughout this period, France and Holland led Europe in the use of tea.
sentences.zh: 在整个这一时期，法国和荷兰在饮茶方面引领着欧洲。

sentences.en: G As the craze for all things oriental swept through Europe, tea became part of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 随着对一切东方事物的狂热席卷欧洲，茶成了日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Adding milk to the drink was first mentioned in 1680.
sentences.zh: 在饮品中加奶的做法最早见于1680年的记载。

sentences.en: Around that time, Dutch inns provided the first restaurant service of tea.
sentences.zh: 大约在那时，荷兰的客栈提供了最早的茶水餐饮服务。

sentences.en: Innkeepers would furnish guests with a portable tea set complete with a heating unit.
sentences.zh: 客栈老板会为客人备上一套便携茶具，连加热装置也一应俱全。

sentences.en: The Dutchman would then prepare tea for himself and his friends outside in the inn garden.
sentences.zh: 荷兰人随后会在客栈花园里为自己和朋友沏茶。

sentences.en: Tea remained popular in France for only about fifty years, being replaced by a preference for wine, chocolate and exotic coffees.
sentences.zh: 茶在法国只流行了约五十年，便被人们对葡萄酒、巧克力和各种异域咖啡的偏爱所取代。

sentences.en: Tea was introduced into England in 1660 by King Charles II and his Portuguese queen, who were both confirmed tea drinkers.
sentences.zh: 1660年，茶由查理二世国王及其葡萄牙王后引入英格兰，两人都是不折不扣的饮茶者。

sentences.en: Tea mania swept across England as it had earlier spread throughout France and Holland.
sentences.zh: 正如茶早先传遍法国和荷兰一样，饮茶的狂热也席卷了英格兰。

sentences.en: By 1708, tea importation had risen to thirteen times the 1699 level.
sentences.zh: 到1708年，茶叶进口量已升至1699年水平的十三倍。

sentences.en: Tea was drunk by all levels of society.
sentences.zh: 社会各阶层的人都饮茶。

sentences.en: H Russian interest in tea began as early as 1618, when the Chinese embassy in Moscow presented several chests of tea to the Emperor, Czar Alexis.
sentences.zh: 俄国对茶的兴趣早在1618年就开始了，当时中国驻莫斯科的使团向沙皇阿列克谢进献了几箱茶叶。

sentences.en: Later in the century, a trade treaty between Russia and China allowed caravans to cross back and forth freely between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 到了那个世纪的后期，俄中之间的一项贸易条约允许商队在两国之间自由往返。

sentences.en: Still, the journey was not easy.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这段旅程并不轻松。

sentences.en: The average caravan consisted of 200 to 300 camels, and the 18,000-kilometre trip took over 16 months to complete.
sentences.zh: 一支商队平均由200到300峰骆驼组成，全程18000公里的路要花16个多月才能走完。

sentences.en: Eventually, however, tea became – as it still is – one of the most popular drinks in the country.
sentences.zh: 然而，茶最终成为——并且至今仍然是——这个国家最受欢迎的饮品之一。

sentences.en: A Street soccer, as its name implies, is an informal variation of the sport, often played on the street, particularly in urban areas.
sentences.zh: 街头足球，顾名思义，是这项运动的一种非正式变体，常常在街上踢，尤其在城市地区。

sentences.en: There are many reasons for the widespread popularity of street soccer.
sentences.zh: 街头足球广受欢迎有许多原因。

sentences.en: Unlike youth soccer, its more formally organized counterpart, no large space is needed, and goal posts, corner markers, and marked lines, associated with the formal game, are typically absent, as are game officials or referees.
sentences.zh: 与它更正式组织起来的对应物青少年足球不同，它不需要大片空间，与正式比赛相关的球门柱、角旗和画好的边线通常都没有，比赛官员或裁判也没有。

sentences.en: Another attraction of street soccer is that it is played frequently and competitively, but does not necessarily require standard 11-a-side teams or fixed playing positions.
sentences.zh: 街头足球的另一个吸引力在于，它经常被踢、有竞争性，但不一定需要标准的11人对11人的球队或固定的场上位置。

sentences.en: Unlike in youth soccer, inexperienced street soccer players rarely learn from repetitive technical and tactical drills.
sentences.zh: 与青少年足球不同，没有经验的街头足球球员很少从重复的技术和战术训练中学习。

sentences.en: Instead, they learn from their poor performance in competition, unconscious of the skills they are nonetheless developing, and without older adults or coaches present.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们从自己在比赛中糟糕的表现中学习，却没意识到他们仍在发展的技能，而且没有年长的成年人或教练在场。

sentences.en: Players learn without effort through playing the game, and soon attain an almost natural feeling for the sport.
sentences.zh: 球员通过踢球毫不费力地学习，很快就对这项运动获得一种近乎天生的感觉。

sentences.en: B However, there are lots of cities in the world today where conditions are such that street soccer is no longer possible.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天世界上有很多城市，条件已使街头足球不再可能。

sentences.en: Congested traffic now dominates where games were once played.
sentences.zh: 拥堵的交通如今主导着曾经踢球的地方。

sentences.en: Parks and open fields are used as hangouts for older teenagers with other interests.
sentences.zh: 公园和开阔的场地被有别的兴趣的大龄青少年当作聚集地。

sentences.en: Add to this the requirement in many localities for official permits to use public spaces and the managed schedules that many young people have today, and spontaneous play of any kind is hard to imagine.
sentences.zh: 再加上许多地方使用公共空间需要官方许可的要求，以及今天许多年轻人被安排好的日程，任何形式的自发玩耍都难以想象。

sentences.en: C In spite of all these obstacles, which are probably solvable in most instances, there is another sociological explanation of why in many places street soccer doesn’t enjoy the same popularity it once did.
sentences.zh: 尽管有所有这些大概在多数情况下可以解决的障碍，但对于为什么在许多地方街头足球不再享有它曾经的那种人气，还有另一种社会学解释。

sentences.en: In his book How Soccer Explains the World, US writer Franklin Foer observes: But for all the talk of freedom, the 1960s parenting style had a far less relaxed side too.
sentences.zh: 美国作家Franklin Foer在他的书《How Soccer Explains the World》中观察到，但尽管把自由挂在嘴边，20世纪60年代的育儿方式也有远不那么宽松的一面。

sentences.en: Like the 1960s consumer movement which brought seat belts and airbags to cars, the (youth) soccer movement felt like it could create a set of ...
sentences.zh: 就像给汽车带来安全带和安全气囊的20世纪60年代消费者运动一样，（青少年）足球运动感觉它能创造一套……

sentences.en: regulations that would protect both the child’s body and mind from damage.
sentences.zh: 能保护孩子身心免受伤害的规章。

sentences.en: Soccer leagues like the one I played in as a child handed out ‘participation’ prizes to every player, no matter how few games his (or her) team won.
sentences.zh: 像我小时候参加的那种足球联赛，给每个球员都发“参与”奖，无论他（或她）的球队赢的比赛多么少。

sentences.en: Where most of the world accepts the practice of using your head to hit the ball as an essential element of the game, some (youth) soccer parents have worried over the potential for injury to the brain.
sentences.zh: 在世界大多数地方都接受用头顶球作为比赛一个基本要素这种做法的地方，一些（青少年）足球家长却为对大脑潜在的伤害而担忧。

sentences.en: An entire industry grew up to manufacture protective headgear.
sentences.zh: 一个完整的产业兴起，来制造护头装备。

sentences.en: Even though very little medical evidence supports this fear, some youth leagues prohibited heading the ball altogether.
sentences.zh: 尽管几乎没有医学证据支持这种担忧，一些青少年联赛仍完全禁止头球。

sentences.en: D A growing body of people don’t believe street soccer involves a legitimate educational method.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人不相信街头足球涉及一种正当的教育方法。

sentences.en: They argue that children need to be taught by experts.
sentences.zh: 他们争辩说，孩子需要由专家来教。

sentences.en: Youth soccer instruction now begins with four-year-olds, so that they will have an advantage as six- year-olds.
sentences.zh: 青少年足球教学如今从四岁的孩子开始，好让他们作为六岁的孩子能有优势。

sentences.en: This need to get ahead brings with it a fear of falling behind that only expert instruction can prevent.
sentences.zh: 这种抢先的需要带来一种落后的恐惧，而只有专家的指导才能防止落后。

sentences.en: This type of instruction leaves no room for the trial-and-error approach of street soccer.
sentences.zh: 这种教学给街头足球那种试错的方法不留余地。

sentences.en: E One of the basic ideas of street soccer is that young players are assigned a particular role by a better player and are expected to play for the good of the team.
sentences.zh: 街头足球的一个基本理念是，年轻球员被一位更好的球员指派一个特定的角色，并被期望为球队的利益而踢球。

sentences.en: Such an assignment runs counter to the idea of youth soccer that every child needs to learn every position and will benefit from doing so.
sentences.zh: 这样的指派与青少年足球的理念相悖，后者认为每个孩子都需要学会每个位置、并会从中受益。

sentences.en: In street soccer, you fill the role that you are best able to at a particular time.
sentences.zh: 在街头足球里，你在某个特定时刻担任你最有能力胜任的角色。

sentences.en: While this role assignment can change from game to game, the purpose is always the same: to get the best out of each individual at any given moment.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种角色指派可以一场比赛一变，但目的始终相同，在任何给定时刻把每个人最好的一面发挥出来。

sentences.en: F In street soccer, children have to learn patience, to wait their turn, to realize that they are not entitled to make decisions, or even be listened to simply because they show up.
sentences.zh: 在街头足球里，孩子们必须学会耐心、等待轮到自己，认识到他们没有资格仅仅因为露了面就做决定、甚至被听取意见。

sentences.en: Positions of responsibility are earned through competition within the team.
sentences.zh: 负责的位置是通过球队内部的竞争赢得的。

sentences.en: Younger players in street soccer must wait to attain those positions.
sentences.zh: 街头足球里较年轻的球员必须等待才能获得那些位置。

sentences.en: In youth soccer, however, with its overly democratic values, youngsters are guaranteed their time in the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 然而在青少年足球里，凭着它过度民主的价值观，年轻人被保证有他们出风头的时刻。

sentences.en: Whether it’s their turn to be captain, to play a central position or to take a crucial shot, youth soccer players come to believe that hard work and patience aren’t really necessary.
sentences.zh: 无论是轮到他们当队长、踢中心位置还是踢关键的一脚，青少年足球球员渐渐相信努力和耐心其实并不必要。

sentences.en: G Not only does every youth soccer player get a chance, it is assumed that each individual has played well.
sentences.zh: 不仅每个青少年足球球员都有机会，而且每个人都被假定踢得很好。

sentences.en: ‘Everyone’s a winner; no one’s a loser’ is a guiding principle of youth soccer.
sentences.zh: “人人都是赢家；没有人是输家”是青少年足球的一条指导原则。

sentences.en: This ensures each individual goes away positive about themselves.
sentences.zh: 这确保每个人离开时对自己感觉良好。

sentences.en: No one can leave a game or a practice feeling bad.
sentences.zh: 没有人能带着糟糕的感觉离开一场比赛或一次训练。

sentences.en: But, if there really are no losers, then why try at all?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果真的没有输家，那为什么还要努力？

sentences.en: Since giving less than your best receives the same reward as giving your best, why go to any extra effort?
sentences.zh: 既然付出不及全力得到的奖励和付出全力一样，为什么还要额外费力？

sentences.en: In street soccer, every game results in a winner and a loser and everyone knows who is who.
sentences.zh: 在街头足球里，每场比赛都分出一个赢家和一个输家，每个人都知道谁是谁。

sentences.en: Losing a game is a common experience and players learn early on how to handle this.
sentences.zh: 输掉一场比赛是常有的经历，球员很早就学会如何应对这一点。

sentences.en: As a result, unlike most youth soccer players, they acquire resilience.
sentences.zh: 结果，与大多数青少年足球球员不同，他们获得了复原力。

sentences.en: A further difference between these two strands of soccer is that in street soccer a formal record is not kept.
sentences.zh: 这两类足球的另一个区别是，在街头足球里不保留正式记录。

sentences.en: You can lose one day and win the next.
sentences.zh: 你可以今天输、明天赢。

sentences.en: The results are only temporary and are forgotten within minutes of the end of the match.
sentences.zh: 结果只是暂时的，比赛结束后几分钟内就被遗忘。

sentences.en: But in organized youth soccer, the position each person plays and the results are formally noted and maintained throughout a season.
sentences.zh: 但在有组织的青少年足球里，每个人踢的位置和结果都被正式记录，并在整个赛季中保留。

records.title: A closer examination of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages
records.titleZh: 对一项关于言语和非言语信息的研究的深入分析

sentences.en: (A) The findings of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages in communication by Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues at UCLA in 1967 have been quoted so frequently that they are now often regarded as a self-evident truth.
sentences.zh: 1967 年阿尔伯特·梅赫拉比安（Albert Mehrabian）及其在加州大学洛杉矶分校（UCLA）的同事所做的一项关于言语与非言语信息的沟通研究的发现，被引用得如此频繁，以至于现在常被视为不证自明的真理。

sentences.en: (B) In the first experiment, subjects were asked to listen to a recording of a female saying the word “maybe” in three tones of voice to convey liking, neutrality, and disliking.
sentences.zh: 在第一项实验中，受试者被要求听一段录音：一名女性用三种不同语气说“maybe”这个词，分别表达喜欢、中性和不喜欢。

sentences.en: The subjects were then shown photos of female faces expressing the same three emotions and were asked to guess the emotions in the recorded voice and the photos.
sentences.zh: 随后他们看到一些表现同样三种情绪的女性面部照片，被要求猜测录音中和照片里的情绪。

sentences.en: It was found that the photos received more accurate responses than the voices.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，照片得到的回答比语音更准确。

sentences.en: In the second experiment, subjects listened to nine recorded words spoken in different tones of voice.
sentences.zh: 在第二项实验中，受试者听 9 个以不同语气录下的词。

sentences.en: Three words had positive meanings (e.g.
sentences.zh: 3 个有正面含义（例如

sentences.en: honey), three were neutral (e.g.
sentences.zh: honey），3 个中性（例如

sentences.en: oh), and three were negative (e.g.
sentences.zh: oh），3 个负面（例如

sentences.en: terrible).
sentences.zh: terrible）。

sentences.en: Again, the subjects had to guess the speaker’s emotions.
sentences.zh: 受试者再次需要猜出说话者的情绪。

sentences.en: It was found that tone of voice carried more meaning than the individual words.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，语气所传达的含义比词语本身更多。

sentences.en: From these experiments the researchers concluded that 7% of our feeling towards a speaker is based on the actual words they use, 38% on their tone of voice, and 55% on their body language (e.g.
sentences.zh: 研究者由这些实验得出结论：我们对说话者的感受 7% 取决于他们实际使用的词，38% 取决于其语气，55% 取决于其肢体语言（例如

sentences.en: facial expression).
sentences.zh: 面部表情）。

sentences.en: Methodological Issues
sentences.zh: 方法论上的问题

sentences.en: (C) However, a closer look at the study reveals several limitations.
sentences.zh: 然而，对该研究的近距离审视暴露出若干局限。

sentences.en: The first is that the entire study involved only 62 subjects.
sentences.zh: 第一是整项研究只涉及 62 名受试者。

sentences.en: Of these, 25 were used to select the word for the first experiment, while the key issue – comparing verbal and non-verbal communication – was determined by only the 37 remaining subjects.
sentences.zh: 其中 25 人被用来为第一项实验挑选词语，而真正的关键问题——比较言语与非言语沟通——则只由其余 37 名受试者决定。

sentences.en: All were female undergraduates who participated as part of their introductory psychology course, and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform.
sentences.zh: 她们全是作为心理学入门课程一部分而参加的女性本科生，年龄和学历都相当一致。

sentences.en: Thus, the findings may simply be a product of the nature of the sample.
sentences.zh: 因此，研究结果可能只是这种样本性质的产物。

sentences.en: (D) Critics have also pointed out that the 7–38–55 formula is flawed since it was pieced together from two different experiments, neither of which involved all three channels (verbal, vocal, and facial).
sentences.zh: 批评者还指出，7—38—55 这一公式是有缺陷的，因为它是把两项不同实验拼凑起来的——而这两项实验都没有同时涉及全部三个通道（言语、声音和面部）。

sentences.en: In addition, in the first experiment the single word “maybe” was used throughout so it was impossible for the effects of changes in verbal input to be assessed.
sentences.zh: 此外，在第一项实验中始终只用“maybe”这一个词，因此根本无法评估言语输入变化的影响。

sentences.en: The researchers intentionally used a “neutral” word so naturally the subjects found little meaning there.
sentences.zh: 研究者有意使用一个“中性”的词，于是受试者从中自然找不到什么含义。

sentences.en: Clearly, such a methodology lacks validity.
sentences.zh: 显然，这样的方法论缺乏效度。

sentences.en: In the real world, people communicate in a particular context and speak in phrases and full-blown sentences, making extensive use of the multi-faceted vehicle of language.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，人们在特定语境中交流，使用短语和完整句子，广泛使用多维度的语言载体。

sentences.en: (E) My concern is that interpretations of this study have gained such prominence in our pedagogical literature.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是，这项研究的诠释在我们的教学文献中获得了如此显著的位置。

sentences.en: This 7–38–55 formula appears in many basic texts, used for training in public speaking, interpersonal communication, and organizational communication.
sentences.zh: 7—38—55 这一公式出现在许多基础教材里，被用于公开演讲、人际沟通和组织沟通的培训之中。

sentences.en: Lessons to consider
sentences.zh: 值得思考的教训

sentences.en: (F) Clearly, one appealing aspect of the Mehrabian study is its numerical precision.
sentences.zh: 显然，梅赫拉比安研究的一个吸引人之处在于其数字的精确性。

sentences.en: Communication is a complex phenomenon, but it seems less so when we can rely on these three magical numbers.
sentences.zh: 沟通是一种复杂现象，但当我们能依赖这三个神奇数字时，它看上去就不那么复杂了。

sentences.en: In contrast to the ambiguities of language, numbers seem to possess exactness.
sentences.zh: 与语言的含混相比，数字似乎拥有精确性。

sentences.en: And the popular appeal of the study has given the 7–38–55 formula enormous credibility.
sentences.zh: 研究的大众吸引力也让 7—38—55 这一公式获得了巨大的可信度。

sentences.en: There is a certain mystique about non-verbal communication, and the continued references to this research sustain it, encouraging people to believe in the overwhelming importance of the non-verbal message compared with the verbal one.
sentences.zh: 非言语沟通有一种神秘感，而对这项研究的持续援引在维持这种神秘感——它让人们相信非言语信息相对于言语信息具有压倒性的重要性。

sentences.en: Yet we know that even one ill-chosen word to a colleague or friend can make or break a communicative effort.
sentences.zh: 然而我们知道，对同事或朋友哪怕一个用得不好的词，都可能成就或破坏一次沟通努力。

sentences.en: Words do matter.
sentences.zh: 词语确实重要。

sentences.en: Bradley (1991), one of the few textbook writers to criticize the Mehrabian study, makes the same point when he observes, “If we could communicate 93% of information and attitudes with vocal and facial cues, it would be wasteful to spend time learning a language.”
sentences.zh: 布拉德利（Bradley，1991 年）是少数几位批评梅赫拉比安研究的教材作者之一，他也指出：“如果我们 93% 的信息和态度都能通过声音和面部线索传递，那花时间学习语言就是浪费。”

sentences.en: (G) Mehrabian himself believes his research should not be interpreted to devalue the role of language in communication, saying: “Please remember that all my findings…
sentences.zh: 梅赫拉比安本人也认为，他的研究不应被解读为贬低语言在沟通中的作用，他说：“请记住，我所有的发现……

sentences.en: dealt with communications of feelings and attitudes…
sentences.zh: 涉及的都是感受和态度的沟通……

sentences.en: it is absurd to imply or suggest that the verbal portion of all communication constitutes only 7% of the message…
sentences.zh: 暗示或建议所有沟通的言语部分只占信息的 7%，是荒谬的……

sentences.en: anytime we communicate abstract relationships (e.g., x = y – the square of z) clearly 100% of the entire communication is verbal.”
sentences.zh: 任何时候我们传达抽象关系（例如 x = y − z 的平方），整次沟通显然 100% 都是言语的。“

sentences.en: (Mehrabian, 1995)
sentences.zh: （梅赫拉比安，1995 年）

sentences.en: (H) To be fair, many textbook writers attempt to be faithful to the context of Mehrabian’s research.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，许多教材作者都试图忠实地呈现梅赫拉比安研究的语境。

sentences.en: For example, Stewart and D’Angelo (1988) write: “Mehrabian argues that when we’re uncertain about what someone’s feeling, or about how much we like him or her, we rely…
sentences.zh: 例如，斯图尔特和达安杰洛（Stewart and D’Angelo，1988 年）写道：“梅赫拉比安认为，当我们不确定别人在感受什么、或我们多喜欢对方时，我们依赖……

sentences.en: only 7% on the words that are spoken.”
sentences.zh: 只有 7% 取决于所说的词。“

sentences.en: Others try to play down the specific percentages, saying that an understanding of the general importance of non-verbal cues is more important.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则试图淡化具体百分比，认为对非言语线索整体重要性的理解更为重要。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, other textbook authors simply use the numbers without placing any limits on their meaning.
sentences.zh: 然而，仍有教材作者直接使用这些数字，而没有对其含义加以任何限制。

sentences.en: Conclusion
sentences.zh: 结论

sentences.en: (I) Since this relatively small study was first published it has achieved an influence far beyond its intended scope.
sentences.zh: 自这项相对较小的研究首次发表以来，其影响力已远远超出最初的预期范围。

sentences.en: We need to put it into its proper perspective and learn some important lessons from it regarding social science research, communication pedagogy, and the forces which have created widespread misunderstanding about communication.
sentences.zh: 我们需要把它置于恰当的视角，并从中吸取一些重要教训——关于社会科学研究、沟通教学以及那些造成对沟通广泛误解的力量。

sentences.en: (A) As an island country with a fauna dominated by birds, New Zealand was once home to an owl species which is now extinct, the laughing owl, named for its distinctive cry.
sentences.zh: 作为一个动物以鸟类为主的岛国，新西兰曾是一种如今已灭绝的猫头鹰——笑枭——的家园，因其独特的叫声而得名。

sentences.en: This bird was widespread throughout the islands when European settlers arrived in the middle of the 19th century and it remained in good numbers for some years thereafter.
sentences.zh: 19 世纪中叶欧洲人定居者到来时，这种鸟在群岛各处分布广泛，此后多年数量仍相当可观。

sentences.en: Where other native birds suffered from predation by the Polynesian rat, the laughing owl turned the tables and adapted its diet to include the rodent.
sentences.zh: 在其他本土鸟类遭受波利尼西亚鼠捕食时，笑枭却反过来把这种啮齿动物纳入了自己的食谱。

sentences.en: It was also capable of catching and killing the other New Zealand owl, the morepork, and even larger birds, such as the weka.
sentences.zh: 它也能捕获和杀死新西兰另一种猫头鹰——鹰鸮（morepork），甚至能捕获更大的鸟，比如威卡秧鸡（weka）。

sentences.en: However, the laughing owl was wiped out around the beginning of the 20th century, its demise caused by specimen collectors, habitat changes, and non-native predators including cats and stoats.
sentences.zh: 然而，笑枭在 20 世纪初前后被消灭殆尽，灭绝的原因是标本采集者、栖息地变化以及包括猫和白鼬在内的非本土捕食者。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, it is the smaller owl, the morepork, that has managed to survive until this day.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，正是那种较小的猫头鹰鹰鸮，存活至今。

sentences.en: (B) Speckled dark brown, with yellow eyes and long tails, they are around 29 centimetres long from head to tail and 175 grams in weight.
sentences.zh: 它们身着斑驳深褐色羽毛，有黄色眼睛和长长的尾巴，从头到尾长约 29 厘米，体重 175 克。

sentences.en: Moreporks have fringes on the edge of their feathers, so they can fly almost silently and not alert potential prey.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮的羽毛边缘有缨穗，因此它们几乎可以无声飞行，不会惊动潜在的猎物。

sentences.en: They have acute hearing and their large eyes are very sensitive to light.
sentences.zh: 它们听觉敏锐，大眼睛对光线非常敏感。

sentences.en: (C) Moreporks nest in tree hollows, in clumps of plants, or in cavities among rocks and roots.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮在树洞中、植物丛中或岩石与树根之间的空腔中筑巢。

sentences.en: In the wild, moreporks usually start nesting in October, although two specimens have been recorded nesting in mid-winter, possibly stimulated by an ample food supply.
sentences.zh: 在野外，鹰鸮通常在 10 月开始筑巢，尽管曾记录到两只标本在仲冬筑巢，可能是因为食物供应充足的刺激。

sentences.en: The female lays up to three white eggs, which she incubates for 20 to 30 days.
sentences.zh: 雌鸟最多产三枚白色蛋，由它孵化 20 至 30 天。

sentences.en: During this time, she rarely hunts, and the male brings food to her.
sentences.zh: 在这段时间里，它很少捕猎，由雄鸟为其送来食物。

sentences.en: (D) Once the chicks hatch, she stays mainly on the nest until the young owls are fully feathered.
sentences.zh: 一旦雏鸟孵化，雌鸟主要待在巢中，直到幼鸮羽毛长齐。

sentences.en: When hatched, chicks are covered in light grey down and have their eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 刚孵出时，雏鸟身覆浅灰色绒毛，眼睛紧闭。

sentences.en: The eyes do not open until the eighth day after hatching.
sentences.zh: 它们的眼睛直到孵化后第八天才睁开。

sentences.en: They can fly at around 35 days.
sentences.zh: 大约 35 天时它们便能飞行。

sentences.en: (E) By day, moreporks sleep in roosts.
sentences.zh: 白天，鹰鸮在歇枝上睡觉。

sentences.en: By night, they hunt a variety of animals – mainly large invertebrates including scarab and huhu beetles, moths, caterpillars and spiders.
sentences.zh: 夜里，它们捕猎各种动物——主要是大型无脊椎动物，包括金龟子和巨天牛、蛾、毛虫和蜘蛛。

sentences.en: They also take small birds and mice.
sentences.zh: 它们也会捕食小型鸟类和老鼠。

sentences.en: They can find suitable food in pine forest as well as native forest.
sentences.zh: 它们在松林和本土森林中都能找到适宜的食物。

sentences.en: A morepork uses its sharp talons to catch or stun its prey, which it then carries away in its bill.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮用尖锐的爪子捕获或击晕猎物，然后用喙叼着带走。

sentences.en: Moreporks are clever hunters, and birds such as robins, grey warblers and fantails can end up as their prey.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮是聪明的猎手，知更鸟、灰莺和扇尾鹟等鸟类都可能成为它们的猎物。

sentences.en: In the day, these small birds sometimes mob drowsy moreporks and chase them away from their roosts; they force the sleepy predators to search for a more peaceful spot.
sentences.zh: 白天，这些小鸟有时会围攻昏昏欲睡的鹰鸮，把它们从歇枝上赶走；它们迫使这些瞌睡的捕食者去寻找一个更安静的地方。

sentences.en: (F) Moreporks have proved to be ungracious hosts.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮已被证明是不太友好的“主人”。

sentences.en: Scientists trying to establish a population of plovers on Motuora Island in New Zealand’s Hauraki Gulf were mystified as to why only two birds survived out of the 75 placed there.
sentences.zh: 科学家试图在新西兰豪拉基湾的莫图奥拉岛（Motuora Island）建立一个鸻鸟种群，但对放到那里的 75 只鸟中只有两只活下来感到困惑。

sentences.en: The culprits turned out to be five pairs of moreporks that ate or chased away the new arrivals.
sentences.zh: 罪魁祸首被证实是 5 对鹰鸮——它们把这些新来者吃掉或赶走。

sentences.en: (G) Although moreporks are still considered to be relatively common, it is likely that numbers are in gradual decline due to predation and loss of habitat.
sentences.zh: 尽管鹰鸮目前仍被认为相对常见，但由于捕食和栖息地丧失，其数量很可能正在逐步减少。

sentences.en: As the female is a hole-nester, she is vulnerable to predators such as stoats and possums during the breeding season, and eggs and chicks will also be at risk from rats.
sentences.zh: 由于雌鸟在洞中筑巢，繁殖季节期间它易受白鼬和负鼠等捕食者侵害，蛋和雏鸟也面临老鼠的威胁。

sentences.en: The use of pesticides is another possible threat to the owls, though not a direct one.
sentences.zh: 农药的使用对鹰鸮也是一个可能的威胁，尽管并非直接威胁。

sentences.en: As moreporks are at the top of the food chain, they could be affected by an accumulative poison by consuming prey that has ingested poison.
sentences.zh: 由于鹰鸮处在食物链顶端，它们可能因捕食已摄入毒素的猎物而受到累积性中毒影响。

sentences.en: (H) The New Zealand Department of Conservation is taking steps to ensure the preservation of New Zealand’s only native owl.
sentences.zh: 新西兰自然保护部正在采取措施确保新西兰唯一本土猫头鹰的保育。

sentences.en: The department is involved in measuring the population of moreporks and has put transmitters on a number of birds to determine survival and mortality.
sentences.zh: 该部门参与统计鹰鸮的种群数量，并在多只鸟身上装上发射器以确定其存活和死亡情况。

sentences.en: As well as being New Zealand’s only native owl, the morepork has symbolic and spiritual importance, so in monitoring the birds it is hoped that the morepork will continue to survive and thrive.
sentences.zh: 作为新西兰唯一的本土猫头鹰，鹰鸮在象征意义和精神层面都有重要意义，因此对其加以监测希望能让鹰鸮继续生存并繁衍。

sentences.en: (I) At dusk, the melancholy sound of the morepork can be heard in forests and parks as it calls to other moreporks and claims territory.
sentences.zh: 黄昏时分，可以在森林和公园里听到鹰鸮哀婉的叫声，它在向其他鹰鸮鸣叫并宣示领地。

sentences.en: Its Māori name (ruru) echoes its two-part cry.
sentences.zh: 它的毛利名（ruru）就回响着它两段式的叫声。

sentences.en: In the tradition of the Māori people of New Zealand, the morepork, or ruru, was often seen as a careful guardian.
sentences.zh: 在新西兰毛利人的传统中，鹰鸮——或称 ruru——常常被视为细心的守护者。

sentences.en: A number of sayings referred to the bird’s alertness.
sentences.zh: 许多说法都提到这种鸟的警觉。

sentences.en: As a bird of the night, it was associated with the spirit world.
sentences.zh: 作为一种夜行性鸟类，它与灵界相联系。

sentences.en: Moreporks were believed to act as messengers to the gods in the heavens, flying along spiritual paths in the sky.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮被认为是众神的信使，沿着天空中的灵性路径飞行。

sentences.en: They were the mediums used to communicate with the gods.
sentences.zh: 它们是用来与神祇沟通的媒介。

sentences.en: The occasional high, piercing call of the morepork signified bad news, but the lower-pitched and more common “ruru” call heralded good news.
sentences.zh: 鹰鸮偶尔发出的高亢、尖锐叫声预示坏消息，而较低沉、更常见的“ruru”叫声则预告好消息。

sentences.en: (A) Fishbourne Roman Palace is in the village of Fishbourne in West Sussex, England.
sentences.zh: 菲什本罗马宫殿位于英格兰西萨塞克斯郡的菲什本村。

sentences.en: This large palace was built in the 1st century AD, around thirty years after the Roman conquest of Britain, on the site of Roman army grain stores that had been established after the invasion during the reign of the Roman Emperor Claudius in 43 AD.
sentences.zh: 这座大型宫殿建于公元1世纪，约在罗马征服不列颠三十年之后，其所在地原是罗马军队的粮仓，那是公元43年罗马皇帝克劳狄乌斯在位期间入侵之后所建。

sentences.en: The rectangular palace was built around formal gardens, the northern half of which has been reconstructed.
sentences.zh: 这座长方形的宫殿环绕规整的花园而建，花园的北半部分已得到重建。

sentences.en: There were extensive alterations in the 2nd and 3rd centuries AD, with many of the original black-and-white mosaic floors being overlaid with more sophisticated coloured ones, including a perfectly preserved mosaic of a dolphin in the north wing.
sentences.zh: 公元2世纪和3世纪曾进行过大规模改建，许多原本黑白两色的马赛克地面被更精致的彩色马赛克覆盖，其中包括北翼一幅保存完好的海豚马赛克。

sentences.en: More alterations were in progress when the palace burnt down in around 270 AD, after which it was abandoned.
sentences.zh: 公元270年左右宫殿被烧毁时，更多的改建工程正在进行，此后宫殿便被废弃。

sentences.en: (B) Local people had long believed that a Roman palace once existed in the area.
sentences.zh: 当地人长期以来一直相信，这一带曾经有过一座罗马宫殿。

sentences.en: However, it was not until 1960 that the archaeologist Barry Cunliffe of Oxford University first systematically excavated the site, after workmen had accidentally uncovered a wall while they were laying a water main.
sentences.zh: 然而，直到1960年，在工人铺设自来水总管时意外掘出一段墙体之后，牛津大学的考古学家巴里·坎利夫才首次对该遗址进行了系统的发掘。

sentences.en: The Roman villa excavated by Cunliffe’s team was so grand that it became known as Fishbourne Roman Palace, and a museum was erected to preserve some of the remains.
sentences.zh: 坎利夫团队发掘出的这座罗马别墅规模宏大，因而被称为菲什本罗马宫殿，人们还兴建了一座博物馆来保护部分遗存。

sentences.en: This is administered by the Sussex Archaeological Society.
sentences.zh: 该博物馆由萨塞克斯考古学会管理。

sentences.en: (C) In its day, the completed palace would have comprised four large wings with colonnaded fronts.
sentences.zh: 在其鼎盛时期，建成后的宫殿应由四座正面带柱廊的大型翼楼组成。

sentences.en: The north and east wings consisted of suites of private rooms built around courtyards, with a monumental entrance in the middle of the east wing.
sentences.zh: 北翼和东翼由环绕庭院而建的一套套私人房间构成，东翼中部设有一座宏伟的大门。

sentences.en: In the north-east corner there was an assembly hall.
sentences.zh: 东北角有一座集会大厅。

sentences.en: The west wing contained state rooms, a large ceremonial reception room and a gallery.
sentences.zh: 西翼设有正式厅室、一间大型礼仪接待室和一条长廊。

sentences.en: The south wing contained the owner’s private apartments.
sentences.zh: 南翼则是宫殿主人的私人居室。

sentences.en: The palace included as many as fifty mosaic floors, under-floor central heating and a bathhouse.
sentences.zh: 宫殿内多达五十处马赛克地面，并设有地下集中供暖系统和一座浴场。

sentences.en: In size, Fishbourne Palace would have been approximately equivalent to some of the great Roman palaces of Italy, and was by far the largest known Roman residence north of the European Alps, at about 500 feet (150 m) square.
sentences.zh: 就规模而言，菲什本宫殿大致相当于意大利的一些宏伟罗马宫殿，约为500英尺（150米）见方，是欧洲阿尔卑斯山以北已知规模最大的罗马宅邸。

sentences.en: A team of volunteers and professional archaeologists is involved in an ongoing archaeological excavation on the site of nearby, possibly military, buildings.
sentences.zh: 一支由志愿者和专业考古学家组成的团队，正在附近一处可能属于军事用途的建筑遗址上进行持续的考古发掘。

sentences.en: The first buildings to be erected on the site were constructed in the early part of the conquest in 43 AD.
sentences.zh: 该遗址上最早竖立的建筑，建于公元43年征服时期的早期阶段。

sentences.en: Later, two timber buildings were constructed, one with clay-and-mortar floors and plaster walls, which appears to have been a house of some comfort.
sentences.zh: 后来又建起两座木结构建筑，其中一座有黏土灰泥地面和抹灰墙壁，看来曾是一处颇为舒适的居所。

sentences.en: These buildings were demolished in the 60s AD and replaced by a substantial stone house, which included colonnades and a bath suite.
sentences.zh: 这些建筑在公元60年代被拆除，代之以一座坚固的石砌宅邸，内有柱廊和一套浴室。

sentences.en: It has been suggested that the palace itself, incorporating the previous house in its south-east corner, was constructed around 73–75 AD.
sentences.zh: 有观点认为，宫殿本身把先前那座宅邸并入了自己的东南角，约建于公元73至75年。

sentences.en: However, Dr Miles Russell of Bournemouth University re-interpreted the ground plan and the collection of objects found, and has suggested that, given the extremely close parallels with the imperial palace of Domitian in Rome, its construction may more plausibly date to after 92 AD.
sentences.zh: 然而，伯恩茅斯大学的迈尔斯·拉塞尔博士重新解读了平面布局和所发现的器物，并提出，鉴于它与罗马图密善皇宫极为相似，其建造年代更可能是在公元92年之后。

sentences.en: (D) With regard to who lived in Fishbourne Palace, there are a number of theories.
sentences.zh: 关于究竟是谁住在菲什本宫殿，存在若干种说法。

sentences.en: For example, one proposed by Professor Cunliffe is that, in its early phase, the palace was the residence of Tiberius Claudius Cogidubnus, a local chieftain who supported the Romans and who may have been installed as king of a number of territories following the first stage of the conquest.
sentences.zh: 例如，坎利夫教授提出的一种说法是，在早期阶段，宫殿曾是提比略·克劳狄乌斯·科吉杜布努斯的居所，他是一位支持罗马人的当地酋长，可能在征服的第一阶段之后被立为若干领地的国王。

sentences.en: Cogidubnus is known from a reference to his loyalty in Agricola, a work by the Roman writer Tacitus, and from an inscription commemorating a temple dedicated to the gods Neptune and Minerva found in the nearby city of Chichester.
sentences.zh: 关于科吉杜布努斯的记载，来自罗马作家塔西佗的著作《阿格里科拉传》中对他忠诚的提及，以及在附近的奇切斯特城发现的一处铭文，那处铭文是为纪念一座供奉海神尼普顿和智慧女神密涅瓦的神庙而立。

sentences.en: Another theory is that it was built for Sallustius Lucullus, a Roman governor of Britain in the late 1st century, who may have been the son of the British prince Adminius.
sentences.zh: 另一种说法认为，宫殿是为萨卢斯提乌斯·卢库勒斯所建，他是1世纪后期不列颠的罗马总督，可能是不列颠王子阿德米尼乌斯之子。

sentences.en: Two inscriptions recording the presence of Lucullus have been found in Chichester, and the redating by Miles Russell suggests that, if the palace was designed for Lucullus, then it may have been in use for only a few years, as the Roman historian Suetonius records that Lucullus was executed by the Emperor Domitian in or shortly after 93 AD.
sentences.zh: 奇切斯特已发现两处记录卢库勒斯到访的铭文，而迈尔斯·拉塞尔重新推定的年代表明，如果宫殿是为卢库勒斯设计的，那么它可能只使用了短短数年，因为罗马史学家苏埃托尼乌斯记载，卢库勒斯于公元93年或稍后被图密善皇帝处死。

sentences.en: (E) Additional theories suggest that either Verica, a British king of the Roman Empire in the years preceding the Claudian invasion, was the owner of the palace, or Tiberius Claudius Catuarus, following the recent discovery of a gold ring belonging to him.
sentences.zh: 还有一些说法认为，宫殿的主人要么是维里卡——在克劳狄乌斯入侵之前的那些年里归属罗马帝国的一位不列颠国王，要么是提比略·克劳狄乌斯·卡图阿鲁斯，后者的依据是近来发现了一枚属于他的金戒指。

sentences.en: The palace outlasted the original owner, whoever he was, and was extensively re-planned early in the 2nd century AD and subdivided into a series of smaller apartments.
sentences.zh: 无论最初的主人是谁，宫殿都比他存续得更久，并在公元2世纪初经过大规模的重新规划，被分隔成一系列较小的居室。

sentences.en: Further redevelopment was begun in the late 3rd century AD, but these alterations were incomplete when the north wing was destroyed in a fire in around 270 AD.
sentences.zh: 公元3世纪后期又开始了进一步的改建，但当北翼在公元270年左右毁于一场大火时，这些改建尚未完成。

sentences.en: The damage was too great to repair, and the palace was abandoned and later dismantled.
sentences.zh: 损毁过于严重，无法修复，宫殿因而被废弃，后来又被拆毁。

sentences.en: (F) A modern museum has been built by the Sussex Archaeological Society, incorporating most of the visible remains, including one wing of the palace.
sentences.zh: 萨塞克斯考古学会已建起一座现代博物馆，把大部分可见的遗存囊括其中，包括宫殿的一座翼楼。

sentences.en: The gardens have been replanted using authentic plants from the Roman period.
sentences.zh: 花园已用罗马时期真实的植物重新栽种。

sentences.en: A Maori fish hooks, made from wood, bone, stone and flax, are intended to have the best possible design and function.
sentences.zh: 毛利人的鱼钩由木、骨、石和亚麻制成，目的是在设计和功能上都尽可能完美。

sentences.en: The hooks are designed to target specific species with precision.
sentences.zh: 这些鱼钩被设计成能够精准地针对特定鱼种。

sentences.en: In the industry of commercial long-line fishing, there are some Maori hook designs that are making a splash.
sentences.zh: 在商业延绳钓行业中，有一些毛利人的钩具设计正引起广泛关注。

sentences.en: B When Polynesians first came to New Zealand sometime between AD 1100–1300, they didn’t have the technology necessary to melt and manipulate metal from ore.
sentences.zh: 当波利尼西亚人在公元 1100—1300 年间最早抵达新西兰时，他们还没有从矿石中熔炼并加工金属的技术。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, fish were the settlers’ main food source, so fishermen made their hooks and fishing gear out of wood, bone, stone and shells.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，鱼是这批定居者的主要食物来源，所以渔民们用木、骨、石和贝壳来制作鱼钩和渔具。

sentences.en: Other plants native to New Zealand, such as flax (harakeke), cabbage tree (ti), and astelia (kiekie), provided the necessary fibrous material to make fishing-lines and nets of greater or equal strength to the jute used by Europeans at the time.
sentences.zh: 其他新西兰本土植物，如亚麻（harakeke）、卷心菜树（ti）和星百合（kiekie），提供了制作渔线和渔网所需的纤维材料，其强度不逊于、甚至等于当时欧洲人所用的黄麻。

sentences.en: Metal is more malleable and can be shaped in various ways, whereas natural materials are limited in the forms they can take; the Maori fish hooks needed to be innovative in overcoming these limitations.
sentences.zh: 金属可塑性更强，可被加工成各种形状，而天然材料在所能呈现的形态上则受限；毛利人的鱼钩必须在克服这些限制方面富有创新。

sentences.en: C Early European explorers who settled and explored New Zealand claimed that Maori hooks, known as matau, were “odd”, “of doubtful efficacy”, “very clumsy affairs”, or “impossible looking”.
sentences.zh: 早期在新西兰定居和探险的欧洲探险者声称，毛利人那种被称为 matau 的鱼钩“古怪”“疗效可疑”“非常笨拙”或者“看起来不可能用”。

sentences.en: Archaeologists from recent times have also described the round hook as odd, with comments such as “shaped in a manner which makes it very difficult to imagine could ever be effective in catching a fish”.
sentences.zh: 近些年的考古学家也曾把那种圆形钩形容得很奇怪，给出过类似这样的评论：“形状之诡异让人很难想象它能有效地钓到鱼”。

sentences.en: William Anderson, who was aboard the Resolution during Cook’s third voyage in 1777 as the ship’s surgeon, remarked that the Maori “live chiefly by fishing, making use …
sentences.zh: 威廉·安德森（William Anderson）在 1777 年作为随船军医登上“决心号”、参加库克船长的第三次航行时，评价说毛利人“主要靠打鱼为生……

sentences.en: of wooden fish hooks pointed with bone, but so oddly made that a stranger is at a loss to know how they can answer such a purpose.”
sentences.zh: 使用尖端嵌有骨头的木质鱼钩，但做工实在奇特，外人很难想象这样的钩怎能起到那样的作用”。

sentences.en: D The Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa conducted a study on Maori fish hooks 230 years later and demonstrated that the unique hook design was a matter of function.
sentences.zh: 新西兰的蒂帕帕国家博物馆（Te Papa Tongarewa）在 230 年后对毛利人的鱼钩做了一项研究，结果表明这种独特的钩形设计是出于功能上的考虑。

sentences.en: The hook’s design allowed it to catch fish by spinning away from the direction of the point and catching their jaws, instead of poking a hole through the fish or being used as a lever, as some archaeologists had suggested.
sentences.zh: 这种钩的设计让它能通过远离钩尖方向旋转、勾住鱼的下颌来钓到鱼，而不是像一些考古学家所设想的那样在鱼身上戳穿一个洞或被用作杠杆。

sentences.en: It appears that the design of the Maori fish hook is perhaps the world’s most efficiently and masterfully designed, likely superior to any modern metal fish hook today.
sentences.zh: 看来毛利人的鱼钩或许是世界上设计最为高效、最为精妙的鱼钩之一，可能优于今天任何一种现代金属鱼钩。

sentences.en: E To make larger hooks, Maori used shanks made of strong wood, with stout points made of bone or shell.
sentences.zh: 要制作更大的鱼钩，毛利人会使用以坚硬木材做的钩柄，搭配以骨头或贝壳做成的结实钩尖。

sentences.en: They tied tree branches and saplings together to grow them into ideal shapes for building, then harvested the plants when they reached the appropriate size.
sentences.zh: 他们把树枝和小树苗绑在一起让其长成理想的形状以备制作之用，等植物长到合适的尺寸再砍下。

sentences.en: They hardened wood by carefully drying it and burying it underground with fires lit above.
sentences.zh: 他们通过小心地把木材风干，再埋入地下、在上方点火来对木材进行硬化处理。

sentences.en: Human bone was often used for bone points, which were securely lashed to a groove at the end of the shank using pre-made flax materials (muka).
sentences.zh: 骨制钩尖常用人骨制作，并用事先备好的亚麻线（muka）牢牢绑在钩柄末端的凹槽上。

sentences.en: When they wanted to catch larger species like sharks, groper and ling, they used composite hooks.
sentences.zh: 当他们想捕捉鲨鱼、石斑鱼和长鳕等更大的鱼种时，会使用复合钩。

sentences.en: However, on average, the traditional hook was usually no longer than a three-finger breadth (128 mm in length).
sentences.zh: 不过，传统鱼钩的长度通常平均不超过三指宽（长 128 毫米）。

sentences.en: F To capture seabirds for food and feathers, like albatross, the islanders used slender hooks that can be differentiated from other hooks intended for fish by their lighter build and lack of an in-turned point.
sentences.zh: 为了捕捉信天翁等海鸟以获取食物和羽毛，岛民们使用细长的钩，这种钩可以通过较轻的结构和没有内弯钩尖与用来捕鱼的钩区分开来。

sentences.en: Many of these hooks were collected by early explorers, suggesting that seabird catching with hook and line was an important source of food and feathers for the Maori (105 mm in length).
sentences.zh: 早期探险者收集了许多这类钩，表明用钩和线捕捉海鸟对毛利人来说是食物和羽毛的重要来源（长 105 毫米）。

sentences.en: Slender hooks with wide gaps were used to capture albatross and other seabirds and can be distinguished from fish hooks by their lighter construction and absence of an in-turned point.
sentences.zh: 钩口大、用以捕捉信天翁和其他海鸟的细长钩，可凭其更轻的构造和缺乏内弯钩尖与捕鱼用的钩区分开来。

sentences.en: Early explorers collected many of these hooks, which could indicate that catching seabirds provided significant amounts of food and feathers for the Maori.
sentences.zh: 早期探险者收集了许多此类钩，这或许表明捕捉海鸟为毛利人提供了大量的食物和羽毛。

sentences.en: G The Maori quickly adopted new materials once they became available through European explorers, sealers and whalers who began arriving towards the end of the 1700s.
sentences.zh: 1700 年代末，随着欧洲探险者、海豹猎人和捕鲸者陆续抵达，毛利人迅速采用了那些此时才能获得的新材料。

sentences.en: At this point, the Maori were still making their fish hooks but were now using metals and imported materials.
sentences.zh: 此时，毛利人仍在制作自己的鱼钩，但开始使用金属和进口材料。

sentences.en: Wooden and flax components of old, abandoned fish hooks decomposed quickly as traditional hooks were discarded in favour of new ones.
sentences.zh: 随着旧鱼钩被弃用，其木质和亚麻部分迅速腐烂——传统鱼钩被新式鱼钩所取代。

sentences.en: Tools made of luxury materials such as ivory or greenstone may have been kept as decorative items, with stylised Maori fish hooks today serving as a symbol of cultural revitalisation.
sentences.zh: 用象牙或绿玉等贵重材料制成的工具可能被作为装饰品保留下来，今天具有风格化设计的毛利鱼钩，正作为文化复兴的象征。

sentences.en: H The Maori continued to recreate traditional designs even as new materials became available, preferring hook shapes introduced by Pakeha in the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 即便有了新材料可供使用，毛利人仍继续再现传统设计，更青睐 1800 年代由 Pakeha（毛利语中对非毛利人的称呼）引入的钩形。

sentences.en: By maintaining the tradition of the rotating hook design, they remained connected to an essential part of their cultural heritage.
sentences.zh: 通过保持旋转钩形的传统设计，他们与本民族文化遗产中至关重要的一部分保持着联系。

sentences.en: In the end, however, mass-produced European metal hooks eventually dominated, making it difficult to continue crafting hooks from nails, horseshoes and other metal objects.
sentences.zh: 然而，最终欧洲的批量生产金属钩占据了主导，让人们很难再用钉子、马蹄铁和其他金属物件继续打造鱼钩。

sentences.en: Eventually, traditional designs fell out of favour.
sentences.zh: 最终，传统设计逐渐失宠。

sentences.en: I By the late 19th and early 20th centuries, tourist and collector demand for Maori artefacts had grown, leading manufacturers to produce large quantities of forged hooks.
sentences.zh: 到 19 世纪末与 20 世纪初，游客和收藏者对毛利人手工艺品的需求增加，促使制造商大量生产仿造的鱼钩。

sentences.en: These replicas were then traded with both Maori and Europeans as forgeries of the real thing, sometimes directly commissioned by artefact dealers.
sentences.zh: 这些仿制品随后被作为真品的伪造品卖给毛利人和欧洲人，有时候是直接由古物商委托制作。

sentences.en: Fake hooks can be identified by their cheap construction, inconsistent materials, rudimentary lashings, odd or overly elaborate decorative carvings, and the absence of in-turned points or angled grooves used to attach the fishing-line properly.
sentences.zh: 伪造的鱼钩可以通过其廉价的做工、不一致的材料、粗糙的捆扎、奇怪或过于繁复的装饰雕刻，以及缺乏内弯钩尖或用以正确系牢渔线的斜向凹槽来加以识别。

sentences.en: J The evolution of matau throughout history symbolises how the Maori have adapted to European tools, materials and technology over time.
sentences.zh: matau 在历史进程中的演变象征着毛利人如何随时间适应欧洲的工具、材料和技术。

sentences.en: It also reflects how European influence contributed to, rather than completely replaced, traditional Maori skills, as native materials were replaced or complemented by metals and, more recently, artificial materials.
sentences.zh: 它也反映出欧洲影响在何种程度上是补充而非完全取代了传统的毛利技艺——本土材料逐渐被金属，乃至更近期的人工材料所替代或补充。

sentences.en: Today, commercial long-line fishermen around the world have begun using the circle-hook design—one that is nearly identical in appearance and function to the traditional matau.
sentences.zh: 今天，世界各地的商业延绳钓渔民已经开始使用圆形钩设计——其外观和功能几乎与传统的 matau 相同。

sentences.en: It appears that the advantages and improved catch-rates of this Maori technology have once again been recognised.
sentences.zh: 看起来，这项毛利技艺的优势和更高的捕获率再一次得到了认可。

sentences.en: (A) The plants that produce rubber are spread right across the globe, and grow in many different habitats.
sentences.zh: 能产出橡胶的植物遍布全球，生长在许多不同的生境之中。

sentences.en: One might think it likely, therefore, that humankind has known about rubber for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们也许会以为，人类认识橡胶很可能已有数千年之久。

sentences.en: Yet, unlike other crops of economic importance, rubber led a relatively anonymous life until the last 150 years or so.
sentences.zh: 然而，与其他具有经济价值的作物不同，橡胶在大约最近150年之前一直默默无闻。

sentences.en: The Indians of South America appear to be the first people to have understood the properties of rubber, and the Aztecs of what is now Mexico were the first to be recorded using the substance; a wall painting dating back to the sixth century depicts a scene of a tribute offering of crude rubber.
sentences.zh: 南美洲的印第安人似乎是最早了解橡胶特性的民族，而今墨西哥一带的阿兹特克人则是最早被记录使用这种物质的人；一幅可追溯到六世纪的壁画，描绘了进贡粗制橡胶的场景。

sentences.en: With the arrival of Columbus in the Americas and the resulting Spanish influx, further evidence starts to appear concerning the Native American use of rubber.
sentences.zh: 随着哥伦布抵达美洲以及随之而来的西班牙人涌入，关于美洲原住民使用橡胶的更多证据开始出现。

sentences.en: Antonio de Herrera y Tordesillas describes a ritual game played with a rubber ball at the court of the Aztec Emperor Montezuma II, and the Mayan and Toltec people are known to have taken part in similar activities.
sentences.zh: 安东尼奥·德·埃雷拉·伊·托尔德西利亚斯描述了在阿兹特克皇帝蒙特祖玛二世的宫廷中用橡胶球进行的一种仪式性球赛，而玛雅人和托尔特克人也已知曾参与过类似的活动。

sentences.en: Rubber was also used to make raincoats, shoes, jars, torches and musical instruments, all of which must have been made from the indigenous Castilla elastica, as the Para rubber plant now favoured for rubber cultivation does not grow in the Mexican region.
sentences.zh: 橡胶还被用来制作雨衣、鞋子、罐子、火把和乐器，这些东西一定都是用当地的弹性卡斯蒂亚橡胶树制成的，因为如今橡胶种植所青睐的巴拉橡胶树并不生长在墨西哥地区。

sentences.en: (B) The first description of latex (liquid rubber) extraction was made by Juan de Torquemada, who noted that if a receptacle was not at hand the Native Americans would place the latex on their bodies to allow it to solidify.
sentences.zh: 对乳胶（液态橡胶）提取的最早描述出自胡安·德·托尔克马达之手，他指出，若手边没有容器，美洲原住民便会把乳胶涂在身上，让它凝固。

sentences.en: However, no real interest in rubber was shown by any European until Charles de la Condamine, a French mathematician, published an account of his journey to South America in 1735.
sentences.zh: 然而，直到法国数学家夏尔·德·拉孔达明于1735年发表了他南美之行的记述，才有欧洲人真正对橡胶产生兴趣。

sentences.en: The journey was undertaken on behalf of the Paris Academy of Sciences to measure an arc of the meridian line on the equator, but the journey home was to turn out to be more significant than the true purpose of the trip.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行是代表巴黎科学院进行的，目的是测量赤道上一段子午线的弧长，但归途最终被证明比此行的真正目的更具意义。

sentences.en: Condamine explored Brazil and Peru and discovered how the local people used one single piece of coagulated latex to make boots.
sentences.zh: 孔达明考察了巴西和秘鲁，发现了当地人如何用一整块凝固的乳胶来制作靴子。

sentences.en: The boots were impervious to water and, when smoked, looked like real leather.
sentences.zh: 这种靴子不透水，经过烟熏之后，看上去就像真皮一样。

sentences.en: In 1747 the first description of the rubber tree and latex tapping was made by a military engineer and amateur botanist, François Fresneau, who was posted to French Guiana.
sentences.zh: 1747年，对橡胶树及乳胶采割的最早描述出自一位被派驻法属圭亚那的军事工程师兼业余植物学家弗朗索瓦·弗雷诺之手。

sentences.en: The publications of Condamine and Fresneau created considerable excitement among French scientists, and an attempt was made to discover a solvent that could turn the crude rubber into a substance for commercial exploitation.
sentences.zh: 孔达明和弗雷诺的著作在法国科学家中引起了相当大的轰动，人们开始尝试寻找一种溶剂，能把粗制橡胶变成可供商业开发的物质。

sentences.en: (C) In 1818 a British medical student named James Syme first used rubber to make waterproof cloth.
sentences.zh: 1818年，一位名叫詹姆斯·赛姆的英国医学生首次用橡胶制作了防水布。

sentences.en: Another early use of the substance was as an eraser of pencil marks, hence the name ‘rubber’.
sentences.zh: 这种物质另一项早期用途是擦去铅笔痕迹，“rubber”（橡皮）一名便由此而来。

sentences.en: This was complemented by balloons, rubber bands, braces, boots for the army and other ideas that met with varying degrees of success.
sentences.zh: 与之相辅相成的还有气球、橡皮筋、背带、军用靴等其他创意，它们取得的成功程度各不相同。

sentences.en: In 1820 Thomas Hancock, an English manufacturer of rubber goods such as driving belts, industrial rollers and rubber hoses, invented a machine he called the ‘masticator’, which chewed up waste strips for re-use.
sentences.zh: 1820年，托马斯·汉考克——一位生产传动带、工业辊轮和橡胶软管等橡胶制品的英国厂商——发明了一台他称之为“咀嚼机”的机器，它能把废橡胶条嚼碎以供再用。

sentences.en: It was discovered that the masticated rubber was more malleable, while maintaining much of its elasticity.
sentences.zh: 人们发现，经过咀嚼的橡胶可塑性更强，同时又保留了大部分弹性。

sentences.en: In Scotland at the same time, Charles Mackintosh had discovered a way of using rubber as waterproofing material, by a process he patented in 1823.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在苏格兰，查尔斯·麦金托什发现了一种把橡胶用作防水材料的方法，并于1823年为这一工艺申请了专利。

sentences.en: Hancock and Mackintosh joined forces in 1834, and three years later Hancock invented a machine for spreading rubber onto material.
sentences.zh: 汉考克和麦金托什于1834年携手合作，三年后汉考克发明了一台能把橡胶涂布到织物上的机器。

sentences.en: (D) Despite their beneficial qualities, such as waterproofing, rubber goods were still not particularly popular as they had some major flaws, including the fact that they dissolved malodorously.
sentences.zh: 尽管橡胶制品具有防水之类的优点，它们却仍不怎么受欢迎，因为它们存在一些重大缺陷，包括会发出难闻的气味并溶解掉。

sentences.en: They also became pliant when warm and rigid when cold.
sentences.zh: 它们还会遇热变软、遇冷变硬。

sentences.en: Then in 1839 the American Charles Goodyear discovered that it was possible to stabilise rubber by mixing it with sulphur while exposing it to heat — a process he called vulcanisation — and the full versatility of this extraordinary substance became apparent.
sentences.zh: 后来在1839年，美国人查尔斯·固特异发现，把橡胶与硫磺混合并加热，便能使橡胶变得稳定——他把这一工艺称为硫化——这种非凡物质的全部多用途性自此显现出来。

sentences.en: (E) Rubber goods could now be manufactured which had all the beneficial qualities of the material, such as durability, elasticity and variability, but which were not sticky, soluble or governed by the vagaries of the weather.
sentences.zh: 如今所能制造的橡胶制品，既具备这种材料的一切优点，如耐用、有弹性、可变性强，又不再发黏、可溶，也不再受天气变幻的左右。

sentences.en: The economic potential of rubber was now clearly evident.
sentences.zh: 橡胶的经济潜力此时已昭然若揭。

sentences.en: It played an important role in the Industrial Revolution, being employed in the steam engines found in factories, mills, mines and railways.
sentences.zh: 它在工业革命中发挥了重要作用，被用于工厂、磨坊、矿场和铁路中的蒸汽机上。

sentences.en: It made a triumphant entrance as a new and innovative material at the Great Exhibition of 1851, where shoes, airbeds, furniture and clothing made out of newly improved rubber were proudly displayed.
sentences.zh: 在1851年的万国工业博览会上，它作为一种崭新而富有创意的材料隆重登场，用新近改良的橡胶制成的鞋子、充气床垫、家具和衣物在会上被骄傲地展示。

sentences.en: (F) One of the most important rubber inventions was made in 1888, when an Irishman called John Boyd Dunlop produced the first pneumatic tyre.
sentences.zh: 最重要的橡胶发明之一诞生于1888年，当时一位名叫约翰·博伊德·邓禄普的爱尔兰人制造出了第一条充气轮胎。

sentences.en: Solid rubber tyres had been used for the previous 18 years, but Dunlop’s new design, which he updated in 1890, immediately became popular.
sentences.zh: 在此之前的18年里，人们一直使用实心橡胶轮胎，但邓禄普的新设计——他于1890年加以改进——立刻大受欢迎。

sentences.en: In 1895 Dunlop’s tyres were first used in motor cars, and with the mass production of cars just over the horizon the rubber industry had never looked healthier.
sentences.zh: 1895年，邓禄普的轮胎首次用于汽车，而随着汽车量产即将到来，橡胶业的前景从未如此光明。

sentences.en: The import levels of rubber over the nineteenth century bear witness to its irrepressible rise.
sentences.zh: 整个十九世纪橡胶进口量的变化，见证了它势不可挡的崛起。

sentences.en: In 1830 Britain had imported just 211 kg of crude rubber.
sentences.zh: 1830年，英国仅进口了211千克粗制橡胶。

sentences.en: This had risen to 10,000 kg in 1857, and by 1874 levels were just under six times as much again.
sentences.zh: 到1857年，这一数字已升至10000千克，而到1874年，进口量又增加到接近此前的六倍。

sentences.en: (A) The Australian town of Mossman in the state of Queensland sits in a tropical landscape between the rainforest and the Great Barrier Reef.
sentences.zh: 位于澳大利亚昆士兰州的莫斯曼镇（Mossman）坐落在热带景观之中，介于雨林与大堡礁之间。

sentences.en: Eco-tourism is important there; more than 80 per cent of Douglas Shire, of which Mossman is the administrative centre, is protected by World Heritage listing.
sentences.zh: 在那里，生态旅游业很重要——道格拉斯郡（莫斯曼是其行政中心）超过 80% 的地区受到世界遗产名录的保护。

sentences.en: But for most of the town’s history, forest and reef have been largely irrelevant: since the sugar mill was built in 1894, the town has relied on sugarcane.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这座城镇的大部分历史上，森林和珊瑚礁与它关系不大：自 1894 年糖厂建成以来，全镇就一直依靠甘蔗。

sentences.en: Now Mossman is holding its breath.
sentences.zh: 现在莫斯曼屏息以待。

sentences.en: For two years the mill used by all the farms has been close to bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 两年来，所有种植户都依赖的这座糖厂已濒临破产。

sentences.en: It is at the centre of the economic shocks that have shaken Australia’s sugar industry, and for lifetime farmers and a long list of cane-industry workers a way of life will disappear if the mill closes.
sentences.zh: 它处于撼动澳大利亚糖业的经济冲击的中心；对于一辈子的农民和长长一串甘蔗业工人而言，如果糖厂关闭，一种生活方式将会消失。

sentences.en: Mossman has roughly 160 growers, who now produce less than one million tonnes of the nation’s annual cane harvest of 30–40 million tonnes.
sentences.zh: 莫斯曼大约有 160 名种植户，他们如今的产量不到一百万吨，而全国每年甘蔗收成是 3000 万至 4000 万吨。

sentences.en: But it is a microcosm of the industry.
sentences.zh: 但它是整个行业的缩影。

sentences.en: All across Australia, the cane-growing business is being squeezed between the pincers of economics and the environment.
sentences.zh: 在整个澳大利亚，甘蔗种植业正在经济与环境两面夹击之下被挤压。

sentences.en: (B) The ten-year average return to sugar growers throughout the 1990s was about $350 a tonne.
sentences.zh: 在整个 1990 年代，蔗糖种植户的十年平均收益约为每吨 350 美元。

sentences.en: In early 2004, sugar prices plummeted, resulting in a 25-year-low average price for Australian sugar of about $232 a tonne.
sentences.zh: 2004 年初，糖价暴跌，澳大利亚糖的平均价格跌至 25 年低点——约每吨 232 美元。

sentences.en: Although figures vary widely across farms and regions, that was about what it cost to grow a tonne of sugar in Australia.
sentences.zh: 虽然各地农场之间数据差异很大，但这大致就是在澳大利亚种植一吨蔗糖的成本。

sentences.en: To forestall social and economic disaster, the Government offered more than $400 million to encourage growers to leave the industry.
sentences.zh: 为了阻止社会与经济灾难，政府提供了超过 4 亿美元，鼓励种植户退出该行业。

sentences.en: By the end of the year, 21 farmers had taken up the offer to leave, but another 1 000 are thought to be seriously considering it, allowing those remaining to buy the vacated land and improve their economies of scale.
sentences.zh: 到年底，已有 21 名农户接受退出方案；但据信另有 1000 名正认真考虑此项方案，这将让剩下的人能买下空出的土地，扩大规模以改善经济。

sentences.en: (C) Fourth-generation Mossman grower Bill Phillips-Turner is one who plans to fight on.
sentences.zh: 莫斯曼第四代蔗农比尔·菲利普斯-特纳（Bill Phillips-Turner）是打算坚持下去的人之一。

sentences.en: ‘The consequences of losing the mill would be catastrophic,’ Bill says.
sentences.zh: “失去糖厂将带来灾难性后果，”比尔说。

sentences.en: ‘Sugar has a big economic multiplier effect: for every dollar generated from sugar, an additional $7 is generated in the wider community.
sentences.zh: “蔗糖具有很大的经济乘数效应：每从蔗糖中产生 1 美元，就会在更广泛的社区中产生另外 7 美元。

sentences.en: Because of limited options around here, most people now employed by the industry would have to leave the area to find work.’
sentences.zh: 由于本地选择有限，多数目前就业于该行业的人将不得不离开本地另寻工作。“

sentences.en: The farmer shareholders have so far saved the mill by accepting substantial cuts to cane payments, but this has come at a big cost to everyone.
sentences.zh: 作为农户股东，他们迄今为止靠接受甘蔗收购款大幅缩水才把糖厂救下来，但这给所有人都带来了巨大代价。

sentences.en: As chairman of the board of the mill, Bill has presided over some tough and unpopular decisions; the hardest was slashing the mill workforce.
sentences.zh: 作为糖厂董事会主席，比尔不得不主持一些艰难且不受欢迎的决定；其中最艰难的是大幅削减糖厂员工。

sentences.en: Assets were sold and maintenance costs cut.
sentences.zh: 资产被变卖，维护成本被压缩。

sentences.en: The board has also worked hard to find new ways of doing business.
sentences.zh: 董事会也努力寻找新的经营方式。

sentences.en: Ethanol production, where sugar is used to produce fuel, has potential, and co-generation, using cane waste to generate electric power, is another possibility.
sentences.zh: 用蔗糖生产燃料的乙醇生产具有潜力，用蔗渣发电的余热发电（co-generation）则是另一种可能性。

sentences.en: However, the most radical—but preferred—alternative is to create a future for the mill as a food factory, turning out quality sugar-based foods.
sentences.zh: 然而，最激进——但也最被看好的——选项是把糖厂的未来定位为食品工厂，生产高品质的以蔗糖为基础的食品。

sentences.en: (D) In addition to the economic struggle, there is the environmental one.
sentences.zh: 除经济上的挣扎之外，还有环境上的挣扎。

sentences.en: The sugar industry has the reputation of being environmentally damaging, but it has some surprising supporters.
sentences.zh: 甘蔗行业有破坏环境的名声，但它也有一些出人意料的支持者。

sentences.en: Douglas Shire mayor, Mike Berwick, is a well-known environmentalist and might be expected to be anti-cane.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯郡郡长迈克·伯威克（Mike Berwick）是一位知名的环保人士，按说应当反对种甘蔗。

sentences.en: ‘There’s no question of the past damage it’s done to the reef through chemical and nutrient run-off*,’ he says.
sentences.zh: “毫无疑问，过去它通过化学物质和养分径流对珊瑚礁造成了破坏，”他说。

sentences.en: ‘But there’s a formula for sustainable cane production and Mossman has nearly reached it.’
sentences.zh: “但有一套可持续蔗糖生产的公式，而莫斯曼已经接近做到了。”

sentences.en: Another surprise endorsement for cane comes from the Queensland Environmental Protection Agency’s sugar liaison officer, Karen Benn.
sentences.zh: 对甘蔗的另一项出人意料的认可，来自昆士兰环境保护署蔗糖联络官凯伦·本（Karen Benn）。

sentences.en: ‘I’m less worried about the effect of cane on the environment than I am about other agriculture,’ she says.
sentences.zh: “我对甘蔗对环境的影响所担心的程度，反而比对其他农业要轻，”她说。

sentences.en: ‘There are good growers everywhere, but at Mossman they seem to have taken up the challenges faster.’
sentences.zh: “到处都有好种植户，但在莫斯曼他们似乎更快地迎接了挑战。”

sentences.en: For example, sediment run-off, previously one of the main environmental problems caused by cane growing, is now nothing like it once was, according to Dr Brian Roberts, co-ordinator of the Douglas Shire Water Quality Improvement Program.
sentences.zh: 例如，曾是甘蔗种植主要环境问题之一的泥沙径流，根据道格拉斯郡水质改善项目协调人布莱恩·罗伯茨博士（Dr Brian Roberts）的说法，如今已远非昔日可比。

sentences.en: ‘North Queensland used to hold the record for soil loss,’ he says.
sentences.zh: “北昆士兰曾经保持着土壤流失的纪录，”他说。

sentences.en: ‘Now …
sentences.zh: “现在……

sentences.en: cane country is accumulating soil.’
sentences.zh: 种甘蔗的地方反而在累积土壤。“

sentences.en: (E) However, these improvements have been achieved at a great cost to growers.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些改善是以种植户的巨大代价换来的。

sentences.en: Now in his 60s, Tom Watters has spent a lifetime on the same farm.
sentences.zh: 如今 60 多岁的汤姆·瓦特斯（Tom Watters）已经在同一个农场度过了大半生。

sentences.en: Fourteen years ago, he was alerted to the effect his cane could be having on Mackay Creek, the narrow waterway that receives all his run-off, and so Tom planted a 5 000-tree buffer along the edge of the creek, built up the edges of the creek with rocks to prevent erosion, and began exploring farming methods that cause minimal soil disturbance.
sentences.zh: 14 年前，他被告知自家的甘蔗田可能影响到麦凯溪（Mackay Creek）——那条接纳他所有径流的狭长水道，于是汤姆沿溪边种下了 5000 棵树作为缓冲带，用石头加固溪边以防侵蚀，并开始探索对土壤扰动最小的耕作方法。

sentences.en: However, none of these costly initiatives has helped him get better cane prices.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些代价昂贵的举措都没能让他获得更好的甘蔗收购价。

sentences.en: Another cane grower, Doug Crees, comments that ‘Economically, it [cane growing] doesn’t make much sense.
sentences.zh: 另一位蔗农道格·克里斯（Doug Crees）评论说：“从经济上看，种甘蔗这件事意义不大。

sentences.en: But there’s more to life than money.’
sentences.zh: 但生活不只是钱。“

sentences.en: It’s this addiction to the way of life that keeps many cane farmers growing an underperforming crop.
sentences.zh: 正是这种对生活方式的执着，让许多蔗农坚持种植一种收益不佳的作物。

sentences.en: ‘It’s a good lifestyle,’ Doug says.
sentences.zh: “这是一种好生活方式，”道格说。

sentences.en: ‘I spend eight months working on the farm and four months looking after our kids while my wife works in town.
sentences.zh: “我一年八个月在农场干活，四个月照顾孩子，妻子则在镇上工作。

sentences.en: I’ve been looking at alternative crops, like forestry and cocoa, and it turns out that working away from the farm is the best diversification we could do.
sentences.zh: 我也考察过林业、可可等替代作物，结果发现，离开农场去外面工作才是我们能做的最好的多元化选择。

sentences.en: However, I still don’t want to do that.’
sentences.zh: 然而，我仍然不愿意那么做。“

sentences.en: (F) It is difficult to see how anyone can deal satisfactorily with the passing of a way of life.
sentences.zh: 很难看出谁能令人满意地应对一种生活方式的消逝。

sentences.en: Cane farmers have been part of eastern Queensland for more than a century, but despite the efforts they have put into fighting the good environmental fight, there is no guarantee that the new way of life evolving there will include cane.
sentences.zh: 蔗农作为东昆士兰的一部分已经超过一个世纪，但尽管他们为打这场环保的好仗付出了努力，新兴的生活方式中是否还包括甘蔗，谁也无法保证。

sentences.en: (A) In 1956 the Premier of New South Wales, Australia, announced an international competition for the design of an opera house for Sydney.
sentences.zh: 1956年，澳大利亚新南威尔士州的州长宣布为悉尼举办一场国际竞赛，征集一座歌剧院的设计方案。

sentences.en: It attracted more than 200 entries from around the world and was won by Jørn Utzon, a relatively little-known architect from Denmark.
sentences.zh: 竞赛吸引了来自世界各地的200多份参赛作品，最终由来自丹麦、当时还相对默默无闻的建筑师约恩·乌松胜出。

sentences.en: The story goes that during the judging of the competition, one judge, American architect Eero Saarinen, arrived in Sydney after the other three judges had started assessing the entries.
sentences.zh: 据说，在竞赛评审期间，一位评委——美国建筑师埃罗·沙里宁——在另外三位评委已开始评审参赛作品之后才抵达悉尼。

sentences.en: He looked through their rejected entries and stopped at the Utzon design, declaring it to be outstanding.
sentences.zh: 他翻看了他们淘汰掉的作品，在乌松的设计前停了下来，宣称它出类拔萃。

sentences.en: (B) It was Utzon’s life and travels that had shaped his design for the Sydney Opera House.
sentences.zh: 正是乌松的人生经历与游历，塑造了他为悉尼歌剧院所做的设计。

sentences.en: Though he had never visited the site, he used his maritime background to study naval charts of Sydney Harbour.
sentences.zh: 尽管他从未到过那处场地，他却运用自己的航海背景研究了悉尼港的海图。

sentences.en: His early exposure to shipbuilding provided the inspiration for the design of the roof, which is a series of curved ‘shells’ that look like the sails of a sailing ship billowing in the wind.
sentences.zh: 他早年接触造船业，为屋顶的设计提供了灵感，那屋顶是一系列弯曲的“壳”，看上去就像一艘帆船在风中鼓胀的船帆。

sentences.en: From his travels to Mexico, he had the idea of placing his building on a wide horizontal platform.
sentences.zh: 从他游历墨西哥的经历中，他萌生了把建筑安放在一个宽阔水平平台上的想法。

sentences.en: (C) Construction of the platform began in 1959, and throughout the early 1960s Utzon amended his original designs in order to develop a way to build the large ‘shells’ that cover the two main halls.
sentences.zh: 平台的建造于1959年开始，在整个1960年代初，乌松不断修改自己最初的设计，以摸索出建造覆盖两个主厅的那些大“壳”的方法。

sentences.en: The construction of the roof brought together some of the world’s best engineers and craftsmen, devising innovative techniques to create a major visual impact in accordance with Utzon’s vision.
sentences.zh: 屋顶的建造汇集了世界上一些最优秀的工程师和工匠，他们设计出种种创新的技术，按照乌松的构想营造出强烈的视觉冲击。

sentences.en: The design was one of the first examples of the use of computer-aided design for complex shapes.
sentences.zh: 这一设计是把计算机辅助设计用于复杂形体的最早范例之一。

sentences.en: (D) Although Utzon had spectacular plans for the interior, he was unable to realise them.
sentences.zh: 尽管乌松对内部有着惊艳的设想，他却未能将其实现。

sentences.en: Cost overruns contributed to criticism of the project and, after a change of government, the Minister of Works began questioning Utzon’s schedules and cost estimates.
sentences.zh: 成本超支招致了对该项目的批评，而在政府换届之后，工务部长开始质疑乌松的进度安排和成本估算。

sentences.en: Payments to Utzon were stopped and he was forced to withdraw as chief architect in 1966.
sentences.zh: 对乌松的付款被叫停，他被迫于1966年辞去总建筑师之职。

sentences.en: Following his resignation, there were protests through the streets led by prominent architect Harry Seidler and others, demanding that Utzon be reinstated as architect.
sentences.zh: 在他辞职之后，街头爆发了由著名建筑师哈里·赛德勒等人带头的抗议，要求恢复乌松的建筑师职位。

sentences.en: However, Utzon was not reinstated and left Australia in 1966.
sentences.zh: 然而，乌松并未被复职，并于1966年离开了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: He never returned, and new architects were appointed to complete the building in his absence.
sentences.zh: 他再也没有回来，新的建筑师被任命在他缺席的情况下完成这座建筑。

sentences.en: The original cost estimate for the Opera House was $7 million, with the completion date set for 26 January 1963.
sentences.zh: 歌剧院最初的成本估算为700万美元，竣工日期定在1963年1月26日。

sentences.en: However, the Opera House was not formally completed until 1973, having cost $102 million.
sentences.zh: 然而，歌剧院直到1973年才正式竣工，耗资达1.02亿美元。

sentences.en: (E) Since its opening in 1973, Sydney Opera House has earned a reputation as a world-class performing-arts centre and become a symbol of both Sydney and Australia.
sentences.zh: 自1973年落成以来，悉尼歌剧院赢得了世界一流表演艺术中心的美誉，并成为悉尼和澳大利亚的象征。

sentences.en: Situated at Bennelong Point on Sydney Harbour, it consists of a series of large precast ‘shells’ made of concrete, each composed of sections of a sphere of 75.2 metres radius, forming the roofs of the structure, set on a monumental platform.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在悉尼港的便利朗角，由一系列用混凝土预制的大“壳”组成，每个“壳”都由半径75.2米的球面的若干部分构成，形成这座建筑的屋顶，安放在一座纪念碑般的平台之上。

sentences.en: The building is 183 metres long and 120 metres wide at its widest point.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑长183米，最宽处宽120米。

sentences.en: It is supported on 588 concrete piers, which are sunk approximately 25 metres below sea level.
sentences.zh: 它由588根混凝土桩支撑，这些桩沉入海平面以下约25米处。

sentences.en: (F) Although the roof structures are commonly referred to as ‘shells’, they are precast concrete panels supported by concrete ribs.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些屋顶结构通常被称为“壳”，它们其实是由混凝土肋支撑的预制混凝土板。

sentences.en: The ‘shells’ are covered with 1,056,006 white and cream-coloured tiles manufactured in a factory in Sweden that generally produced stoneware tiles for the paper-mill industry.
sentences.zh: 这些“壳”覆盖着1056006块白色和奶油色的瓷砖，它们产自瑞典一家通常为造纸业生产炻瓷砖的工厂。

sentences.en: The design solution and construction of the shell structure took eight years to complete, and the development of the special ceramic tiles took over three years.
sentences.zh: 壳体结构的设计方案与建造花了八年才完成，而那种特制陶瓷砖的研发则用了三年多。

sentences.en: Apart from the tiles covering the ‘shells’, the building’s exterior is mostly clad with granite quarried in Australia.
sentences.zh: 除了覆盖在“壳”上的瓷砖之外，这座建筑的外立面大多包覆着采自澳大利亚的花岗岩。

sentences.en: (G) Contrary to its name, Sydney Opera House includes multiple performance venues.
sentences.zh: 与它的名称相反，悉尼歌剧院包含多个演出场所。

sentences.en: It is among the busiest performing-arts centres in the world, holding over 1,500 performances each year.
sentences.zh: 它是世界上最繁忙的表演艺术中心之一，每年举办1500多场演出。

sentences.en: It hosts a large number of performing-arts companies, including the four resident companies: Opera Australia, the Australian Ballet, the Sydney Theatre Company and the Sydney Symphony Orchestra.
sentences.zh: 它接待大量表演艺术团体，包括四个驻场团体：澳大利亚歌剧团、澳大利亚芭蕾舞团、悉尼戏剧公司和悉尼交响乐团。

sentences.en: (H) With its grand setting and cathedral-like atmosphere, the Concert Hall is Sydney Opera House’s most prestigious performance space.
sentences.zh: 凭借其宏伟的环境和教堂般的氛围，音乐厅是悉尼歌剧院最负盛名的演出空间。

sentences.en: The largest of all interior venues, it delivers outstanding acoustics thanks to its high ceiling and wood panelling.
sentences.zh: 作为所有室内场所中最大的一个，它凭借高耸的天花板和木质镶板，呈现出卓越的声学效果。

sentences.en: There is a sizeable outdoor forecourt from which people ascend to the main entrance.
sentences.zh: 外面有一片相当大的露天前庭，人们从这里拾级而上，走向主入口。

sentences.en: The steps, which lead up from the forecourt to the main performance venues, are nearly 100 metres wide.
sentences.zh: 从前庭通向各主要演出场所的台阶，宽近100米。

sentences.en: (I) In 1999 Utzon was re-engaged to develop a set of design principles to act as a guide for future changes to the building.
sentences.zh: 1999年，乌松被重新聘请，制定一套设计原则，作为该建筑日后改动的指南。

sentences.en: All of this design work he did from his base in Europe.
sentences.zh: 所有这些设计工作，他都是在自己位于欧洲的基地完成的。

sentences.en: These principles help to ensure that the building’s architectural integrity is maintained.
sentences.zh: 这些原则有助于确保该建筑的建筑完整性得到维护。

sentences.en: The first alteration to the exterior was the addition of a new colonnade, which shades nine large glass openings in the previously solid exterior wall.
sentences.zh: 对外立面的第一处改动，是增建了一道新的柱廊，为先前那面实心外墙上的九个大玻璃开口遮阳。

sentences.en: This Utzon-led project, completed in 2006, enabled theatre patrons to see the harbour for the first time from the theatre foyers.
sentences.zh: 这个由乌松主导、于2006年完成的项目，使观众第一次得以从剧院门厅望见海港。

sentences.en: The design also incorporates the first public lift and interior escalators to assist less-mobile patrons.
sentences.zh: 该设计还首次引入了供公众使用的电梯和室内自动扶梯，以帮助行动不便的观众。

sentences.en: (J) Since 2007, the cultural, heritage and architectural importance of Sydney Opera House has been protected by its inclusion on the World Heritage List.
sentences.zh: 自2007年起，悉尼歌剧院在文化、遗产和建筑方面的重要性，因被列入《世界遗产名录》而受到保护。
