sentences.en: A  A rare textile made from the silk of more than a million wild spiders has been on display at the American Museum of Natural History in New York City.
sentences.zh: 一件用一百多万只野生蜘蛛的丝制成的稀有纺织品，一直在纽约市的美国自然历史博物馆展出。

sentences.en: To produce this golden cloth, 70 people spent four years collecting golden-orb spiders from telephone poles in Madagascar, while another dozen workers carefully extracted about 80 feet of silk filament from each of the arachnids.
sentences.zh: 为生产这块金色布料，70个人花了四年时间在马达加斯加从电线杆上采集金球蛛，另有十几名工人小心地从每只蛛中抽取约80英尺的丝纤维。

sentences.en: The resulting 11-foot-by-4-foot textile is the only large piece of cloth made from natural spider silk in the world today.
sentences.zh: 最终制成的这块11英尺乘4英尺的纺织品，是当今世界上唯一一块用天然蜘蛛丝制成的大块布料。

sentences.en: B  Spider silk is very elastic and strong compared with steel or Kevlar, said textile expert Simon Peers, who co-led the project.
sentences.zh: 与钢或凯夫拉相比，蜘蛛丝非常有弹性且结实，共同领导这个项目的纺织专家Simon Peers说。

sentences.en: Kevlar is a lightweight synthetic fabric, chemically related to nylon, that is used in bullet-proof vests.
sentences.zh: 凯夫拉是一种轻质合成织物，在化学上与尼龙相关，用于防弹背心。

sentences.en: Kevlar is resistant to wear, tear and heat and has virtually no melting point.
sentences.zh: 凯夫拉耐磨、抗撕裂、耐热，而且几乎没有熔点。

sentences.en: But the tensile strength of spider silk is even greater than Kevlar’s aramid filaments and higher than that of high-grade steel.
sentences.zh: 但蜘蛛丝的抗拉强度甚至大于凯夫拉的芳纶纤维，也高于优质钢。

sentences.en: Most importantly, spider silk is extremely lightweight: a strand long enough to circle the Earth would weigh less than 500 grams (18 oz).
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，蜘蛛丝极其轻：一根长到足以环绕地球的丝重量不到500克（18盎司）。

sentences.en: It is also especially ductile, able to stretch up to 140 percent of its length without breaking and to retain its strength below –40 °C, giving it toughness equal to that of leading commercial fibres.
sentences.zh: 它还特别有延展性，能拉伸到自身长度的140%而不断裂，并能在零下40摄氏度以下保持强度，使它的韧性与领先的商用纤维相当。

sentences.en: C  Researchers have long been intrigued by the unique properties of spider silk.
sentences.zh: 研究人员长期以来一直对蜘蛛丝的独特性质着迷。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, spider silk is extremely hard to mass-produce.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，蜘蛛丝极难大规模生产。

sentences.en: Unlike silkworms—easy to raise in captivity—spiders have a habit of biting off each other’s heads when housed together.
sentences.zh: 与易于圈养的蚕不同，蜘蛛被关在一起时有咬掉彼此脑袋的习性。

sentences.en: According to Peers, there is intensive research worldwide aimed at replicating spider-silk tensile properties for use in medicine and industry, but no-one has yet reproduced all the qualities of natural silk.
sentences.zh: 据Peers说，全世界都有密集的研究，旨在复制蜘蛛丝的抗拉特性以用于医学和工业，但还没有人复制出天然丝的全部品质。

sentences.en: D  Peers conceived the idea of weaving spider silk after reading about French missionary Jacob Paul Camboué, who worked with spiders in Madagascar during the 1880s and 1890s.
sentences.zh: Peers在读到关于法国传教士Jacob Paul Camboué的事迹后，构思出了编织蜘蛛丝的想法，Camboué在19世纪80和90年代在马达加斯加和蜘蛛打交道。

sentences.en: Camboué built a small hand-driven machine to extract silk from up to 24 spiders at once, without harming them: the spiders were briefly restrained, their silk collected, then released.
sentences.zh: Camboué造了一台小型手摇机器，一次最多从24只蜘蛛身上抽丝而不伤害它们，蜘蛛被短暂固定、采下它们的丝，然后放掉。

sentences.en: Peers built a replica of this 24-spider “silking” machine, said co-leader Nicholas Godley.
sentences.zh: Peers造了一台这种24蜘蛛“抽丝”机的复制品，共同领导者Nicholas Godley说。

sentences.en: As a test the pair collected about 20 spiders.
sentences.zh: 作为测试，两人采集了约20只蜘蛛。

sentences.en: “When we stuck them in the machine and started turning it, lo and behold, this beautiful gold-coloured silk started coming out,” Godley recalled.
sentences.zh: “当我们把它们放进机器、开始转动它时，瞧，这种美丽的金色丝开始出来了，”Godley回忆道。

sentences.en: E  To make a textile of any significant size, the scale had to increase dramatically.
sentences.zh: 要做一块有相当尺寸的纺织品，规模就得大幅增加。

sentences.en: Fourteen thousand spiders yield about an ounce of silk, Godley said, and the finished textile weighs about 2.6 pounds.
sentences.zh: 一万四千只蜘蛛产出约一盎司丝，Godley说，而成品纺织品重约2.6磅。

sentences.en: By the end, handlers had worked with more than one million female golden-orb spiders—abundant in Madagascar and famed for their golden thread.
sentences.zh: 到最后，处理者和超过一百万只雌性金球蛛打过交道——这种蜘蛛在马达加斯加很多，以其金色的丝线闻名。

sentences.en: Because the spiders produce silk only in the rainy season, all were collected between October and June.
sentences.zh: 由于蜘蛛只在雨季产丝，所有蜘蛛都在十月到六月间采集。

sentences.en: An additional 12 workers used hand-powered machines to extract the silk and twist it into 96-filament yarn.
sentences.zh: 另有12名工人用手摇机器抽丝，并把它捻成96股的纱线。

sentences.en: After “silking”, the spiders were released; within a week they regenerate their silk, allowing the same individuals to be used again—“the gift that never stops giving,” said Godley.
sentences.zh: “抽丝”之后，蜘蛛被放掉；一周内它们就再生出丝，使同一批个体能再次被使用——“永不停止馈赠的礼物，”Godley说。

sentences.en: F  Spending four years to produce a single piece of cloth is hardly practical for scientists or companies hoping to exploit spider silk in biomedicine or as a Kevlar alternative.
sentences.zh: 花四年时间生产一块布，对希望在生物医学领域或作为凯夫拉替代品利用蜘蛛丝的科学家或公司来说几乎不切实际。

sentences.en: Several groups have inserted spider genes into bacteria and even goats to make silk, but results have been only partly successful.
sentences.zh: 有几个团队把蜘蛛基因插入细菌甚至山羊体内来制造丝，但结果只是部分成功。

sentences.en: One reason is that spider silk begins as a liquid protein produced in a special gland in the abdomen.
sentences.zh: 一个原因是，蜘蛛丝起初是腹部一个特殊腺体产生的液态蛋白。

sentences.en: Using the spinneret, the spider applies force that rearranges the protein’s molecular structure, transforming it into solid fibre.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛利用纺器施加力，重新排列蛋白的分子结构，把它转化为固体纤维。

sentences.en: “When we talk about a spider spinning silk, we’re talking about how it applies forces to convert liquid to solid,” explained spider-silk expert Todd Blackledge of the University of Akron, who was not involved in the project.
sentences.zh: “当我们说蜘蛛吐丝时，我们说的是它如何施力把液体转化为固体，”未参与该项目的阿克伦大学蜘蛛丝专家Todd Blackledge解释道。

sentences.en: “Every year we get closer to mass production, but we’re not there yet.”
sentences.zh: “每年我们都更接近大规模生产，但我们还没到那一步。”

sentences.en: For now, we must be content with one extraordinarily beautiful cloth—courtesy of more than a million spiders.
sentences.zh: 眼下，我们只能满足于一块格外美丽的布——这要归功于一百多万只蜘蛛。

sentences.en: A  Birds are highly mobile and among the swiftest of living creatures.
sentences.zh: 鸟类机动性很强，是现存生物中最敏捷的一类。

sentences.en: Flight gives them the power to move in any direction for as long as they have the energy to keep going.
sentences.zh: 飞行赋予它们一种能力：只要还有能量继续飞，它们就能朝任何方向移动。

sentences.en: They are equipped with lightweight, hollow bones, a finely-tuned navigation system and an ingenious heat-conserving design that allows them to face life in the harshest of climates.
sentences.zh: 它们生有轻巧的空心骨骼、一套精密调校的导航系统，以及一种巧妙的保温构造，使它们能够在最严酷的气候中求生。

sentences.en: Their respiratory systems have to perform efficiently during sustained flights at altitude, so they have evolved a system of extracting air from their lungs that far exceeds that of any other animal.
sentences.zh: 它们的呼吸系统必须在高空持续飞行时高效运作，因此它们进化出了一套从肺部摄取空气的系统，其效率远超任何其他动物。

sentences.en: These features enable birds to come and go with the seasons.
sentences.zh: 这些特征使鸟类得以随季节往来迁徙。

sentences.en: On the way, they face constant danger and a daily requirement to find food, water and a safe place to rest.
sentences.zh: 途中，它们面临着无时不在的危险，以及每天都要寻找食物、水和安全栖息地的需求。

sentences.en: So why do millions of birds migrate rather than stay in one place?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么数以百万计的鸟要迁徙，而不是待在一个地方呢？

sentences.en: B  Most of the explanation revolves around food.
sentences.zh: 大部分解释都围绕着食物。

sentences.en: In temperate and arctic regions of the northern hemisphere, food is abundant during a short growing season.
sentences.zh: 在北半球的温带和北极地区，食物在短暂的生长季里十分充足。

sentences.en: Migration evolved as a way for birds to exploit resources that are seasonally abundant and, equally important, to go elsewhere when the resources become scarce or harsh weather arrives.
sentences.zh: 迁徙作为一种方式进化出来，让鸟类得以利用季节性丰富的资源，而同样重要的是，能在资源变得稀缺或恶劣天气来临时转往别处。

sentences.en: Many species can tolerate cold temperatures if food is plentiful but when food is not available they must migrate.
sentences.zh: 如果食物充足，许多物种能够忍受寒冷的气温，但当食物无处可寻时，它们就必须迁徙。

sentences.en: C  While this simple explanation for why birds migrate is essentially true, intriguing questions remain.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个关于鸟为何迁徙的简单解释大体上是对的，但仍有耐人寻味的问题。

sentences.en: One puzzling fact is that many birds journey much further than would be necessary to find food and good weather.
sentences.zh: 一个令人困惑的事实是，许多鸟飞的路程远比觅食和寻找好天气所需的要长得多。

sentences.en: Another apparent conundrum involves the huge migrations performed by arctic birds and mudflat-probing shore birds that breed close to polar regions.
sentences.zh: 另一个表面上的难题，涉及北极鸟类以及那些在极地附近繁殖、在泥滩上探食的滨鸟所进行的大规模迁徙。

sentences.en: In general, the further north a migrant species breeds, the further south it spends the winter.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，一个候鸟物种繁殖地越靠北，它过冬的地方就越靠南。

sentences.en: Yet, en route to a final destination in southern latitudes, all these individuals overfly areas of seemingly suitable habitat spanning two hemispheres.
sentences.zh: 然而，在飞往南方纬度地区最终目的地的途中，所有这些个体都会飞越跨及两个半球的、看似适宜的栖息地。

sentences.en: Such compulsive journeys probably evolved over time and in response to fluctuations in weather but we do not really know.
sentences.zh: 这种身不由己的旅程很可能是随时间、为应对天气波动而进化出来的，但我们并不真正了解。

sentences.en: D  But just how do birds reach their destination and, more to the point, how do young birds migrate over vast distances without parental assistance?
sentences.zh: 可是，鸟类究竟是如何抵达目的地的，而更关键的是，幼鸟在没有父母帮助的情况下又是如何长途迁徙的呢？

sentences.en: Very few adults migrate accompanied by their offspring and youngsters may have little or no inkling of their parents' appearance.
sentences.zh: 极少有成鸟在迁徙时由后代相伴，而幼鸟对父母的模样也许只有一点、甚至毫无印象。

sentences.en: Cuckoos are famous for depositing their eggs in the nests of other birds that unwittingly serve as foster-parents.
sentences.zh: 杜鹃以把蛋下在其他鸟的巢里、让它们在不知情中充当养父母而闻名。

sentences.en: Astonishing as this piece of evolutionary behaviour is, it is even more remarkable to consider that, once grown, the young cuckoo makes its own way to ancestral wintering grounds in the tropics before returning single-handedly to northern Europe to seek out a mate among its own kind.
sentences.zh: 这种进化行为已属惊人，而更令人称奇的是：一旦长大，幼杜鹃便会独自前往热带祖辈的越冬地，然后又孤身一鸟返回北欧，在自己的同类中寻找配偶。

sentences.en: E  As we continue to study bird migration, its mystery is better understood but also compounded.
sentences.zh: 随着我们对鸟类迁徙的研究不断深入，它的奥秘既被更好地理解，也变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Mounting evidence has confirmed that birds use the sun and stars to obtain compass directions but true navigation requires an awareness of position and time, especially when lost.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的证据已经证实，鸟类利用太阳和星辰来获取罗盘方向，但真正的导航需要对位置和时间有所觉知，尤其是在迷失方向时。

sentences.en: Experiments have shown that, after being taken thousands of miles over an unfamiliar landmass, birds are still capable of returning rapidly to nest sites.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，鸟类在被带到数千英里之外一片陌生的大陆之后，仍然能够迅速返回巢址。

sentences.en: Such phenomenal powers are the product of computing a number of sophisticated cues including an innate map of the night sky and the pull of the Earth's magnetic field.
sentences.zh: 这种非凡的本领，是综合运算一系列复杂线索的结果，其中包括对夜空的一幅天生的地图，以及地球磁场的牵引。

sentences.en: How the birds use their 'instruments' remains unknown, but one thing is clear – they see the world with a sensory perception superior to ours.
sentences.zh: 鸟类究竟如何使用它们的“仪器”仍是未知数，但有一点是清楚的——它们以一种优于我们的感官知觉来观察世界。

sentences.en: Most small birds migrate at night and take their direction from the position of the setting sun.
sentences.zh: 大多数小型鸟类在夜间迁徙，并从落日的位置来确定自己的方向。

sentences.en: However, as well as seeing the sun go down, they also seem to see the plane of polarised light it causes.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了看到太阳落下之外，它们似乎还能看到太阳所造成的偏振光平面。

sentences.en: This calibrates their compass.
sentences.zh: 这校准了它们的罗盘。

sentences.en: Travelling at night provides other benefits: the danger of meeting predators as well as the risk of dehydration due to flying for long periods in warm sunlit skies is reduced.
sentences.zh: 在夜间飞行还有其他好处：遇到捕食者的危险，以及在温暖、阳光普照的天空中长时间飞行而脱水的风险，都减小了。

sentences.en: Furthermore, at night the air structure is cool and smooth and conducive to sustained, stable flight.
sentences.zh: 此外，夜间的空气结构清凉而平稳，有利于持续而稳定的飞行。

sentences.en: F  Nevertheless, all journeys involve considerable risk and part of the skill in arriving safely is setting off at the right time.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，一切旅程都伴随着相当大的风险，而平安抵达的本领之一，就是在恰当的时刻启程。

sentences.en: This means accurate weather forecasting and utilising favourable winds.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要准确地预测天气并利用顺风。

sentences.en: Birds are adept at both and, in tests, some can detect the minute difference in barometric pressure between the floor and ceiling of a room.
sentences.zh: 鸟类对这两者都很在行，在测试中，有些鸟能察觉一个房间地板与天花板之间气压上极其微小的差别。

sentences.en: Often birds react to weather changes before there is any visible sign of them.
sentences.zh: 鸟类常常在天气变化出现任何可见迹象之前就做出反应。

sentences.en: Certain species that feed on grassland flee at the onset of a cold snap because when the ground surface freezes the birds could starve.
sentences.zh: 某些以草原为食的物种，会在寒潮来临之初就逃离，因为地表一旦封冻，这些鸟就可能挨饿。

sentences.en: Yet they return ahead of a thaw, their arrival linked to a pressure change presaging an improvement in the weather.
sentences.zh: 然而它们会赶在解冻之前返回，它们的到来与一种预示天气好转的气压变化相关联。

sentences.en: G  Unfortunately, some never complete their journey.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，有些鸟永远无法完成它们的旅程。

sentences.en: Not so long ago the assumption was that a bird in the air on a dark windy night with no visible reference points to judge position was, like a pilot without radar, hopelessly lost.
sentences.zh: 不久之前，人们还以为，一只在漆黑有风的夜里飞行、没有可见参照物来判断位置的鸟，就像没有雷达的飞行员一样，会无可救药地迷失方向。

sentences.en: We now know this is not the case.
sentences.zh: 如今我们知道事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Losses do occur, but mainly because birds get swept off course by strong air masses against which battle is futile, and this results in a watery grave.
sentences.zh: 损失确实会发生，但主要是因为鸟被强劲的气团卷离航线，与之抗争是徒劳的，其结果便是葬身水中。

sentences.en: Indeed, it is not unusual for ocean fish to be caught with bird remains in their stomachs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，海里的鱼被捕获时，胃里有鸟的残骸，这种情况并不罕见。

sentences.en: But sometimes there's a silver lining.
sentences.zh: 但有时也会有一线转机。

sentences.en: Each autumn a small number of North American birds are blown across the Atlantic by fast-moving westerly tail winds.
sentences.zh: 每年秋天，都有少数北美鸟类被快速移动的西风顺风吹越大西洋。

sentences.en: Not only do they arrive safely in Europe but, based on tracking evidence, some make it back to North America in the following spring – probably after spending the winter with European migrants in sunny African climes.
sentences.zh: 它们不仅平安抵达欧洲，而且根据追踪证据，有些还在第二年春天成功返回了北美——很可能是在阳光明媚的非洲气候中与欧洲候鸟一同越冬之后。

29.stemZh: 根据文章，以下哪两项关于候鸟的说法是正确的？

sentences.en: A An excellent definition was developed in the 1980s by Norwegian Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland and used by the World Business Council for Sustainable Development: “Meeting the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.”
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代，挪威首相Gro Harlem Brundtland提出了一个出色的定义，并被世界可持续发展工商理事会采用，“在不损害后代满足其自身需求的能力的前提下满足当代的需求。”

sentences.en: Nowadays, governments and companies need to account for the social consequences of their actions.
sentences.zh: 如今，政府和公司需要为其行为的社会后果负责。

sentences.en: As a result, corporate social responsibility (CSR) has become a priority for business leaders around the world.
sentences.zh: 因此，企业社会责任（CSR）已成为全世界商业领袖的优先事项。

sentences.en: When a well-run business applies its vast resources and expertise to social problems that it understands and in which it has a stake, it can have a greater impact than any other organisation.
sentences.zh: 当一家经营良好的企业把它庞大的资源和专长用于它了解、又与之利害相关的社会问题时，它能产生比任何其他组织都更大的影响。

sentences.en: The notion of licence to operate derives from the fact that every company needs tacit or explicit permission from governments, communities, and numerous other stakeholders to justify CSR initiatives to improve a company’s image, strengthen its brand, enliven morale and even raise the value of its stock.
sentences.zh: “经营许可”这个概念源于这样一个事实，每家公司都需要政府、社区以及众多其他利益相关方的默许或明确许可，来为提升公司形象、强化品牌、振奋士气、甚至提高股票价值的企业社会责任举措提供正当理由。

sentences.en: B To advance CSR, we must root it in a broad understanding of the interrelationship between a corporation and society.
sentences.zh: 要推进企业社会责任，我们必须把它扎根于对企业与社会之间相互关系的广泛理解之上。

sentences.en: Successful corporations need a healthy society.
sentences.zh: 成功的企业需要一个健康的社会。

sentences.en: Education, health care, and equal opportunity are essential to a productive workforce.
sentences.zh: 教育、医疗和平等机会对一支高生产力的劳动力队伍至关重要。

sentences.en: Safe products and working conditions not only attract customers but lower the internal costs of accidents.
sentences.zh: 安全的产品和工作条件不仅吸引顾客，还降低事故的内部成本。

sentences.en: Efficient utilisation of land, water, energy, and other natural resources makes business more productive.
sentences.zh: 高效利用土地、水、能源和其他自然资源会让企业更有生产力。

sentences.en: Good government, the rule of law, and property rights are essential for efficiency and innovation.
sentences.zh: 良好的治理、法治和产权对效率和创新至关重要。

sentences.en: Strong regulatory standards protect both consumers and competitive companies from exploitation.
sentences.zh: 强有力的监管标准保护消费者和有竞争力的公司免受盘剥。

sentences.en: Ultimately, a healthy society creates expanding demand for business, as more human needs are met and aspirations grow.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，随着更多人类需求得到满足、抱负不断增长，一个健康的社会会为企业创造不断扩大的需求。

sentences.en: Any business that pursues its ends at the expense of the society in which it operates will find its success to be illusory and ultimately temporary.
sentences.zh: 任何以牺牲其所处社会为代价来追求自身目的的企业，都会发现它的成功是虚幻的、最终是短暂的。

sentences.en: At the same time, a healthy society needs successful companies.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一个健康的社会需要成功的公司。

sentences.en: No social programme can rival the business sector when it comes to creating the jobs, wealth, and innovation that improve standards of living and social conditions over time.
sentences.zh: 在创造能随时间改善生活水平和社会状况的就业、财富和创新方面，没有任何社会项目能与商业部门相匹敌。

sentences.en: C A company’s impact on society also changes over time, as social standards evolve and science progresses.
sentences.zh: 一家公司对社会的影响也会随时间变化，因为社会标准在演变、科学在进步。

sentences.en: Asbestos, now understood as a serious health risk, was thought to be safe in the early 1900s, given the scientific knowledge then available.
sentences.zh: 石棉，如今被认识到是一种严重的健康风险，在20世纪初以当时可获得的科学知识来看曾被认为是安全的。

sentences.en: Evidence of its risks gradually mounted for more than 50 years before any company was held liable for the harms it can cause.
sentences.zh: 在任何公司因它可能造成的危害被追究责任之前，它的风险证据已逐渐积累了50多年。

sentences.en: Many firms that failed to anticipate the consequences of this evolving body of research have been bankrupted by the results.
sentences.zh: 许多没能预见到这一不断演进的研究成果之后果的公司，被这些后果搞破产了。

sentences.en: No longer can companies be content to monitor only the obvious social impacts of today.
sentences.zh: 公司不能再满足于只监测今天显而易见的社会影响。

sentences.en: Without a careful process for identifying evolving social effects of tomorrow, firms may risk their very survival.
sentences.zh: 若没有一套细致的流程来识别明天不断演变的社会影响，公司可能危及自身的存亡。

sentences.en: D No business can solve all of society’s problems or bear the cost of doing so.
sentences.zh: 没有任何企业能解决社会的所有问题，或承担这么做的成本。

sentences.en: Instead, each company must select issues that intersect with its particular business.
sentences.zh: 相反，每家公司必须选择与其特定业务相交的议题。

sentences.en: Other social agendas are best left to those companies in other industries, NGOs, or government institutions that are better positioned to address them.
sentences.zh: 其他社会议程最好留给其他行业那些更有条件应对它们的公司、非政府组织或政府机构。

sentences.en: The essential test that should guide CSR is not whether a cause is worthy but whether it presents an opportunity to create shared value – that is, a meaningful benefit for society that is also valuable to the business.
sentences.zh: 应该指导企业社会责任的根本检验，不是某项事业是否有价值，而是它是否提供了创造共享价值的机会——也就是一种既对社会有意义、又对企业有价值的益处。

sentences.en: Each company can identify the particular set of societal problems that it is best equipped to help resolve and from which it can gain the greatest competitive benefit.
sentences.zh: 每家公司都能识别出它最有能力帮助解决、又能从中获得最大竞争利益的那一组特定社会问题。

sentences.en: E The best corporate citizenship initiatives involve far more than writing a cheque: they specify clear, measurable goals and track results over time.
sentences.zh: 最好的企业公民举措远不止开一张支票，它们设定清晰、可衡量的目标，并长期跟踪结果。

sentences.en: A good example is General Electric’s programme to adopt underperforming public high schools near several of its major U.S. facilities.
sentences.zh: 一个很好的例子是通用电气资助其美国几个主要厂区附近表现不佳的公立高中的项目。

sentences.en: The company contributes between $250,000 and $1 million over a five-year period to each school and makes in-kind donations as well.
sentences.zh: 公司在五年内向每所学校捐助25万到100万美元，还进行实物捐赠。

sentences.en: GE managers and employees take an active role by working with school administrators to assess needs and mentor or tutor students.
sentences.zh: 通用电气的管理者和员工积极参与，与校方管理人员合作评估需求，并指导或辅导学生。

sentences.en: In an independent study of ten schools in the programme between 1989 and 1999, nearly all showed significant improvement, while the graduation rate in four of the five worst-performing schools doubled from an average of 30 % to 60 %.
sentences.zh: 在1989到1999年间对该项目中十所学校的一项独立研究中，几乎所有学校都有显著改善，而表现最差的五所学校中有四所的毕业率从平均30%翻倍到了60%。

sentences.en: Effective corporate citizenship initiatives such as this one create goodwill and improve relations with local governments and other important constituencies.
sentences.zh: 像这样有效的企业公民举措会赢得好感，并改善与地方政府及其他重要群体的关系。

sentences.en: What’s more, GE’s employees feel great pride in their participation.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，通用电气的员工对自己的参与深感自豪。

sentences.en: Their effect is inherently limited, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的作用本质上是有限的。

sentences.en: No matter how beneficial the programme is, it remains incidental to the company’s business, and the direct effect on GE’s recruiting and retention is modest.
sentences.zh: 无论这个项目多么有益，它对公司业务来说仍是附带的，对通用电气招聘和留住人才的直接作用也不大。

sentences.en: F Microsoft’s Working Connections partnership with the American Association of Community Colleges (AACC) is a good example of a shared-value opportunity arising from investments in context.
sentences.zh: 微软与美国社区学院协会（AACC）的Working Connections合作，是从对外部环境的投资中产生共享价值机会的一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: The shortage of information-technology workers is a significant constraint on Microsoft’s growth; currently, there are more than 450,000 unfilled IT positions in the United States alone.
sentences.zh: 信息技术人才的短缺是微软增长的一大制约；目前，仅美国就有超过45万个IT岗位空缺。

sentences.en: Community colleges, with an enrolment of 11.6 million students, representing 45 % of all U.S. undergraduates, could be a major solution.
sentences.zh: 社区学院，招生人数达1160万，占全美本科生的45%，可能是一个重要的解决方案。

sentences.en: Microsoft recognises, however, that community colleges face special challenges: IT curricula are not standardised, technology used in classrooms is often outdated, and there are no systematic professional development programmes to keep faculty up to date.
sentences.zh: 然而，微软认识到社区学院面临特殊的挑战，IT课程不标准化、课堂上使用的技术往往过时，而且没有系统的专业发展项目让教职员工跟上最新进展。

sentences.en: Microsoft’s $50 million five-year initiative was aimed at all three problems.
sentences.zh: 微软这项5000万美元的五年计划针对的是所有这三个问题。

sentences.en: In addition to contributing money and products, Microsoft sent employee volunteers to colleges to assess needs, contribute to curriculum development, and create faculty-development institutes.
sentences.zh: 除了捐钱和捐产品，微软还派员工志愿者去学院评估需求、参与课程开发，并创办教师发展研修班。

sentences.en: Microsoft has achieved results that have benefited many communities while having a direct and potentially significant impact on the company.
sentences.zh: 微软取得的成果让许多社区受益，同时对公司本身有着直接且可能重大的影响。

sentences.en: G At the heart of any strategy is a unique value proposition: a set of needs a company can meet for its chosen customers that its competitors cannot.
sentences.zh: 任何战略的核心都是一个独特的价值主张，即一家公司能为其选定的客户满足、而竞争对手无法满足的一组需求。

sentences.en: The most strategic CSR occurs when a company adds a social dimension to its value proposition, making social impact integral to the overall strategy.
sentences.zh: 最具战略性的企业社会责任，发生在一家公司为其价值主张增添社会维度、使社会影响成为整体战略不可分割的一部分时。

sentences.en: Consider Whole Foods Market, whose value proposition is to sell organic, natural, and healthy food products to customers who are passionate about food and the environment.
sentences.zh: 以Whole Foods Market为例，它的价值主张是向热衷于食物和环境的顾客出售有机、天然、健康的食品。

sentences.en: The company’s sourcing emphasises purchases from local farmers through each store’s procurement process.
sentences.zh: 公司的采购强调通过每家门店的采购流程从当地农户购买。

sentences.en: Buyers screen out foods containing any of nearly 100 common ingredients that the company considers unhealthy or environmentally damaging.
sentences.zh: 采购员会筛除含有公司认为不健康或有损环境的近100种常见成分中任何一种的食品。

sentences.en: The same standards apply to products made internally.
sentences.zh: 同样的标准适用于内部生产的产品。

sentences.en: Whole Foods’ commitment to natural and environmentally friendly operating practices extends well beyond sourcing.
sentences.zh: Whole Foods对天然、环保运营做法的承诺远远超出采购。

sentences.en: Stores are constructed using a minimum of virgin raw materials.
sentences.zh: 门店的建造尽量少用原生原材料。

sentences.en: Recently, the company purchased renewable wind-energy credits equal to 100 % of its electricity use in all of its stores and facilities, the only Fortune 500 company to offset its electricity consumption entirely.
sentences.zh: 最近，公司购买了相当于其所有门店和设施100%用电量的可再生风能额度，是唯一一家完全抵消其用电量的财富500强公司。

sentences.en: Spoiled produce and biodegradable waste are trucked to regional centres for composting.
sentences.zh: 变质的农产品和可生物降解的废物被运到区域中心堆肥。

sentences.en: Whole Foods’ vehicles are being converted to run on biofuels.
sentences.zh: Whole Foods的车辆正在被改造为使用生物燃料。

sentences.en: Even the cleaning products used in its stores are environmentally friendly.
sentences.zh: 甚至它门店里用的清洁产品也是环保的。

sentences.en: And through its philanthropy, the company has created the Animal Compassion Foundation to develop more natural and humane ways of raising farm animals.
sentences.zh: 而且通过慈善，公司创立了动物关怀基金会，以开发更自然、更人道的饲养家畜方式。

sentences.en: In short, nearly every aspect of the company’s value chain reinforces the social dimensions of its value proposition, distinguishing Whole Foods from its competitors.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，公司价值链的几乎每个方面都强化了其价值主张的社会维度，使Whole Foods有别于其竞争对手。

sentences.en: (A) A desert refers to a barren section of land, mainly in arid and semi-arid areas, where there is almost no precipitation and the environment is hostile for any creature to inhabit.
sentences.zh: 沙漠指的是一片贫瘠的土地，主要分布在干旱和半干旱地区，那里几乎没有降水，环境对任何生物的栖居都十分恶劣。

sentences.en: Deserts have been classified in a number of ways, generally combining total precipitation, how many days the rainfall occurs, temperature, humidity, and sometimes additional factors.
sentences.zh: 人们以多种方式对沙漠进行分类，一般综合考虑总降水量、降雨发生的天数、温度、湿度，有时还有其他因素。

sentences.en: In some places, deserts have clear boundaries marked by rivers, mountains or other landforms, while in other places there are no clear-cut borders between deserts and other landscape features.
sentences.zh: 在有些地方，沙漠有由河流、山脉或其他地貌标示的清晰边界，而在另一些地方，沙漠与其他地貌特征之间并没有明确的分界。

sentences.en: (B) In arid areas where there is no covering of vegetation to protect the land, sand and dust storms frequently take place.
sentences.zh: 在没有植被覆盖来保护土地的干旱地区，沙尘暴频频发生。

sentences.en: This phenomenon often occurs along the desert margins rather than within the deserts, where there is already no finer material left.
sentences.zh: 这种现象往往发生在沙漠边缘地带，而非沙漠内部，因为沙漠内部已经没有更细的物质残留。

sentences.en: When a steady wind starts to blow, fine particles on the open ground begin vibrating.
sentences.zh: 当一阵稳定的风开始吹起时，开阔地面上的细小颗粒便开始振动。

sentences.en: As the wind picks up, some of the particles are lifted into the air.
sentences.zh: 随着风力增强，一些颗粒被卷入空中。

sentences.en: When they fall onto the ground, they hit other particles, which are then jerked into the air in their turn, initiating a chain reaction.
sentences.zh: 当它们落回地面时，会撞到其他颗粒，那些颗粒随之又被掀入空中，从而引发一连串的连锁反应。

sentences.en: (C) There has been a great deal of publicity about how severe desertification can be, but the academic circle has never agreed on its causes.
sentences.zh: 关于荒漠化能有多严重，已有大量的宣传，但学术界对其成因却始终未能达成一致。

sentences.en: A common misunderstanding is that a shortage of precipitation causes desertification—yet land in some barren areas will soon recover after rain falls.
sentences.zh: 一个常见的误解是，降水不足导致了荒漠化——然而，某些贫瘠地区的土地在降雨之后很快就会恢复。

sentences.en: In fact, more often than not, human activities are responsible.
sentences.zh: 事实上，人类活动往往才是元凶。

sentences.en: It is widely accepted that the explosion in world population, especially in developing countries, is the primary cause of soil degradation and desertification.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为，世界人口的激增，尤其是在发展中国家，是土壤退化和荒漠化的首要原因。

sentences.en: As populations become denser, the cultivation of crops has expanded into progressively drier areas.
sentences.zh: 随着人口变得越来越密集，作物的种植逐渐扩展到越来越干旱的地区。

sentences.en: These regions are especially likely to go through periods of severe drought, which explains why crop failures are common.
sentences.zh: 这些地区尤其容易经历严重干旱时期，这也解释了为什么歉收很常见。

sentences.en: The raising of most crops requires the natural vegetation cover to be removed first; when crop failures occur, extensive tracts of land are left devoid of plant cover and thus susceptible to wind and water erosion.
sentences.zh: 种植大多数作物都需要先除去天然的植被覆盖；当歉收发生时，大片土地便失去植物覆盖，从而易受风蚀和水蚀。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1990s, dry-land areas experienced a population growth of 18.5 per cent, mostly in severely impoverished developing countries.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪90年代，旱地地区经历了18.5%的人口增长，且大多发生在极度贫困的发展中国家。

sentences.en: (D) Livestock farming in semi-arid areas accelerates soil erosion and becomes one of the reasons for advancing desertification.
sentences.zh: 半干旱地区的畜牧养殖加速了水土流失，并成为荒漠化推进的原因之一。

sentences.en: In such areas, where the vegetation is dominated by grasses, the breeding of livestock is a major economic activity.
sentences.zh: 在这类以草类为主要植被的地区，饲养牲畜是一项主要的经济活动。

sentences.en: Grasses are necessary for anchoring barren topsoil in a dry-land area.
sentences.zh: 在旱地地区，草类对于固定贫瘠的表层土壤是必不可少的。

sentences.en: When a specific field is used to graze an excessive herd, it loses vegetation cover, and the soil is trampled as well as pulverised, leaving the topsoil exposed to destructive forces such as wind and unexpected thunderstorms.
sentences.zh: 当一块特定的田地被用来放牧过多的畜群时，它就会失去植被覆盖，土壤被踩踏并被碾成粉末，使表层土壤暴露在风和突如其来的雷暴等破坏性力量之下。

sentences.en: For centuries, nomads have grazed their flocks and herds wherever pasture could be found, and oases have offered opportunities for a more settled way of living.
sentences.zh: 数百年来，游牧民族在任何能找到牧草的地方放牧他们的羊群和畜群，而绿洲则为一种更安定的生活方式提供了机会。

sentences.en: For some nomads, wherever they move, the desert follows.
sentences.zh: 对一些游牧民族来说，无论他们走到哪里，沙漠都尾随而至。

sentences.en: (E) Trees are of great importance when it comes to maintaining topsoil and slowing down wind speed.
sentences.zh: 在维持表层土壤和减缓风速方面，树木至关重要。

sentences.en: In many Asian countries, firewood is the chief fuel used for cooking and heating, which has caused uncontrolled clear-cutting of forests in dry-land ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 在许多亚洲国家，柴火是用于做饭和取暖的主要燃料，这导致了旱地生态系统中森林被失控地皆伐。

sentences.en: When too many trees are cut down, windstorms and dust storms tend to occur.
sentences.zh: 当太多树木被砍倒时，风暴和沙尘暴便往往随之而来。

sentences.en: (F) What is worse, political conflicts and wars can also contribute to desertification.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，政治冲突和战争也可能助长荒漠化。

sentences.en: To escape invading enemies, refugees often move into some of the most vulnerable ecosystems on the planet.
sentences.zh: 为了躲避入侵之敌，难民往往迁入地球上一些最脆弱的生态系统。

sentences.en: They bring along their traditional cultivation practices, which may not be suitable for their new settlements.
sentences.zh: 他们带来了自己传统的耕作方式，而这些方式对他们的新定居地或许并不适宜。

sentences.en: (G) In the 20th century, one state in the United States had a large section of farmland that turned into desert.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪，美国有一个州曾有一大片农田变成了沙漠。

sentences.en: Since then, measures have been enforced so that such a phenomenon will not happen again.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，人们强制推行了一些措施，以免此类现象再度发生。

sentences.en: To avoid the recurrence of desertification, people must find livelihoods that do not rely on traditional land uses, are less demanding on local natural resources, yet can still generate viable income.
sentences.zh: 为避免荒漠化重演，人们必须找到这样的谋生方式：它们不依赖传统的土地利用，对当地自然资源的索取较少，却仍能带来可观的收入。

sentences.en: Such livelihoods include, but are not limited to, dry-land aquaculture for the raising of fish, crustaceans and industrial compounds derived from micro-algae, greenhouse agriculture, and activities related to tourism.
sentences.zh: 这类谋生方式包括但不限于：用于养殖鱼类、甲壳类以及从微藻中提取工业化合物的旱地水产养殖、温室农业，以及与旅游相关的活动。

sentences.en: Another way to prevent desertification is to create economic prospects in the city centres of dry-lands and in areas outside them.
sentences.zh: 另一种防止荒漠化的办法，是在旱地的城市中心及其周边地区创造经济前景。

sentences.en: Changing the wider economic and institutional structures so that people have new ways to support themselves would help alleviate the pressures that drive desertification.
sentences.zh: 改变更广泛的经济和制度结构，使人们有新的方式养活自己，将有助于缓解那些驱动荒漠化的压力。

sentences.en: (H) In today’s society, new technologies are being used to address the problems brought about by desertification.
sentences.zh: 在当今社会，人们正在运用新技术来应对荒漠化带来的种种问题。

sentences.en: Satellites, for example, have been utilised to investigate the influence that people and livestock have on our planet.
sentences.zh: 例如，卫星已被用来调查人和牲畜对我们这颗星球所产生的影响。

sentences.en: However, this does not mean that alternative technologies are not needed to help tackle the processes of desertification.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不意味着不再需要其他替代技术来帮助应对荒漠化的进程。

sentences.en: A For centuries, many scholars maintained that humans were the only intelligent organisms on Earth.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多学者坚持认为，人类是地球上唯一具有智能的生物。

sentences.en: Many traits were considered to be exclusively human examples of acumen – for example, language, tool use, deception, and awareness of self and others.
sentences.zh: 许多特质曾被认为是人类才智所独有的例证——比如语言、工具的使用、欺骗，以及对自我和他人的意识。

sentences.en: However, exciting new research on a number of animals, particularly birds, has called into question the uniqueness of these traits, forcing us to reconsider this opinion.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于若干动物、尤其是鸟类的激动人心的新研究，使这些特质的独特性受到了质疑，迫使我们重新考虑这一看法。

sentences.en: In 1964, people were amazed when naturalist Jane Goodall first discovered chimpanzees making and using tools.
sentences.zh: 1964年，当博物学家珍·古道尔首次发现黑猩猩制造并使用工具时，人们大为惊叹。

sentences.en: But ornithologists, people who study birds, were not overly surprised.
sentences.zh: 但研究鸟类的鸟类学家却并不太感意外。

sentences.en: Almost 20 years earlier, a renowned ornithologist had shown that tool use was commonplace in populations of woodpecker finches residing on the Galápagos Islands.
sentences.zh: 几乎在20年前，一位著名的鸟类学家就已表明，工具的使用在栖息于加拉帕戈斯群岛的拟䴕树雀种群中司空见惯。

sentences.en: These tiny birds routinely used twigs to extract grubs from under bark.
sentences.zh: 这些小鸟惯常用细枝从树皮下掏取幼虫。

sentences.en: B Since then, the catalogue of tool-using animals has grown.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，会使用工具的动物名录不断增加。

sentences.en: At least three Australian bird species make tools similar to those of the woodpecker finch, and when white-winged choughs come across shellfish, they have been known to use rocks as hammers to crack open the recalcitrant shells.
sentences.zh: 至少有三种澳大利亚鸟类会制造与拟䴕树雀类似的工具，而当白翅澳鸦遇到贝类时，已知它们会用石头当锤子来敲开那些顽固的贝壳。

sentences.en: Other birds show a more sophisticated level of insight.
sentences.zh: 其他鸟类则表现出更高层次的洞察力。

sentences.en: For example, black kites have been reported dropping bait into lakes to bring fish to the surface of the water, thereby making them easier to catch.
sentences.zh: 例如，有报告称黑鸢会把诱饵投进湖中，把鱼引到水面，从而使其更容易被捕获。

sentences.en: A kite may also pick up a smouldering stick from an area recently burned by a bushfire and drop the stick on a patch of unburned grass.
sentences.zh: 黑鸢还可能从一片刚被丛林大火烧过的区域叼起一根尚在闷烧的木棍，把它丢到一片未被烧过的草地上。

sentences.en: The bird then feasts on the small animals that flee from the subsequent fire.
sentences.zh: 随后，这只鸟便饱餐那些从接踵而至的大火中逃出来的小动物。

sentences.en: C Most tool-using behaviours are a means of extracting food, which may provide a clue as to how the mental abilities needed for tool use evolved.
sentences.zh: 大多数使用工具的行为都是一种获取食物的手段，这或许为使用工具所需的心智能力是如何进化而来的提供了线索。

sentences.en: The predominant explanation is based on the proverb that ‘necessity is the mother of invention’.
sentences.zh: 占主导地位的解释，是基于“需要是发明之母”这句谚语。

sentences.en: Essentially, brain tissue is energetically expensive, so animals should have evolved only the intellectual capabilities required to overcome the challenges they face in their environment.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，脑组织在能量上是昂贵的，因此动物应当只进化出克服它们在环境中所面临的挑战所必需的智力。

sentences.en: Consider a hypothetical duck grazing on a seemingly endless supply of grass.
sentences.zh: 设想有一只假想的鸭子，在看似取之不尽的草地上吃草。

sentences.en: Being particularly intelligent will not help the duck eat more grass.
sentences.zh: 格外聪明并不会帮助这只鸭子吃到更多的草。

sentences.en: In contrast, other species, such as birds of prey, live in a more challenging environment, where food may be distributed erratically, hidden from view or highly mobile.
sentences.zh: 与之相反，其他物种，比如猛禽，生活在一个更具挑战性的环境中，那里的食物可能分布无常、藏而不露或高度移动。

sentences.en: The food itself may be quite intelligent.
sentences.zh: 食物本身可能相当聪明。

sentences.en: So, if there are not enough resources to feed all individuals, then only the smartest in each generation will live and reproduce.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果没有足够的资源养活所有个体，那么每一代中只有最聪明的才能存活并繁衍。

sentences.en: D New Caledonian crows boast many different tools in their toolkit.
sentences.zh: 新喀里多尼亚乌鸦的工具箱里有许多不同的工具。

sentences.en: They use a hooked tool made by removing all but one of the side branches from a twig.
sentences.zh: 它们使用一种带钩的工具，那是把一根细枝上除一根之外的所有侧枝都去掉后做成的。

sentences.en: They fashion serrated rakes (using their beaks as scissors) from stiff, leathery pandanus leaves.
sentences.zh: 它们用坚硬如革的露兜树叶（把自己的喙当作剪刀）制作带锯齿的耙子。

sentences.en: They also make probes by modifying their own moulted feathers.
sentences.zh: 它们还通过改造自己脱落的羽毛来制作探针。

sentences.en: Each tool is used in slightly different ways to pull grubs from deep within tree trunks.
sentences.zh: 每种工具都以略有不同的方式，被用来从树干深处拉出幼虫。

sentences.en: The crows carry their favourite tool from one foraging site to the next.
sentences.zh: 这些乌鸦会把自己最喜欢的工具从一个觅食地点带到下一个。

sentences.en: They also store their tools for later reuse in a secure place on their perch.
sentences.zh: 它们还会把工具存放在栖木上一个安全的地方，以备日后再用。

sentences.en: Problem-solving abilities have traditionally been thought to be beyond the reach of animals.
sentences.zh: 解决问题的能力，历来被认为是动物所不能企及的。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, birds are coming up with innovative solutions all the time.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，鸟类却始终在想出富有创意的解决办法。

sentences.en: Recently, New Caledonian crows were observed moulding a piece of wire, something they had never seen before, into a hook and then using it to retrieve food.
sentences.zh: 最近，人们观察到新喀里多尼亚乌鸦把一段它们从未见过的铁丝弯成一个钩子，然后用它来取食。

sentences.en: E Literally hundreds of such reports have accumulated in back copies of scientific journals.
sentences.zh: 在科学期刊的旧刊里，已经积累了不下数百份这样的报告。

sentences.en: Recently, a team of biologists from McGill University in Canada collated them and compared the frequency and size of innovations with the size of the birds’ forebrain (the brain area responsible for higher-order information processing) relative to the hindbrain.
sentences.zh: 最近，加拿大麦吉尔大学的一组生物学家把它们汇集起来，将创新的频率和规模，与鸟类前脑（负责高阶信息处理的脑区）相对于后脑的大小进行了比较。

sentences.en: The team uncovered a clear relationship: birds with relatively large forebrains are able to invent fresh solutions to ecological challenges, and to exploit the discoveries and inventions of others, more often than birds with relatively small forebrains.
sentences.zh: 该团队揭示出一种明确的关系：相比前脑相对较小的鸟，前脑相对较大的鸟更经常能够为生态挑战发明出新的解决办法，并利用他者的发现和发明。

sentences.en: F Intelligence in birds may also arise as a result of selection to overcome the dynamic challenges of communal living.
sentences.zh: 鸟类的智能也可能是为克服群居生活的动态挑战而进行选择的结果。

sentences.en: Since this involves competition between group members, to be successful a social animal may need to be able to reflect on its own intentions, as well as those of others.
sentences.zh: 由于这涉及群体成员之间的竞争，一种社会性动物若要成功，可能需要能够反思自己的意图以及他者的意图。

sentences.en: The consequence of being part of a community may be the evolution of a distinctly ‘political’ brain.
sentences.zh: 身为群体一员的结果，可能就是一种明显“政治化”的大脑的进化。

sentences.en: G What better way to exercise a political brain than to be deceitful!
sentences.zh: 还有什么比施展欺骗更能锻炼一颗政治化的大脑呢！

sentences.en: Perhaps the best example of deception among birds comes from the white-winged choughs.
sentences.zh: 鸟类中欺骗行为最好的例子，也许就来自白翅澳鸦。

sentences.en: Choughs are cooperative breeders – that is, they form a communal group consisting of one breeding pair and up to 15 non-breeding ‘helpers’.
sentences.zh: 澳鸦是合作繁殖者——也就是说，它们组成一个由一对繁殖配偶和多达15只不繁殖的“帮手”构成的群体。

sentences.en: However, because young choughs have so little enthusiasm for foraging, or gathering food, they are often too hungry to help.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于年幼的澳鸦对觅食、也就是搜集食物如此缺乏热情，它们往往饿得无力帮忙。

sentences.en: And because it is socially unacceptable to be part of a group and provide little help, young choughs often act deceptively.
sentences.zh: 而由于身为群体一员却出力甚少在社交上不被接受，年幼的澳鸦便常常做出欺骗的举动。

sentences.en: For example, when an adult is watching, a young chough will place some food in the mouth of a hungry chick but not release it.
sentences.zh: 例如，当有成年澳鸦在看着时，一只年幼的澳鸦会把一些食物放进一只饥饿雏鸟的嘴里，却不松口放下。

sentences.en: Instead, it waits until the adult departs and then eats the food itself.
sentences.zh: 相反，它会等到那只成年澳鸦离开，然后自己把食物吃掉。

sentences.en: A chough can also help the group by preening the chicks.
sentences.zh: 一只澳鸦也可以通过给雏鸟理羽来帮助群体。

sentences.en: Interestingly, it is more likely to preen the chicks if another bird can see it do so.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，如果有另一只鸟能看到它这么做，它就更可能去给雏鸟理羽。

sentences.en: A chough that has been sitting totally still on the nest while the rest of the group is foraging out of sight will comically spring up and frantically start to preen the chicks as soon as some of its group members come into view.
sentences.zh: 当群体的其余成员在看不见的地方觅食时，一只一直一动不动地待在巢里的澳鸦，会在它的某些群体成员一进入视野时，就滑稽地一跃而起，疯狂地开始给雏鸟理羽。

sentences.en: It is likely that these young choughs are only motivated to help when others are watching because they are concerned about their social status.
sentences.zh: 这些年幼的澳鸦很可能只有在别人看着时才有帮忙的动力，因为它们在意自己的社会地位。

sentences.en: Choughs need other choughs to like them, as they cannot breed without them.
sentences.zh: 澳鸦需要其他澳鸦喜欢它们，因为没有其他澳鸦，它们就无法繁殖。

records.title: Investment in shares versus investment in other assets
records.titleZh: 投资股票与投资其他资产的比较

sentences.en: A It all began in 1958 with a phone call from Louis Engel, a banker at Merrill Lynch, a US-based financial management company, who wanted to know how investors in shares had performed relative to investors in other assets such as low-risk investments with guaranteed returns.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于1958年的一通电话，打电话的是美国金融管理公司美林的银行家路易斯·恩格尔，他想知道股票投资者相比投资于其他资产（如有保证回报的低风险投资）的投资者，业绩表现如何。

sentences.en: ‘I don’t know, but if you gave me $50,000 I could find out,’ replied Jim Lorie, a dean at the University of Chicago’s business school.
sentences.zh: “我不知道，但如果你给我5万美元，我就能查清楚，”芝加哥大学商学院院长吉姆·洛里回答道。

sentences.en: Louis Engel soon agreed to provide the funding, and more.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·恩格尔很快就同意提供这笔资金，而且不止于此。

sentences.en: The result, in 1960, was the launch of the University’s Center for Research in Security Prices.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，1960年这所大学的证券价格研究中心宣告成立。

sentences.en: Half a century later CRSP (pronounced ‘crisp’) data are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 半个世纪之后，CRSP（读作“crisp”）的数据已无处不在。

sentences.en: They provided the foundation of at least one-third of all empirical research in finance over the past 40 years, according to a presentation at a symposium held this month.
sentences.zh: 据本月召开的一次研讨会上的一份报告，在过去40年里，金融领域至少三分之一的实证研究都以它们为基础。

sentences.en: They probably influenced much of the rest.
sentences.zh: 它们很可能也影响了其余研究中的大部分。

sentences.en: B Getting the CRSP data together was a tough process in what were then the early days of computers.
sentences.zh: 在当时计算机尚处于早期的年代，把CRSP的数据汇集到一起是个艰难的过程。

sentences.en: Up to three million pieces of information on all the shares traded on the New York Stock Exchange between 1926 and 1960 were transferred from paper in the exchange’s archive to magnetic tape.
sentences.zh: 1926年至1960年间在纽约证券交易所交易的所有股票的多达三百万条信息，从交易所档案中的纸面被转录到了磁带上。

sentences.en: A lot of time was spent adjusting prices to take account of complexities in the market.
sentences.zh: 大量时间被花在调整价格上，以把市场中的种种复杂情况考虑进去。

sentences.en: Lorie and his co-researcher, Lawrence Fisher, chose January 1926 as the start date because they wanted the data to span at least one complete business cycle from boom to bust, or vice versa.
sentences.zh: 洛里和他的合作研究者劳伦斯·费希尔之所以选择1926年1月作为起始日期，是因为他们希望这些数据至少能涵盖一个从繁荣到萧条、或反之的完整商业周期。

sentences.en: C When these two economists published the first study based on the CRSP data in 1964, they reported that the annual compound return on the shares over the entire 35-year period was (depending on the tax status of the investor) between 6.8% and 9%.
sentences.zh: 当这两位经济学家于1964年发表第一份基于CRSP数据的研究时，他们报告说，在整个35年间，股票的年复合回报率（取决于投资者的纳税身份）在6.8%到9%之间。

sentences.en: Acknowledging that good data on the performance of other assets were not available, the study claimed that the rate of return on shares was ‘substantially higher than for alternative investment media’, providing the first empirical support for the still-popular idea that shares outperform other investments over the long run.
sentences.zh: 该研究承认，关于其他资产表现的良好数据并不存在，但仍声称股票的回报率“大大高于其他投资媒介”，从而为“股票长期表现优于其他投资”这一至今仍流行的观点提供了首个实证支持。

sentences.en: Fisher and Lorie also observed that many people chose to invest in assets with lower returns because they were cautious by nature and were concerned about the risk of loss inherent in investing in the stock market.
sentences.zh: 费希尔和洛里还观察到，许多人选择投资于回报较低的资产，是因为他们生性谨慎，担心投资股市所固有的亏损风险。

sentences.en: Economists today call the amount of extra return that investors need to compensate them for this additional risk the ‘equity risk premium’, although they differ greatly on how big investors should expect it to be.
sentences.zh: 今天的经济学家把投资者为补偿这种额外风险所需的那部分额外回报称为“股权风险溢价”，尽管他们对投资者应当预期它有多大众说纷纭。

sentences.en: D After Fisher and Lorie’s 1964 report there was no stopping the love affair between financial economists and the data that studying these numbers produced.
sentences.zh: 在费希尔和洛里1964年的报告之后，金融经济学家与研究这些数字所产生的数据之间的热恋便一发不可收拾。

sentences.en: Myron Scholes, now a Nobel laureate, became director of CRSP in 1974, and ensured the database was both kept up to date and made readily available to academic economists everywhere.
sentences.zh: 如今已是诺贝尔奖得主的迈伦·斯科尔斯，于1974年出任CRSP的主任，并确保这个数据库既保持更新，又能让各地的学院派经济学家随时取用。

sentences.en: In turn, this resource became ever more useful as computing power became more affordable.
sentences.zh: 反过来，随着计算能力变得更加廉价，这一资源也变得愈发有用。

sentences.en: The CRSP database has since been expanded to include a full range of different types of investments.
sentences.zh: 此后，CRSP数据库已被扩充，纳入了各种不同类型投资的全套数据。

sentences.en: It has been replicated across the world.
sentences.zh: 它已在世界各地被复制推广。

sentences.en: E One of the earliest uses of CRSP data was by Eugene Fama, an economist at the University of Chicago, to support his ‘efficient-market hypothesis’.
sentences.zh: CRSP数据最早的用途之一，是芝加哥大学的经济学家尤金·法马用它来支持自己的“有效市场假说”。

sentences.en: He found that over a lengthy period share prices tended to rise and fall randomly, without showing much of a pattern.
sentences.zh: 他发现，在一段很长的时期里，股价往往随机涨跌，并不显示出多少规律。

sentences.en: Markets are efficient, he said, because all relevant information is reflected in share prices at any given moment, meaning there are no predictable movements in prices for smart investors to exploit.
sentences.zh: 他说，市场是有效的，因为所有相关信息在任何给定时刻都已反映在股价之中，这意味着不存在可供精明投资者利用的、可预测的价格走势。

sentences.en: Fama did concede that there was some evidence of temporary short-term predictability in share prices, however.
sentences.zh: 不过，法马确实承认，有一些证据表明股价存在暂时的短期可预测性。

sentences.en: That stipulation has resulted in a vast number of papers based on discovering such ‘variations’ through data mining.
sentences.zh: 这一附带说法，催生出了大量基于通过数据挖掘发现此类“变异”的论文。

sentences.en: In theory, such anomalies are potentially lucrative for investors, but as believers in efficient markets observe with satisfaction, it seems that no sooner are such anomalies discovered and reported in journals than they typically disappear.
sentences.zh: 理论上，这类反常现象对投资者可能有利可图，但正如有效市场的信奉者满意地观察到的那样，这类反常现象似乎刚一被发现并在期刊上报告，通常就随即消失了。

sentences.en: F However, the sheer volume of material means that financial economists are becoming increasingly specialised, which may have costs as well as benefits.
sentences.zh: 然而，材料数量之庞大，意味着金融经济学家正变得越来越专门化，而这可能既有好处也有代价。

sentences.en: Some economists worry that much of this statistical analysis is creating some interference that drowns out serious thinking about the big questions, such as why the financial system nearly collapsed in 2008 and how a repeat can be avoided.
sentences.zh: 一些经济学家担心，这种统计分析中的很大一部分正在制造某种干扰，淹没了对那些重大问题的严肃思考，比如金融体系为何在2008年几近崩溃、又如何才能避免重蹈覆辙。

sentences.en: Robert Shiller, an economist at Yale University and a long-time sceptic about the efficient-market hypothesis, feels that with the creation of the CRSP database economists suddenly believed that finance had become scientific.
sentences.zh: 耶鲁大学的经济学家、长期以来对有效市场假说持怀疑态度的罗伯特·席勒认为，随着CRSP数据库的建立，经济学家们突然相信金融已经变成了一门科学。

sentences.en: According to Shiller, conventional ideas about investing and financial markets – and about their vulnerabilities – seemed out of date to the new empiricists.
sentences.zh: 据席勒所言，关于投资和金融市场——以及关于它们的脆弱性——的传统观念，在这些新的经验主义者看来已经过时。

sentences.en: He worries that academic departments are full of economists who are so specialised in data analysis that they fail to see and understand the whole.
sentences.zh: 他担心，各个学术部门里满是这样的经济学家：他们在数据分析上如此专门化，以致看不到也理解不了整体。

sentences.en: They get a sense of authority from work that contains lots of data.
sentences.zh: 他们从含有大量数据的研究工作中获得一种权威感。

sentences.en: To have seen the 2008 global financial crisis coming, he argues, it would have been better to ‘go back to old-fashioned readings of history, studying institutions and laws.
sentences.zh: 他主张，若想预见到2008年的全球金融危机，更好的做法本应是“回到对历史的老派研读，去钻研各种制度和法律。

sentences.en: We should have talked to grandpa.’
sentences.zh: 我们本该去和爷爷聊聊。”

sentences.en: G Scholes responds to this criticism with the contention that the usefulness of this empirical analysis is proven by the fact that demand for it continues to grow.
sentences.zh: 斯科尔斯对这一批评的回应是，他主张这种实证分析的有用性，已被对它的需求持续增长这一事实所证明。

sentences.en: At CRSP’s 50th-anniversary symposium, plans were unveiled to publish indicators on an expanding range of investments, as well as for growth and value stocks.
sentences.zh: 在CRSP成立50周年的研讨会上，公布了一些计划，要就范围不断扩大的各类投资、以及成长股和价值股发布指标。

sentences.en: These indicators, CRSP claims, will be more academically rigorous and cheaper than existing ones.
sentences.zh: CRSP声称，这些指标将比现有的指标在学术上更为严谨，也更为便宜。

sentences.en: For believers in the efficiency of markets, that should be enough to ensure CRSP’s continuing success.
sentences.zh: 对于市场有效性的信奉者来说，这应当足以确保CRSP持续取得成功。

sentences.en: A In a quest to make concrete more durable and sustainable, an international team of geologists and engineers has found inspiration in the concrete used by the ancient Romans.
sentences.zh: 在让混凝土更耐久、更可持续的探索中，一支由地质学家和工程师组成的国际团队从古罗马人使用的混凝土中获得了灵感。

sentences.en: The chemical secrets of Roman concrete have been uncovered in samples taken from a concrete Roman breakwater.
sentences.zh: 罗马混凝土的化学奥秘，在从一座罗马混凝土防波堤取得的样本中被揭开。

sentences.en: A breakwater is a barrier that is built out into the sea to protect coasts and harbors from the force of waves.
sentences.zh: 防波堤是一道伸入海中、保护海岸和港口免受波浪冲击的屏障。

sentences.en: This particular breakwater has spent the last 2,000 years submerged in seawater.
sentences.zh: 这座特定的防波堤过去2000年一直浸没在海水中。

sentences.en: The international team of researchers that collected the samples was led by Paulo Monteiro, a professor of civil and environmental engineering at the University of California, Berkeley.
sentences.zh: 采集样本的国际研究团队由加州大学伯克利分校土木与环境工程教授Paulo Monteiro领导。

sentences.en: Analysis of samples from the ancient underwater site in Pozzuoli Bay near Naples in Italy, and pinpointed why the best Roman concrete was superior to most modern concrete.
sentences.zh: 对取自意大利那不勒斯附近Pozzuoli湾古代水下遗址样本的分析，精确指出了为什么最好的罗马混凝土优于大多数现代混凝土。

sentences.en: B Concrete was the Roman Empire’s construction material of choice.
sentences.zh: 混凝土是罗马帝国首选的建筑材料。

sentences.en: It was used in land monuments such as the Pantheon in Rome, as well as in underwater and partially underwater coastal and harbor structures.
sentences.zh: 它被用于陆地纪念建筑，如罗马的万神殿，也用于水下及部分水下的海岸和港口结构。

sentences.en: Monteiro and his team were particularly interested in how the coastal and harbor structures endured the unforgiving saltwater environment.
sentences.zh: Monteiro和他的团队尤其感兴趣的是这些海岸和港口结构如何经受住了无情的海水环境。

sentences.en: Chemical analysis of Roman concrete showed that it differs from the modern kind in several ways.
sentences.zh: 对罗马混凝土的化学分析表明，它在几个方面与现代混凝土不同。

sentences.en: One is the content of the cement that binds the material in the concrete.
sentences.zh: 其一是把混凝土中材料粘合在一起的水泥的成分。

sentences.en: The most commonly used cement in recent decades has been Portland cement.
sentences.zh: 近几十年最常用的水泥一直是波特兰水泥。

sentences.en: Portland cement is a compound of calcium, silicates, and hydrates (C-S-H).
sentences.zh: 波特兰水泥是钙、硅酸盐和水合物（C-S-H）的化合物。

sentences.en: However, analysis of Roman concrete shows that it contains a significantly different cement.
sentences.zh: 然而，对罗马混凝土的分析表明，它含有一种明显不同的水泥。

sentences.en: Roman cement contains aluminum, which is not found in Portland cement, and less silicon than is found in Portland cement.
sentences.zh: 罗马水泥含有铝，这在波特兰水泥中找不到，而硅则比波特兰水泥中的少。

sentences.en: The resulting calcium-aluminum-silicate- hydrate (C-A-S-H) is an exceptionally stable cement.
sentences.zh: 由此形成的钙铝硅酸盐水合物（C-A-S-H）是一种异常稳定的水泥。

sentences.en: C The recipe for the contents of Roman concrete was first described around 30 BC by Vitruvius, an engineer for the Roman Emperor Augustus.
sentences.zh: 罗马混凝土成分的配方最早大约在公元前30年由罗马皇帝奥古斯都的工程师维特鲁威描述。

sentences.en: Volcanic ash was one of the ingredients, and it is now understood that this is crucial, as it is volcanic ash that contains the aluminum that ultimately gives Roman concrete its great durability.
sentences.zh: 火山灰是其中一种原料，现在人们明白这一点至关重要，因为正是火山灰含有最终赋予罗马混凝土极大耐久性的铝。

sentences.en: The Romans devised an efficient method of making concrete for coastal structures.
sentences.zh: 罗马人想出了一种为海岸结构制造混凝土的高效方法。

sentences.en: They combined volcanic ash with lime, which added the calcium to the mix.
sentences.zh: 他们把火山灰与石灰结合，石灰为混合物加入了钙。

sentences.en: This was then packed, together with stones and chunks of rock, into wooden molds, which were then immersed in seawater.
sentences.zh: 然后把它和石块及大块岩石一起塞进木模，木模随后被浸入海水。

sentences.en: The seawater instantly triggered a hot chemical reaction.
sentences.zh: 海水立即引发一场炽热的化学反应。

sentences.en: The lime was hydrated by the seawater, which means that it incorporated water molecules into its structure, and reacted with the volcanic ash to cement the whole mixture together.
sentences.zh: 石灰被海水水化，也就是把水分子并入它的结构中，并与火山灰反应，把整个混合物胶结在一起。

sentences.en: This reaction formed the concrete that was used to build some of the most enduring structures in Western civilization.
sentences.zh: 这一反应形成了用来建造西方文明一些最持久结构的混凝土。

sentences.en: D According to Marie Jackson, a member of the research team, Roman concrete is one of the most durable construction materials on the planet, and that was no accident.
sentences.zh: 据研究团队成员Marie Jackson说，罗马混凝土是地球上最耐久的建筑材料之一，而那并非偶然。

sentences.en: Shipping was the lifeline of political, economic, and military stability for the Roman Empire, so constructing harbors that would last was critical.
sentences.zh: 航运是罗马帝国政治、经济和军事稳定的命脉，所以建造能持久的港口至关重要。

sentences.en: ‘Over time, the Romans used less and less concrete.’
sentences.zh: “随着时间推移，罗马人用的混凝土越来越少。”

sentences.en: ‘As the Roman Empire declined, and shipping declined, the need for the seawater concrete declined,’ said Jackson.
sentences.zh: “随着罗马帝国衰落、航运衰落，对海水混凝土的需求也下降了，”Jackson说。

sentences.en: ‘You could also argue that the original structures were built so well that, once they were in place, they didn’t need to be replaced,’ she added.
sentences.zh: “你也可以说，最初的结构建得太好，以至于一旦建成，就不需要更换，”她补充道。

sentences.en: E Producing Roman concrete also left a smaller carbon footprint than its modern counterpart.
sentences.zh: 生产罗马混凝土留下的碳足迹也比它的现代对应物更小。

sentences.en: ‘It’s not that modern concrete isn’t good—it’s so good we use 19 billion tons of it a year,’ says Monteiro.
sentences.zh: “不是说现代混凝土不好——它太好了，我们一年用190亿吨，”Monteiro说。

sentences.en: ‘The problem is that manufacturing Portland cement accounts for seven percent of the carbon dioxide that industry puts into the air.’
sentences.zh: “问题在于，制造波特兰水泥占了工业排入空气的二氧化碳的百分之七。”

sentences.en: Portland cement holds most modern concrete together.
sentences.zh: 波特兰水泥把大多数现代混凝土粘合在一起。

sentences.en: However, making Portland cement releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere from burning fuel in order to heat a mix of limestone and clays to 1,450 degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 然而，制造波特兰水泥会通过燃烧燃料把石灰石和黏土的混合物加热到1450摄氏度，从而向大气释放二氧化碳。

sentences.en: The production of Roman concrete, however, was much cleaner, as less heat was needed.
sentences.zh: 然而，罗马混凝土的生产要清洁得多，因为需要的热量更少。

sentences.en: A temperature that was a third lower than that required for making Portland cement was sufficient for making Roman concrete.
sentences.zh: 一个比制造波特兰水泥所需温度低三分之一的温度，就足以制造罗马混凝土。

sentences.en: F Some modern concrete no longer contains Portland cement; instead, fly ash is used, which causes fewer greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 有些现代混凝土不再含波特兰水泥；取而代之的是粉煤灰，它造成的温室气体排放更少。

sentences.en: Fly ash is a waste product from burning coal, and the researchers are investigating whether volcanic ash would be a good, large-volume replacement in countries that cannot access fly ash easily.
sentences.zh: 粉煤灰是燃煤的废产物，研究人员正在调查在那些不易获得粉煤灰的国家，火山灰会不会是一种好的、大批量的替代品。

sentences.en: ‘There is not enough fly ash in this world to replace half of the Portland cement being used,’ said Monteiro.
sentences.zh: “这个世界上没有足够的粉煤灰来替代正在使用的一半波特兰水泥，”Monteiro说。

sentences.en: ‘Many countries don’t have fly ash, so the idea is to find alternative local materials that will work, including the kind of volcanic ash that Romans used.
sentences.zh: “许多国家没有粉煤灰，所以这个想法是找到能用的替代性本地材料，包括罗马人用的那种火山灰。

sentences.en: Using these alternatives could replace 40 percent of the world’s demand for Portland cement.’
sentences.zh: 使用这些替代品可以替代全世界对波特兰水泥40%的需求。”

sentences.en: G Cutting greenhouse gas emissions is one powerful incentive for finding a better way to provide the concrete the world needs; another is the need for stronger, longer-lasting buildings, bridges, and other structures.
sentences.zh: 削减温室气体排放是寻找更好办法来提供世界所需混凝土的一个有力动因；另一个是对更结实、更持久的建筑、桥梁和其他结构的需求。

sentences.en: ‘In the middle 20th century, concrete structures were designed to last 50 years, and a lot of them are on borrowed time,’ Monteiro says.
sentences.zh: “在20世纪中叶，混凝土结构被设计为能用50年，而它们当中很多都已是超期服役，”Monteiro说。

sentences.en: ‘Now we design buildings to last 100 to 120 years.’
sentences.zh: “如今我们把建筑设计为能用100到120年。”

sentences.en: Yet Roman harbor installations have survived 2,000 years of chemical attack from seawater and wave action.
sentences.zh: 然而罗马的港口设施已经经受住了2000年来自海水和波浪作用的化学侵蚀。

sentences.en: Stronger, longer-lasting modern concrete may be the legacy of a deeper understanding of how the Romans made their incomparable concrete.
sentences.zh: 更结实、更持久的现代混凝土，也许是更深入理解罗马人如何制造他们无与伦比的混凝土所留下的遗产。

sentences.en: (A) Like a passenger train, a roller coaster consists of a series of connected cars that move on a track.
sentences.zh: 和客运列车一样，过山车由一系列在轨道上移动的相连车厢组成。

sentences.en: But unlike a passenger train, it has no engine or power source of its own.
sentences.zh: 但和客运列车不同，它没有自己的引擎或动力源。

sentences.en: For most of the ride, it is moved only by the forces of inertia and gravity.
sentences.zh: 这趟旅程的大部分时间，它只靠惯性和重力的作用来移动。

sentences.en: The only exertion of energy occurs at the very beginning of the ride when the coaster train is pulled up the lift hill.
sentences.zh: 唯一一次能量的施加发生在旅程一开始，当过山车列车被拉上提升坡时。

sentences.en: (B) The traditional lifting mechanism is a long length of chain running up the hill under the track.
sentences.zh: 传统的提升机构是一长段沿坡在轨道下方延伸的链条。

sentences.en: The chain is fastened in a loop, which is wound around a gear at the top of the hill and another one at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 链条系成一个环，绕在坡顶的一个齿轮和坡底的另一个齿轮上。

sentences.en: The gear at the bottom of the hill is turned by a motor.
sentences.zh: 坡底的齿轮由一台马达带动。

sentences.en: This turns the chain so that it continually moves up the hill like a long conveyor belt.
sentences.zh: 这转动链条，使它像一条长长的传送带一样不断向坡上移动。

sentences.en: The coaster cars grip onto the chain, which simply pulls them to the top.
sentences.zh: 过山车车厢抓住链条，链条就把它们拉到顶部。

sentences.en: At the summit, the train is released and starts its descent.
sentences.zh: 到了顶点，列车被释放，开始它的下降。

sentences.en: (C) The purpose of this initial ascent is to build up a sort of reservoir of potential energy, which simply means that as the coaster gets higher in the air, there is a greater distance gravity can pull it down.
sentences.zh: 这个最初爬升的目的是积累一种势能的储备，意思就是说，过山车在空中升得越高，重力能把它拉下来的距离就越大。

sentences.en: (D) As the train starts coasting down the hill, this potential energy is converted into kinetic energy (energy of motion), and the train speeds up.
sentences.zh: 当列车开始顺坡滑下时，这种势能转化为动能（运动的能量），列车加速。

sentences.en: At the bottom of the hill, this has reached its maximum, and this propels the train up the second hill, again building up the potential-energy level.
sentences.zh: 在坡底，这达到最大值，并推动列车冲上第二个坡，再次积累势能水平。

sentences.en: (E) In this way, the course of the track is constantly converting energy from kinetic to potential and back again.
sentences.zh: 这样，轨道的走向不断地把能量在动能和势能之间来回转化。

sentences.en: This fluctuation in acceleration is what makes roller coasters so much fun.
sentences.zh: 加速度的这种波动正是过山车如此好玩的原因。

sentences.en: At its most basic level, this is all a roller coaster is – a machine that uses gravity and inertia to send a train along a winding track.
sentences.zh: 在最基本的层面上，过山车就是这么回事——一台利用重力和惯性让列车沿着蜿蜒轨道行进的机器。

sentences.en: Coasting through history
sentences.zh: 滑行穿越历史

sentences.en: (F) Roller coasters have a long, fascinating history.
sentences.zh: 过山车有着悠久而引人入胜的历史。

sentences.en: Their direct ancestors were ice slides, popular in Russia in the 16th and 17th centuries.
sentences.zh: 它们的直系祖先是冰滑道，在16和17世纪的俄罗斯很流行。

sentences.en: They consisted of a long, steep, wooden slide covered in ice.
sentences.zh: 它们由一条又长又陡、覆着冰的木滑道组成。

sentences.en: Riders walked up a ladder or set of stairs to the top of the slide, as high as 21 metres up.
sentences.zh: 乘坐者沿梯子或一段台阶走到滑道顶部，高达21米。

sentences.en: At the top, they climbed into sleds made of wood or blocks of ice and shot down the slope.
sentences.zh: 在顶部，他们爬进用木头或冰块做的雪橇，沿斜坡飞射而下。

sentences.en: At the base, the sleds would crash-land in a sand pile.
sentences.zh: 在底部，雪橇会撞落进一堆沙里。

sentences.en: (G) It seems that the idea was then imported into France.
sentences.zh: 看来这个主意随后被引入了法国。

sentences.en: For most of the year, the warmer climate would melt the ice, so the French started building waxed slides instead.
sentences.zh: 一年中大部分时间，较暖的气候会把冰融化，所以法国人改建打蜡的滑道。

sentences.en: To help the sleds move down these slides, they added wheels, and in 1817, for the first time, a train was attached to the track.
sentences.zh: 为帮助雪橇沿这些滑道下滑，他们加了轮子，并在1817年第一次把一列车厢连到了轨道上。

sentences.en: The French continued to expand on this idea, coming up with more complex track layouts, with multiple cars and all sorts of twists and turns.
sentences.zh: 法国人继续扩展这个主意，想出更复杂的轨道布局，带有多节车厢和各种各样的扭转弯道。

sentences.en: (H) The first American roller coaster was built in the mountains of Pennsylvania in the mid-1800s, originally to provide an easy way to send coal to the railway 29 km down the mountain.
sentences.zh: 第一辆美国过山车于19世纪中叶建在宾夕法尼亚的山里，最初是为了提供一种便捷的方式，把煤运到山下29公里处的铁路。

sentences.en: When the track was first built, a crew at the bottom of the mountain would attach the cart to a team of mules after emptying the load, and the mules would drag it back up to the top.
sentences.zh: 轨道刚建成时，山底的一组工人会在卸完货后把矿车挂到一队骡子上，骡子把它拖回顶部。

sentences.en: They were eventually replaced with steam engines to make the system more efficient.
sentences.zh: 它们最终被蒸汽机取代，以使这套系统更高效。

sentences.en: (I) Soon after these improvements were made, the railway company built a new tunnel that brought the freight trains much closer to the coal mine.
sentences.zh: 这些改进做出后不久，铁路公司建了一条新隧道，把货运列车带到离煤矿近得多的地方。

sentences.en: No longer required for its original purpose, the roller coaster was configured as a ‘scenic tour’.
sentences.zh: 不再被原来的用途所需要，这辆过山车被改造成了一次“观光之旅”。

sentences.en: For one dollar, tourists got a leisurely ride up to the top of the mountain, followed by a wild, bumpy ride straight down.
sentences.zh: 花一美元，游客就能悠闲地上行到山顶，随后是一段疯狂、颠簸的笔直俯冲。

sentences.en: This was soon a resounding success, attracting thousands of tourists every year.
sentences.zh: 这很快大获成功，每年吸引数千名游客。

sentences.en: (J) Scenic rides like this continued to thrive and were joined by wooden roller coasters similar to the ones we know today.
sentences.zh: 像这样的观光乘坐继续兴盛，并加入了与我们今天所知相似的木制过山车。

sentences.en: These coasters were the main attraction at popular amusement parks throughout the United States, such as the many parks of Coney Island in New York.
sentences.zh: 这些过山车是全美各地热门游乐园的主要看点，比如纽约康尼岛的众多公园。

sentences.en: By the 1920s, roller coasters were in full swing, with some 2,000 rides in operation around the country.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪20年代，过山车全面兴起，全国约有2000个在运营。

sentences.en: (K) Following the Great Depression, a decline in roller-coaster production began in the early 1930s, but a second roller-coaster boom in the 1970s and the beginning of the 1980s revitalised the amusement-park industry and introduced a slew of innovative tubular steel coasters.
sentences.zh: 大萧条之后，过山车的生产在20世纪30年代初开始衰退，但20世纪70年代和80年代初的第二次过山车热潮重振了游乐园业，并引入了一大批创新的管状钢过山车。

sentences.en: (L) This was followed by a decline in interest for the rest of the decade, but since the early 1990s the amusement-park industry has experienced another coaster boom of sorts.
sentences.zh: 接下来是那个十年其余时间里兴趣的下降，但自20世纪90年代初以来，游乐园业又经历了某种过山车热潮。

sentences.en: New launching techniques and other technological developments have opened up a world of options for designers, so in some rides you feel as if you are flying.
sentences.zh: 新的发射技术和其他技术发展为设计师打开了一个充满选择的世界，所以在有些乘坐中你感觉仿佛在飞。

sentences.en: In the next few years we can expect to see many faster, taller and more twisted rides popping up in amusement parks around the world.
sentences.zh: 在接下来几年里，我们可以期待看到许多更快、更高、更扭曲的乘坐在世界各地的游乐园里冒出来。

records.title: Solving the problem of waste disposal

sentences.en: A For many years, burning rubbish has been portrayed as the lazy option when it comes to dealing with the problem of waste disposal, since it sends toxic fumes into the air and appears to support a consumerist, throwaway society.
sentences.zh: 多年来，在处理废物处置问题上，焚烧垃圾一直被描绘成懒惰的选项，因为它把有毒烟雾送进空气、并且似乎在支持一个消费主义的、用完即扔的社会。

sentences.en: Norway, however, appears to be burning its way through a sizeable chunk of Europe's municipal waste, using the heat created by this process to warm and power homes in many of its cities.
sentences.zh: 然而，挪威似乎正在焚烧掉欧洲城市废物中相当大的一块，利用这一过程产生的热量来为它许多城市的家庭供暖、供电。

sentences.en: Norway isn't alone: Germany, Sweden, Belgium and the Netherlands all burn significant quantities of rubbish, and across Europe there are 420 plants burning municipal waste.
sentences.zh: 挪威并不孤单：德国、瑞典、比利时和荷兰都焚烧大量垃圾，而在整个欧洲有420座焚烧城市废物的工厂。

sentences.en: With Europe dumping 150 million tonnes of rubbish into landfill* every year, there would seem to be a limitless supply.
sentences.zh: 欧洲每年向垃圾填埋场倾倒一亿五千万吨垃圾，供应似乎是无限的。

sentences.en: B Those who support burning waste say that a new generation of incinerators has made it a more attractive option.
sentences.zh: 那些支持焚烧废物的人说，新一代的焚烧炉使它成为一个更有吸引力的选项。

sentences.en: Filters and scrubbing mechanisms now capture harmful substances such as mercury, hydrochloric acid and heavy metals.
sentences.zh: 过滤器和洗涤装置现在能捕获汞、盐酸和重金属等有害物质。

sentences.en: According to Ted Michaels, president of the US-based Energy Recovery Centre, ‘There has been constant evolution in combustion engineering and emissions-control technology, and the output from these facilities is now minuscule.'
sentences.zh: 据美国能源回收中心主席泰德·迈克尔斯说：“燃烧工程和排放控制技术一直在不断演进，如今这些设施的排放物已微乎其微。”

sentences.en: Above all, however, supporters say that incineration is the only way of preventing the long-term impacts of landfill.
sentences.zh: 然而，最重要的是，支持者说焚烧是防止垃圾填埋长期影响的唯一办法。

sentences.en: In ten years' time, says the World Bank, humans will be generating 2.2 billion tonnes of solid waste per year.
sentences.zh: 世界银行说，十年后，人类每年将产生22亿吨固体废物。

sentences.en: Advocates see incineration as a practical way to deal swiftly with an immediate problem.
sentences.zh: 倡导者把焚烧视为迅速处理一个迫在眉睫问题的实际办法。

sentences.en: C Levels of waste generation vary hugely around the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地废物产生的水平差异巨大。

sentences.en: ‘It's a problem for the developed nations,' says Joergen Fenhann, a senior scientist working with the UN Environment Programme in Denmark.
sentences.zh: 在丹麦与联合国环境规划署合作的高级科学家约根·芬汉说：“这是发达国家的问题。

sentences.en: ‘The more you develop, the more you produce, buy and throw away.'
sentences.zh: 你越发达，你生产、购买和丢弃的就越多。”

sentences.en: But the growth of incineration hasn't been universally welcomed.
sentences.zh: 但焚烧的增长并没有受到普遍的欢迎。

sentences.en: Lars Haltbrekken, chairman of Friends of the Earth in Norway, is concerned that incineration plants appear to generate demand for their services.
sentences.zh: 挪威地球之友的主席拉尔斯·哈尔特布雷肯担心，焚烧厂似乎在为它们自己的服务制造需求。

sentences.en: ‘The problem in Norway,' he explains, ‘is that we have built too many waste-burning factories.
sentences.zh: 他解释说：“挪威的问题在于我们建了太多的垃圾焚烧厂。

sentences.en: So we've ended up importing waste from other countries.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最终从其他国家进口垃圾。

sentences.en: If you look at this in a very small perspective, it is, of course, better for the climate to burn rubbish from the UK rather than leave it in landfill there,' he continues.
sentences.zh: 他继续说：“如果你从一个非常小的视角看这件事，那么焚烧来自英国的垃圾、而不是把它留在那里填埋，对气候来说当然更好。

sentences.en: ‘But in a broader perspective, it's a lazy way of getting rid of waste; you don't stimulate the goals of reducing, reusing and recycling.'
sentences.zh: 但从更广的视角看，这是一种处理废物的懒惰方式；你没有去推动减少、再利用和回收的目标。”

sentences.en: D Incineration is also at odds with EU policy, which promotes a ‘recycling hierarchy': ideally, we simply produce less waste in the first place; failing that, we reuse objects more; the next step is recycling; only then should we consider incineration, while dumping in landfill is the last resort.
sentences.zh: 焚烧也与欧盟的政策相抵触，欧盟提倡一种“回收等级”：理想情况下，我们一开始就少产生废物；做不到的话，就更多地重复使用物品；下一步是回收；只有到那时我们才应考虑焚烧，而填埋是最后的手段。

sentences.en: Dealing with the problem of waste disposal involves tracing the whole process that took the material from its inception to landfill.
sentences.zh: 处理废物处置的问题涉及追溯把材料从诞生带到填埋场的整个过程。

sentences.en: We used to call this the ‘cradle to grave' life cycle; now, the talk is of ‘cradle to cradle' and an even more comprehensive concept known as ‘zero waste'.
sentences.zh: 我们过去把这叫作“从摇篮到坟墓”的生命周期；如今，谈的是“从摇篮到摇篮”、以及一个更全面、叫作“零废物”的概念。

sentences.en: ‘The philosophy of cradle to cradle is about designing products that are actually good for the environment at the end of their life,' says Joan Marc Simon, European spokesman for the environmental movement GAIA.
sentences.zh: 环境运动组织GAIA的欧洲发言人琼·马克·西蒙说：“从摇篮到摇篮的理念是关于设计在产品生命末期实际上对环境有益的产品。

sentences.en: ‘You design a bottle that contains no toxins, is fully recyclable and requires the minimum amount of energy to be produced.'
sentences.zh: 你设计一个不含毒素、可完全回收、且生产所需能量最少的瓶子。”

sentences.en: As Simon points out, however, without the right mechanisms in place ‘nothing guarantees that this bottle will end up being properly collected and treated in the appropriate recycling facility'.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如西蒙指出的，如果没有合适的机制到位，“没有什么能保证这个瓶子最终会被恰当地收集、并在适当的回收设施中处理”。

sentences.en: E Tim Burns, policy manager at Keep Britain Tidy, says, ‘In the UK alone, people waste £10 billion of food every year.
sentences.zh: 让英国保持整洁组织的政策经理蒂姆·伯恩斯说：“仅在英国，人们每年就浪费掉100亿英镑的食物。

sentences.en: You can argue about composting that, or not buying it in the first place — if you do that, then that's money the retailers don't get, so it's not always clear-cut.'
sentences.zh: 你可以争论说把它堆肥，或者一开始就别买它——如果你那么做，那就是零售商得不到的钱，所以并不总是非黑即白。”

sentences.en: The implications of zero waste are that we're going to have to take a good long look at those well-stocked supermarket shelves, too.
sentences.zh: 零废物的含义是，我们也将不得不好好审视那些货品充足的超市货架。

sentences.en: ‘Supermarkets keep their shelves stocked even when demand isn't there, which means they have to pay to dispose of a lot of food,' says Burns.
sentences.zh: 伯恩斯说：“超市即便没有需求也让货架保持满满当当，这意味着它们不得不花钱去处理掉大量的食物。

sentences.en: ‘But that cost is less to them than the cost in brand damage of having empty shelves.'
sentences.zh: 但对它们来说，那个成本比货架空空带来的品牌损害成本要小。”

sentences.en: F Recent history and changes in trends in recycling suggest that we should be prepared for unexpected developments.
sentences.zh: 近来的历史以及回收趋势的变化表明，我们应该为意想不到的发展做好准备。

sentences.en: ‘If someone back in the 1980s had suggested what waste would be like now, they would be completely wrong,' says Richard Fisher, a PhD researcher at Cranfield University.
sentences.zh: 克兰菲尔德大学的博士研究员理查德·费舍尔说：“如果20世纪80年代有人提出废物现在会是什么样，他们会完全错。

sentences.en: ‘Consumerism has developed at a pace we never expected.
sentences.zh: 消费主义以一种我们从未预料的速度发展。

sentences.en: Nobody would have said there would be so much electronic waste.
sentences.zh: 没有人会说会有这么多电子废物。

sentences.en: But recycling has grown, too — ten years ago nobody would have predicted today's levels of recycling.'
sentences.zh: 但回收也增长了——十年前没有人会预测到今天的回收水平。”

sentences.en: But he points out that the need to reduce waste is still a difficult message to sell to consumers.
sentences.zh: 但他指出，减少废物的必要性仍然是一个难以向消费者推销的信息。

sentences.en: He suggests that what people are really concerned about is their loved ones and the future they face.
sentences.zh: 他认为，人们真正关心的是他们所爱的人、以及他们面对的未来。

sentences.en: ‘Perhaps we can align the environmental message to these deep-seated values,' he says.
sentences.zh: 他说：“也许我们可以把环境信息与这些根深蒂固的价值观对接起来。

sentences.en: ‘We need to look at whether it's business that drives consumers or the other way around.
sentences.zh: 我们需要审视究竟是企业驱动消费者、还是反过来。

sentences.en: You need government to play a leadership role, whereas countries such as the UK seem to be stepping away from the environment in pursuit of short-term economic goals.'
sentences.zh: 你需要政府发挥领导作用，而像英国这样的国家似乎正在为追求短期经济目标而疏远环境。”
