sentences.en: A The book is called Fruit Trees and Useful Plants in the Lives of Amazonians, but is better known simply as the “fruit book”.
sentences.zh: 这本书叫《亚马孙人生活中的果树与有用植物》，但更简单地以“果书”而为人所知。

sentences.en: The second edition was produced at the request of politicians in western Amazonia.
sentences.zh: 第二版是应西亚马孙地区政客的请求制作的。

sentences.en: Its blend of hard science and local knowledge on the use and trade of 35 native forest species has been so well received (and well used) that no less a dignitary than Brazil’s environment minister, Marina Silva, has written the foreword.
sentences.zh: 它把硬科学与关于35种本土森林物种使用和贸易的本地知识相融合，受到了极好的接纳（也得到了很好的使用），以至于地位不亚于巴西环境部长玛丽娜·席尔瓦这样的要人为它作了序。

sentences.en: “There is nothing else like the Shanley book,” says Adalberto Veríssimo, director of the Institute of People and the Environment of the Amazon.
sentences.zh: 亚马孙人与环境研究所所长阿达尔贝托·韦里西莫说：“再没有别的东西像沙恩利这本书一样。

sentences.en: “It gives science back to the poor, to the people who really need it.”
sentences.zh: 它把科学还给穷人、还给真正需要它的人。”

sentences.en: B Shanley’s work on the book began a decade ago, with a plea for help from the Rural Workers’ Union of Paragominas, a Brazilian town whose prosperity is based on exploitation of timber.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利在这本书上的工作始于十年前，源于帕拉戈米纳斯农村工人工会的求助，那是一个繁荣建立在木材开采之上的巴西城镇。

sentences.en: The union realised that logging companies would soon be knocking on the doors of the caboclos, peasant farmers living on the Rio Capim, an Amazon tributary in the Brazilian state of Pará.
sentences.zh: 工会意识到，伐木公司很快就会敲响卡博克洛人的门，那是生活在卡平河沿岸的农民，卡平河是巴西帕拉州的一条亚马孙支流。

sentences.en: Isolated and illiterate, the caboclos would have little concept of the true value of their trees; communities downstream had already sold off large blocks of forest for a pittance.
sentences.zh: 与世隔绝又不识字的卡博克洛人，对他们树木的真正价值几乎没有概念；下游的社区已经以微薄的价格卖掉了大片森林。

sentences.en: “What they wanted to know was how valuable the forests were,” recalls Shanley, then a researcher in the area for the Massachusetts-based Woods Hole Research Centre.
sentences.zh: “他们想知道的是这些森林有多值钱，”当时在该地区做研究、来自马萨诸塞的伍兹霍尔研究中心的沙恩利回忆道。

sentences.en: C The Rural Workers’ Union wanted to know whether harvesting wild fruits would make economic sense in the Rio Capim.
sentences.zh: 帕拉戈米纳斯农村工人工会想知道，在卡平河采收野生果实在经济上是否说得通。

sentences.en: “There was a lot of interest in trading non-timber forest products (NTFPs),” Shanley says.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利说：“当时人们对交易非木材林产品很有兴趣。”

sentences.en: At the time, environmental groups and green-minded businesses were promoting the idea.
sentences.zh: 在那时，环保团体和有绿色意识的企业都在推广这个想法。

sentences.en: This was the view presented in a seminal paper, Valuation of an Amazonian Rainforest, published in Nature in 1989.
sentences.zh: 这是1989年发表在《自然》上一篇开创性论文《亚马孙雨林的估值》中所提出的观点。

sentences.en: The researchers had calculated that revenues from the sale of fruits could far exceed those from a one-off sale of trees to loggers.
sentences.zh: 研究人员曾计算出，出售果实的收入可能远超一次性把树卖给伐木者的收入。

sentences.en: “The union was keen to discover whether it made more sense conserving the forest for subsistence use and the possible sale of fruit, game and medicinal plants, than selling trees for timber,” says Shanley.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利说：“工会很想弄清楚，把森林保留下来供自家使用、并可能出售果实、猎物和药用植物，是否比把树卖作木材更有意义。”

sentences.en: Whether it would work for the caboclos was far from clear.
sentences.zh: 它对卡博克洛人是否行得通，远不清楚。

sentences.en: D Although Shanley had been invited to work in the Rio Capim, some caboclos were suspicious.
sentences.zh: 尽管沙恩利是受邀来卡平河工作的，但一些卡博克洛人心存疑虑。

sentences.en: “When Patricia asked if she could study my forest,” says Joao Fernando Moreira Brito, “my neighbours said she was a foreigner who’d come to rob me of my trees.”
sentences.zh: “当帕特里夏问她能不能研究我的森林时，”若昂·费尔南多·莫雷拉·布里托说，“我的邻居们说她是个来抢我树木的外国人。”

sentences.en: In the end, Moreira Brito, or Mangueira as he is known, welcomed Shanley and worked on her study.
sentences.zh: 最终，莫雷拉·布里托、即人们所称的曼盖拉，欢迎了沙恩利并参与了她的研究。

sentences.en: His land, an hour’s walk from the Rio Capim, is almost entirely covered with primary forest.
sentences.zh: 他的土地离卡平河有一小时步行路程，几乎完全覆盖着原始森林。

sentences.en: A study of this and other tracts of forest selected by the communities enabled Shanley to identify three trees, found throughout the Amazon, whose fruit was much favoured by the caboclos: bacuri (Platonia insignis), uxi (Endopleura uchi) and piquia (Caryocar villosum).
sentences.zh: 对这片以及社区选定的其他林地的研究，使沙恩利得以辨认出三种遍布亚马孙、其果实深受卡博克洛人喜爱的树：bacuri、uxi和piquia。

sentences.en: The caboclos used their fruits, extracted oils, and knew what sort of wildlife they attracted.
sentences.zh: 卡博克洛人使用它们的果实、提取油脂，并知道它们吸引什么样的野生动物。

sentences.en: But, in the face of aggressive tactics from the logging companies, they had no measure of the trees’ financial worth.
sentences.zh: 但面对伐木公司咄咄逼人的策略，他们对这些树的经济价值毫无衡量。

sentences.en: The only way to find out, Shanley decided, was to start from scratch with a scientific study.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利认定，弄清这一点的唯一办法是从头开始做一项科学研究。

sentences.en: “From a scientific point of view, hardly anything was known about these trees,” she says.
sentences.zh: 她说：“从科学的角度看，关于这些树几乎一无所知。”

sentences.en: But six years of field research yielded a mass of data on their flowering and fruiting behaviour.
sentences.zh: 但六年的田野研究产出了大量关于它们开花和结果行为的数据。

sentences.en: During 1993 and 1994, 30 families weighed everything they used from the forest – game, fruit, fibre, medicinal plants – and documented its source.
sentences.zh: 在1993年和1994年，有30个家庭称量了他们从森林中使用的一切——猎物、果实、纤维、药用植物——并记录其来源。

sentences.en: E After three logging sales and a major fire in 1997, the researchers were also able to study the ecosystem’s reaction to logging and disturbance.
sentences.zh: 在1997年的三次伐木销售和一场大火之后，研究人员还得以研究这个生态系统对伐木和扰动的反应。

sentences.en: They carried out a similar, though less exhaustive, study in 1999, this time with 15 families.
sentences.zh: 他们在1999年进行了一次类似但不那么详尽的研究，这次有15个家庭。

sentences.en: The changes were striking.
sentences.zh: 变化是惊人的。

sentences.en: Average annual household consumption of forest fruit had fallen from 89 to 28 kilograms between 1993 and 1999.
sentences.zh: 在1993年到1999年间，家庭年均森林果实消费量从89千克降到了28千克。

sentences.en: “What we found,” says Shanley, “was that fruit collection could coexist with a certain amount of logging, but after the forest fire, it dropped dramatically.”
sentences.zh: 沙恩利说：“我们发现，果实采集可以与一定量的伐木共存，但在那场森林大火之后，它急剧下降了。”

sentences.en: Over the same period, fibre use also dropped from around 20 to 4 kilograms.
sentences.zh: 在同一时期，纤维使用量也从约20千克降到了4千克。

sentences.en: The fire and logging also changed the nature of the caboclo diet.
sentences.zh: 大火和伐木还改变了卡博克洛人饮食的性质。

sentences.en: In 1993 most households ate game two or three times a month.
sentences.zh: 在1993年，大多数家庭一个月吃两三次猎物。

sentences.en: By 1999 some were fortunate if they ate game more than two or three times a year.
sentences.zh: 到1999年，有些家庭如果一年能吃上两三次以上的猎物就算幸运了。

sentences.en: F The loss of certain species of tree was especially significant.
sentences.zh: 某些树种的丧失尤其重大。

sentences.en: Shanley’s team persuaded local hunters to weigh their catch, noting the trees under which the animals were caught.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利的团队说服当地猎人称量他们的猎获，记下动物是在哪些树下捕到的。

sentences.en: Over the year, they trapped five species of game averaging 232 kilogrammes under piquia trees.
sentences.zh: 在这一年里，他们在piquia树下捕到五种、平均232千克的猎物。

sentences.en: Under copaiba, they caught just two species averaging 63 kilogrammes; and under uxi, four species weighing 38 kilogrammes.
sentences.zh: 在copaiba树下，他们只捕到两种、平均63千克；而在uxi树下，捕到四种、重38千克。

sentences.en: At last, the team was getting a handle on which trees were worth keeping, and which could reasonably be sold.
sentences.zh: 团队终于开始掌握哪些树值得保留、哪些可以合理地出售。

sentences.en: “This showed that selling piquia trees to loggers for a few dollars made little sense,” explains Shanley.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利解释说：“这表明把piquia树以几美元卖给伐木者没什么意义。

sentences.en: “Their local value lies in providing a prized fruit, as well as flowers which attract more game than any other species.”
sentences.zh: 它们的本地价值在于提供一种珍贵的果实、以及比任何其他物种都更能吸引猎物的花。”

sentences.en: G As a result of these studies, Shanley had to tell the Rural Workers’ Union of Paragominas that the Nature thesis could not be applied wholesale to their community – harvesting NTFPs would not always yield more than timber sales.
sentences.zh: 作为这些研究的结果，沙恩利不得不告诉帕拉戈米纳斯农村工人工会，《自然》上的论点不能整体套用到他们的社区——采收非木材林产品并不总能比木材销售产出更多。

sentences.en: Fruiting patterns of trees such as uxi were unpredictable, for example.
sentences.zh: 比如，uxi等树的结果模式难以预测。

sentences.en: In 1994, one household collected 3,654 uxi fruits; the following year, none at all.
sentences.zh: 在1994年，一户人家采集了3654个uxi果实；第二年，一个都没有。

sentences.en: H This is not to say that wild fruit trees were unimportant.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说野生果树不重要。

sentences.en: On the contrary, argues Shanley, they are critical for subsistence, something that is often ignored in much of the current research on NTFPs, which tends to focus on their commercial potential.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，沙恩利主张，它们对自给生存至关重要，而这一点在当前许多关于非木材林产品的研究中常常被忽视，那些研究往往聚焦于它们的商业潜力。

sentences.en: Geography was another factor preventing the Rio Capim caboclos from establishing a serious trade in wild fruit: villagers in remote areas could not compete with communities collecting NTFPs close to urban markets, although they could sell them to passing river boats.
sentences.zh: 地理是另一个阻碍卡平河卡博克洛人建立正经野生果实贸易的因素：偏远地区的村民无法与那些在城市市场附近采集非木材林产品的社区竞争，尽管他们可以把果实卖给路过的河船。

sentences.en: I But Shanley and her colleagues decided to do more than just report their results to the union.
sentences.zh: 但沙恩利和她的同事们决定做得比仅仅向工会报告他们的结果更多。

sentences.en: Together with two of her research colleagues, Shanley wrote the fruit book.
sentences.zh: 沙恩利和她的两位研究同事一起写了这本果书。

sentences.en: This, the Bible and a publication on medicinal plants co-authored by Shanley and designed for people with minimal literacy skills are about the only books you will see along this stretch of the Rio Capim.
sentences.zh: 这本书、《圣经》、以及一本由沙恩利合著、为识字能力有限的人设计的药用植物出版物，几乎是你在卡平河这一段沿岸会看到的仅有的书。

sentences.en: The first print run was only 3,000 copies, but the fruit book has been remarkably influential, and is used by colleges, peasant unions, industries and the caboclos themselves.
sentences.zh: 第一次印刷只有3000册，但这本果书影响力非凡，被各院校、农民工会、各行业以及卡博克洛人自己使用。

sentences.en: Its success is largely due to the fact that people with poor literacy skills can understand much of the information it contains about the non-timber forest products, thanks to its illustrations, anecdotes, stories and songs.
sentences.zh: 它的成功在很大程度上归功于这样一个事实，即识字能力差的人多亏其插图、轶事、故事和歌谣，能理解它所包含的许多关于非木材林产品的信息。

sentences.en: “The book doesn’t tell people what to do,” says Shanley, “but it does provide them with choices.”
sentences.zh: 沙恩利说：“这本书不告诉人们该做什么，但它确实为他们提供了选择。”

sentences.en: The caboclos who have used the book now have a much better understanding of which trees to sell to the loggers, and which to protect.
sentences.zh: 用过这本书的卡博克洛人现在对哪些树该卖给伐木者、哪些该保护，有了好得多的理解。

records.title: The New Zealand writer Margaret Mahy
records.titleZh: 新西兰作家玛格丽特·马希

sentences.en: (A) In a career spanning some fifty years, Margaret Mahy has come to occupy a unique place in New Zealand writing with innovative fiction and original characterisation.
sentences.zh: 在长达约五十年的职业生涯中，玛格丽特·马伊（Margaret Mahy）凭借创新性的小说和独特的人物塑造，在新西兰文学中占据了独一无二的位置。

sentences.en: In our solidly realist tradition, the linguistic fireworks of Mahy's children's fiction and the explorations of human behaviour at the heart of her supernatural teenage fiction stand gloriously alone.
sentences.zh: 在我们扎实的现实主义传统中，马伊儿童小说的语言烟花，以及她超自然青少年小说中对人类行为核心的探索，独自闪耀。

sentences.en: Mahy's clearest heir, I have always thought, is Elizabeth Knox — and maybe the true inheritance there is sheer singularity.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为，马伊最明显的继承者是伊丽莎白·诺克斯（Elizabeth Knox）——而也许真正的传承就在于绝对的独特性。

sentences.en: Just as there is no one else like Knox in New Zealand writing, Mahy, too, has ventured into imaginative territory unknown to other local writers.
sentences.zh: 正如在新西兰文学中没有人像诺克斯一样，马伊也涉足了其他本地作家未曾踏入的想象领域。

sentences.en: So it was with great pleasure that I visited Mahy recently at her Governor's Bay home to talk about her new book.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我最近在她位于总督湾的家中拜访她、讨论她的新书时，我倍感愉悦。

sentences.en: As with all journalists, she is generous to a fault with her time and attention; and, as always — despite her careful consideration of questions and thoughtful answers — I'm reminded she isn't truly comfortable making herself or her life the heart of any conversation.
sentences.zh: 和对所有记者一样，她把时间和注意力毫无保留地奉献出来；而且，一如既往——尽管她对问题的认真考量和深思熟虑的回答——我又一次被提醒：让自己或自己的生活成为任何对话的核心，她其实并不真正自在。

sentences.en: (B) Certainly, any consideration of the style of Mahy's novels and picture books throws up some irresistible theories.
sentences.zh: 当然，任何对马伊小说和图画书风格的考量都会带出一些难以抗拒的理论。

sentences.en: As a writer committed to supporting herself through her art, she has seldom had the time for formal research.
sentences.zh: 作为一名靠艺术养活自己的作家，她几乎没有时间做正式的研究。

sentences.en: Rather, it has been a matter of going out and finding inspiration from her immediate environment: the writing on the side of a bus; a spelling mistake in a note to herself; the similarity between a cat and a fur hat.
sentences.zh: 相反，她的方式是走出门，从身边环境中寻找灵感：公交车侧面的文字；写给自己的便条上的一处拼写错误；猫和皮帽之间的相似性。

sentences.en: But despite these sometimes mundane origins, the settings for her stories are delightfully varied, as these books celebrate the dramatic plot twists and unpredictability of adventures on the high seas or in Antarctica, and also in quite unassuming places like the library or even down the back of a chair at home.
sentences.zh: 但尽管这些起源有时颇为平凡，她故事的场景却令人愉悦地多种多样。这些书赞美公海上或南极上险境中的戏剧性情节转折与不可预测性，也歌颂相当不起眼之处——比如图书馆，甚至家中椅子背后。

sentences.en: Mahy has a lifelong affection for characters who are agents of upheaval and disturbance.
sentences.zh: 马伊对那些充当变乱与扰动之代理人的角色怀有终身的钟爱。

sentences.en: Her junior and picture books are peppered with pirates, robbers and lions, though they appear alongside librarians, mothers and children, working against comfortable stereotype.
sentences.zh: 她的初级读物和图画书中点缀着海盗、强盗和狮子，尽管它们与图书馆员、母亲和孩子并置出现，与舒适的刻板印象唱反调。

sentences.en: Her fictions often have at their heart a young adult burdened with special powers, such as the ability to cast spells in order to transform their world in supernatural and fantastical ways.
sentences.zh: 她的小说常常以一个背负特殊能力的青少年为核心，例如能够施咒，以超自然和幻想的方式改变其世界。

sentences.en: Another common feature is that, while the conclusions of her tales are usually predictable, they leave the reader feeling absolutely complete, the moral questions resulting from our hero's powers having been resolved.
sentences.zh: 另一个常见特征是：虽然她故事的结局通常是可预见的，但读者读完后感觉绝对的圆满——主人公能力所引发的道德问题已经得到化解。

sentences.en: (C) Many of these themes can be found in her new novel, The Magician of Hoad.
sentences.zh: 这些主题中的许多都能在她的新小说《霍亚德的魔法师》（The Magician of Hoad）中找到。

sentences.en: The book was begun more than 15 years ago and envisioned as an 'entire' fantasy — one set in a fully imagined world with detailed history and complex tribal inter-relationships, a classical hero quest at its heart.
sentences.zh: 这本书在 15 年多前动笔，被构想为一部“完整”的奇幻——背景设在一个被完整想象出的世界里，有详尽的历史和复杂的部落关系，核心是一个经典的英雄历险。

sentences.en: The story ballooned at one point to 800 pages and has been through at least two substantial rewrites.
sentences.zh: 故事一度膨胀到 800 页，至少经历过两次大规模重写。

sentences.en: Now half its original size, it is a fascinating read — an adventure, a romance, and a gold mine of Mahy literary preoccupations.
sentences.zh: 现在篇幅是最初的一半，读起来引人入胜——既是冒险、也是浪漫，更是马伊文学关注点的金矿。

sentences.en: (D) The other splendid Mahy publication this year is a re-issue of Bubble Trouble in a now-illustrated edition.
sentences.zh: 马伊今年另一项出色的出版物是《泡泡麻烦》（Bubble Trouble）的再版——一个现在配了插图的版本。

sentences.en: This tongue-twister tale first appeared in 1991, was included in 100 New Zealand Poems (1993) and has been recited by Mahy at countless private and public functions.
sentences.zh: 这则绕口令式的故事于 1991 年首次发表，被收入《100 首新西兰诗》（1993 年），并由马伊在无数私人和公开场合朗诵过。

sentences.en: Perhaps more than any other work, Bubble Trouble is the Mahy that New Zealand children and their parents know so well, the rollicking story of a clown who serves up a joyous torrent of word-play and unexpected rhyme.
sentences.zh: 也许比任何其他作品都更甚的是，《泡泡麻烦》是新西兰孩子和他们的父母最熟悉的马伊——一个小丑奉上的欢腾的文字游戏与意料之外押韵的故事。

sentences.en: (E) Those connections are four or five deep now.
sentences.zh: 这些联结现在已是四五代之深。

sentences.en: I read The Lion in the Meadow in the School Journal in the late 1960s; my step-daughter listened to The Boy Who Was Followed Home over and over in the 1970s; my own children sat very still mouthing The Great White Man-Eating Shark in the 80s and 90s; now, in the 21st century, my grandchildren have heard Down the Dragon's Tongue, A Summery Saturday Morning and Dashing Dog many times.
sentences.zh: 1960 年代末，我在《校刊》上读到《草地上的狮子》（The Lion in the Meadow）；70 年代我的继女反复听《被跟回家的男孩》（The Boy Who Was Followed Home）；80 至 90 年代我自己的孩子安静地坐着、嘴里念叨着《吃人的大白人鲨》（The Great White Man-Eating Shark）；现在到了 21 世纪，我的孙辈已经听过很多遍《沿龙舌而下》（Down the Dragon’s Tongue）、《一个夏日的星期六早晨》（A Summery Saturday Morning）和《飞奔的狗》（Dashing Dog）。

sentences.en: (F) Of course, readers are important to any working writer, but Mahy's espousal of the act of reading goes beyond that: a book is not properly finished, she has often said, until it has been read, because a reader brings something important to the book.
sentences.zh: 当然，读者对任何在工作的作家都很重要，但马伊对阅读这一行为的拥护远不止于此：她常说，一本书直到被阅读了才算真正完成，因为读者会为这本书带来某种重要的东西。

sentences.en: So, doubtless out of need to build a market — she's not ignorant of her popularity — but also out of genuine care for that other dynamic part of the author-reader relationship, Mahy has, until recently, kept up a punishing schedule of public appearances.
sentences.zh: 因此，无疑出于建立市场的需要——她并非不知自己受欢迎——但也出于对作者—读者关系中那另一动态部分的真诚关切，马伊直到最近仍保持着一种把人累垮的公开露面行程。

sentences.en: (G) Private conversation with Mahy has always been a wild ride — marvellous, in the true sense of the word, the product of a hungry head and an infinite capacity to be astonished.
sentences.zh: 与马伊的私下交谈一向是一次狂野的旅程——在这个词真正意义上的“奇妙”——出自一颗饥渴的头脑和无尽的惊讶能力。

sentences.en: She races away at one stage to consult an encyclopaedia for L.
sentences.zh: 她一度急忙离开去查百科全书，想知道 L.

sentences.en: M.
sentences.zh: M.

sentences.en: Montgomery's date of death, and speculates about the 'real' Montgomery, creator of the ever-popular Anne of Green Gables.
sentences.zh: 蒙哥马利（L. M. Montgomery）——广受欢迎的《绿山墙的安妮》的作者——的逝世日期，并对“真实的”蒙哥马利展开推测。

sentences.en: Although I'd come to talk about her new book, I couldn't help but be captivated by her infectious curiosity.
sentences.zh: 虽然我本来是来谈她的新书的，但我忍不住被她那感染性的好奇所迷住。

sentences.en: (H) A few years ago, the writer David Hill told a funny story.
sentences.zh: 几年前，作家戴维·希尔（David Hill）讲过一个有趣的故事。

sentences.en: Though his writing was, he conceded, very different from Mahy's, he had been affected by her peculiarly alert way of looking at the world, particularly the mad, slippery life of language.
sentences.zh: 他承认，他的写作与马伊的非常不同，但他被她那种特别警觉的观察世界的方式——尤其是语言疯狂、滑溜的生命——所影响。

sentences.en: Once, Hill said, in a motel room, a sign on a door caught his eye: 'This door is alarmed.'
sentences.zh: 希尔说，有一次在一家汽车旅馆房间里，一扇门上的标牌吸引了他的注意：“This door is alarmed.”（这扇门已设警报。）

sentences.en: Mahy would like that, thought Hill.
sentences.zh: 希尔想，马伊会喜欢这句的。

sentences.en: She would enjoy the comedy just below the surface of the formal warning; she would leap immediately to the possibilities for story and language play: 'Yes, and this window is concerned, this light fitting is irritated.'
sentences.zh: 她会享受正式警告下面隐藏的喜剧；她会立刻跳到讲故事和玩文字的可能性：“是的，而这扇窗户在担心，这盏灯具在烦躁。”

sentences.en: His story was a wonderful comment on Mahy's vision.
sentences.zh: 他的这个故事，是对马伊视野的一段精彩注脚。

sentences.en: (A) The Pirahã tribe live deep in Brazil’s Amazon forest, and their language is hotly debated by linguists.
sentences.zh: 皮拉罕（Pirahã）部落生活在巴西亚马逊森林深处，他们的语言在语言学家中争论激烈。

sentences.en: Since 1977, the ethnologist Daniel Everett has spent a total of seven years living with the Pirahã and has committed his career to studying their puzzling speech.
sentences.zh: 自 1977 年起，民族学家丹尼尔·埃弗里特（Daniel Everett）共在皮拉罕人中生活了七年，把自己的职业生涯投入到研究他们令人费解的语言。

sentences.en: Indeed, he was uncertain for so long about what he was actually hearing while living among the Pirahã that he waited nearly three decades before publishing his findings.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在与皮拉罕人相处期间，他对自己究竟听到了什么长期心存疑虑，以至于等待将近三十年才发表自己的发现。

sentences.en: (B) The debate over the Pirahã language goes right to the core of the riddle regarding how Homo sapiens managed to develop vocal communication.
sentences.zh: 关于皮拉罕语的争论直指智人如何发展出有声交流之谜的核心。

sentences.en: Although bees dance, birds sing and whales even sing with syntax, human language is unique, if only for the reason that it enables humans to piece together never-before-constructed thoughts, and be infinitely imaginative - think of Shakespeare’s plays or Einstein’s theory of relativity.
sentences.zh: 尽管蜜蜂会跳舞、鸟会唱歌、鲸甚至会以句法歌唱，但人类语言是独一无二的——哪怕仅因为它使人类能够把前所未有的思想拼接起来，并具有无穷的想象力——想想莎士比亚的剧作或爱因斯坦的相对论。

sentences.en: (C) Linguistics generally focuses on what features all human languages have in common, but the Pirahã language departs from what some academics have long maintained are essential and inalienable features of all human languages.
sentences.zh: 语言学一般关注所有人类语言共有的特征，但皮拉罕语却背离了一些学者长期以来所主张的、所有人类语言不可或缺的本质特征。

sentences.en: Most of all, it may be unique for not employing subordinate clauses.
sentences.zh: 最显著的是，它可能是独一无二地不使用从句。

sentences.en: Instead of saying, ‘When I have finished eating, I will speak to you,’ the Pirahã say, ‘I finish eating, I speak with you.’
sentences.zh: 皮拉罕人不说“我吃完饭后就跟你说话”，而是说“我吃完饭，我和你说话”。

sentences.en: Equally perplexing, the Pirahã appear not to use numbers.
sentences.zh: 同样令人困惑的是，皮拉罕人似乎不使用数字。

sentences.en: During the time he spent with them, Everett never heard words like ‘all’, ‘every’ and ‘more’.
sentences.zh: 在与他们相处期间，埃弗里特从未听到“所有”“每个”“更多”这样的词。

sentences.en: There is one word, ‘hoi’, that comes close to the numeral 1, but it can also mean ‘small’.
sentences.zh: 有一个词“hoi”接近数字“1”，但它也可以表示“小”。

sentences.en: And they were never observed to count without language, on their fingers for example, in order to determine important tasks in village life like how many pieces of meat to grill.
sentences.zh: 也从未观察到他们脱离语言用手指等方式计数，以决定村庄生活中重要的任务，比如要烤多少块肉。

sentences.en: (D) Everett’s findings among the Pirahã have brought new life to a controversial theory by the linguist Benjamin Whorf, who suggested that people are only capable of constructing thoughts for which they possess actual words.
sentences.zh: 埃弗里特在皮拉罕人中的发现，让语言学家本杰明·沃尔夫（Benjamin Whorf）一项有争议的理论重新焕发活力——他提出人们只能构造他们已有实际词语的思想。

sentences.en: Or to put it another way, because they have no words for numbers, they cannot even begin to understand the concept of numbers or arithmetic.
sentences.zh: 换言之，因为他们没有表示数字的词，他们甚至无法开始理解数字或算术的概念。

sentences.en: (E) The Warlpiri language - spoken by a group of Australian Aborigines - like that of the Pirahã, features only the most rudimentary system of counting.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔皮里语（Warlpiri）——一个澳大利亚原住民群体所说的语言——与皮拉罕语一样，只具备最初级的计数体系。

sentences.en: However, the Warlpiri people had no difficulty counting farther than three in a foreign language, in this case English, but when Everett attempted to teach the Pirahã how to count in Portuguese, like other Brazilians, not a single person could count to 10.
sentences.zh: 然而，瓦尔皮里人用外语（此处是英语）数到 3 以上毫不费力，但当埃弗里特尝试教皮拉罕人像其他巴西人一样用葡萄牙语数数时，没有一个人能数到 10。

sentences.en: (F) Everett is at pains to point out that the Pirahã are not unintelligent, for their thinking is not any slower than that of the average university student.
sentences.zh: 埃弗里特再三指出，皮拉罕人并非不聪明，他们的思考速度并不比一般大学生慢。

sentences.en: And although they reside in a remote part of the forest, they do not live in complete genetic isolation, but mix with people from the surrounding populations and share similar intellectual capacities with their neighbours whose languages do contain numbers.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们居住在森林的偏远地区，但他们并不处于完全的遗传隔离中——他们与周围族群有混居，并且与那些使用含数字语言的邻居拥有相似的智力能力。

sentences.en: (G) Eventually, after some 30 years of research, Everett has come up with a surprising explanation for the peculiarities of the Pirahã language.
sentences.zh: 经过约 30 年的研究，埃弗里特最终给出了关于皮拉罕语种种特殊性的一个惊人解释。

sentences.en: Language, he believes, is created by a people’s way of life, their belief system and values.
sentences.zh: 他认为，语言由一个民族的生活方式、信仰体系和价值观所创造。

sentences.en: In this way, variety in human language is almost limitless, a function of the human capacity to live in different ways, such as in the forest.
sentences.zh: 以这种方式来看，人类语言的多样性几乎是无限的，是人类以不同方式生活——例如在森林中——的能力的表现。

sentences.en: What Everett’s research has revealed is that the central tenet of the Pirahã culture is to live in the here and now.
sentences.zh: 埃弗里特的研究所揭示的是，皮拉罕文化的核心信条是活在当下。

sentences.en: The only thing of importance that is worth communicating to others is what is being experienced at that very moment, though this can often be described with great care and detail.
sentences.zh: 对他们而言，唯一值得向他人传达的重要事情是此时此刻所经历之事——尽管对此可以非常细致用心地描述。

sentences.en: In consequence, the language has no means to conjugate verbs in order to describe ‘yesterday’ or ‘last week’ or ‘when I was a child’.
sentences.zh: 因此，这门语言没有任何手段去变化动词来描述“昨天”“上周”或“我小时候”。

sentences.en: Their very literal view of the world curtails abstract thought, and many features taken for granted among other peoples are absent among the Pirahã, such as a creation myth, storytelling and painting.
sentences.zh: 他们对世界极其字面化的看法限制了抽象思考，许多在其他民族中视为理所当然的特征在皮拉罕人中是缺失的，例如创世神话、讲故事和绘画。

sentences.en: One manifestation of their beliefs is that by tradition the names they give their children are not particularly imaginative.
sentences.zh: 他们信仰的一种表现是，按传统给孩子取的名字并不特别富有想象力。

sentences.en: Often they are named after other members of the tribe with whom they share similar character traits.
sentences.zh: 他们常以部落中性格相近的其他成员的名字为孩子命名。

sentences.en: Standing out or being different is not encouraged by the Pirahã, and this is reflected in their perhaps colourless choice of names.
sentences.zh: 皮拉罕人不鼓励出风头或与众不同，这反映在他们或许略显单调的取名上。

sentences.en: (H) Everett anticipated that these findings would be controversial and the reaction came as expected.
sentences.zh: 埃弗里特预料到这些发现会引发争议，反应正如所料。

sentences.en: Until this point, many linguists had defended the theories of Noam Chomsky, according to which all human languages have a universal grammar.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，许多语言学家一直为诺姆·乔姆斯基（Noam Chomsky）的理论辩护，即所有人类语言都具有普遍语法。

sentences.en: What exactly makes up this universal grammar is the subject of debate, but at its heart is the concept of ‘recursion’, which is defined as replication of a structure within its single parts.
sentences.zh: 这种普遍语法的具体内容是争论的话题，但其核心是“递归”的概念，被定义为在一个结构内复制其单个组成部分。

sentences.en: Without it, humans would not be able to view separate thoughts as subordinate parts of a complex whole.
sentences.zh: 没有递归，人类就无法把分立的思想视为复杂整体中的从属部分。

sentences.en: And, most pertinent to Everett’s work, there would not be subordinate clauses, which are responsible for translating the concept of recursion into grammar.
sentences.zh: 对埃弗里特的工作最直接相关的是：那样就不会有从句——把递归概念翻译为语法的载体。

sentences.en: But if the Pirahã do not form subordinate clauses, then recursion cannot explain the uniqueness of human language, and this would negate Chomsky’s theories.
sentences.zh: 但如果皮拉罕人不构造从句，那么递归就不能解释人类语言的独特性，这将否定乔姆斯基的理论。

sentences.en: (I) The logical way forward now would be to try to prove that the Pirahã can think in a recursive fashion.
sentences.zh: 接下来合乎逻辑的做法是尝试证明皮拉罕人可以以递归方式思考。

sentences.en: The only problem is, nobody can confirm or deny Everett’s observations since no other researcher can speak Pirahã as well as he does.
sentences.zh: 唯一的问题是，没人能确认或否认埃弗里特的观察——因为没有其他研究者能像他那样精通皮拉罕语。

sentences.en: Despite this, several researchers - including two of Chomsky’s colleagues - will soon travel to Brazil to check his claims.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，包括乔姆斯基两位同事在内的几位研究者很快将前往巴西核查他的说法。

sentences.en: My concern is that soon the Pirahã will simply become one more scientific oddity with every aspect of their lives being exploited and analysed.
sentences.zh: 我担心的是，皮拉罕人很快会沦为又一个被科学奇观式地展示与剖析的对象——他们生活的方方面面都被开发和分析。

records.title: The Significant Role of Mother Tongue in Education
records.titleZh: 母语在教育中的重要作用

sentences.en: (A) One consequence of population mobility is an increasing diversity within schools.
sentences.zh: 人口流动的一个后果是学校内部日益增长的多样性。

sentences.en: To illustrate, in the city of Toronto in Canada, 58% of kindergarten pupils come from homes where English is not the usual language of communication.
sentences.zh: 举例来说，在加拿大多伦多市，58%的幼儿园学童来自英语不是日常交流语言的家庭。

sentences.en: Schools in Europe and North America have experienced this diversity for years, and educational policies and practices vary widely between countries and even within countries.
sentences.zh: 欧洲和北美的学校多年来一直经历着这种多样性，而教育政策和做法在各国之间、甚至各国内部都差异很大。

sentences.en: Some political parties and groups search for ways to solve the problem of diverse communities and their integration in schools and society.
sentences.zh: 一些政党和团体寻找办法来解决多元社区及其融入学校和社会的问题。

sentences.en: However, they see few positive consequences for the host society and worry that this diversity threatens the identity of the host society.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们看到对东道社会的积极后果很少，并担心这种多样性威胁到东道社会的认同。

sentences.en: Consequently, they promote unfortunate educational policies that will make the “problem” disappear.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们推行一些不幸的教育政策，让这个“问题”消失。

sentences.en: If students retain their culture and language, they are viewed as less capable of identifying with the mainstream culture and learning the mainstream language of the society.
sentences.zh: 如果学生保留自己的文化和语言，他们就被视为不太能够认同主流文化、学习社会的主流语言。

sentences.en: (B) The challenge for educators and policy-makers is to shape the evolution of national identity in such a way that the rights of all citizens (including school children) are respected, and the cultural, linguistic, and economic resources of the nation are maximised.
sentences.zh: 对教育者和政策制定者的挑战，是以这样一种方式来塑造国家认同的演变，即所有公民（包括学童）的权利都得到尊重，而国家的文化、语言和经济资源得到最大化。

sentences.en: To waste the resources of the nation by discouraging children from developing their mother tongues is quite simply unintelligent from the point of view of national self-interest.
sentences.zh: 从国家自身利益的角度看，通过劝阻孩子发展他们的母语来浪费国家的资源，简直就是不明智的。

sentences.en: A first step in providing an appropriate education for culturally and linguistically diverse children is to examine what the existing research says about the role of children's mother tongues in their educational development.
sentences.zh: 为文化和语言多元的孩子提供恰当教育的第一步，是审视现有研究对孩子母语在其教育发展中作用的看法。

sentences.en: (C) In fact, the research is very clear.
sentences.zh: 事实上，研究非常清楚。

sentences.en: When children continue to develop their abilities in two or more languages throughout their primary school, they gain a deeper understanding of language and how to use it effectively.
sentences.zh: 当孩子在整个小学阶段继续发展他们两门或更多语言的能力时，他们会对语言、以及如何有效地使用它获得更深的理解。

sentences.en: They have more practice in processing language, especially when they develop literacy in both.
sentences.zh: 他们在处理语言方面有更多的练习，尤其是当他们在两门语言中都发展出读写能力时。

sentences.en: More than 150 research studies conducted during the past 25 years strongly support what Goethe, the famous eighteenth-century German philosopher, once said: the person who knows only one language does not truly know that language.
sentences.zh: 在过去25年里进行的150多项研究有力地支持了著名的十八世纪德国哲学家歌德曾说过的话：只懂一门语言的人并不真正懂那门语言。

sentences.en: Research suggests that bilingual children may also develop more flexibility in their thinking as a result of processing information through two different languages.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，双语儿童也可能由于通过两门不同的语言处理信息，而在思维上发展出更多的灵活性。

sentences.en: (D) The level of development of children's mother tongue is a strong predictor of their second language development.
sentences.zh: 孩子母语的发展水平是其第二语言发展的一个有力预测指标。

sentences.en: Children who come to school with a solid foundation in their mother tongue develop stronger literacy abilities in the school language.
sentences.zh: 带着扎实母语基础来上学的孩子，在学校语言中发展出更强的读写能力。

sentences.en: When parents and other caregivers (e.g., grandparents) are able to spend time with their children and tell stories or discuss issues with them in a way that develops their mother tongue, children come to school well-prepared to learn the school language and succeed educationally.
sentences.zh: 当父母和其他照护者（例如祖父母）能够花时间陪孩子、以一种发展其母语的方式给他们讲故事或与他们讨论问题时，孩子来上学时就为学习学校语言、并在教育上取得成功做好了充分的准备。

sentences.en: Children's knowledge and skills transfer across languages from the mother tongue to the school language.
sentences.zh: 孩子的知识和技能会跨语言地从母语迁移到学校语言。

sentences.en: Transfer across languages can be two-way: both languages nurture each other when the educational environment permits children access to both languages.
sentences.zh: 跨语言的迁移可以是双向的：当教育环境允许孩子接触两门语言时，两门语言会相互滋养。

sentences.en: (E) Some educators and parents are suspicious of mother tongue-based teaching programs because they worry that they take time away from the majority language.
sentences.zh: 一些教育者和家长对以母语为基础的教学项目心存疑虑，因为他们担心这些项目会占用学习主流语言的时间。

sentences.en: For example, in a bilingual program when 50% of the time is spent teaching through children's home language and 50% through the majority language, surely children won't progress as far in the latter?
sentences.zh: 比如，在一个双语项目中，当50%的时间用来通过孩子的家庭语言教学、50%通过主流语言时，孩子在后者上肯定不会进步得那么远吧？

sentences.en: One of the most strongly established findings of educational research, however, is that well-implemented bilingual programs can promote literacy and subject-matter knowledge in a minority language without any negative effects on children's development in the majority language.
sentences.zh: 然而，教育研究最有力确立的发现之一是，实施得当的双语项目能够在不对孩子主流语言发展产生任何负面影响的情况下，促进少数语言的读写能力和学科知识。

sentences.en: Within Europe, the Foyer program in Belgium, which develops children's speaking and literacy abilities in three languages (their mother tongue, Dutch and French), most clearly illustrates the benefits of bilingual and trilingual education (see Cummins, 2000).
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，比利时的Foyer项目发展孩子三门语言（他们的母语、荷兰语和法语）的口语和读写能力，最清楚地说明了双语和三语教育的好处（见卡明斯，2000）。

sentences.en: (F) It is easy to understand how this happens.
sentences.zh: 很容易理解这是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: When children are learning through a minority language, they are learning concepts and intellectual skills too.
sentences.zh: 当孩子通过一门少数语言学习时，他们也在学习概念和智力技能。

sentences.en: Pupils who know how to tell the time in their mother tongue understand the concept of telling time.
sentences.zh: 会用母语报时的学生理解报时这个概念。

sentences.en: In order to tell time in the majority language, they do not need to re-learn the concept.
sentences.zh: 为了用主流语言报时，他们不需要重新学习这个概念。

sentences.en: Similarly, at more advanced stages, there is transfer across languages in other skills such as knowing how to distinguish the main idea from the supporting details of a written passage or story, and distinguishing fact from opinion.
sentences.zh: 同样，在更高级的阶段，在其他技能上也有跨语言的迁移，比如懂得如何把一篇书面文章或故事的主旨与支撑细节区分开来、以及区分事实与观点。

sentences.en: Studies of secondary school pupils are providing interesting findings in this area, and it would be worth extending this research.
sentences.zh: 对中学生的研究正在这一领域提供有意思的发现，而拓展这项研究会很值得。

sentences.en: (G) Many people marvel at how quickly bilingual children seem to “pick up” conversational skills in the majority language at school (although it takes much longer for them to catch up with native speakers in academic language skills).
sentences.zh: 许多人惊叹于双语儿童在学校里似乎多么快就“学会”了主流语言的会话技能（尽管他们要在学术语言技能上赶上母语者要花长得多的时间）。

sentences.en: However, educators are often much less aware of how quickly children can lose their ability to use their mother tongue, even in the home context.
sentences.zh: 然而，教育者往往远没那么意识到，孩子能多么快地失去使用自己母语的能力，即便是在家庭情境中。

sentences.en: The extent and rapidity of language loss will vary according to the concentration of families from a particular linguistic group in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 语言流失的程度和速度会根据某个特定语言群体的家庭在社区中的集中程度而有所不同。

sentences.en: Where the mother tongue is used extensively in the community, then language loss among young children will be less.
sentences.zh: 在母语于社区中被广泛使用的地方，幼儿中的语言流失就会较少。

sentences.en: However, where language communities are not concentrated in particular neighborhoods, children can lose their ability to communicate in their mother tongue within 2–3 years of starting school.
sentences.zh: 然而，在语言群体没有集中于特定社区的地方，孩子可能在开始上学后的2到3年内就失去用母语交流的能力。

sentences.en: They may retain receptive skills in the language but they will use the majority language in speaking with their peers and siblings and in responding to their parents.
sentences.zh: 他们也许保留对该语言的接受性技能，但他们在与同伴和兄弟姐妹说话、以及回应父母时会使用主流语言。

sentences.en: By the time children become adolescents, the linguistic division between parents and children has become an emotional chasm.
sentences.zh: 等孩子进入青春期时，父母与孩子之间的语言鸿沟已经变成了一道情感上的深渊。

sentences.en: Pupils frequently become alienated from the cultures of both home and school with predictable results.
sentences.zh: 学生常常与家庭和学校两种文化都疏离开来，并带来可以预见的后果。

records.title: The tuatara-past and future
records.titleZh: 图阿塔拉的过去与未来

sentences.en: (A) The New Zealand species of lizard, the tuatara, is firmly embedded in the national psyche: an icon for today which dates from the age of dinosaurs; an ancient reptile commemorated on the back of the five-cent coin.
sentences.zh: 新西兰的蜥蜴物种喙头蜥牢牢嵌入了民族的心理：一个源自恐龙时代的当代标志；一种被纪念在五分硬币背面的古老爬行动物。

sentences.en: New Zealanders feel an affinity with the tuatara, and accept that active conservation management is required to ensure it will be among the legacies left to future generations.
sentences.zh: 新西兰人对喙头蜥怀有一种亲近感，并接受需要积极的保护管理来确保它将位列留给后代的遗产之中。

sentences.en: When European explorers reached New Zealand in 1769 they found two large islands, which together they called the mainland, and many tiny offshore islands around the coast.
sentences.zh: 当欧洲探险家在1769年到达新西兰时，他们发现了两个大岛，他们把它们合称为本岛，以及海岸周围许多微小的近海岛屿。

sentences.en: The naturalists who came with the explorers disregarded the tuatara, though it is improbable none were seen.
sentences.zh: 随探险家而来的博物学家无视了喙头蜥，尽管一只都没见到是不大可能的。

sentences.en: Only several decades later did a tuatara specimen reach the British Museum, where it was eventually classified as just another type of lizard.
sentences.zh: 直到几十年后，一只喙头蜥标本才抵达大英博物馆，在那里它最终被归类为不过是又一种蜥蜴。

sentences.en: (B) One of the first scientists who realised that aspects of tuatara anatomy were odd—unchanged for tens of thousands of years—was Albert Gunther in 1876.
sentences.zh: 最早意识到喙头蜥解剖结构的某些方面很奇特——数万年来未曾改变——的科学家之一，是1876年的阿尔伯特·京特。

sentences.en: Gunther believed the tuatara was one of the most valuable objects in zoological anatomical collections, and also noted, in passing, the reptile was likely to become extinct.
sentences.zh: 京特相信喙头蜥是动物解剖收藏中最有价值的对象之一，还顺带指出，这种爬行动物很可能会灭绝。

sentences.en: From today's perspective, it is striking that Gunther expressed no concern about the probable demise of the tuatara.
sentences.zh: 从今天的视角看，引人注目的是京特对喙头蜥可能的消亡没有表达任何担忧。

sentences.en: He and his contemporaries were products of their age, strongly influenced by Charles Darwin's theory, which had only recently been published.
sentences.zh: 他和他的同时代人是他们那个时代的产物，深受查尔斯·达尔文理论的影响，而那一理论当时刚刚发表不久。

sentences.en: Their views were something like this: 'Extinction is a natural process.
sentences.zh: 他们的看法大致是这样：“灭绝是一个自然的过程。

sentences.en: It is sad that species disappear, but that is part of nature.'
sentences.zh: 物种消失是令人悲伤的，但那是自然的一部分。”

sentences.en: (C) There is a second important aspect of Gunther's work.
sentences.zh: 京特的工作还有第二个重要的方面。

sentences.en: He recorded, correctly, that some of the mammals introduced by Europeans were predators of the tuatara—particularly rats.
sentences.zh: 他正确地记录下，欧洲人引入的一些哺乳动物是喙头蜥的捕食者——尤其是老鼠。

sentences.en: But what he did not realise was that New Zealand has two species of rat, both introduced, both with an appetite for tuatara: the ship's rat came with European explorers and settlers; but the kiore rat had already been in the country for hundreds of years, brought by Polynesians from the Pacific Islands.
sentences.zh: 但他没意识到的是，新西兰有两种老鼠，都是引入的，都对喙头蜥有胃口：船鼠随欧洲探险家和定居者而来；但kiore鼠数百年前就已在这个国家，是波利尼西亚人从太平洋群岛带来的。

sentences.en: Gunther failed to recognise the distinction, believing all rats to be a relatively recent introduction.
sentences.zh: 京特没能认出这一区别，相信所有老鼠都是相对晚近才引入的。

sentences.en: Little further research was conducted until Ian Crook of the NZ Wildlife Service published his findings in 1973, which can be summarised as follows.
sentences.zh: 此后很少有进一步的研究，直到新西兰野生动物局的伊恩·克鲁克在1973年发表了他的发现，可概括如下。

sentences.en: Tuatara thrive on offshore islands with no rats.
sentences.zh: 喙头蜥在没有老鼠的近海岛屿上繁荣。

sentences.en: Tuatara never survived on islands with ship's rats.
sentences.zh: 喙头蜥从未在有船鼠的岛屿上存活。

sentences.en: On a few islands, small and declining populations of tuatara occur with the kiore.
sentences.zh: 在少数几个岛屿上，喙头蜥与kiore鼠一起出现，种群小且在减少。

sentences.en: This should not be seen, however, as evidence that tuatara and kiore can coexist.
sentences.zh: 然而，这不应被看作喙头蜥和kiore鼠能共存的证据。

sentences.en: Rather, Crook proposed, kiore probably only arrived recently on such islands, and thus the small populations represent extinctions in progress.
sentences.zh: 相反，克鲁克提出，kiore鼠很可能只是晚近才到达这些岛屿，因此这些小种群代表着正在进行中的灭绝。

sentences.en: (D) Throughout the 1990s, Richard Holdaway and his colleagues at Victoria University in Wellington documented the surprising discovery that kiore probably arrived about 1,800 years ago, although the human population of New Zealand is thought to be no older than 800 years.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪90年代，理查德·霍尔德韦和他在惠灵顿维多利亚大学的同事记录了一个令人惊讶的发现，即kiore鼠很可能在约1800年前到达，尽管新西兰的人类居民被认为不早于800年前。

sentences.en: How is this possible?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能呢？

sentences.en: Presumably, Holdaway argued, the kiore were brought by Polynesian explorers who visited the country but did not settle.
sentences.zh: 霍尔德韦主张，kiore鼠大概是由造访过这个国家、却没有定居的波利尼西亚探险家带来的。

sentences.en: Thereafter, the rats were agents of ecological warfare, exterminating perhaps 1,000–3,000 species.
sentences.zh: 此后，这些老鼠成了生态战的施动者，灭绝了或许1000到3000个物种。

sentences.en: Thus, tuatara and many other species were already rare or extinct when permanent human inhabitants—the Maori—arrived around 1300.
sentences.zh: 因此，当永久的人类居民——毛利人——在约1300年到达时，喙头蜥和许多其他物种已经稀有或灭绝了。

sentences.en: This hypothesis is still being debated, but the evidence continues to accumulate in its favour.
sentences.zh: 这一假说仍在被争论，但证据持续地朝有利于它的方向积累。

sentences.en: (E) Conservation practice has changed dramatically since Crook's findings were published in 1973.
sentences.zh: 自克鲁克的发现在1973年发表以来，保护实践发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: Eradication of rats from any given environment was believed to be virtually impossible until about 1980, but since then has become routine.
sentences.zh: 从任何给定环境中根除老鼠，在约1980年之前一直被认为几乎不可能，但自那以后已变得司空见惯。

sentences.en: Enormous conservation benefits are accruing as newly rat-free offshore islands are providing sanctuaries for the country's rarest species.
sentences.zh: 随着新近无鼠的近海岛屿正为这个国家最稀有的物种提供庇护所，巨大的保护效益正在累积。

sentences.en: In 1995, for example, Nicola Nelson of the Department of Conservation established 68 tuatara on Titi Island.
sentences.zh: 比如在1995年，自然保护部的妮古拉·纳尔逊在提蒂岛上建立了68只喙头蜥。

sentences.en: Since then, four more populations of tuatara have been established elsewhere under similar conditions.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，又有另外四个喙头蜥种群在类似条件下于别处建立起来。

sentences.en: Today, numbers of tuatara are still a fraction of what they once were, but for the first time in 1,800 years the decline has been reversed.
sentences.zh: 今天，喙头蜥的数量仍只是它们曾经数量的一小部分，但1800年来第一次，这种下降被逆转了。

sentences.en: (F) While the recovery of rare species is itself a good thing, the truly significant outcome of this research is that it liberates the imagination.
sentences.zh: 虽然稀有物种的恢复本身是件好事，但这项研究真正重大的成果在于它解放了想象力。

sentences.en: If we can remove predatory introduced mammals from islands, why not from the mainland too?
sentences.zh: 如果我们能把捕食性的引入哺乳动物从岛屿上清除，为什么不也从本岛上清除呢？

sentences.en: Perhaps the questions we ask should demonstrate even more visionary ambition.
sentences.zh: 也许我们提出的问题应该展现出更有远见的雄心。

sentences.en: Can non-mammalian pests also be removed from the mainland?
sentences.zh: 非哺乳类的有害物种也能从本岛上清除吗？

sentences.en: Our rivers, for example, are full of surrogate rats, in the form of introduced species of fish called trout.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们的河流里满是替身老鼠，以一种叫鳟鱼的引入鱼类的形式。

sentences.en: Some day more people will understand that trout have replaced a whole native fauna in our waterways, just as rats replaced tuatara on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 有朝一日会有更多人明白，鳟鱼在我们的水道里取代了一整套本土动物群，正如老鼠在本岛上取代了喙头蜥。

sentences.en: Will such knowledge lead to the creation of mainland 'aquatic islands' where we can once again establish those species of indigenous fish that used to live in our rivers?
sentences.zh: 这样的知识会不会导致本岛“水生岛屿”的创建，在那里我们可以再一次建立起那些曾经生活在我们河流里的本土鱼类物种？

sentences.en: Similarly, can bellbirds and tuis replace birds like starlings and mynahs?
sentences.zh: 同样，钟鸟和图伊鸟能取代椋鸟和鹩哥这样的鸟吗？

sentences.en: The answers to such questions are uncertain, and opposing sides will doubtless be fiercely debated.
sentences.zh: 这类问题的答案是不确定的，而对立的各方无疑将激烈地争论。

sentences.en: But the role of scientific knowledge in illuminating the past will be crucial.
sentences.zh: 但科学知识在照亮过去方面的作用将至关重要。

sentences.en: Just as we no longer tolerate extinction, in the future we may no longer accept a mainland devoid of the biological wonders of our past such as tuatara.
sentences.zh: 正如我们不再容忍灭绝，在未来我们也许不再接受一个没有我们过去那些生物奇迹、比如喙头蜥的本岛。

sentences.en: Conservation is thus not primarily about the past but about imagining and then creating the future we wish for our children and ourselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，保护主要不是关于过去，而是关于想象、然后创造我们为我们的孩子和我们自己所希望的未来。

sentences.en: For 80 million years until humans arrived, tuatara occurred throughout New Zealand—might they do so again?
sentences.zh: 在人类到来之前的八千万年里，喙头蜥遍布整个新西兰——它们会不会再一次如此呢？

sentences.en: (A) The starkly modern Beinecke Library at Yale University is home to some of the most valuable books in the world: first folios of Shakespeare, Gutenberg Bibles and manuscripts from the early Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 耶鲁大学风格鲜明的现代派拜内克图书馆收藏着世界上一些最珍贵的图书：莎士比亚作品的初版对开本、古登堡《圣经》以及来自中世纪早期的手稿。

sentences.en: Yet the library's most controversial possession is an unprepossessing vellum manuscript about the size of a hardback book, containing 240-odd pages of drawings and text of unknown age and authorship.
sentences.zh: 然而该图书馆最具争议的藏品却是一份不起眼的羊皮纸手稿，大小约相当于一本精装书，包含 240 多页年代和作者不详的图画与文字。

sentences.en: Catalogued as MS 408, the manuscript would attract little attention were it not for the fact that the drawings hint at esoteric knowledge, while the text seems to be some sort of code — one that no-one has been able to break.
sentences.zh: 目录编号为 MS 408，如果不是因为这些图画暗指深奥知识、而文字看起来像某种无人能破译的密码，这份手稿不会引起多少关注。

sentences.en: It is known to scholars as the Voynich manuscript, after the American book-dealer Wilfrid Voynich, who bought the manuscript from a Jesuit college in Italy in 1912.
sentences.zh: 它在学者中被称为“伏尼契手稿”——以美国书商威尔弗里德·伏尼契（Wilfrid Voynich）命名；他在 1912 年从意大利的一所耶稣会学院买下了这份手稿。

sentences.en: Over the years, the manuscript has attracted the attention of everyone from amateur dabblers to top code-breakers, all determined to succeed where countless others have failed.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这份手稿吸引了从业余涉猎者到顶级密码破译者所有人的注意，他们都决心在无数前人失败的地方取得成功。

sentences.en: Academic research papers, books and websites are devoted to making sense of the contents of the manuscript, which are freely available to all.
sentences.zh: 学术研究论文、书籍和网站都致力于厘清手稿内容的含义——所有这些资源对所有人都是免费可得的。

sentences.en: “Most other mysteries involve second-hand reports,” says Dr Gordon Rugg of Keele University, a leading Voynich expert.
sentences.zh: “大多数其他谜团都涉及二手报告，”基尔大学（Keele University）的戈登·拉格博士（Dr Gordon Rugg）说，他是研究伏尼契手稿的领军学者。

sentences.en: “But this is one that you can see for yourself.”
sentences.zh: “但这一份你可以自己亲眼看到。”

sentences.en: (B) It is certainly strange: page after page of drawings of weird plants, astrological symbolism and human figures, accompanied by a script that looks like some form of shorthand.
sentences.zh: 它确实奇怪：一页页的奇异植物、占星象征和人形画作，伴有看起来像某种速记的文字。

sentences.en: What does it say — and what are the drawings about?
sentences.zh: 它说的是什么——以及那些图画又是关于什么的？

sentences.en: Voynich himself believed that the manuscript was the work of the 13th-century English monk Roger Bacon, famed for his knowledge of alchemy, philosophy and science.
sentences.zh: 伏尼契本人相信，这份手稿是 13 世纪英国修士罗杰·培根（Roger Bacon）的作品；培根以其对炼金术、哲学和科学的知识而闻名。

sentences.en: In 1921 Voynich's view that Bacon was the writer appeared to win support from the work of William Newbold, Professor of Philosophy at the University of Pennsylvania, who claimed to have found the key to the cipher system used by Bacon.
sentences.zh: 1921 年，伏尼契关于培根就是作者的看法似乎得到了宾夕法尼亚大学哲学教授威廉·纽博尔德（William Newbold）研究的支持——他声称找到了培根所用密码体系的密钥。

sentences.en: According to Newbold, the manuscript proved that Bacon had access to a microscope centuries before they were supposedly first invented.
sentences.zh: 按纽博尔德的说法，这份手稿证明培根比显微镜被假定首次发明的时间早了几个世纪就接触过显微镜。

sentences.en: The claim that this medieval monk had observed living cells created a sensation.
sentences.zh: 这位中世纪修士已观察到活细胞的说法引起了轰动。

sentences.en: It soon became clear, however, that Newbold had fallen victim to wishful thinking.
sentences.zh: 然而很快就清楚，纽博尔德陷入了一厢情愿的想法。

sentences.en: Other scholars showed that his “decoding” methods produced a host of possible interpretations.
sentences.zh: 其他学者表明，他的“解码”方法可以产生大量可能的诠释。

sentences.en: (C) The Voynich manuscript has continued to defy the efforts of world-class experts.
sentences.zh: 伏尼契手稿一直让世界级专家的努力受挫。

sentences.en: In 1944, a team was assembled to tackle the mystery, led by William Friedman, the renowned American code breaker.
sentences.zh: 1944 年，一支团队组建起来攻克这一谜团，由著名美国密码破译者威廉·弗里德曼（William Friedman）领导。

sentences.en: They began with the most basic code-breaking task: analysing the relative frequencies of the characters making up the text, looking for signs of an underlying structure.
sentences.zh: 他们从最基本的破译任务入手：分析构成文本的字符的相对频率，以寻找潜在结构的迹象。

sentences.en: Yet Friedman's team soon found themselves in deep water.
sentences.zh: 但弗里德曼的团队很快发现自己陷入了困境。

sentences.en: The precise size of the “alphabet” of the Voynich manuscript was unclear: it is possible to make out more than 70 distinct symbols among the 170,000-character text.
sentences.zh: 伏尼契手稿“字母表”的确切规模并不清楚：在 170000 个字符的文本中可以辨认出 70 多个不同符号。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Friedman discovered that some words and phrases appeared more often than expected in a standard language, casting doubt on claims that the manuscript concealed a real language, as encryption typically reduces word frequencies.
sentences.zh: 此外，弗里德曼发现，相比于一种标准语言，某些词和短语出现的频率高于预期，这让人怀疑手稿是否真的隐藏了一种真实语言——因为加密通常会降低词频。

sentences.en: Friedman concluded that the most plausible resolution of this paradox was that “Voynichese” is some sort of specially created artificial language, whose words are devised from concepts rather than linguistics.
sentences.zh: 弗里德曼得出结论，对这一悖论最合理的解决是“”伏尼契语“是某种特别创制的人工语言，其词汇是按概念而非语言学原理设计的”。

sentences.en: So could the Voynich manuscript be the earliest-known example of an artificial language?
sentences.zh: 那么，伏尼契手稿会是已知最早的人工语言示例吗？

sentences.en: “Friedman's hypothesis commands respect because of the lifetime of cryptanalytic expertise he brought to bear,” says Rob Churchill, co-author of The Voynich Manuscript.
sentences.zh: “弗里德曼的假说值得尊重，因为他带去的是一生的密码分析专长，”《伏尼契手稿》合著者罗布·丘吉尔（Rob Churchill）说。

sentences.en: That still leaves a host of questions unanswered, however, such as the identity of the author and the meaning of the bizarre drawings.
sentences.zh: 然而这仍然留下了一大堆悬而未决的问题，例如作者的身份和那些怪异图画的含义。

sentences.en: “It does little to advance our understanding of the manuscript as a whole,” says Churchill.
sentences.zh: “它对推进我们对整份手稿的理解作用甚微，”丘吉尔说。

sentences.en: (D) Even though Friedman was working more than 60 years ago, he suspected that major insights would come from using the device that had already transformed code-breaking: the computer.
sentences.zh: 尽管弗里德曼是在 60 多年前从事这项工作的，他仍然猜想，使用那台已经改变密码破译的设备——计算机——将带来重大洞见。

sentences.en: In this he was right — it is now the key tool for uncovering clues about the manuscript's language.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上他是对的——它现在是揭示手稿语言线索的关键工具。

sentences.en: The insights so far have been perplexing.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止得到的洞见令人困惑。

sentences.en: For example, in 2001 another leading Voynich scholar, Dr Gabriel Landini of Birmingham University in the UK, published the results of his study of the manuscript using a pattern-detecting method called spectral analysis.
sentences.zh: 例如，在 2001 年，另一位领军的伏尼契学者、英国伯明翰大学的加布里埃尔·兰迪尼博士（Dr Gabriel Landini）发表了他用一种叫做谱分析的模式检测方法研究该手稿的结果。

sentences.en: This revealed evidence that the manuscript contains genuine words, rather than random nonsense, consistent with the existence of some underlying natural language.
sentences.zh: 这显示了证据：手稿包含真实的词语，而非随机的胡言乱语，与某种潜在自然语言的存在相一致。

sentences.en: Yet the following year, Voynich expert René Zandbergen of the European Space Agency in Darmstadt, Germany, showed that the entropy of the text (a measure of the rate of transfer of information) was consistent with Friedman's suspicions that an artificial language had been used.
sentences.zh: 然而第二年，德国达姆施塔特欧洲航天局的伏尼契专家勒内·赞德伯根（René Zandbergen）表明，文本的熵（一种衡量信息传递率的指标）与弗里德曼怀疑使用了人工语言的看法相一致。

sentences.en: (E) Many are convinced that the Voynich manuscript is not a hoax.
sentences.zh: 许多人相信，伏尼契手稿不是一场骗局。

sentences.en: For how could a medieval hoaxer create so many tell-tale signs of a message from random nonsense?
sentences.zh: 因为一个中世纪的骗子怎么可能从随机胡言乱语中造出如此多的“讯息”信号呢？

sentences.en: Yet even this has been challenged in new research by Rugg.
sentences.zh: 然而即便这一点也已在拉格的新研究中受到挑战。

sentences.en: Using a system first published by the Italian mathematician Girolamo Cardano in 1150, in which a specially constructed grille is used to pick out symbols from a table, Rugg found he could rapidly generate text with many of the basic traits of the Voynich manuscript.
sentences.zh: 使用 1150 年意大利数学家吉罗拉莫·卡尔达诺（Girolamo Cardano）首次发表的一套系统——其中一种特别构造的栅格被用来从表格中挑选符号——拉格发现他能够快速生成具有伏尼契手稿许多基本特征的文本。

sentences.en: Publishing his results in 2004, Rugg stresses that he had not set out to prove the manuscript a hoax.
sentences.zh: 2004 年发表研究结果时，拉格强调他并未试图证明手稿是骗局。

sentences.en: “I simply demonstrated that it is feasible to hoax something this complex in a few months,” he says.
sentences.zh: “我只是表明，在几个月内伪造像这样复杂的东西是可行的，”他说。

sentences.en: (F) Inevitably, others beg to differ.
sentences.zh: 不可避免地，其他人有不同意见。

sentences.en: Some scholars, such as Zandbergen, still suspect the text has genuine meaning, though believe it may never be decipherable.
sentences.zh: 一些学者，如赞德伯根，仍然怀疑该文本具有真正的含义，尽管相信它可能永远无法被破译。

sentences.en: Others, such as Churchill, have suggested that the sheer weirdness of the illustrations and text hints at an author who had lost touch with reality.
sentences.zh: 另一些学者，如丘吉尔，则提出插图和文本本身的极端怪异性暗示作者已经与现实脱节。

sentences.en: What is clear is that the book-sized manuscript, kept under lock and key at Yale University, has lost none of its fascination.
sentences.zh: 明确的是，这份被锁在耶鲁大学保管的、书本大小的手稿丝毫未失其迷人之处。

sentences.en: “Many derive great intellectual pleasure from solving puzzles,” says Rugg.
sentences.zh: “许多人从解谜中获得巨大的智力愉悦，”拉格说。

sentences.en: “The Voynich manuscript is as challenging a puzzle as anyone could ask for.”
sentences.zh: “伏尼契手稿就是任何人能要求的最具挑战性的谜题。”

records.title: What makes a musical expert?
records.titleZh: 什么使一个人成为音乐专家？

sentences.en: (A) Does that class of people acknowledged to be musical experts just have more of the same basic skills we are all endowed with, or do they have a set of abilities — or neural structures — that are totally different from those of the rest of us?
sentences.zh: 那些被公认为音乐专家的人，只是拥有更多与我们大家共有的基本技能；还是说他们拥有一套——或一套神经结构——与我们其他人完全不同的能力？

sentences.en: Are high levels of musical achievement simply the result of training and practice, or are they based on innate brain structure — what we refer to as talent?
sentences.zh: 高水平的音乐成就只是训练和练习的结果，还是基于天生的脑结构——也就是我们所说的天赋？

sentences.en: Talent can be defined as something that originates in genetic structures and that is identifiable by trained people who can recognize its existence before a person has achieved exceptional levels of performance.
sentences.zh: 天赋可以被定义为：源自遗传结构、可以在一个人达到非凡水平的表现之前由受过训练的人识别出来的某种东西。

sentences.en: The emphasis on early identification means that to investigate it, we study the development of skills in children.
sentences.zh: 对早期识别的强调意味着，要研究它，我们就要研究儿童身上技能的发展。

sentences.en: It is evident that some children acquire skills more rapidly than others: the age of onset for walking and talking varies widely, even between children in the same household.
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，有些儿童习得技能的速度比其他儿童更快：走路和说话的起始年龄差异很大，甚至同一家庭中的儿童之间也是如此。

sentences.en: There may be genetic factors at work, but these are closely linked with other factors — with a presumably environmental component — such as motivation and family dynamics.
sentences.zh: 可能有遗传因素在起作用，但这些因素与其他因素（包括推测起来是环境性的成分，比如动机和家庭动力学）密切相关。

sentences.en: Similar factors can influence musical development and can mask the contribution of genetics to musical ability.
sentences.zh: 类似的因素也能影响音乐发展，并掩盖遗传对音乐能力的贡献。

sentences.en: (B) Brain studies, so far, haven't been of much use in sorting out the issues.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，脑研究在厘清这些问题上并没有多大用处。

sentences.en: Gottfried Schlaug at Harvard collected brain scans of individuals with absolute pitch* (AP) and showed that a region in the brain called the planum temporale is larger in these people than in others.
sentences.zh: 哈佛的戈特弗里德·施劳格（Gottfried Schlaug）收集了具有绝对音感（absolute pitch，AP）的人的脑扫描，结果表明大脑中一个被称为颞平面的区域在这些人身上比其他人更大。

sentences.en: This suggests that the planum is involved in AP, but it's not clear if it starts out larger in people who eventually acquire AP, or if the acquisition of AP makes the planum increase in size.
sentences.zh: 这表明颞平面参与了 AP，但并不清楚的是：在最终获得 AP 的人那里，它一开始就更大；还是获得 AP 反过来使颞平面变大。

sentences.en: Results of research into the areas of the brain involved in skilled motor movement are more conclusive.
sentences.zh: 关于参与熟练运动动作的大脑区域的研究结果更具结论性。

sentences.en: Studies of violin players have shown that the region of the brain responsible for controlling the movement of the left hand (the hand that requires greater precision in violin playing) increases in size as a result of practice.
sentences.zh: 对小提琴演奏者的研究表明，负责控制左手（在小提琴演奏中要求更高精度的手）运动的脑区，因练习而尺寸变大。

sentences.en: We do not know yet if the propensity for increase pre-exists in some people and not others.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道，这种增大倾向是否在某些人身上先天存在、而在另一些人身上并不存在。

sentences.en: (C) The evidence against talent comes from research on how much training the experts do.
sentences.zh: 反对天赋说的证据来自对专家们要做多少训练的研究。

sentences.en: Like experts in mathematics, chess, or sports, experts in music require lengthy periods of instruction and practice.
sentences.zh: 和数学、象棋或体育的专家一样，音乐的专家也需要漫长时期的指导和练习。

sentences.en: In several studies, the very best music students were found to have practised more than twice as much as the others.
sentences.zh: 在多项研究中，最优秀的音乐学生被发现练习量比其他人多两倍以上。

sentences.en: In another study, students were secretly divided into two groups based on teachers' perceptions of their talent.
sentences.zh: 在另一项研究中，学生根据老师对其天赋的看法被秘密分为两组。

sentences.en: Several years later, it was found that the students who achieved the highest performance ratings had practised the most, irrespective of which talent group they had been assigned to, suggesting that practice does not merely correlate with achievement, but causes it.
sentences.zh: 数年后，研究发现，取得最高表现评级的学生练习得最多，而不管他们被分到哪一组——这表明练习不仅与成就相关，还导致了成就。

sentences.en: (D) Anders Ericsson, at Florida State University, approaches the topic of musical expertise as a general problem in cognitive psychology.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州立大学的安德斯·埃里克森把音乐专长这一话题视为认知心理学中的一个一般性问题。

sentences.en: He takes as a starting point the assumption that there are certain issues involved in becoming an expert at anything; that we can learn about musical expertise by studying expert chess players, athletes, artists, mathematicians, as well as the musicians themselves.
sentences.zh: 他以一个假设作为出发点：成为任何事的专家都涉及某些共通的问题；通过研究象棋专家、运动员、艺术家、数学家以及音乐家本身，我们可以了解音乐专长。

sentences.en: The emerging picture from such studies is that ten thousand hours of practice is required to achieve the level of mastery associated with being a world-class expert — in anything.
sentences.zh: 从这些研究中浮现的画面是：要达到与世界级专家相关的精通水平——在任何事情上——都需要一万小时的练习。

sentences.en: In study after study, of composers, ice-skaters, concert pianists, chess players and master criminals, this number comes up again and again.
sentences.zh: 在一项又一项研究中，从作曲家、花样滑冰选手、音乐会钢琴家、象棋大师到惯犯，这个数字一再出现。

sentences.en: Someone would do this amount of practice if they practised, for example, roughly 20 hours a week for ten years.
sentences.zh: 如果一个人例如每周练习约 20 小时、坚持十年，就能达到这个练习量。

sentences.en: Of course, this does not address why some people do not seem to get anywhere when they practise, and why some people get more out of their practice sessions than others.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并未回答：为什么有些人练习似乎却毫无进展，为什么有些人比其他人从练习中获益更多。

sentences.en: But no-one has yet found a case in which true world-class expertise was accomplished in less time.
sentences.zh: 但还没有人发现过哪个真正世界级的专长是在更短时间内达成的。

sentences.en: It seems that it takes the brain this long to assimilate all that it needs to know to achieve true mastery.
sentences.zh: 看来大脑需要这么长时间，才能吸收实现真正精通所需的一切。

sentences.en: The ten-thousand-hour theory is consistent with what we know about how the brain learns.
sentences.zh: 一万小时理论与我们关于大脑如何学习的知识相一致。

sentences.en: Learning requires the assimilation and consolidation of information in neural tissue.
sentences.zh: 学习需要在神经组织中对信息进行吸收和巩固。

sentences.en: The more experiences we have with something, the stronger the memory/learning trace for that experience becomes.
sentences.zh: 我们对某事的体验越多，对该体验的记忆/学习痕迹就越强。

sentences.en: Although people differ in how long it takes them to consolidate information neurally, it remains true that increased practice leads to a greater number of neural traces, which create stronger memory representation.
sentences.zh: 尽管不同的人在神经层面巩固信息所需时间不同，但有一点仍然成立：更多的练习导致更多的神经痕迹，从而创造出更强的记忆表征。

sentences.en: (E) The classic rebuttal to this theory goes something like this: What about Mozart?
sentences.zh: 对这一理论的经典反驳大致是这样的：那莫扎特怎么解释？

sentences.en: I hear that he composed his first symphony at the age of four!
sentences.zh: 我听说他四岁就写出了第一部交响曲！

sentences.en: First, there is a factual error here: Mozart did not write it until he was eight.
sentences.zh: 首先，这里有一个事实错误：莫扎特直到八岁才写下它。

sentences.en: Still, this is unusual, to say the least.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这至少也是不寻常的。

sentences.en: However, this early work received little acclaim and was not performed very often.
sentences.zh: 然而，这部早期作品几乎没有受到赞誉，也不常被演奏。

sentences.en: In fact, the only reason we know about it is because the child who wrote it grew up to become Mozart.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们之所以知道它，仅仅是因为写下它的那个孩子长大后成了莫扎特。

sentences.en: And Mozart had an expert teacher in his father, who was renowned as a teacher of musicians all over Europe.
sentences.zh: 而莫扎特还有一位作为父亲的专家老师——他在全欧洲都以音乐家的老师而知名。

sentences.en: We do not know how much Mozart practised, but if he started at age two and worked thirty-two hours a week (quite possible, given that his father was a stern task master) he would have made his ten thousand hours by the time he composed his first symphony.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道莫扎特练习了多少；但如果他从两岁开始、每周练习 32 小时（考虑到他父亲是个严厉的督课人，这相当可能），那么到他写出第一部交响曲时，他就完成了一万小时。

sentences.en: This does not mean that there are no genetic factors involved in Mozart's greatness, but that inborn traits may not be the only cause.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着莫扎特的伟大不涉及任何遗传因素，而是说天生特质可能并不是唯一原因。

sentences.en: (A) When Robert R.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·R.

sentences.en: Provine began studying yawning in the 1960s, it was difficult for him to convince research students of the merits of 'yawning science'.
sentences.zh: 普罗文（Robert R. Provine）在 1960 年代开始研究打哈欠时，他很难让研究生相信“打哈欠的科学”具有价值。

sentences.en: Although it may appear quirky to some, Provine's decision to study yawning was a logical extension of his research in developmental neuroscience.
sentences.zh: 尽管对某些人而言它可能看起来古怪，普罗文研究打哈欠的决定其实是他在发育神经科学研究上的合乎逻辑的延伸。

sentences.en: The verb to yawn is derived from the Old English ganien or ginian, meaning to gape or open wide.
sentences.zh: 动词“to yawn”源自古英语 ganien 或 ginian，意为张大或张开。

sentences.en: But in addition to gaping jaws, yawning has significant features that are easy to observe and analyse.
sentences.zh: 但除了张开下颌之外，打哈欠还有一些容易观察和分析的显著特征。

sentences.en: Provine 'collected' yawns to study by using a variation of the contagion response*.
sentences.zh: 普罗文通过对感染反应进行变体处理来“采集”哈欠进行研究。

sentences.en: He asked people to “think about yawning” and, once they began to yawn, to depress a button that would record from the start of the yawn to the exhalation at its end.
sentences.zh: 他请人“想着打哈欠”，一旦他们开始打哈欠，就按下一个按钮，记录从哈欠开始到结束时呼气的过程。

sentences.en: (B) Provine's early discoveries can be summarized as follows: the yawn is highly stereotyped but not invariant in its duration and form.
sentences.zh: 普罗文早期的发现可以总结如下：哈欠高度刻板，但持续时间和形态并非恒定不变。

sentences.en: It is an excellent example of the instinctive fixed-action pattern of classical animal-behaviour study, or ethology.
sentences.zh: 它是经典动物行为学（即“动物行为学”）中“本能式固定动作模式”的极佳例子。

sentences.en: It is not a reflex (short-duration, rapid, proportional response to a simple stimulus), but, once started, a yawn progresses with the inevitability of a sneeze.
sentences.zh: 它不是一种反射（对简单刺激的短时、快速、成比例的反应），但一旦开始，哈欠就像打喷嚏一样不可避免地推进下去。

sentences.en: The standard yawn runs its course over about six seconds on average, but its duration can range from about three seconds to much longer than the average.
sentences.zh: 标准的哈欠平均持续约 6 秒，但其持续时间可从约 3 秒一直到远超平均值。

sentences.en: There are no half-yawns: this is an example of the typical intensity of fixed-action patterns and a reason why you cannot stifle yawns.
sentences.zh: 不存在“半个哈欠”：这是固定动作模式典型强度的一个例子，也是你无法压制哈欠的一个原因。

sentences.en: Just like a cough, yawns can come in bouts with a highly variable inter-yawn interval, which is generally about 68 seconds but rarely more than 70.
sentences.zh: 和咳嗽一样，哈欠可以成阵地出现，哈欠之间的间隔变化很大，通常约 68 秒，但很少超过 70 秒。

sentences.en: There is no relation between yawn frequency and duration: producers of short or long yawns do not compensate by yawning more or less often.
sentences.zh: 哈欠频率与持续时间之间没有关系：打短或长哈欠的人不会通过打得更多或更少来补偿。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Provine's hypotheses about the form and function of yawning can be tested by three informative yawn variants which can be used to look at the roles of the nose, the mouth and the jaws.
sentences.zh: 此外，普罗文关于哈欠形式与功能的假说可以通过三种富有信息量的哈欠变体来检验——这些变体可用于考察鼻、口和下颌的作用。

sentences.en: i The closed-nose yawn
sentences.zh: i 闭鼻哈欠

sentences.en: (C) Subjects are asked to pinch their nose closed when they feel themselves start to yawn.
sentences.zh: 研究者要求受试者在感觉自己要打哈欠时捏住鼻子。

sentences.en: Most subjects report being able to perform perfectly normal closed-nose yawns.
sentences.zh: 大多数受试者报告说，他们能完美正常地完成闭鼻哈欠。

sentences.en: This indicates that the inhalation at the onset of a yawn, and the exhalation at its end, need not involve the nostrils — the mouth provides a sufficient airway.
sentences.zh: 这表明哈欠开始时的吸气和结束时的呼气并不必涉及鼻孔——口腔提供了足够的气道。

sentences.en: ii The clenched-teeth yawn
sentences.zh: ii 咬牙哈欠

sentences.en: (D) Subjects are asked to clench their teeth when they feel themselves start to yawn but allow themselves to inhale normally through their open lips and clenched teeth.
sentences.zh: 研究者要求受试者在感觉自己要打哈欠时咬住牙齿，但允许他们通过张开的嘴唇和咬合的牙齿正常吸气。

sentences.en: This variant gives one the sensation of being stuck mid-yawn.
sentences.zh: 这种变体给人一种被卡在哈欠中途的感觉。

sentences.en: This shows that gaping of the jaws is an essential component of the fixed-action pattern of the yawn, and unless it is accomplished, the programme will not run to completion.
sentences.zh: 这表明下颌张开是哈欠这一固定动作模式的核心组成部分——除非它被完成，否则程序不会走到结束。

sentences.en: The yawn is also shown to be more than a deep breath, because, unlike normal breathing, inhalation and exhalation cannot be performed so well through the clenched teeth as through the nose.
sentences.zh: 哈欠也被证明不仅仅是一次深呼吸，因为与正常呼吸不同，吸气和呼气在牙齿咬合下不能像通过鼻子时那样顺利地完成。

sentences.en: iii The nose yawn
sentences.zh: iii 鼻哈欠

sentences.en: (E) This variant tests the adequacy of the nasal airway to sustain a yawn.
sentences.zh: 这一变体测试鼻腔气道维持一次哈欠的能力。

sentences.en: Unlike normal breathing, which can be performed equally well through mouth or nose, yawning is impossible via nasal inhalation alone.
sentences.zh: 与可以通过口或鼻同样顺畅完成的正常呼吸不同，仅通过鼻腔吸气来打哈欠是不可能的。

sentences.en: As with the clenched-teeth yawn, the nose yawn provides the unfulfilling sensation of being stuck in mid-yawn.
sentences.zh: 和咬牙哈欠一样，鼻哈欠也带来一种被卡在哈欠中途、无法满足的感觉。

sentences.en: Exhalation, on the other hand, can be accomplished equally well through nose or mouth.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，呼气则可以同样顺畅地通过鼻或口完成。

sentences.en: Through this methodology Provine demonstrated that inhalation through the oral airway and the gaping of jaws are necessary for normal yawns.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方法论，普罗文证明了：经口腔气道吸气以及下颌的张开是正常哈欠所必需的。

sentences.en: The motor programme for yawning will not run to completion without feedback that these parts of the programme have been accomplished.
sentences.zh: 哈欠的运动程序不会走完，除非有反馈表明这些程序部分已经完成。

sentences.en: (F) But yawning is a powerful, generalised movement that involves much more than airway manoeuvres and jaw-gaping.
sentences.zh: 但哈欠是一种强有力、广泛分布的动作，涉及的远不只是气道操作和下颌张开。

sentences.en: When yawning you also stretch your facial muscles, tilt your head back, narrow or close your eyes, produce tears, salivate, open the Eustachian tubes of your middle ear and perform many other, yet unspecified, cardiovascular and respiratory acts.
sentences.zh: 打哈欠时，你也会拉伸面部肌肉、把头向后仰、眯眼或闭眼、流泪、流口水、打开中耳的咽鼓管，并进行许多其他尚未明确的心血管和呼吸活动。

sentences.en: Perhaps the yawn shares components with other behaviour.
sentences.zh: 也许哈欠与其他行为共享某些成分。

sentences.en: For example, is the yawn a kind of 'slow sneeze', or is the sneeze a 'fast yawn'?
sentences.zh: 例如，哈欠是不是一种“慢的喷嚏”？或者喷嚏是不是一种“快的哈欠”？

sentences.en: Both share common respiratory and other features including jaw gaping, eye closing and head tilting.
sentences.zh: 两者都共享共同的呼吸和其他特征——包括下颌张开、闭眼和头部后仰。

sentences.en: (G) Yawning and stretching share properties and may be performed together as parts of a global motor complex.
sentences.zh: 哈欠和伸展共享某些属性，并可能作为一个全局性运动复合体的一部分被同时完成。

sentences.en: Studies by J.
sentences.zh: J.

sentences.en: I.
sentences.zh: I.

sentences.en: P.
sentences.zh: P.

sentences.en: de Vries et al. in the early 1980s, charting movement in the developing foetus using ultrasound, observed a link between yawning and stretching.
sentences.zh: de Vries 等人 1980 年代初的研究——利用超声波描绘发育中胎儿的运动——观察到了哈欠与伸展之间的联系。

sentences.en: The most extraordinary demonstration of the yawn-stretch linkage occurs in many people paralysed on one side of their body because of brain damage caused by a stroke: the prominent British neurologist Sir Francis Walshe noted in 1923 that when these people yawn, they are startled and mystified to observe that their otherwise paralysed arm rises and flexes automatically in what neurologists term an 'associated response'.
sentences.zh: 哈欠—伸展联结最非凡的呈现发生在许多由于中风导致脑损伤而身体一侧瘫痪的人身上：杰出的英国神经学家弗朗西斯·沃尔什爵士（Sir Francis Walshe）在 1923 年指出，这些人打哈欠时会惊讶且困惑地观察到——他们原本瘫痪的手臂会自动抬起并屈曲，神经学家把这称为“伴随反应”。

sentences.en: Yawning apparently activates undamaged, unconsciously controlled connections between the brain and the motor system, causing the paralysed limb to move.
sentences.zh: 打哈欠显然激活了大脑与运动系统之间未受损、不受意识控制的联结，使瘫痪的肢体得以动起来。

sentences.en: It is not known whether the associated response is a positive prognosis for recovery, nor whether yawning is therapeutic for prevention of muscular deterioration.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚伴随反应是否为康复的良好预兆，也不清楚打哈欠是否对预防肌肉退化具有治疗作用。

sentences.en: (H) Provine speculated that, in general, yawning may have many functions, and selecting a single function from the available options may be an unrealistic goal.
sentences.zh: 普罗文推测，总体而言，打哈欠可能具有许多功能；从可用选项中挑选单一功能可能是不现实的目标。

sentences.en: Yawning appears to be associated with a change of behavioural state, switching from one activity to another.
sentences.zh: 打哈欠似乎与行为状态的改变相关——从一种活动切换到另一种。

sentences.en: Yawning is also a reminder that ancient and unconscious behaviour linking us to the animal world lurks beneath the veneer of culture, rationality and language.
sentences.zh: 打哈欠也提醒我们，把我们与动物世界相连接的、古老而无意识的行为，正潜藏在文化、理性与语言的表层之下。
