sentences.en: A One widely held assumption about talent is that it is a reasonably fixed characteristic and it is therefore the job of organisations to identify, recruit and retain star performers.
sentences.zh: 关于天赋的一个广为流传的假设是：它是一种相对固定的特质，因此组织的职责就是识别、招募并留住明星员工。

sentences.en: This belief affects the way people are managed in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 这一信念影响着职场中人员被管理的方式。

sentences.en: Most recruitment decisions are influenced by the skills and abilities of an individual rather than their aptitude and attitude.
sentences.zh: 大多数招聘决策受个人的技能与能力的影响，而不是其潜质与态度。

sentences.en: In terms of career development, organisations invest in staff who have been selected to reach higher-level positions, while ignoring front-line employees and people with less perceived potential.
sentences.zh: 就职业发展而言，组织把投入用在被选定要升入更高职位的员工身上，而忽视一线员工和被认为潜力较小的人。

sentences.en: This idea, that talent is a fixed, identifiable characteristic – and that those firms with the best people do the best – is both flawed and harmful to people and organisations.
sentences.zh: 这种观念——即天赋是一种固定的、可识别的特征，并且拥有最佳人才的公司表现最佳——不仅有缺陷，对个人和组织都有害。

sentences.en: There is a lot of evidence on this point, and it is useful to highlight some of the most pertinent arguments.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点有许多证据，有必要列出其中一些最相关的论点。

sentences.en: B First, are there stars?
sentences.zh: 首先，明星存在吗？

sentences.en: There is no question that in every field, from sports to computer programming to music, there are people who are better than the rest.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，在每一个领域——从体育到计算机编程再到音乐——都有人比其他人更强。

sentences.en: As psychologist Dean Keith Simonton, who has spent his career studying greatness, has said, 'Wherever you look, the same story can be told.
sentences.zh: 心理学家迪安·基思·西蒙顿（Dean Keith Simonton）将其职业生涯都用于研究伟大，他说过：“无论你看向哪里，都能讲出同一个故事。

sentences.en: Identify the ten per cent who have achieved the most in a certain endeavour.
sentences.zh: 找出在某项事业中成就最高的 10%。

sentences.en: Count the accomplishments they have to their credit.
sentences.zh: 清点他们名下的成就。

sentences.en: Now tally the accomplishments of the remaining 90 per cent.
sentences.zh: 再清点其余 90% 的成就。

sentences.en: The first tally will equal or surpass the second.'
sentences.zh: 第一份清单将持平或超过第二份。“

sentences.en: For instance, in music, 16 individuals have produced about 50 per cent of the Western classical music that is performed and recorded today, while another 235 composers have produced the remaining half.
sentences.zh: 例如，在音乐方面，16 位个人贡献了今天演奏和录制的西方古典音乐的约 50%，而另外 235 位作曲家贡献了剩下的一半。

sentences.en: The more interesting questions concern not the existence of stars, but whether these stars can be reliably identified and, even more importantly, whether their talent is a fixed aspect or can be altered.
sentences.zh: 更有趣的问题不是明星是否存在，而是：这些明星能否被可靠地识别？更重要的是，他们的天赋是固定不变的，还是可以被改变的？

sentences.en: C Identifying the best people is tricky.
sentences.zh: 识别最优秀的人很棘手。

sentences.en: Quality of performance changes over time and this is true whether we are talking about professors or footballers.
sentences.zh: 表现的质量会随时间变化，无论我们谈的是教授还是足球运动员都是如此。

sentences.en: If performance naturally varies, any measurement taken at a single point in time, such as when someone is being hired, will have error and imprecision.
sentences.zh: 如果表现自然变动，那么任何单一时间点（比如某人被雇用之时）的衡量都会有误差和不精确之处。

sentences.en: Therefore, single assessments of talent are likely to contain mistakes in their categorisation of people.
sentences.zh: 因此，对天赋的单次评估很可能在对人的分类上出错。

sentences.en: Also, judgements about performance and ability depend on the standards used to judge what is good and bad.
sentences.zh: 此外，对表现和能力的判断取决于用以评判好坏的标准。

sentences.en: It should surprise no-one that for Bach to be considered a great musician, standards of music needed to change to embrace the qualities that his compositions possessed.
sentences.zh: 巴赫之所以被视为伟大的音乐家，是因为音乐的标准需要发生变化以接纳他作品所具有的品质——这一点不该让任何人意外。

sentences.en: Similarly, artists and art come in and out of fashion, which means that what is genius depends not only on a person's ability, but on the prevailing standards used to evaluate output.
sentences.zh: 同样，艺术家和艺术会随时尚来去，这意味着何为天才不仅取决于一个人的能力，也取决于当时用来评估其产出的主流标准。

sentences.en: D Finally, it is difficult to evaluate people and their abilities with precision.
sentences.zh: 最后，要精确地评估人及其能力是困难的。

sentences.en: In the domain of work, research shows that the best predictors of job performance tend to be measures of intelligence.
sentences.zh: 在工作领域，研究表明对工作表现最好的预测因子往往是智力的衡量。

sentences.en: But even these measures correlate only loosely with performance, which means that more than 80 per cent of the variation in performance is unexplained by even the best predictors.
sentences.zh: 但即便是这些衡量也只是与表现弱相关，这意味着即便是最好的预测因子也无法解释 80% 以上的表现差异。

sentences.en: Even in the sports arena, where one would think natural ability would be readily assessed because sports teams spend lots of resources on identifying talent, mistakes get made.
sentences.zh: 即便是在体育领域——人们会以为天生能力很容易被评估，因为体育队投入大量资源去识别天赋——也会出错。

sentences.en: Basketball star Michael Jordan was dropped by his high school basketball coach and a number of top American football quarterbacks were available early in their careers because they were not considered good enough by various teams.
sentences.zh: 篮球明星迈克尔·乔丹曾被他的高中篮球教练淘汰；美国职业橄榄球的多位顶尖四分卫在职业生涯早期能够被各队签下，是因为他们被各队认为不够好。

sentences.en: E This leads on to the next question: is talent born or made?
sentences.zh: 由此引出下一个问题：天赋是天生的还是后天造就的？

sentences.en: Should organisations assume that almost anyone can become a star performer, which implies that there ought to be a greater emphasis on motivation and development, or do they just figure out who is good and who isn't?
sentences.zh: 组织是应当假定几乎任何人都能成为明星员工（这意味着应当更加强调动机和发展），还是只去判断谁好谁不好？

sentences.en: Here the evidence is clear: talent is at least as much 'created' as inherent and, more importantly, the customary way companies think about identifying talent almost certainly works to destroy a lot of untapped potential.
sentences.zh: 在这个问题上证据是清晰的：天赋至少有相当一部分是被“创造”出来的，而非与生俱来；更重要的是，公司通常用来识别天赋的方式几乎一定会摧毁大量未被开发的潜力。

sentences.en: Decades of research by K.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州立大学心理学教授 K.

sentences.en: Anders Ericsson, professor of psychology at Florida State University, show that exceptional performance doesn't happen without around ten years of nearly daily, deliberate practice for about four hours a day, by people who, with the assistance of their coaches, have access to the best techniques.
sentences.zh: 安德斯·埃里克森（Anders Ericsson）几十年的研究表明，卓越的表现不可能离开大约十年、几乎每天、每天约 4 小时刻意练习而获得，而练习者还要在教练帮助下接触到最好的技巧。

sentences.en: Once achieved, exceptional performance can't be maintained without relentless effort.
sentences.zh: 一旦达成，卓越的表现也无法在没有持续努力的情况下被维持。

sentences.en: So performance may be as much a consequence of training as it is of innate ability, which suggests that performance can be altered by how people are managed.
sentences.zh: 因此，表现可能既是训练的结果，也是天生能力的结果——这表明表现可以通过对人的管理方式被改变。

sentences.en: F Further research by Stanford psychology professor Carol Dweck shows that the tendency of organisations to see performance results as an opportunity for an 'assessment' of ability, results in lower performance and poor motivation.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福大学心理学教授卡萝尔·德韦克（Carol Dweck）的进一步研究表明，组织倾向于把表现结果视为对能力进行“评估”的机会，这会导致表现下降、动机变差。

sentences.en: Dweck identified two sets of goals that people bring to a performance context: 'performance goals, where the purpose is to validate one's ability or avoid demonstrating a lack of ability, and learning goals, where the aim is to acquire new knowledge and skills'.
sentences.zh: 德韦克识别出人们在表现情境中所带的两套目标：“表现目标——目的是证明自己的能力、或避免显示出能力不足；和学习目标——目的是获得新的知识与技能”。

sentences.en: People with performance goals have been shown to be more prone to helpless behaviour and debilitation after a setback, while people with learning goals strive for higher performance.
sentences.zh: 已有研究显示，带表现目标的人在挫折后更容易表现出无助行为并崩溃；而带学习目标的人则会努力追求更高的表现。

sentences.en: The implications for managing people and talent are clear.
sentences.zh: 对管理人才的影响是清晰的。

sentences.en: Seeing talent as fixed and job performance as a way of classifying people creates a self-fulfilling prophecy in which ability and intelligence do become fixed.
sentences.zh: 把天赋视为固定、把工作表现视为对人分类的方式，会制造一种自我实现的预言——能力和智力真的就此变得固定不变。

sentences.en: By contrast, seeing ability as malleable leads to a different sort of self-fulfilling prophecy, in which individuals and their employers may invest in ways to enhance performance.
sentences.zh: 相反，把能力视为可塑造的，则带来另一种自我实现的预言——其中个人及其雇主可能投资于提升表现的方式。

sentences.en: A We think of our prehistoric ancestors as people of the ice and snow, living in caves, and for many of the West European Neanderthalers that is just a picture of their life.
sentences.zh: 我们把史前祖先想成生活在冰雪中的洞穴居民，对许多西欧尼安德特人而言，这正是他们生活的样子。

sentences.en: But where there were no caves, further to the east on the Russian steppe, for example, open-air sites with some sort of constructed shelter were the only option.
sentences.zh: 但在没有洞穴的地方——例如更东边的俄罗斯草原——具有某种搭建庇护所的露天遗址是唯一选择。

sentences.en: We now know much more about the cave sites than the open-air ones because, historically, it was the cave sites of Western Europe that were first explored by archaeologists and also because open-air sites are harder to find – many of them have disappeared under deep mud deposits or under the rising postglacial seas.
sentences.zh: 我们对洞穴遗址的了解远多于露天遗址，因为从历史上看，正是西欧的洞穴遗址首先被考古学家发掘，并且露天遗址更难发现——许多已被深厚的泥沙堆积或冰后期上升的海面掩埋。

sentences.en: Caves, moreover, aid the survival of archaeological material and can preserve the records of remote millennia.
sentences.zh: 此外，洞穴有助于考古遗物的保存，能保留遥远千年的记录。

sentences.en: B In south-west France, the limestone caves of the Périgord region made ideal homes for the Neanderthal people.
sentences.zh: 在法国西南部，佩里戈尔（Périgord）地区的石灰岩洞穴是尼安德特人的理想居所。

sentences.en: There were good supplies of flint to hand for axes and the like, and the caves were often sited in small river valleys that offered protection against the worst of the weather.
sentences.zh: 手边有充足的燧石可以制作斧子等工具，洞穴常位于小河谷中，能抵御最恶劣的天气。

sentences.en: The Neanderthalers liked south-facing caves, for obvious reasons of sunshine and wind avoidance, and caves at some height above the valley floor offered refuge from floods and good game-watching vantage points.
sentences.zh: 尼安德特人喜欢朝南的洞穴——出于阳光照射和避风等显然的原因——而位于谷底之上一定高度的洞穴则提供了躲避洪水的庇护和良好的观猎视点。

sentences.en: The Périgord region during the last ice age was, in fact, an exceptionally benign habitat for humans.
sentences.zh: 事实上，最后冰期的佩里戈尔地区是人类异常宜居的栖息地。

sentences.en: It enjoyed a rather maritime climate with cooler summers that permitted the extension of tundra and steppe over its higher plateaux, and its year-round high levels of sunshine favoured the growth of the ground plants needed by reindeer, bison and horse.
sentences.zh: 它享有较为海洋性的气候，夏季较凉，使得苔原和草原能够延伸到更高的台地上；而全年充沛的阳光又有利于驯鹿、野牛和马所需的地表植物生长。

sentences.en: Winters were mildish for the ice age, animals never needed to migrate far from summer to winter, and men never needed to travel far from home to find abundant supplies of meat.
sentences.zh: 对冰期而言冬季较为温和，动物在夏冬之间不需远距离迁徙，人类也无需远离家园就能找到充裕的肉食供应。

sentences.en: C In Central and Eastern Europe, where caves are less readily available, such open-air sites as have been discovered were mostly located near water: bottom-land was a good area to be for people and animals, and also because the sedimentation pattern of lakes and stream courses has aided archaeological preservation – whereas erosion has presumably blown away sites which were out in the open.
sentences.zh: 在洞穴较少的中欧和东欧，所发现的露天遗址多位于水边：低地是人和动物都好去的地方，并且湖与河道的沉积模式有助于考古保存——而风化侵蚀想必已把那些暴露在外的遗址吹散。

sentences.en: Some of the open-air sites in Germany, Central Europe and Russia have provided valuable information about Neanderthal man and his way of life.
sentences.zh: 德国、中欧和俄罗斯的一些露天遗址提供了关于尼安德特人及其生活方式的有价值信息。

sentences.en: From Moldova, for example, comes evidence that has been interpreted as the remains of wind-breaks, or even a large tent-ring, up to about 8 x 5 m in size, of mainly mammoth bones enclosing a dense concentration of stone tools, animal bones and ash.
sentences.zh: 例如来自摩尔多瓦的证据被解读为防风墙的遗迹，甚至是大小约 8 × 5 米的大型帐篷圈，主要由猛犸象骨构成，里面密集分布着石器、动物骨头和灰烬。

sentences.en: D From the West European caves more evidence of built structures is available, and some of it goes back a long way in time.
sentences.zh: 从西欧洞穴可获得更多关于建造结构的证据，其中一些可追溯到很久以前。

sentences.en: In the Grotte du Lazaret, near Nice, at a date during the last ice age but one, claims for some sort of skin tent within the cave have been advanced, on the basis of arrangements of large stones out from the cave wall that might have supported timber struts for a covering of skins up to the rock face above.
sentences.zh: 在尼斯附近的拉萨雷洞穴（Grotte du Lazaret），在倒数第二个冰期的某个时间，有人根据洞内墙边一些大石块的排列方式，提出洞内可能搭有某种皮帐——这些石块可能用以支撑通往上方岩壁的覆有兽皮的木撑。

sentences.en: At Lazaret, what might be openings in the hypothesised tents seem to point away from the cave mouth, and finds of wolf and fox foot bones, without the rest of the skeletons, inside these 'tents' have been thought to indicate the use of animal pelts as bed coverings.
sentences.zh: 在拉萨雷，这些假设中的“帐篷”开口似乎都背离洞口；而在这些“帐篷”内发现的狼和狐的足骨——其余骨架缺失——被认为表明用兽皮做床上覆盖物。

sentences.en: The two patches of ash at Lazaret that mark ancient fires, with stone tools around them evidently made and used on the spot, are edged with small marine mollusc shells, prompting the excavator to suggest that seaweed had been used as bedding around the fires.
sentences.zh: 拉萨雷的两处烧灰显示是古老的火堆，周围的石器显然是就地制造和使用的，并以小型海生软体动物贝壳为边——这促使发掘者推测火旁铺有海藻作床。

sentences.en: The cave of Baume-Bonne in the Basses-Alpes region of France, another early site, boasts ten square metres of cobbles brought up from the local river and laid down, as though to take care of a puddle area in the cave, with the smoothest and roundest surfaces of the stones uppermost, and there are other similar cases.
sentences.zh: 位于法国下阿尔卑斯（Basses-Alpes）地区的鲍姆-博纳洞穴（Baume-Bonne）——另一个早期遗址——拥有 10 平方米的卵石面，这些卵石从附近河中搬来铺设在洞内，似乎是用来处理一块积水区，石面最平滑、最圆润的一面朝上；还有其他类似情形。

sentences.en: E The ash encountered in concentrations at some sites testifies to the Neanderthal people's use of fire: not surprising, since use of fire was, by Neanderthal times, an already ancient accomplishment of evolving humanity, and survival in the sub-arctic conditions faced by the Neanderthalers is inconceivable without control of fire.
sentences.zh: 在一些遗址成堆的灰烬，证明了尼安德特人对火的使用——这并不令人意外，因为到尼安德特时代，火的使用已经是进化人类的一项古老成就，而尼安德特人所面对的近北极条件下要生存，没有对火的掌控是不可想象的。

sentences.en: Fire gave warmth, light, heat for cooking and defence against predatory animals.
sentences.zh: 火提供了温暖、光、烹饪用的热度，以及对捕食性动物的防御。

sentences.en: A charred piece of birch from Krapina in Croatia is thought to be the remains of a fire-making twirl stick.
sentences.zh: 克罗地亚克拉皮纳（Krapina）一块烧焦的白桦木被认为是钻木取火棒的残骸。

sentences.en: But Neanderthal hearths, in the sense of specially constructed places for fire, are fewer and harder to identify with certainty than the mere ash piles that are a regular feature of their sites.
sentences.zh: 但与他们遗址中常见的灰堆相比，尼安德特人专门搭建的火塘——确切意义上的灶——更少见、更难确证。

sentences.en: They seem often to have just lit a small fire (40–50 cm across) on the existing ground surface of the cave, without preparation.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎常常只是在洞内现有地面上点起一小堆火（直径 40—50 厘米），没有任何准备。

sentences.en: Judging from the shallow penetration of heat effects under the ash, this fire was only of short duration.
sentences.zh: 从灰下热效应渗透较浅来看，这种火只持续了短暂时间。

sentences.en: Sometimes the fires were larger in size, up to one metre across, and quite irregular in shape.
sentences.zh: 有时火堆较大，直径可达一米，形状颇不规则。

sentences.en: It is not always easy to decide how much additional structure some fires possessed: claims of stone circles to contain the fire run up against the fact that stones tend to litter the cave floors everywhere and those around a fire can quite accidentally look as though they were arranged in a circle.
sentences.zh: 要判断某些火堆带有多少附加结构并不容易：声称围火的石圈往往会遇到一个事实——洞内地面到处散落着石头，火周围的那些石头看上去也可能完全是偶然排成圈的样子。

sentences.en: A Human beings naturally become attached to places they visit or inhabit and these emotional attachments have become increasingly important in research on recreation sites and activities.
sentences.zh: 人类天生会对他们造访或居住的地方产生依恋，而这些情感依恋在关于休闲场所和活动的研究中已变得越来越重要。

sentences.en: Research into this phenomenon is called 'sense-of-place research'.
sentences.zh: 对这一现象的研究被称为“地方感研究”。

sentences.en: This research has employed a variety of approaches to gauge people's feelings toward a place, including surveys and personal interviews, but so far has not used photo-based methods.
sentences.zh: 这项研究采用了各种各样的方法来衡量人们对一个地方的感受，包括问卷和个人访谈，但迄今为止还没有使用过以照片为基础的方法。

sentences.en: However, Visitor Employed Photography (VEP), used to capture visitor perceptions of landscape and recreational quality, represents a potential innovation in sense-of-place research.
sentences.zh: 然而，用来捕捉游客对景观和休闲质量感知的“游客自拍摄影”（VEP），代表着地方感研究中一种潜在的创新。

sentences.en: B A 'place' is a setting that we give meaning to based on the personal experiences, relationships and feelings we associate with it.
sentences.zh: 一个“地方”是一个我们基于与之相关联的个人经历、关系和感受而赋予其意义的环境。

sentences.en: A crucial distinction that needs to be made is between the more subjective concept of attachment and the symbolic 'meanings' or labels we use to describe the type of place a setting represents.
sentences.zh: 需要做出的一个关键区分，是更主观的依恋概念与我们用来描述一个环境所代表地方类型的象征性“意义”或标签之间的区分。

sentences.en: Is, for example, a multiple-use forest area a wilderness?
sentences.zh: 比如，一片多用途的森林区是一片荒野吗？

sentences.en: A playground?
sentences.zh: 一个游乐场？

sentences.en: A workplace?
sentences.zh: 一个工作场所？

sentences.en: Symbolic meanings are important in that they form the basis of our attachment to a place: we attribute meaning to our settings, and in turn become attached to the meanings (Stedman, 2003).
sentences.zh: 象征性意义之所以重要，在于它们构成了我们对一个地方依恋的基础：我们赋予我们的环境以意义，进而又依恋于这些意义（斯特德曼，2003）。

sentences.en: All settings can have multiple meanings depending on how we encounter them.
sentences.zh: 所有环境都可以有多重意义，取决于我们如何遇见它们。

sentences.en: Some researchers suggest that, because meaning emerges through individual experience, for example 'my camping trip', place meanings are completely individualistic: a given setting such as a park will contain as many different meanings as there are people using the setting (Meinig, 1979).
sentences.zh: 一些研究者认为，由于意义是通过个人体验、比如“我的露营之旅”而浮现的，地方意义是完全个体化的：一个给定的环境、比如一座公园，包含的不同意义会和使用这个环境的人一样多（迈尼希，1979）。

sentences.en: Others, however, (e.g.
sentences.zh: 然而，另一些人（例如

sentences.en: Greider & Garkovich, 1994) assert that meanings are based on social categories and therefore are shared by others within these categories.
sentences.zh: 格雷德与加尔科维奇，1994）则主张，意义基于社会类别、因此被这些类别内的其他人所共享。

sentences.en: For example, farmers share certain meanings for a plot of land that are distinct from those of real-estate developers or hunters.
sentences.zh: 比如，农民对一块土地共享着某些与房地产开发商或猎人不同的意义。

sentences.en: C Clearly, place attachment is built through familiarity with a place over a period of months or even years.
sentences.zh: 显然，地方依恋是通过在数月、甚至数年的时间里对一个地方的熟悉而建立起来的。

sentences.en: Relph (1976) describes sense-of-place attachment as the steady accumulation of events within a setting; this creates 'home places'.
sentences.zh: 雷尔夫（1976）把地方感依恋描述为一个环境内部事件的稳步积累；这创造出“家的地方”。

sentences.en: According to this view, those who have participated fully in the life of the home or community, or have accumulated a series of everyday events in a setting, will have the strongest attachment to it.
sentences.zh: 按照这种观点，那些充分参与了家庭或社区生活、或在一个环境中积累了一系列日常事件的人，会对它有最强的依恋。

sentences.en: Extended residence in a place tends to make us feel toward it almost as a living thing, affecting our emotions in the same way as a family would (Ryden, 1993).
sentences.zh: 在一个地方长期居住往往使我们对它的感觉几乎像对一个活物一样，以一种家人般的方式影响我们的情感（赖登，1993）。

sentences.en: However, Tuan (1977) notes that a sense of place may also develop quite rapidly in 'chosen places', where dramatic landscapes and intense experiences can lead to an immediate attachment.
sentences.zh: 然而，段（1977）指出，在“被选择的地方”，地方感也可能发展得相当迅速，在那里壮丽的景观和强烈的体验可以导致一种即时的依恋。

sentences.en: Indeed, many settings, especially those that attract visitors, may simultaneously exist as home places and chosen places.
sentences.zh: 的确，许多环境、尤其是那些吸引游客的环境，可能同时作为家的地方和被选择的地方而存在。

sentences.en: D Clearly we are dealing with a complex phenomenon and photo-based research methods may help us to understand it better.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们处理的是一个复杂的现象，而以照片为基础的研究方法可能帮助我们更好地理解它。

sentences.en: In VEP, tourists are asked to take photographs.
sentences.zh: 在游客自拍摄影中，游客被要求拍照片。

sentences.en: This technique has primarily been used to assess the perceptions of visitors to parks and recreation places.
sentences.zh: 这种技术主要被用来评估公园和休闲场所游客的感知。

sentences.en: Haywood (1990) describes several benefits of VEP.
sentences.zh: 海伍德（1990）描述了游客自拍摄影的几个好处。

sentences.en: Photography is an enjoyable, familiar activity to tourists which helps to sharpen observation and identify specific locations that are important.
sentences.zh: 摄影对游客来说是一种令人愉快、熟悉的活动，它有助于敏锐观察、并辨认出重要的特定地点。

sentences.en: It can give clearer ideas on elements that are liked or disliked and also facilitates comparisons between places.
sentences.zh: 它能就所喜欢或不喜欢的元素给出更清晰的想法，也便于在各地点之间进行比较。

sentences.en: E However, several methodological issues need to be taken into account.
sentences.zh: 然而，有几个方法论上的问题需要被考虑在内。

sentences.en: First, who should take the photographs?
sentences.zh: 首先，谁该拍照片？

sentences.en: VEP research typically involves visitors or tourists but, when applied to questions of attachment to a community, this approach has potential pitfalls.
sentences.zh: 游客自拍摄影研究通常涉及访客或游客，但当应用于对一个社区依恋的问题时，这种方法有潜在的陷阱。

sentences.en: Chenoweth (1984) notes that research subjects may take photos that represent only a part of their entire recreational experience.
sentences.zh: 切诺韦思（1984）指出，研究对象可能拍下只代表他们整个休闲体验一部分的照片。

sentences.en: This tendency probably relates to unfamiliarity with the setting.
sentences.zh: 这种倾向很可能与对环境的不熟悉有关。

sentences.en: For example, when researchers assign the task of photographing a travel route with which respondents are not familiar, participants may save too many pictures and then use them all up at the end of their visit, even if there is no suitable material.
sentences.zh: 比如，当研究人员布置拍摄一条受访者不熟悉旅行路线的任务时，参与者可能存下太多照片、然后在他们造访结束时把它们全用完，即便没有合适的素材。

sentences.en: Markwell (1997) noted an opposite tendency in his study of pictures taken on a nature tour: beginnings of excursions were over-represented, due perhaps to the initial novelty of the trip.
sentences.zh: 马克韦尔（1997）在他对一次自然之旅所拍照片的研究中注意到一种相反的倾向：行程的开头被过度呈现，也许是由于旅程最初的新鲜感。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Haywood (1990) suggests that compressing the photo-taking period into a single day (as he did in his work) may result in an over-representation of tourist icons rather than ordinary places.
sentences.zh: 此外，海伍德（1990）认为，把拍照时段压缩到单独一天（就像他在工作中所做的那样）可能导致旅游标志性景点、而不是普通地方的过度呈现。

sentences.en: In contrast, Yamashita (2002), when focusing on local residents' perceptions of the qualities of the water around them, noted that residents may have more difficulty expressing visual appeal than visitors, precisely because they are insiders and less conscious of aesthetic qualities.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，山下（2002）在聚焦于当地居民对他们周围水域品质的感知时指出，居民在表达视觉吸引力上可能比游客更困难，恰恰因为他们是内部人、对审美品质不那么有意识。

sentences.en: When addressing complex attachment to landscape, we would expect, however, that familiarity ought to increase the validity of the items selected to represent sources of attachment.
sentences.zh: 然而，在处理对景观的复杂依恋时，我们会预期，熟悉应当会提高所选用来代表依恋来源之项目的有效性。

sentences.en: We also expect that photographs taken by local residents will represent a wider range of phenomena than pictures taken by transient visitors.
sentences.zh: 我们还预期，当地居民所拍的照片会比短暂游客所拍的照片代表更广泛的现象。

sentences.en: F But how should the photographs be interpreted?
sentences.zh: 但这些照片该如何解读呢？

sentences.en: Goin (2001) notes that with every photo taken 'a fiction is created …
sentences.zh: 戈因（2001）指出，每拍一张照片，‘就创造出一种虚构……

sentences.en: but presents to the uninformed an overwhelming conviction of fact' (p.
sentences.zh: 但向不知情者呈现出一种压倒性的事实确信感’（第

sentences.en: By implication, what photos appear to be and what they really represent may be very different things, and some follow-up helps to uncover the intended meanings of the participant.
sentences.zh: 言下之意，照片看上去是什么、和它们真正代表什么，可能是非常不同的两回事，而一些后续追问有助于揭示参与者意图表达的意义。

sentences.en: Yamashita (2002) notes the utility of asking respondents to provide descriptions of each photo in a notebook or diary.
sentences.zh: 山下（2002）指出请受访者在笔记本或日记里为每张照片提供描述的用处。

sentences.en: These elaborations are helpful, but in cases of complex phenomena, an interview may help participants clarify their intentions (Markwell, 1997).
sentences.zh: 这些详述很有帮助，但在复杂现象的情况下，一次访谈可能帮助参与者澄清他们的意图（马克韦尔，1997）。

sentences.en: (A) Every year the film academy in the USA celebrates the outstanding achievements of the year in a ceremony known as the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 每年，美国的电影学院都在一个被称为奥斯卡的典礼上表彰这一年的杰出成就。

sentences.en: An increasingly important component of the ceremony is the presentation of the Scientific and Technical awards.
sentences.zh: 这个典礼一个日益重要的组成部分是科学技术奖的颁发。

sentences.en: In 2004 a notable event took place: the academic world met the cinematographic world when researchers from Stanford University in the USA were awarded an Oscar.
sentences.zh: 在2004年发生了一件值得注意的事：当美国斯坦福大学的研究人员获得一座奥斯卡奖时，学术界与电影界相遇了。

sentences.en: These researchers, led by Steve Marschner, were from the field of Computer Graphics at Stanford.
sentences.zh: 这些由史蒂夫·马施纳领导的研究人员，来自斯坦福的计算机图形学领域。

sentences.en: They were part of a growing cohort of computer scientists that has become fundamental to moviemaking.
sentences.zh: 他们是一个不断壮大、已对电影制作变得至关重要的计算机科学家群体的一部分。

sentences.en: (B) Films have shown that it is possible to use CGI to make actors look younger, older, weaker or stronger than they actually are in a surprisingly realistic manner.
sentences.zh: 影片已经表明，可以用CGI以一种出奇逼真的方式让演员看起来比他们实际上更年轻、更年长、更虚弱或更强壮。

sentences.en: At least, it is possible if the altered actors are not filmed too closely.
sentences.zh: 至少，如果被改造的演员不被拍得太近，这是可能的。

sentences.en: This is because the difficulty of recreating the textures of both skin and fabric means that the effect is less convincing when seen close up.
sentences.zh: 这是因为重现皮肤和织物的纹理之难，意味着近看时效果就不那么令人信服。

sentences.en: The work of Marschner and his colleagues has greatly improved the accurate and realistic modeling of both skin and fabric.
sentences.zh: 马施纳和他同事的工作极大地改进了对皮肤和织物准确而逼真的建模。

sentences.en: They recognized that one of the difficulties of creating lifelike characters in the computer world is that, in CGI, the characters’ skin is opaque (two-dimensional) whereas real skin is in fact translucent (three-dimensional), that is to say, it is semi-transparent.
sentences.zh: 他们认识到，在计算机世界里创造栩栩如生角色的难点之一在于，在CGI中，角色的皮肤是不透明的（二维的），而真实的皮肤实际上是半透明的（三维的），也就是说，它是半透明的。

sentences.en: (C) Marschner and his colleagues received the Oscar for their work in successfully producing a CGI model that simulates translucency; this is when light penetrates skin and then scatters below the skin’s surface before re-emerging.
sentences.zh: 马施纳和他的同事因成功制作出一个模拟半透明的CGI模型而获得奥斯卡奖；半透明就是当光线穿透皮肤、然后在皮肤表面之下散射、再重新射出的时候。

sentences.en: This is called subsurface scattering, and the mathematics for the model goes back many decades to the time when it was used in astrophysics.
sentences.zh: 这被称为次表面散射，而这个模型的数学可追溯到几十年前它被用于天体物理学的时候。

sentences.en: Because human skin is naturally translucent, it was necessary to be able to create this artificially in order to simulate the soft appearance of real skin.
sentences.zh: 因为人类皮肤天然是半透明的，所以为了模拟真实皮肤柔和的外观，有必要能够人工地创造出这一点。

sentences.en: Previous CGI models, which assumed that skin was entirely opaque, resulted in characters with a plastic appearance.
sentences.zh: 以前那些假定皮肤完全不透明的CGI模型，造出的角色有一种塑料般的外观。

sentences.en: The scientists’ new model of CGI was so important in bringing digital characters to life that, within two years of their original research paper, all the major special-effects studios had incorporated it into their digital rendering systems.
sentences.zh: 科学家这种新的CGI模型在让数字角色栩栩如生方面如此重要，以至于在他们最初的研究论文发表后两年内，所有主要的特效工作室都把它纳入了他们的数字渲染系统。

sentences.en: (D) However, despite their award, the scientists, with admirable tenacity, continued their search for perfection, as they still did not feel that they had yet satisfactorily recreated the subtle ways light is reflected.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管获了奖，这些科学家还是以令人钦佩的执着继续他们对完美的追求，因为他们仍觉得自己尚未令人满意地重现光线被反射的微妙方式。

sentences.en: To do this, they began to look in detail at the way skins and fabrics reflect light differently according to their make-up: the exact arrangement of fibers in fabric and the network of fibers in skin.
sentences.zh: 为此，他们开始详细研究皮肤和织物根据其构成不同地反射光线的方式：织物中纤维的确切排列、以及皮肤中纤维的网络。

sentences.en: Marschner and his team tried to do this by using computerized tomography, which is most familiar as a medical technique for examining people’s internal organs.
sentences.zh: 马施纳和他的团队试图通过使用计算机断层扫描来做到这一点，这种技术作为一种检查人内脏器官的医学手段最为人所熟悉。

sentences.en: Like classical radiology, it uses X-rays, but because the image is constructed inside a computer using exposures taken from many different positions, rather than a single exposure on photographic film, it can capture fine details that are invisible in classical radiography.
sentences.zh: 和经典放射学一样，它使用X射线，但因为图像是在计算机内部用从许多不同位置拍摄的曝光构建的、而不是在照相胶片上的单次曝光，所以它能捕捉到经典放射术中看不见的精细细节。

sentences.en: (E) Unfortunately, the scientists understood that at this point in time they could not use computerized tomography on skin, because a very high-intensity X-ray is needed to show the kind of detail they wanted and this would be very dangerous for human skin.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，科学家明白在目前这个时点他们还不能在皮肤上使用计算机断层扫描，因为要显示他们想要的那种细节需要一种非常高强度的X射线，而这对人类皮肤会非常危险。

sentences.en: They have, however, had some success with fabric.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们在织物上取得了一些成功。

sentences.en: Using this new method of imaging, they are able to accurately record the three-dimensional structure of all the fibers in a number of small pieces of fabric.
sentences.zh: 使用这种新的成像方法，他们能够准确记录若干小块织物中所有纤维的三维结构。

sentences.en: These same pieces of fabric, through the use of CGI, can then be patched together to form an entire garment inside a computer, in the same way that a small group of actors can be made to look like hundreds of people gathered together.
sentences.zh: 这些同样的织物块，通过使用CGI，随后可以在计算机内部被拼接成一整件衣服，就像一小群演员可以被弄得看起来像聚在一起的数百人一样。

sentences.en: A garment created through CGI is therefore made up of pieces of fabric whose internal structure has been pre-recorded.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过CGI创造的一件衣服，是由一些内部结构已被预先记录的织物块组成的。

sentences.en: This means that the way light is reflected by the garment can be calculated far more realistically than if the scientists just made a computer model of what they thought the interior of the fabric looked like.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，衣服反射光线的方式可以被计算得比科学家仅仅为他们认为织物内部所看起来的样子做一个计算机模型要逼真得多。

sentences.en: Cinematography will benefit from this because, although it may take some years to be able to use computerized tomographic imaging of skin, for the moment the movement of a virtual cloak or the lifting of a computerized hat should look far more realistic.
sentences.zh: 电影摄影将从中受益，因为尽管能在皮肤上使用计算机断层成像可能要花一些年头，但就目前而言，一件虚拟斗篷的飘动、或一顶计算机生成帽子的掀起，应该看起来逼真得多。

sentences.en: (F) In the meantime, according to Marschner’s colleague Kavita Bala, the technology might have an application in online retailing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，据马施纳的同事卡维塔·巴拉说，这项技术可能在在线零售中有一种应用。

sentences.en: At the moment, people buying clothes over the internet have only a standard photograph to help them choose their purchases.
sentences.zh: 目前，在网上买衣服的人只有一张标准照片来帮助他们挑选他们要买的东西。

sentences.en: It is hoped that if online shoppers can view items which have been presented through the use of computerized tomography graphics, they will have a much better understanding of what the material the item is made of is really like.
sentences.zh: 人们希望，如果网购者能查看通过使用计算机断层扫描图形所呈现的商品，他们就能对该商品所用材料真正是什么样有好得多的理解。

sentences.en: Marschner is now working on the way light is scattered from individual hairs.
sentences.zh: 马施纳现在正在研究光线从单根头发上被散射的方式。

sentences.en: He says, ‘I feel lucky to be working in this niche.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我觉得自己很幸运能在这个利基领域工作。

records.title: Tasmania's Museum of Old and New Art
records.titleZh: 塔斯马尼亚新旧艺术博物馆

sentences.en: A As an eighteen-year-old living in the small Australian island state of Tasmania, moving to the 'mainland' could not happen soon enough.
sentences.zh: 作为一名在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚（一座小岛州）长大的 18 岁青年，搬到“大陆”上的迫切心情怎么都嫌不够快。

sentences.en: Now, ten years later, I look forward to going home.
sentences.zh: 如今，十年过去，我期待回家。

sentences.en: This is probably because I've grown up, but also perhaps because the cultural landscape of Tasmania has matured.
sentences.zh: 这大概是因为我已经长大了，但也许同样因为塔斯马尼亚的文化景观已经成熟。

sentences.en: The latest addition to Tasmania's cultural scene is David Walsh's Museum of Old and New Art (MONA), a museum that has established Hobart, the capital city of Tasmania, on the global art circuit.
sentences.zh: 塔斯马尼亚文化生态的最新增项是戴维·沃尔什（David Walsh）的旧与新艺术博物馆（Museum of Old and New Art，MONA）——一座让塔斯马尼亚的首府霍巴特跻身全球艺术版图的博物馆。

sentences.en: This building is an example of how art and architecture can have an instant impact on the social and cultural reputation of a place.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑展示了艺术与建筑如何能对一个地方的社会与文化声誉产生瞬时影响。

sentences.en: Andrew Bain of The Sydney Morning Herald wrote, 'In a virtual blink, Hobart's cultural landscape has been transformed, with art, wine, fine food and stylish accommodation becoming integral features of the city ...
sentences.zh: “悉尼晨锋报”的安德鲁·贝恩（Andrew Bain）写道：“几乎是一眨眼之间，霍巴特的文化景观已经发生改变，艺术、葡萄酒、美食和雅致的住宿都成为这座城市不可或缺的特征……

sentences.en: If Hobart's makeover has an origin, it's the opening of MONA – the Museum of Old and New Art.'
sentences.zh: 如果霍巴特的改头换面有一个起点，那就是 MONA——旧与新艺术博物馆——的开馆。“

sentences.en: MONA is said to have been solely instrumental in the reinvention of Hobart as a cultural hub.
sentences.zh: 据说 MONA 一手促成了霍巴特作为文化中心的重塑。

sentences.en: B MONA made the national press and international blogs before it opened.
sentences.zh: MONA 在开馆之前就登上了全国性报刊和国际博客。

sentences.en: After that, Tourism Industry Council of Tasmania's chief executive, Luke Martin, claimed that MONA was proving so popular it was underpinning the tourism industry in Tasmania.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，塔斯马尼亚旅游业理事会首席执行官卢克·马丁（Luke Martin）声称，MONA 大受欢迎，已成为塔斯马尼亚旅游业的支柱。

sentences.en: However, MONA's effect on Hobart has broader ramifications for Tasmania's tourism industry.
sentences.zh: 然而，MONA 对霍巴特的影响对塔斯马尼亚的旅游业有更广泛的影响。

sentences.en: As reported in Hobart's local paper, The Mercury, there is concern about how long people are staying in Tasmania.
sentences.zh: 如霍巴特当地报纸《水星报》（The Mercury）所报道的那样，关于人们在塔斯马尼亚停留时间长短的担忧确实存在。

sentences.en: Rather than spending a week in the state and hiring a car to experience the beauty of the Tasmanian landscape, people are making short stays in Hobart only to visit the gallery.
sentences.zh: 人们没有花一周时间留在这个州、租车体验塔斯马尼亚的风景之美，而是只在霍巴特短暂停留以参观博物馆。

sentences.en: The next challenge for the state is how to entice holiday-makers to stay longer, and to venture further afield.
sentences.zh: 该州接下来的挑战是：如何吸引度假者停留更久、走得更远。

sentences.en: Tasmania is more than a one-hit wonder.
sentences.zh: 塔斯马尼亚不仅仅是一个“一招鲜”。

sentences.en: According to Martin, possibilities for packaging up MONA with visits to other galleries around Tasmania are being investigated.
sentences.zh: 据马丁说，把 MONA 与塔斯马尼亚各地其他画廊参观打包的可能性正在被探讨。

sentences.en: Although not directly related to these investigations, the 1891 Queen Victoria Museum and Art Gallery at Royal Park in Launceston is currently being restored to its original condition; there are also plans to extensively redevelop the Tasmanian Museum and Art Gallery in Hobart.
sentences.zh: 虽然与上述探讨并非直接相关，但位于朗塞斯顿皇家公园的、1891 年建成的维多利亚女王博物馆与美术馆目前正在被恢复原状；此外还有大规模重建霍巴特的塔斯马尼亚博物馆与美术馆的计划。

sentences.en: In addition to this, there are up to twenty other existing quality galleries in the state.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，州内还有多达 20 家其他既有的优质画廊。

sentences.en: So there is more to see than just MONA.
sentences.zh: 所以可看的不只是 MONA。

sentences.en: C Although large, the building is rather nondescript, sitting heavily on the edge of the Derwent River.
sentences.zh: 尽管体量很大，建筑本身却相当不显眼，沉重地坐落在德文特河畔。

sentences.en: MONA's 'wow factor' comes from the notoriety of David Walsh, the museum's millionaire founder, and his choice of unusual artworks.
sentences.zh: MONA 的“震撼因子”来自其百万富翁创始人戴维·沃尔什的名声及其对不寻常艺术品的选择。

sentences.en: The architecture has more depth of meaning and does exactly as it should: it supports the vision of the museum, essentially the vision of Walsh.
sentences.zh: 建筑本身的意涵要更深，并恰如其分地做到了它该做的事：它支撑起博物馆的愿景——本质上就是沃尔什的愿景。

sentences.en: It's a new building in the context of a maturing city.
sentences.zh: 在一座正在成熟的城市中，它是一座新建筑。

sentences.en: The dark, moody labyrinth of gallery spaces could be likened to the mind of the eccentric founder himself.
sentences.zh: 那些昏暗、阴郁的迷宫般的画廊空间，可以被比作这位古怪创办人本人的心智。

sentences.en: Each artwork appears to be integrated into the dark materiality of the architecture – the interiors are far from light, bright and neutral, as might be seen in a more traditional gallery.
sentences.zh: 每件艺术品似乎都被融入这座建筑黑暗的物质性之中——内饰远非传统画廊中明亮、轻盈、中性的样子。

sentences.en: The dim lighting and rough, rocky surfaces are a reminder that visitors are three levels underground.
sentences.zh: 昏暗的灯光和粗糙、嶙峋的表面提醒访客：他们身处地下三层。

sentences.en: D The warped, mirrored surface at the museum's entry could be seen as the start of a journey of reflecting on one's existence.
sentences.zh: 博物馆入口处扭曲的镜面，可以被视为反思自身存在之旅的起点。

sentences.en: Much of the art explores the human condition – there are uninhibited artistic descriptions of human relationships, death, and even the digestion process.
sentences.zh: 许多作品探索人之处境——有对人际关系、死亡乃至消化过程的无拘束艺术化描绘。

sentences.en: Going to a gallery with such confronting artworks with your parents is an interesting experience; I was pleasantly surprised by my parents' openness to the exhibitions.
sentences.zh: 和父母一起去一家展出如此正面冲撞之作的画廊是一种有趣的体验；我对父母对这些展览的开放态度感到欣慰。

sentences.en: My father, who normally whisks through a gallery while my mother likes to take her time, happily spent almost five hours at MONA; the urge to linger is a common feeling here.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲平时在画廊里疾走而过，而我母亲喜欢慢慢看，但他却在 MONA 高兴地待了将近五小时；在这里，想要驻足是一种普遍的感觉。

sentences.en: This is because the gallery engages all of the senses, and visitors often pause to experience the effect each artwork has on them.
sentences.zh: 这是因为画廊调动了所有感官，访客常常停下来体会每件作品对自己产生的效果。

sentences.en: This raises the question of who is actually visiting MONA – and it's definitely not just the normal gallery-goers.
sentences.zh: 这就引出一个问题：究竟是谁在参观 MONA——这绝不仅仅是常规的画廊观众。

sentences.en: People from all kinds of socioeconomic backgrounds are curious about what lies within the subterranean maze of MONA.
sentences.zh: 来自各种社会经济背景的人都对 MONA 地下迷宫中所藏之物感到好奇。

sentences.en: Conservative minds are being opened, which is a good thing anywhere.
sentences.zh: 保守的心灵正在被打开——这在任何地方都是好事。

sentences.en: Walsh's antiquities collection is superb, but he knew that old coins would compete for attention against new works that are more challenging in scale and subject matter, hence the device of setting antiquities among twentieth- and twenty-first-century works.
sentences.zh: 沃尔什的古董收藏非常出色，但他知道古币会与那些在规模和题材上更具挑战性的新作竞争注意力，因此他采用了把古董穿插在 20 世纪和 21 世纪作品之间的手法。

sentences.en: For me, one of the intriguing outcomes of this strategy was an intensified feeling that the makers of the coins and antiquities were the great contemporary artists of their time.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这一策略一个引人入胜的结果是一种被强化的感觉——这些钱币和古董的制作者，曾是他们那个时代伟大的当代艺术家。

sentences.en: E The so-called Bilbao Effect has worked its magic on Hobart because, just as Frank Gehry's Guggenheim Museum has transformed the city of Bilbao in Spain, MONA has been a magnet for tourists in Hobart.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“毕尔巴鄂效应”已经在霍巴特施展了它的魔力——正如弗兰克·盖里（Frank Gehry）的古根海姆博物馆改造了西班牙的毕尔巴鄂市一样，MONA 已成为霍巴特的游客磁石。

sentences.en: However, the architectural 'wow' factor of the Guggenheim was the most famous component of that city's transformation, whereas Fender Katsalidis's MONA does not have the same spectacular impact as the shimmering metal surfaces of Gehry's building.
sentences.zh: 然而，古根海姆建筑上的“震撼”因子是那座城市改造中最著名的组成部分；而芬德·卡查利迪斯（Fender Katsalidis）的 MONA 并不具有盖里那座建筑闪烁的金属表面所带来的同等戏剧性冲击。

sentences.en: Walsh himself abhors descriptions of MONA as the Bilbao of the south, saying that Fender Katsalidis solved a problem when he designed MONA, in executing a project of this scale in an underground location.
sentences.zh: 沃尔什本人厌恶把 MONA 描述为南半球的毕尔巴鄂，他说芬德·卡查利迪斯在设计 MONA 时解决了一个问题——在一个地下场地上执行如此规模的项目。

sentences.en: Walsh contrasts this with what he describes as the “architectural self-indulgence of Gehry when designing the Guggenheim in Bilbao.”
sentences.zh: 沃尔什把这与他所说的“盖里在设计毕尔巴鄂古根海姆时的建筑自我放纵”作对比。

sentences.en: Call it the Bilbao Effect, but this phenomenon has been around for thousands of years – good public architecture forms the centrepiece of a city.
sentences.zh: 称之为“毕尔巴鄂效应”也好，但这一现象已存在数千年——好的公共建筑构成一座城市的核心。

sentences.en: This is probably true, but like the Guggenheim, MONA has initiated something very important for Tasmania, and for Hobart in particular.
sentences.zh: 这大概是真的，但和古根海姆一样，MONA 已为塔斯马尼亚——尤其是为霍巴特——开启了非常重要的某种东西。

sentences.en: Now the question is how Tasmania will build on David Walsh's input into its cultural setting.
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是，塔斯马尼亚将如何在戴维·沃尔什为其文化环境注入的内容之上继续建造。

records.title: Research into the effects of different teaching styles
records.titleZh: 研究不同教学风格的影响

sentences.en: (A) Prior to 1960, most inquiries into pupils' learning skills explored the relationship between factors such as children's social background, personality or measured intelligence and their achievement in various school subjects.
sentences.zh: 1960 年以前，大多数关于学生学习能力的研究探讨的是儿童的社会背景、性格或所测量的智力等因素，与他们在各门学科上的学业成绩之间的关系。

sentences.en: Studies of teachers were largely a quest for criteria of effectiveness, and numerous investigations sought links between personality or attitude and 'success' at teaching.
sentences.zh: 对教师的研究主要是在寻找衡量“教学效能”的标准，许多调查都在试图找出性格或态度与教学“成功”之间的联系。

sentences.en: By 1950, Domas and Tiedeman were able to survey 672 such studies of teacher effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 到 1950 年，多马斯（Domas）和蒂德曼（Tiedeman）已经能对 672 项此类教师效能研究进行综述。

sentences.en: Yet there was widespread disappointment with such research, partly because so little of value seemed to emerge.
sentences.zh: 然而人们对这类研究普遍感到失望，部分原因是其中似乎鲜有真正有价值的成果。

sentences.en: First of all, there was little agreement about what constituted 'good' teaching or who the good teachers were.
sentences.zh: 首先，关于什么样的教学才算“好”、谁才算好教师，几乎没有共识。

sentences.en: Secondly, there were numerous conflicting and contradictory findings.
sentences.zh: 其次，研究中存在大量相互冲突、彼此矛盾的结论。

sentences.en: No sooner had one investigator found a relationship which appeared to be significant, than another discovered the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 一位研究者刚刚发现某种看似显著的相关关系，另一位就会发现相反的效应。

sentences.en: (B) For example, in 1945, two American researchers, Rostker and Rolfe, both using standardized testing techniques and broad samples of teachers, reached exactly opposite conclusions.
sentences.zh: 例如，1945 年，两位美国研究者罗斯克（Rostker）和罗尔夫（Rolfe）都使用标准化测试方法和广泛的教师样本，却得出了截然相反的结论。

sentences.en: Rostker concluded that the intelligence of the teacher is the most important single factor conditioning teaching ability, and that there is no significant relationship between personality and teaching ability.
sentences.zh: 罗斯克的结论是：教师的智力是决定其教学能力的最重要的单一因素，而性格与教学能力之间并无显著关系。

sentences.en: Rolfe, however, found no correlation between intelligence and teaching efficiency: he claimed that the teacher's personality was what produced good teaching.
sentences.zh: 罗尔夫却发现，智力与教学效率之间没有相关性：他主张，是教师的性格造就了好的教学。

sentences.en: Another American writer, Barr (1961), summarized a massive amount of American research and underlined the chaos in the research literature on effectiveness: “Some teachers were preferred by administrators, some were liked by the pupils, and some taught in classes where there were substantial pupil gains, and generally speaking these were not the same teachers.”
sentences.zh: 另一位美国学者巴尔（Barr，1961 年）综述了大量美国研究，强调了教学效能研究文献中的混乱状况：“有些教师受到校方青睐，有些教师受到学生喜爱，有些教师所带班级学生的进步显著——一般说来，这并不是同一批教师。”

sentences.en: (C) One of the earliest pieces of research dates from 1912, when Stevens made 100 random observations of lessons in a variety of subject areas, in order to analyze the number and nature of questions being asked by teachers.
sentences.zh: 最早的研究之一可以追溯到 1912 年，当时史蒂文斯（Stevens）对各学科的课堂进行了 100 次随机观察，目的是分析教师所提问题的数量和性质。

sentences.en: Stevens's overall total was 64% teacher talk and 36% pupil talk, figures which are remarkably similar to a number of findings half a century later.
sentences.zh: 史蒂文斯的总体统计结果是：64% 的课堂时间是教师在讲，36% 是学生在讲，这一数字与半个世纪后多项研究的结论高度相似。

sentences.en: (D) For many years in the first half of the 20th century, so-called 'formal' teaching was the norm.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪上半叶的许多年里，所谓“正规”教学一直是常态。

sentences.en: Teachers taught their classes as a whole group, gave out information, asked questions which predominantly required factual recall, and frequently set a common written task for the children to complete in a prescribed period of time.
sentences.zh: 教师把全班作为一个整体来授课，传授知识，提出的问题主要考察事实性回忆，并经常给孩子们布置一项共同的书面作业，让他们在规定时间内完成。

sentences.en: It was hardly surprising, therefore, that one focus of classroom interaction research in the decades following Stevens's inquiry was on the phenomenon of 'attentiveness'.
sentences.zh: 因此，在史蒂文斯之后的数十年里，课堂互动研究的一个重点理所当然地落在“专注度”这一现象上。

sentences.en: A number of studies in the 1920s and 1930s, by Morrison and others, sought relationships between the degree of attention being paid by children and the amount they subsequently appeared to have learnt.
sentences.zh: 20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代，莫里森（Morrison）等人开展了若干研究，试图找出孩子专注程度与他们随后所学到的内容多少之间的关系。

sentences.en: Such research was usually based on observing teachers at work, a technique which was also employed extensively by United States administrators in the 1920s and 1930s, in order to assess teachers' competence and allocate merit payments to so-called 'superior' teachers.
sentences.zh: 这类研究通常以观察教师上课为基础，这种方法在 20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代也被美国学校管理者广泛使用，用以评估教师能力，并向所谓“优秀”教师发放绩效奖金。

sentences.en: (E) As the 1930s came to an end, it was partly the emergence of totalitarian regimes in Europe which led to a shift in interest in the United States away from attentiveness, with its emphasis on the authority of the teacher, and towards a scrutiny of authoritarianism itself.
sentences.zh: 随着 20 世纪 30 年代接近尾声，部分由于欧洲极权政权的兴起，美国的研究兴趣开始从强调教师权威的“专注度”研究，转向对“权威主义”本身的审视。

sentences.en: A number of people began to feel that if dictatorship were to be avoided, children must learn in school how to handle democracy.
sentences.zh: 不少人开始觉得，要想避免独裁主义，孩子们就必须在学校里学会如何驾驭民主。

sentences.en: Several investigators examined the processes taking place within small discussion groups, and tried to establish superiority for discussion groups over lecture classes, but with conflicting results.
sentences.zh: 若干研究者考察了小型讨论小组中发生的种种过程，并试图证明讨论式小组优于讲授式课堂，但研究结论彼此冲突。

sentences.en: The movement towards what was becoming known as child-centred education was gathering momentum, and as interest in child development increased, investigators began to discover the usefulness of direct observation and the categorization of child behavior.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，逐渐被称为“以儿童为中心的教育”的运动也在积聚动力，随着人们对儿童发展兴趣的增加，研究者开始意识到对儿童行为进行直接观察和分类的价值。

sentences.en: (F) This was when systematic observation of teacher-pupil interaction began in earnest.
sentences.zh: 正是在这一时期，对师生互动的系统化观察真正开始进入正轨。

sentences.en: Anderson (1939) studied what he called 'domination' and 'integration' amongst kindergarten children.
sentences.zh: 安德森（Anderson，1939 年）研究了幼儿园儿童之间他所称的“支配”和“融合”行为。

sentences.en: Dominative acts by children included blaming and snatching toys, and such acts by teachers included restricting children's activities; while children's integrative acts included sharing facilities and playing harmoniously, and those of teachers included expanding opportunities for self-direction and co-operation.
sentences.zh: 儿童的支配行为包括责怪他人和抢夺玩具，教师的支配行为则包括限制儿童的活动；而儿童的融合行为包括分享设施和友好玩耍，教师的融合行为则包括为儿童创造更多自主和合作的机会。

sentences.en: Anderson then attempted to measure what is now commonly called 'classroom climate'.
sentences.zh: 随后，安德森尝试测量如今通常所说的“课堂氛围”。

sentences.en: (G) Lewin, Lippitt and White (1939 and 1943) studied the effects of different teaching styles.
sentences.zh: 勒温（Lewin）、利皮特（Lippitt）和怀特（White）（1939 年和 1943 年）研究了不同教学风格的影响。

sentences.en: They arranged for three groups of five boys each to be taught in very different ways: these were labelled 'authoritarian', 'democratic' and 'laissez-faire'.
sentences.zh: 他们安排三组、每组五名男孩，分别接受截然不同的教学方式，这三种方式被标为“权威式”、“民主式”和“放任式”。

sentences.en: The first two of these were similar to Anderson's concept of dominative and integrative teachers.
sentences.zh: 其中前两种与安德森提出的支配型教师与融合型教师的概念相近。

sentences.en: (H) Beginning with Withall's work in 1949, there was much greater interest in interaction within the classroom.
sentences.zh: 从威索尔（Withall）1949 年的研究开始，人们对课堂内部互动的兴趣大为增强。

sentences.en: Withall used the term 'social-emotional climate' to describe the emotional tone created as a result of face-to-face interaction in groups, and, like many who followed him, concentrated his analysis of this climate on the study of teachers' verbal behavior.
sentences.zh: 威索尔用“社会—情绪氛围”一词来描述群体面对面互动所形成的情感基调，并且像许多后继者一样，将这种氛围的分析重心放在对教师言语行为的研究上。

sentences.en: Withall also made efforts towards increasing the reliability of analyses, and this important pioneering work in the development of classroom observation methodology was followed by many others during the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 威索尔还致力于提高分析的信度，他在课堂观察方法论发展中的这项开创性重要工作，在 20 世纪 50 年代被许多其他研究者所沿用。

sentences.en: (I) Partly because of the disappointing results of the teacher-effectiveness research, and partly because of the general neglect in earlier work of the variables of actual classroom behavior, the decade 1960–70 produced a large number of studies of classroom processes, based on observation of teachers at work.
sentences.zh: 一方面是由于教师效能研究结果令人失望，另一方面是由于以往研究对实际课堂行为这一变量普遍忽视，1960—1970 这十年间出现了大量基于观察教师工作的课堂过程研究。

sentences.en: A Self-propelled motion is a fundamental ability in many organisms.
sentences.zh: 自我推进的运动是许多生物的一种基本能力。

sentences.en: From the beating flagella of tiny plankton keeping afloat near the ocean surface to the playful perfection of dolphins surfing the bow wave of a ship, marine creatures have adopted a huge variety of styles, speeds, and methods of movement.
sentences.zh: 从微小浮游生物那拍打着、让它们在海面附近保持漂浮的鞭毛，到海豚冲浪般完美地嬉戏于一艘船的船首波，海洋生物已采用了种类繁多的运动风格、速度和方法。

sentences.en: Each species has its own particular need for the evolutionary developments that have taken place, but the basic requirements are the same—finding food, avoiding predation, seeking a mate or a safe place to have young, or migrating to an area with more favorable conditions.
sentences.zh: 每个物种对已经发生的进化发展都有自己特定的需求，但基本的要求是相同的——寻找食物、躲避被捕食、寻觅配偶或一个生育后代的安全之所、或迁徙到一个条件更有利的区域。

sentences.en: B The particular physical properties of water that most affect movement are density, viscosity (stickiness), and buoyancy.
sentences.zh: 对运动影响最大的水的特定物理属性是密度、黏度（黏性）和浮力。

sentences.en: Seawater is about 800 times denser than air and nearly 100 times as viscous.
sentences.zh: 海水的密度约为空气的800倍，黏度近100倍。

sentences.en: Consequently, there is much more resistance to movement than on land, as anyone will know who has ever tried to wade through waist- deep water.
sentences.zh: 因此，运动所受的阻力比在陆地上大得多，任何曾试图蹚过齐腰深水的人都会知道这一点。

sentences.en: However, with density comes much greater buoyancy, so that organisms need to spend relatively little energy to stay afloat.
sentences.zh: 然而，随密度而来的是大得多的浮力，因此生物只需花相对较少的能量就能保持漂浮。

sentences.en: As they move through the ocean environment, organisms seek to make wave motion, currents, and natural turbulence work to their advantage, not to their detriment.
sentences.zh: 当它们穿过海洋环境移动时，生物寻求让波浪运动、洋流和自然湍流为它们所用、而非对它们不利。

sentences.en: C Most fishes have swim bladders to help them offset the density of their bodies and so maintain neutral buoyancy with minimal effort.
sentences.zh: 大多数鱼有鱼鳔来帮助它们抵消身体的密度，从而以最小的力气维持中性浮力。

sentences.en: These small, gas-filled chambers contain specialized networks of blood vessels that can add or remove gases such as oxygen and carbon dioxide.
sentences.zh: 这些小的、充气的腔室含有专门的血管网络，能添加或移除氧和二氧化碳等气体。

sentences.en: The ability to remain indefinitely at a constant depth without expending energy is especially important for slow-moving fishes that seek food in the shallows, or for those that hunt and scavenge in kelp forests.
sentences.zh: 在不消耗能量的情况下无限期地保持在一个恒定深度的能力，对在浅水中觅食的慢游鱼类、或对那些在海带林中捕猎和觅食的鱼类尤其重要。

sentences.en: Active swimmers, such as mackerel, skipjacks, and sharks, do not have swim bladders because they need to change depth more rapidly than they could regulate the gas content.
sentences.zh: 活跃的游泳者，比如鲭鱼、鲣鱼和鲨鱼，没有鱼鳔，因为它们需要比调节气体含量所能做到的更快地改变深度。

sentences.en: These fishes must swim forever or they will sink.
sentences.zh: 这些鱼必须永远游动，否则它们会下沉。

sentences.en: D Many animals, especially the tiny zooplankton, have taken to a life of simply drifting near the surface, contentedly feeding on the microscopic phytoplankton and bacteria floating there.
sentences.zh: 许多动物，尤其是微小的浮游动物，已习惯于一种只是在水面附近漂流、心满意足地以漂浮在那里的微观浮游植物和细菌为食的生活。

sentences.en: Although life among the plankton might seem easy, there is in fact a remarkable range of movement.
sentences.zh: 尽管浮游生物中的生活看起来也许容易，但事实上有着非凡的运动幅度。

sentences.en: Some tiny plankton only 1–2 mm in length actually travel long distances each day.
sentences.zh: 一些只有1到2毫米长的微小浮游生物，实际上每天都行进很长的距离。

sentences.en: Species that live below the level where sunlight reaches nightly swim hundreds of meters up to the surface to feed in the relative safety of darkness.
sentences.zh: 生活在阳光所及水平以下的物种，每晚游上数百米到水面，在黑暗相对的安全中觅食。

sentences.en: At dawn, they sink back down in an effort to escape predators—a double journey equivalent to a person swimming 700 km a day.
sentences.zh: 黎明时，它们又沉回去以努力躲避捕食者——这是一段相当于一个人每天游700公里的双程旅程。

sentences.en: E It has taken marine creatures millions of years of evolution to overcome the chief deterrent to motion through a dense medium such as water—that of drag resistance.
sentences.zh: 海洋生物花了数百万年的进化，才克服了穿过水这样致密介质运动的主要阻碍——阻力。

sentences.en: Swimming efficiency has been achieved by minimizing the three types of drag created by friction, turbulence, and body form.
sentences.zh: 游泳效率是通过把由摩擦、湍流和身体形态所产生的三种阻力降到最低来实现的。

sentences.en: To reduce surface friction, the body must be smooth and rounded.
sentences.zh: 为减少表面摩擦，身体必须光滑而圆润。

sentences.en: In addition, the scales of most fishes are coated with slime to lubricate their passage through water.
sentences.zh: 此外，大多数鱼的鳞片都涂有黏液，以润滑它们穿过水的通道。

sentences.en: To reduce the turbulent drag created as water flows around the moving shape, a rounded front end and tapered back end are required.
sentences.zh: 为减少水流过移动形体时产生的湍流阻力，需要一个圆润的前端和一个渐细的后端。

sentences.en: To reduce form drag, the cross-sectional area of the body should be minimal—a pencil shape would be ideal.
sentences.zh: 为减少形态阻力，身体的横截面积应尽量小——铅笔形会是理想的。

sentences.en: The combined shape, taking into account all three types of drag, is the streamlined torpedo form of a tuna, the fastest-swimming of all fishes.
sentences.zh: 把三种阻力都考虑在内的综合形状，就是金枪鱼那流线型的鱼雷形态，金枪鱼是所有鱼中游得最快的。

sentences.en: F Speed is only one of three important aspects of swimming ability.
sentences.zh: 速度只是游泳能力三个重要方面之一。

sentences.en: Tuna, swordfish, and mackerel all specialize in fast, steady cruising, but there are many other fishes for whom sustained speed is less important, such as the barracuda.
sentences.zh: 金枪鱼、剑鱼和鲭鱼都专擅快速、平稳的巡游，但还有许多其他鱼类，对它们来说持续的速度不那么重要，比如梭鱼。

sentences.en: This formidable predator specializes in swift acceleration, and has a far higher success rate for its attacks than its steady-cruising cousins.
sentences.zh: 这种可畏的捕食者专擅迅猛的加速，其攻击的成功率远高于它那些平稳巡游的表亲。

sentences.en: The freshwater pike, which lurks in the shadows until its quarry is within striking distance and then lunges with great rapidity, achieves a remarkable 70–80 percent success rate.
sentences.zh: 淡水梭鱼潜伏在阴影中，直到它的猎物进入攻击距离，然后极其迅速地猛扑过去，取得了非凡的百分之七十到八十的成功率。

sentences.en: The third specialization is maneuverability, best demonstrated by the butterfly fishes.
sentences.zh: 第三种专长是机动性，由蝴蝶鱼最好地展现出来。

sentences.en: These have disk-shaped bodies that permit abrupt changes of track.
sentences.zh: 这些鱼有盘状的身体，允许航向的突然改变。

sentences.en: Many fishes are generalists, being at least partly proficient in all three modes of movement.
sentences.zh: 许多鱼是多面手，在所有三种运动模式中都至少部分熟练。

sentences.en: G Almost all fishes swim by undulation.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有鱼都靠波动来游泳。

sentences.en: Strong W-shaped muscles along the side of the body progressively contract and relax in sequence, from head to tail and from side to side, creating a traveling horizontal wave.
sentences.zh: 沿身体两侧的强壮W形肌肉依次渐进地收缩和放松，从头到尾、从一侧到另一侧，制造出一道行进的水平波。

sentences.en: The body is thrown into a series of curves that press sideways and back against the water, producing a forward thrust.
sentences.zh: 身体被甩成一系列曲线，朝侧面和后方压向水，产生一股向前的推力。

sentences.en: The narrow, elongated forms of eels and sea snakes allow easy undulation along their full length.
sentences.zh: 鳗和海蛇那狭窄、细长的形体允许沿其全长轻松地波动。

sentences.en: In contrast, the more stubby and inflexible bodies of armor-plated trunkfish use only the swish of their short tail fins to move themselves through the water.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，披甲的箱鲀那更粗短、不灵活的身体只用它们短尾鳍的摆动来推动自己穿过水。

sentences.en: Most other fishes combine elements of both methods, coordinating powerful strokes of the tail fins with subtle body undulations.
sentences.zh: 大多数其他鱼把两种方法的要素结合起来，把尾鳍有力的划动与微妙的身体波动协调起来。

sentences.en: H A fish's fins also play a vital and versatile role.
sentences.zh: 鱼的鳍也起着至关重要而多样的作用。

sentences.en: The vertically oriented dorsal and ventral fins on the back and belly control sideways motion, while up-and-down motion is controlled by the pectoral and pelvic fins on the fish's sides.
sentences.zh: 背上和腹上垂直朝向的背鳍和腹鳍控制侧向运动，而上下运动由鱼两侧的胸鳍和腹鳍控制。

sentences.en: Whereas the shape of the tail fin relates directly to speed—crescent-moon-shaped for fast cruising, broad and flat for acceleration—the style and arrangement of the other fins are crucial for maneuverability.
sentences.zh: 而尾鳍的形状直接关系到速度——快速巡游用新月形，加速用宽而平的——其他鳍的样式和排布则对机动性至关重要。

sentences.en: Puffer fishes scull with tiny, oscillating pectoral fins, while butterfly fishes undulate their broad dorsal and ventral fins, twisting and turning with great precision through intricate coral reefs.
sentences.zh: 鲀鱼用微小、摆动的胸鳍来划水，而蝴蝶鱼则波动它们宽阔的背鳍和腹鳍，极其精确地在错综复杂的珊瑚礁中扭转、转向。

sentences.en: (A) One of the most prominent design issues in pharmacy is that of drug packages and the patient information leaflets (PILs) included in them.
sentences.zh: 药学中最突出的设计问题之一，就是药品包装及其中所附的患者用药说明书（PIL）的设计问题。

sentences.en: Many pharmacists are concerned that current designs are 'accidents waiting to happen'.
sentences.zh: 许多药剂师担心，现行设计是“等着发生的事故”。

sentences.en: The UK government shares this concern and, in 2003, the National Patient Safety Agency created a new role, appointing Colum Lowe, who has 14 years' experience as a designer in the private sector, as head of design and human factors.
sentences.zh: 英国政府也有同样的担忧。2003 年，国家患者安全署（National Patient Safety Agency）设立了一个新职位，任命在私营部门有 14 年设计经验的科伦·洛（Colum Lowe）担任设计与人因负责人。

sentences.en: (B) Packaging design in the pharmaceutical industry is handled by either in-house teams or external design agencies.
sentences.zh: 制药行业的包装设计由内部团队或外部设计机构负责。

sentences.en: For packaging design of over-the-counter medicines, which do not have to be dispensed by a pharmacist but can be bought directly from a sales assistant, characteristics such as attractiveness and distinguishability are important and so these are usually commissioned from an external design team.
sentences.zh: 对于非处方药——它们不必由药剂师调配，可以直接从售货员处购买——包装设计的吸引力和辨识度等特性很重要，因此通常交由外部设计团队承接。

sentences.en: The marketing team prepares the initial brief and the designers come up with six or seven designs.
sentences.zh: 市场团队准备初始简报，设计师提出六七个方案。

sentences.en: Two or three of these are then tested on a consumer group.
sentences.zh: 其中两三个方案随后会在一个消费者群体中进行测试。

sentences.en: In contrast, most designs for prescription-only products are created in-house.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，大多数处方药包装设计是在公司内部完成的。

sentences.en: In some cases, this may simply involve the company's design team applying the house design and then handing it over to design engineers rather than testing the design on a consumer group.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，这可能只是公司设计团队套用本公司的统一设计，然后把它交给设计工程师，而不在消费者群体中进行测试。

sentences.en: Clearly this process cannot adequately address the needs of the wide variety of patients using medication.
sentences.zh: 显然，这一流程无法充分满足使用药物的各类不同患者的需求。

sentences.en: Design considerations
sentences.zh: 设计上的考量

sentences.en: (C) In her book Information Design for Patient Safety, Thea Swayne highlighted a multitude of design problems.
sentences.zh: 西娅·斯韦恩（Thea Swayne）在她的著作《面向患者安全的信息设计》（Information Design for Patient Safety）中，列出了许多设计问题。

sentences.en: For example, drugs that look or sound alike can lead to confusion; small type sizes and even the glare on silver-foil packaging can lead to names or instructions being misread.
sentences.zh: 例如，外观或名称相近的药物会导致混淆；字号过小、甚至银箔包装的反光都可能导致名称或说明被误读。

sentences.en: One such example is a drug that was accidentally injected into a patient through the spine (intrathecally) rather than through the veins (intravenously).
sentences.zh: 一个这样的例子是：一种药物本应经静脉注射，却被意外通过脊柱（鞘内）注射给了一位患者。

sentences.en: Investigations following this tragedy attributed some blame to the poor choice of typescript used on the drug container.
sentences.zh: 此次悲剧的事后调查把部分责任归咎于药物容器上字体选用不当。

sentences.en: Furthermore, according to Swayne, real situations in which medicines are used include a parent giving a cough medicine to a child in the middle of the night; packaging should be designed for moments such as these rather than for the ideal world of a hospital.
sentences.zh: 此外，按斯韦恩的说法，药物被使用的真实情境包括家长在半夜给孩子服用止咳糖浆；包装应当为这样的时刻而设计，而不是为医院里的“理想世界”而设计。

sentences.en: Safety and compliance
sentences.zh: 安全性与依从性

sentences.en: (D) Child protection is another area that gives designers opportunities to improve safety.
sentences.zh: 儿童保护是另一个设计师能用来改善安全性的领域。

sentences.en: According to the Child Accident Prevention Trust, 70% of children admitted to hospital with suspected poisoning have swallowed medicines, and although child-resistant lids have helped, they are not yet fully effective.
sentences.zh: 据儿童意外预防信托基金（Child Accident Prevention Trust）的数据，因疑似中毒入院的儿童中有 70% 是吞食了药物，尽管防儿童的盖子起到了帮助，但还未做到完全有效。

sentences.en: There is scope for improving what is currently available, according to Richard Mawle, a freelance product designer who feels it is not just children who are blocked by child-proof closures.
sentences.zh: 自由职业产品设计师理查德·莫尔（Richard Mawle）认为，目前的产品仍有改进空间——而被防儿童盖挡住的并不只有儿童。

sentences.en: 'Many child-resistant packs are based on strength but older people may have the same level of strength as a child,' he explained, and suggested that better designs could rely on cognitive skills (e.g.

sentences.en: removing the lid using a three-step process).
sentences.zh: 通过三步流程才能打开盖子）。

sentences.en: Mawle also worked on a project which involved applying his skills to packaging and PILs.
sentences.zh: 莫尔还参与过一个项目，把他的技能应用于包装和 PIL。

sentences.en: Commenting on the information presented, he said: 'There can be an awful lot of junk at the beginning of PILs.
sentences.zh: 在评论 PIL 上所呈现的信息时，他说：“PIL 开头可能有一大堆没用的东西。

sentences.en: For example, why are company details towards the beginning of a leaflet when what might be more vital for the patient is that the medicine should not be taken with alcohol?'
sentences.zh: 例如，公司细节为何放在说明书开头，而对患者来说更关键的可能是这种药不能与酒同服？“

sentences.en: Design principles and guidelines
sentences.zh: 设计原则与指南

sentences.en: (E) Most designers work according to basic principles; for example, certain print styles are known to be more difficult to read than others.
sentences.zh: 大多数设计师按基本原则工作；例如，已知某些印刷字体比其他字体更难阅读。

sentences.en: Look-alike boxes present the potential for errors and an obvious solution would be to use colours to highlight a larger dosage of a drug.
sentences.zh: 外观相似的盒子有出错的潜在风险，一个显而易见的解决办法是用颜色突出某种药的较大剂量。

sentences.en: However, according to Thea Swayne, designating a colour to a particular dosage is not recommended because this could lead to the user not reading the text on a box.
sentences.zh: 然而，按西娅·斯韦恩的说法，把特定颜色指定给特定剂量并不被推荐，因为这可能让使用者不再阅读包装上的文字。

sentences.en: Design features can provide the basis for lengthy debates.
sentences.zh: 设计特征可以引发长时间的辩论。

sentences.en: One argument is that if all packaging was white with black lettering, people would have no choice but to read every box carefully.
sentences.zh: 一种观点认为，如果所有包装都是白底黑字，人们除了仔细阅读每个盒子之外就别无选择。

sentences.en: The problem is that trials of drug packaging are few – common signage studies concern road-traffic signs and visual-display units.
sentences.zh: 问题在于：关于药物包装的试验很少——常见的标识研究关注的是道路交通标志和视觉显示器。

sentences.en: Although some designers take results from such studies into account, proving that a particular feature is beneficial can be difficult.
sentences.zh: 尽管一些设计师会参考这类研究的结果，但要证明某一具体特征是有益的可能很困难。

sentences.en: For example, current UK legislation requires packaging to include the name of the medicine in Braille, but, according to Karel van der Waarde, a design consultant to the pharmaceutical industry, 'it is not known how much visually impaired patients will benefit nor how much the reading of visually able patients will be impaired'.
sentences.zh: 例如，英国现行立法要求包装在药品名称处标注盲文，但据制药业设计顾问卡雷尔·范德瓦尔德（Karel van der Waarde）所说，“目前并不清楚视障患者会从中受益多少，也不清楚普通患者的阅读会被妨碍多少”。

sentences.en: Van der Waarde is sceptical about current legislation and says that many regulatory authorities do not have the resources to handle packaging information properly.
sentences.zh: 范德瓦尔德对现行立法持怀疑态度，并表示许多监管机构没有足够资源去妥善处理包装信息。

sentences.en: 'They do not look at the use of packaging in a practical context – they only see one box at a time and not several together as pharmacists would do,' he said.
sentences.zh: “他们不会在实际语境中看包装的使用——只看一次一个盒子，而不像药剂师那样同时看好几个，”他说。

sentences.en: Innovation
sentences.zh: 创新

sentences.en: (F) On a positive note, a recent innovation exhibition revealed several new designs.
sentences.zh: 积极的一面是，最近一次创新展览上出现了几款新设计。

sentences.en: 'The popper' aims to help arthritis sufferers remove tablets from blister packs , and 'Pluspoint' is an adrenaline auto-injector (a device that allows diabetics to inject themselves) aimed at overcoming the fact that many patients do not carry their medication due to its prohibitive size.
sentences.zh: “the popper”旨在帮助关节炎患者从泡罩包装中取出药片，而“Pluspoint”是一款肾上腺素自动注射器（一种让糖尿病人能给自己注射的装置），其目的是克服许多患者因体积过大而不随身携带药物的问题。

sentences.en: The aim of good design is to try to make things more user-friendly as well as safer.
sentences.zh: 良好设计的目标是让东西更易使用，也更安全。

sentences.en: The guidelines in Information Design for Patient Safety are not intended to be legally binding.
sentences.zh: 《面向患者安全的信息设计》中的指南并不打算具有法律约束力。

sentences.en: Rather, the book's purpose is to create a basic design standard and to stimulate innovation.
sentences.zh: 相反，该书旨在建立基本的设计标准并激发创新。

sentences.en: The challenge for the pharmaceutical industry is to adopt such a standard.
sentences.zh: 制药业面临的挑战是采纳这样的标准。

records.title: Inside the mind of a fan

sentences.en: A At about the same time that the poet Homer invented the epic there, the ancient Greeks started a festival in which men competed in a single race, about 200 metres long.
sentences.zh: 大约就在诗人荷马在那里创作出史诗的同时，古希腊人开始了一项节庆，男子们在其中参加一场约200米长的单项赛跑。

sentences.en: The winner received a branch of wild olives.
sentences.zh: 胜者会得到一根野橄榄枝。

sentences.en: The Greeks called this celebration the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 希腊人把这一庆典称为奥林匹克。

sentences.en: Though the ancient sprint remains, today the Olympics are far more than that.
sentences.zh: 尽管古老的短跑仍在，但今天的奥运会远不止于此。

sentences.en: Indeed, the Games seem to celebrate the dream of progress as embodied in the human form.
sentences.zh: 的确，这些赛事似乎在颂扬一个体现于人类形体之中的进步之梦。

sentences.en: That the Games are intoxicating to watch is beyond question.
sentences.zh: 这些赛事看起来令人陶醉，这是毋庸置疑的。

sentences.en: During the Athens Olympics in 2004, 3.4 billion people, half the world, watched them on television.
sentences.zh: 在2004年雅典奥运会期间，有34亿人、即全世界一半的人，在电视上观看了它们。

sentences.en: Certainly, being a spectator is a thrilling experience—but why?
sentences.zh: 当然，做一名观众是一种激动人心的体验——但为什么呢？

sentences.en: B In 1996, three Italian neuroscientists, Giacomo Rizzolatti, Leonardo Fogassi and Vittorio Gallese, examined the premotor cortex of monkeys.
sentences.zh: 在1996年，三位意大利神经科学家，贾科莫·里佐拉蒂、莱昂纳多·福加西和维托里奥·加莱塞，研究了猴子的运动前皮层。

sentences.en: They discovered that inside these primate brains there were groups of cells that 'store vocabularies of motor actions', just as there are grammars of movement.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，在这些灵长类的大脑内部，有一组组细胞“储存着运动动作的词汇”，正如有动作的语法一样。

sentences.en: These networks of cells are the bodily 'sentences' we use every day, the ones our brain has chosen to retain and refine.
sentences.zh: 这些细胞网络是我们每天使用的身体“句子”，是我们的大脑选择保留和精炼的那些。

sentences.en: Think, for example, about a golf swing.
sentences.zh: 比如，想想挥杆。

sentences.en: To those who have only watched the Masters Tournament on TV, golfing seems easy.
sentences.zh: 对那些只在电视上看过大师赛的人来说，打高尔夫似乎很容易。

sentences.en: To the novice, however, the skill of casting a smooth arc with a lopsided metal stick is virtually impossible.
sentences.zh: 然而，对新手来说，用一根不对称的金属杆划出一道平滑弧线的技巧几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: This is because most novices swing with their consciousness, using an area of the brain next to the premotor cortex.
sentences.zh: 这是因为大多数新手是用他们的意识在挥杆，使用紧挨运动前皮层的一个大脑区域。

sentences.en: To the expert, on the other hand, a perfectly balanced stroke is second nature.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，对专家来说，一次完美平衡的击球是第二天性。

sentences.en: For him, the motor action has become memorized, and the movements are embedded in the neurons of his premotor cortex.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，这个运动动作已被记住，而这些动作嵌入在他运动前皮层的神经元中。

sentences.en: He hits the ball with the tranquility of his perfected autopilot.
sentences.zh: 他以其臻于完美的自动驾驶般的平静击球。

sentences.en: C These neurons in the premotor cortex, besides explaining why certain athletes seem to possess almost unbelievable levels of skill, have an even more amazing characteristic, one that caused Rizzolatti, Fogassi and Gallese to give them the lofty title 'mirror neurons'.
sentences.zh: 运动前皮层中的这些神经元，除了解释为什么某些运动员似乎拥有几乎令人难以置信的技艺水平之外，还有一个更惊人的特征，正是它使里佐拉蒂、福加西和加莱塞给了它们“镜像神经元”这一崇高的称号。

sentences.en: They note that 'the main functional characteristic of mirror neurons is that they become active both when the monkey performs a particular action (for example, grasping an object or holding it) and, astonishingly, when it sees another individual performing a similar action'.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，“镜像神经元的主要功能特征是，当猴子执行一个特定动作（比如抓握或握住一个物体）时它们会变得活跃，而且令人惊讶的是，当它看到另一个个体执行一个类似动作时也会”。

sentences.en: Humans have an even more elaborate mirror neuron system.
sentences.zh: 人类有一个甚至更精细的镜像神经元系统。

sentences.en: These peculiar cells mirror, inside the brain, the outside world: they enable us to internalize the actions of another.
sentences.zh: 这些奇特的细胞在大脑内部映射出外部世界：它们使我们能够把另一个人的动作内化。

sentences.en: In order to be activated, though, these cells require what the scientists call 'goal-orientated movements'.
sentences.zh: 不过，要被激活，这些细胞需要科学家所称的“目标导向的动作”。

sentences.en: If we are staring at a photograph, a fixed image of a runner mid-stride, our mirror neurons are totally silent.
sentences.zh: 如果我们盯着一张照片，一张跑步者半步定格的固定图像，我们的镜像神经元就完全沉默。

sentences.en: They only fire when the runner is active: running, moving or sprinting.
sentences.zh: 它们只在跑步者处于活动状态时才放电：奔跑、移动或冲刺。

sentences.en: D What these electrophysiological studies indicate is that when we watch a golfer or a runner in action, the mirror neurons in our own premotor cortex light up as if we were the ones competing.
sentences.zh: 这些电生理学研究所表明的是，当我们观看一名高尔夫球手或一名跑步者在行动中时，我们自己运动前皮层中的镜像神经元会亮起来，仿佛是我们在参赛。

sentences.en: This phenomenon of neural mirroring was first discovered in 1954, when two French physiologists, Gastaut and Bert, found that the brains of humans vibrate with two distinct wavelengths, alpha and mu.
sentences.zh: 这种神经镜像现象最早是在1954年被发现的，当时两位法国生理学家，加斯托和贝尔，发现人脑以两种不同的波长振动，阿尔法波和缪波。

sentences.en: The mu system is involved in neural mirroring.
sentences.zh: 缪系统参与神经镜像。

sentences.en: It is active when our bodies are still, and disappears whenever we do something active, like playing a sport or changing the TV channel.
sentences.zh: 它在我们身体静止时活跃，而每当我们做某种活动的事情、比如进行一项运动或换电视频道时，它就消失。

sentences.en: The surprising fact is that the mu signal is also quiet when we watch someone else being active, as on TV.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的事实是，当我们观看别人在活动、比如在电视上时，缪信号也是安静的。

sentences.en: These results are the effect of mirror neurons.
sentences.zh: 这些结果是镜像神经元的作用。

sentences.en: E Rizzolatti, Fogassi and Gallese call the idea of mirror neurons the 'direct matching hypothesis'.
sentences.zh: 里佐拉蒂、福加西和加莱塞把镜像神经元这一观念称为“直接匹配假说”。

sentences.en: They believe that we only understand the movement of sports stars when we 'map the visual representation of the observed action onto our motor representation of the same action'.
sentences.zh: 他们相信，我们只有在“把所观察动作的视觉表征映射到我们自己对同一动作的运动表征上”时，才理解体育明星的动作。

sentences.en: According to this theory, watching an Olympic athlete 'causes the motor system of the observer to resonate.
sentences.zh: 按照这一理论，观看一名奥运选手“会使观察者的运动系统产生共鸣。

sentences.en: The 'motor knowledge' of the observer is used to understand the observed action.'
sentences.zh: 观察者的‘运动知识’被用来理解所观察的动作。”

sentences.en: But mirror neurons are more than just the neural basis for our attitude to sport.
sentences.zh: 但镜像神经元不只是我们对待体育态度的神经基础。

sentences.en: It turns out that watching a great golfer makes us better golfers, and watching a great sprinter actually makes us run faster.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，观看一位伟大的高尔夫球手会使我们成为更好的高尔夫球手，而观看一位伟大的短跑运动员实际上会使我们跑得更快。

sentences.en: This ability to learn by watching is a crucial skill.
sentences.zh: 这种通过观看来学习的能力是一项至关重要的技能。

sentences.en: From the acquisition of language as infants to learning facial expressions, mimesis (copying) is an essential part of being conscious.
sentences.zh: 从婴儿时期对语言的习得到学习面部表情，模仿是有意识这件事必不可少的一部分。

sentences.en: The best athletes are those with a premotor cortex capable of imagining the movements of victory, together with the physical properties to make those movements real.
sentences.zh: 最优秀的运动员是那些拥有能够想象胜利动作之运动前皮层、连同把那些动作变为现实之身体素质的人。

sentences.en: F But how many of us regularly watch sports in order to be a better athlete?
sentences.zh: 但我们当中有多少人会为了成为更好的运动员而定期观看体育呢？

sentences.en: Rather, we watch sport for the feeling, the human drama.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们观看体育是为了那种感觉、那种人间戏剧。

sentences.en: This feeling also derives from mirror neurons.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉也源于镜像神经元。

sentences.en: By letting spectators share in the motions of victory, they also allow us to share in its feelings.
sentences.zh: 通过让观众分享胜利的动作，它们也让我们分享胜利的感觉。

sentences.en: This is because they are directly connected to the amygdala, one of the main brain regions involved in emotion.
sentences.zh: 这是因为它们直接连接到杏仁核，那是涉及情感的主要大脑区域之一。

sentences.en: During the Olympics, the mirror neurons of whole nations will be electrically identical, their athletes causing spectators to feel, just for a second or two, the same thing.
sentences.zh: 在奥运会期间，整个国家的镜像神经元在电学上将是相同的，它们的运动员使观众感受到，哪怕只是一两秒钟，同样的东西。

sentences.en: Watching sports brings people together.
sentences.zh: 观看体育把人们聚到一起。

sentences.en: Most of us will never run a mile in under four minutes, or hit a home run.
sentences.zh: 我们当中大多数人永远不会在四分钟内跑完一英里、或击出一记本垒打。

sentences.en: Our consolation comes in watching.
sentences.zh: 我们的慰藉来自观看。

sentences.en: When we gather around the TV, we all feel, just for a moment, what it is to do something perfectly.
sentences.zh: 当我们围坐在电视旁时，我们都感受到，哪怕只是片刻，把某件事做得完美无瑕是什么滋味。
