sentences.en: (A) Of all the ideas for improving education, few are as simple or attractive as reducing the number of pupils per teacher.
sentences.zh: 在所有改善教育的想法中，很少有像减少每位教师所教学生人数这样简单或有吸引力的。

sentences.en: Unlike competing proposals for reform, class-size reductions rarely elicit huge outcries or involve structural change.
sentences.zh: 与相互竞争的改革提案不同，缩减班级规模很少招致巨大的抗议、或涉及结构性的变化。

sentences.en: The testing of educators, by contrast, generally arouses the anger of unions.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，对教育者的考核通常会激起工会的愤怒。

sentences.en: Similarly, establishing special 'charter' schools involves privileging some schools over others, with the credits provided usually coming out of the budgets of struggling local schools.
sentences.zh: 同样，设立特殊的“特许”学校涉及让一些学校优先于另一些，而所提供的拨款通常出自陷入困境的当地学校的预算。

sentences.en: With its uncomplicated appeal, class-size reduction in the U.S. has lately gone from being a subject of primary academic interest to a policy juggernaut with over twenty states aiming at decreasing class sizes.
sentences.zh: 凭着其简单的吸引力，缩减班级规模在美国近来已从一个主要属于学术兴趣的话题，变成了一股政策大潮，有二十多个州以缩小班级规模为目标。

sentences.en: (B) Do small classes improve school achievement?
sentences.zh: 小班能提高学业成绩吗？

sentences.en: To answer this, investigators have attempted to analyse existing data, such as records at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 为了回答这一点，调查者试图分析现有的数据，比如美国教育部的记录。

sentences.en: Department of Education.
sentences.zh: 这些数据揭示，在1969到1997年间师生比急剧下降，但学业表现没有显著的提高。

sentences.en: These reveal that there were steep drops in pupil-teacher ratios between 1969 and 1997, but no significant gains in academic performance.
sentences.zh: 但这些发现是否意味着班级规模没有差别呢？

sentences.en: But do these findings mean that class size makes no difference?
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 比如，学校追求的不只是高考试分数；它们通常还努力让自己的辍学率保持在低位。

sentences.en: For instance, schools strive for more than just high test scores; they also usually try to keep their drop-out rates low.
sentences.zh: 而事实上，年龄较大学生的辍学率在那段时期里大幅下降了。

sentences.en: And, indeed, the drop-out rate for older students fell considerably over that period.
sentences.zh: 因为辍学者一般来自成绩分布的低端，辍学率的下降可以被预期会拉低平均考试分数。

sentences.en: Because drop-outs generally come from the low end of the achievement distribution, a reduction in the drop-out rate could be expected to pull down average test scores.
sentences.zh: 对那些数据打折扣的另一个原因，是确保一个公平竞争环境之难。

sentences.en: Another reason for discounting those data is the difficulty of ensuring a level playing field.
sentences.zh: 在一个完美的世界里，美国学生会全都来自富裕的家庭，有两位受过高等教育、说英语、参与孩子教育的父母。

sentences.en: In a perfect world, U.S. students would all come from well-off families, with two highly educated English-speaking parents who are involved in their children's schooling.
sentences.zh: 教师会全都富有创造力、并对学科内容有完全的掌握。

sentences.en: Teachers would all be creative and have complete mastery of the subject matter.
sentences.zh: 现实非常不同。

sentences.en: The reality is very different.
sentences.zh: 现实非常不同。

sentences.en: (C) Over the past 35 years, some studies of existing data have produced evidence that smaller classes benefit students, but most of these studies were poorly designed.
sentences.zh: 在过去35年里，一些对现有数据的研究产生了证据表明小班有益于学生，但这些研究大多设计得很差。

sentences.en: The exception was the Tennessee study called Project STAR (Student Teacher Achievement Ratio).
sentences.zh: 例外是田纳西州那项叫STAR项目（师生成绩比）的研究。

sentences.en: Frederick Mosteller of Harvard University has called it 'one of the greatest experiments in education in United States history'.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的弗雷德里克·莫斯特勒称它为“美国历史上最伟大的教育实验之一”。

sentences.en: Students entering kindergarten were randomly assigned to one of three kinds of classes: a small class of 13 to 17 students, a regular-size class of 22 to 26 or a regular- size class with both a teacher and a full-time teacher's aide.
sentences.zh: 进入幼儿园的学生被随机分配到三类班级之一：13到17名学生的小班、22到26名的常规班、或一个既有一名教师又有一名全职助教的常规班。

sentences.en: The students remained in whatever category they had been assigned to throughout the third grade, after which they joined a regular classroom in the fourth.
sentences.zh: 学生在整个三年级阶段都留在他们被分配到的那一类里，之后他们在四年级加入一个常规班级。

sentences.en: To ensure that teaching quality did not differ, teachers were randomly assigned to small and regular- size classrooms.
sentences.zh: 为确保教学质量没有差别，教师被随机分配到小班和常规班。

sentences.en: Few teachers received any special training for working with small classes, and there were no new curricular materials.
sentences.zh: 很少有教师为带小班接受过任何特殊培训，也没有新的课程材料。

sentences.en: (D) At the end of STAR, researchers analysed the data.
sentences.zh: 在STAR结束时，研究人员分析了数据。

sentences.en: Jeremy Finn of New York University and Charles Achilles of Eastern Michigan University found evidence for 'an array of benefits of small classes'.
sentences.zh: 纽约大学的杰里米·芬恩和东密歇根大学的查尔斯·阿基里斯找到了“小班一系列益处”的证据。

sentences.en: They calculated that students in smaller classes were outperforming their counterparts in regular-sized classes by the first grade and that this advantage persisted even after students returned to larger classes.
sentences.zh: 他们计算出，小班的学生到一年级时表现就超过常规班的同龄人，而且这种优势即便在学生回到大班之后仍然持续。

sentences.en: They also found that the effect was stronger for black and Hispanic minority groups – a significant finding for policy-makers.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现，这种效应对黑人和西班牙裔少数群体更强——这对政策制定者来说是一个重要的发现。

sentences.en: Eric Hanushek of Stanford, however, criticises some of STAR's key conclusions.
sentences.zh: 然而，斯坦福的埃里克·哈努谢克批评了STAR的一些关键结论。

sentences.en: He argues that STAR does not prove that gains persist long after students return to regular classes.
sentences.zh: 他主张，STAR并没有证明在学生回到常规班很久之后增益仍然持续。

sentences.en: It was debatable how much later improvement stemmed from other factors, such as a supportive home.
sentences.zh: 后来的改善有多少源于其他因素、比如一个支持性的家庭，是有争议的。

sentences.en: Nor does he accept that the benefits accumulate, with participants widening the gap with their peers in larger classes year by year.
sentences.zh: 他也不接受这种增益会累积、参与者逐年与大班同龄人拉大差距的看法。

sentences.en: Hanushek and others have also shown that during the study too many children moved from regular to small classes, probably because school personnel caved in to parent demands.
sentences.zh: 哈努谢克和其他人还表明，在研究期间太多孩子从常规班转到了小班，很可能是因为校方人员屈服于家长的要求。

sentences.en: And Hanushek also asserts that STAR failed to ensure good randomisation of teacher and student assignments.
sentences.zh: 哈努谢克还断言，STAR没能确保教师和学生分配的良好随机化。

sentences.en: However, these points do not undermine STAR's basic findings.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些观点并没有动摇STAR的基本发现。

sentences.en: (E) The largest public class size reduction programme so far, California's, stands more as a warning than as worthy of emulation.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止最大的公立缩减班级规模项目，加利福尼亚的，更应作为一个警示、而非值得效仿。

sentences.en: That state is trying to reduce classes in kindergarten through grade three despite a shortage of teachers that is most acute in low-income areas.
sentences.zh: 该州正试图缩减从幼儿园到三年级的班级，尽管存在教师短缺，而这种短缺在低收入地区最为严重。

sentences.en: This is exacerbating the disparity in resources available to rich and poor schools in California, because more affluent areas can attract the best teachers.
sentences.zh: 这正在加剧加利福尼亚富裕学校和贫困学校可获得资源的差距，因为更富裕的地区能吸引最好的教师。

sentences.en: Indeed, some of the extra teachers needed are being recruited from the poorer schools.
sentences.zh: 的确，所需的一些额外教师正从较贫困的学校招募。

sentences.en: Researchers found a statistically significant achievement advantage in reading, writing and mathematics for students in classes that had been reduced to 20.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，对于被缩减到20人班级的学生，在阅读、写作和数学上有统计意义上显著的成绩优势。

sentences.en: What is more, the effect did not vary for students of different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，这种效应对不同背景的学生没有差异。

sentences.en: (F) Wisconsin's Student Achievement Guarantee in Education (SAGE) was a five-year pilot study to do some of the groundwork for a major project.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州的“教育中的学生成绩保障”（SAGE）是一项为期五年的试点研究，为一个重大项目做一些基础工作。

sentences.en: Class sizes were reduced in only 14 schools, but it was noteworthy for targeting schools at which 30% of the students were below poverty level, compared with California's across-the-board approach.
sentences.zh: 班级规模只在14所学校被缩减，但它值得注意的是它针对的是30%学生处于贫困线以下的学校，相比之下加利福尼亚采取的是一刀切的做法。

sentences.en: SAGE lowered the average pupil-teacher ratio in kindergarten through third grade to 12–15:1 from 21–25:1.
sentences.zh: SAGE把从幼儿园到三年级的平均师生比从21到25比1降到了12到15比1。

sentences.en: Analysts have studied the results of first-grade students in these schools and similar first-grade students elsewhere and found the results accord with those from STAR.
sentences.zh: 分析人员研究了这些学校一年级学生、以及别处类似一年级学生的结果，发现结果与STAR的相符。

sentences.en: STAR and SAGE have made it hard to argue against reducing class sizes.
sentences.zh: STAR和SAGE已经使人难以反对缩减班级规模。

sentences.en: But the California initiative shows that reductions made with too little forethought can yield minuscule gains.
sentences.zh: 但加利福尼亚的举措表明，考虑太少就做出的缩减可能产生微乎其微的增益。

sentences.en: Administrators need solid information before they can make sensible policy decisions.
sentences.zh: 管理者在能够做出明智的政策决定之前，需要可靠的信息。

sentences.en: A For the early practitioners of marketing in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, the business of selling was simply a matter of continually finding new customers.
sentences.zh: 对于十九世纪末和二十世纪初早期的营销从业者来说，销售这件事不过是不断寻找新顾客的问题。

sentences.en: By contrast, marketing managers in the current era recognise the importance of gathering information about the market and about potential customers.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，当今时代的营销经理认识到收集关于市场和潜在顾客信息的重要性。

sentences.en: They recognise that if companies are to be profitable, customers must gain and retain their perceptions of value from the brands they buy over a long time frame, rather than from a single transaction.
sentences.zh: 他们认识到，如果公司要盈利，顾客就必须在很长的时间跨度里、而不是从单次交易中，获得并保持他们对所购品牌的价值感知。

sentences.en: This also means that customers must see value in returning continually to the stores where they shop, as well as to the service providers they deal with.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着，顾客必须看到不断回到他们购物的商店、以及他们打交道的服务提供商那里去的价值。

sentences.en: B Marketing practitioners and marketing scientists have never worked more closely than they currently do.
sentences.zh: 营销从业者与营销科学家之间的合作从未像现在这样紧密。

sentences.en: There are many reasons for this, including the fact that this is the information age where convergence in telecommunications, media and technology is causing old ways to be challenged, and new methods and tools to be tested.
sentences.zh: 这有许多原因，包括这是一个信息时代这一事实，电信、媒体和技术的融合正使旧的方式受到挑战、新的方法和工具受到检验。

sentences.en: Customer expectations have risen as new technologies allow new approaches.
sentences.zh: 随着新技术使新的方法成为可能，顾客的期望也上升了。

sentences.en: For instance, the subscriber-TV music channel Channel [V] encourages its viewers to sign up for text messages and email alerts that tell them when their favourite artists and songs are about to be broadcast.
sentences.zh: 比如，付费电视音乐频道Channel [V]鼓励它的观众注册短信和电子邮件提醒，在他们最喜欢的艺人和歌曲即将播出时通知他们。

sentences.en: Competitive advantage lies in being able to recognise which customers can be given greater attention, not just because they demand it but because it makes commercial sense to provide high levels of product quality and service.
sentences.zh: 竞争优势在于能够识别出哪些顾客可以被给予更多关注，不只是因为他们要求得到关注，而是因为提供高水平的产品质量和服务在商业上说得通。

sentences.en: C Modern marketing information systems rely on information technology to enable marketing intelligence to be gathered and to store and analyse marketing research information.
sentences.zh: 现代营销信息系统依靠信息技术来收集营销情报、并存储和分析营销研究信息。

sentences.en: While some of the information used is gathered by government bodies such as the Australian Bureau of Statistics and Statistics New Zealand, most of it is purposefully gathered by marketing organisations for client companies.
sentences.zh: 虽然所用信息中有一些是由澳大利亚统计局和新西兰统计局等政府机构收集的，但其中大部分是营销机构为客户公司有目的地收集的。

sentences.en: In the process, computer technology is used to manipulate the data and then to present the information in such a way that executives can readily identify any problems or issues, and quickly arrive at solutions.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，计算机技术被用来处理数据，然后以这样一种方式呈现信息，使高管能够轻易识别出任何问题或议题、并迅速得出解决方案。

sentences.en: D In order to produce superior value and satisfaction for customers, marketing managers need information at almost every turn.
sentences.zh: 为了为顾客创造卓越的价值和满意度，营销经理几乎在每一个环节都需要信息。

sentences.en: They need information about customers – end-users and resellers – as well as competitors and governmental and other forces in the marketplace.
sentences.zh: 他们需要关于顾客——终端用户和经销商——以及市场中竞争者、政府和其他力量的信息。

sentences.en: One marketing executive put it this way: 'To manage a business well is to manage its future; and to manage the future is to manage information.'
sentences.zh: 一位营销高管是这样说的：“把一个企业管理好就是管理它的未来；而管理未来就是管理信息。”

sentences.en: Increasingly, marketers are viewing information not just as an input for making better decisions but also as an important strategic asset and marketing tool.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的营销者把信息不仅视为做出更好决策的一种输入，也视为一项重要的战略资产和营销工具。

sentences.en: As household incomes increase, choice widens and buyers become better at discriminating, so sellers need information about how buyers respond to different products and advertising campaigns.
sentences.zh: 随着家庭收入增加、选择变宽、买家变得更善于辨别，卖家就需要关于买家如何对不同产品和广告活动作出反应的信息。

sentences.en: E The supply of information has also increased greatly.
sentences.zh: 信息的供应也大大增加了。

sentences.en: It has been suggested by the futurist and best-selling author John Naisbitt that the United States and, by observation, developed countries such as Australia, New Zealand and Singapore are moving from industrial to information-based economies.
sentences.zh: 未来学家、畅销书作家约翰·奈斯比特提出，美国、以及由观察可知的澳大利亚、新西兰和新加坡等发达国家，正在从工业经济向以信息为基础的经济转变。

sentences.en: These post-industrial economies earn 70–80% of their Gross Domestic Product from services, and have entered what some commentators have termed the 'Information Age' or the 'Information Technology Era'.
sentences.zh: 这些后工业经济从服务业赚取其国内生产总值的百分之七十到八十，并已进入一些评论者所称的“信息时代”或“信息技术时代”。

sentences.en: F One study found that with all the information now available through supermarket scanners, a packaged-goods product controller is bombarded with one million to one billion new numbers each week.
sentences.zh: 一项研究发现，有了现在通过超市扫描仪可获得的所有信息，一名包装商品的产品负责人每周被一百万到十亿个新数字所轰炸。

sentences.en: As Naisbitt points out: 'Running out of information is not a problem, but drowning in it is.'
sentences.zh: 正如奈斯比特所指出的：“信息用尽不是问题，但被它淹没才是。”

sentences.en: Yet marketers frequently complain that they lack information of the right kind but have plenty of the wrong kind, or they claim that marketing information is so widely spread throughout the organisation that it takes great effort to locate even simple facts.
sentences.zh: 然而，营销者常常抱怨说，他们缺乏正确类型的信息、却有大量错误类型的信息，或者他们声称营销信息在整个组织中分布得如此广泛，以至于要花很大力气才能找到哪怕是简单的事实。

sentences.en: In addition, subordinates may withhold information they believe will reflect badly on their performance and important information often arrives too late to be useful, or on-time information is not accurate.
sentences.zh: 此外，下属可能扣下他们认为会让自己表现显得不好的信息，而重要的信息往往到得太晚、没了用处，或者及时的信息不准确。

sentences.en: So marketing managers need better information.
sentences.zh: 所以营销经理需要更好的信息。

sentences.en: Although marketing organisations have greater capacity to provide managers with information, they often do not use it well.
sentences.zh: 尽管营销机构有更大的能力为经理提供信息，但他们往往没有很好地利用它。

sentences.en: As a result, many marketing organisations are now studying their managers' information needs and designing information systems specifically to meet those needs.
sentences.zh: 结果，许多营销机构现在正在研究他们经理的信息需求，并专门设计信息系统来满足那些需求。

sentences.en: G One solution is to use a Marketing Information System (MIS).
sentences.zh: 一种解决方案是使用营销信息系统（MIS）。

sentences.en: This consists of people, equipment and procedures which, when put together, are able to gather, analyse, evaluate and distribute needed, timely and accurate information to marketing decision-makers.
sentences.zh: 它由人员、设备和程序组成，这些组合在一起时，能够收集、分析、评估并向营销决策者分发所需的、及时而准确的信息。

sentences.en: The MIS begins and ends with marketing managers.
sentences.zh: 营销信息系统始于营销经理、也终于营销经理。

sentences.en: First, it interacts with these managers to assess the information needs they have.
sentences.zh: 首先，它与这些经理互动，以评估他们的信息需求。

sentences.en: Next, it develops the needed information from internal records, marketing intelligence activities and the research process.
sentences.zh: 接下来，它从内部记录、营销情报活动和研究过程中开发出所需的信息。

sentences.en: The analysis unit processes the data to make it more useful and, finally, the MIS distributes it to managers in the right form and at the right time to help them make better marketing decisions.
sentences.zh: 分析单元处理这些数据使其更有用，而最后，营销信息系统以正确的形式、在正确的时间把它分发给经理，以帮助他们做出更好的营销决策。

sentences.en: H However, the costs of obtaining, processing, storing and delivering information can mount quickly.
sentences.zh: 然而，获取、处理、存储和递送信息的成本可能迅速攀升。

sentences.en: In some cases additional information will do little to change or improve a manager's decision, or the costs of the information will exceed the returns from the improved decision.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，额外的信息对改变或改进一位经理的决策作用甚微，或者信息的成本会超过改进后决策所带来的回报。

sentences.en: For example, if an organisation estimates that launching a new product without any further information will yield a profit of $500,000, then it would be foolish to spend $30,000 for additional information that would increase the profit to only $525,000.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果一个机构估计，在没有任何进一步信息的情况下推出一款新产品会带来50万美元的利润，那么花3万美元去获取只会把利润提高到52.5万美元的额外信息就是愚蠢的。

sentences.en: By itself, information is valueless – its value comes from its use.
sentences.zh: 信息本身是没有价值的——它的价值来自它的使用。

sentences.en: A Most social scientists stubbornly resist the idea that animals have culture.
sentences.zh: 大多数社会科学家固执地抵制动物有文化这一观点。

sentences.en: Even such advanced cetacean mammals as whales and dolphins clearly don't have art, literature, or architecture.
sentences.zh: 即便是鲸和海豚这样高级的鲸类哺乳动物，显然也没有艺术、文学或建筑。

sentences.en: But patient observation over many years has begun to reveal behaviours that can only be learnt from other whales.
sentences.zh: 但多年来耐心的观察已经开始揭示出一些只能从其他鲸那里习得的行为。

sentences.en: And that, say whale biologists, constitutes culture.
sentences.zh: 而鲸类生物学家说，那就构成了文化。

sentences.en: B So far, humpback and killer whales provide the best evidence of culture in cetaceans, and the song of the male humpback is among the most striking examples.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，座头鲸和虎鲸提供了鲸类有文化的最佳证据，而雄性座头鲸的歌是其中最引人注目的例子之一。

sentences.en: Humpback populations in different oceans sing different songs, but within the same ocean they all stick to the same one.
sentences.zh: 不同海洋里的座头鲸种群唱着不同的歌，但在同一片海洋里它们全都唱同一首。

sentences.en: However, during the breeding season the sounds change, as it appears that females are drawn to novel songs.
sentences.zh: 然而，在繁殖季节，这些声音会改变，因为雌鲸似乎被新奇的歌所吸引。

sentences.en: One male might add an extra set of groans; another might drop a series of grunts.
sentences.zh: 一头雄鲸可能加上额外一组呻吟声；另一头可能去掉一连串咕哝声。

sentences.en: Soon all the other males have altered their own rendition to incorporate the changes until they are once again singing the same song.
sentences.zh: 很快所有其他雄鲸都改变了自己的演唱以纳入这些变化，直到它们再一次唱起同一首歌。

sentences.en: Since this occurs among thousands of whales spread across a vast part of the planet, the change cannot be in response to any factor in the animal's environment.
sentences.zh: 由于这发生在散布于地球广阔地带的成千上万头鲸之间，这种变化不可能是对这种动物环境中任何因素的反应。

sentences.en: The latest version of the song can be learnt only from other whales – almost certainly by imitation.
sentences.zh: 这首歌的最新版本只能从其他鲸那里习得——几乎可以肯定是通过模仿。

sentences.en: C Culture plays an even bigger part in the life of killer whales.
sentences.zh: 文化在虎鲸的生活中扮演着更重要的角色。

sentences.en: Nowhere is this more obvious than along the north-west coast of America, where killer whales are split into two distinct populations – 'residents' and 'transients'.
sentences.zh: 这一点在美洲西北海岸沿线最为明显，那里的虎鲸被分成两个截然不同的种群——“定居型”和“过客型”。

sentences.en: They live in the same stretch of water, but they don't mingle.
sentences.zh: 它们生活在同一片水域，但它们不混在一起。

sentences.en: In effect, they belong to two quite separate cultures.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它们属于两种相当独立的文化。

sentences.en: Residents live in stable groups, or 'pods', made up of two or three mothers and their offspring – perhaps 20 whales in all.
sentences.zh: 定居型生活在稳定的群体、即“豚群”中，由两三头母鲸及其后代组成——一共也许20头鲸。

sentences.en: Calves stay with their mothers throughout adulthood, and in many years of observation no one has ever seen a whale switch pods.
sentences.zh: 幼鲸在整个成年期都和它们的母亲待在一起，而在多年的观察中，从没有人见过一头鲸换群。

sentences.en: Transients travel in smaller, more changeable groups of between three and six.
sentences.zh: 过客型以三到六头之间、更小、更多变的群体活动。

sentences.en: D One of the most obvious distinctions between the transient and resident societies is the way they impart information.
sentences.zh: 过客型社会和定居型社会之间最明显的区别之一，是它们传递信息的方式。

sentences.en: Killer whales detect prey with a range of echo-locating clicks, but converse with a vocabulary of squeaks, whistles and whines.
sentences.zh: 虎鲸用一系列回声定位的咔嗒声来探测猎物，但用一套吱吱声、口哨声和呜咽声的词汇来交谈。

sentences.en: Transients have only a few such calls, and all transient societies share the same ones.
sentences.zh: 过客型只有少数几种这样的叫声，而所有过客型社会共享同样的叫声。

sentences.en: Residents have a much more extensive repertoire, and each family group has its own unique and distinctive set of calls.
sentences.zh: 定居型有丰富得多的曲目，而每个家庭群体都有自己独特而鲜明的一套叫声。

sentences.en: Despite regular interaction between them, each resident pod sticks firmly to its own dialect.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们之间有定期的互动，但每个定居型豚群都坚定地坚持自己的方言。

sentences.en: Research shows these dialects are maintained for at least 40 years.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，这些方言至少保持了40年。

sentences.en: E To qualify as part of killer whale culture, dialects must be learnt from other members of the pod.
sentences.zh: 要算作虎鲸文化的一部分，方言必须从豚群的其他成员那里习得。

sentences.en: Animals with different dialects share the same waters, so the variation can't be a product of physical environment.
sentences.zh: 有不同方言的动物共享同一片水域，所以这种差异不可能是物理环境的产物。

sentences.en: 'And we can throw out the notion that dialects are inherited,' says Lance Barrett-Lennard of the University of British Columbia.
sentences.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学的兰斯·巴雷特-伦纳德说：“而且我们可以摒弃方言是遗传而来的这种看法。”

sentences.en: He has spent the past seven years analysing DNA from 270 whales.
sentences.zh: 他过去七年一直在分析来自270头鲸的DNA。

sentences.en: His paternity tests reveal that female killer whales invariably attract mates from outside their own pod – males with a very different dialect.
sentences.zh: 他的亲子鉴定揭示，雌虎鲸无一例外地从自己豚群之外吸引配偶——方言非常不同的雄鲸。

sentences.en: If dialects were programmed by genetics, call patterns from both father and mother would be passed on to the calf.
sentences.zh: 如果方言是由基因编程的，那么来自父亲和母亲两方的叫声模式都会传给幼鲸。

sentences.en: 'A calf uses the calls of its maternal pod very precisely.
sentences.zh: “一头幼鲸非常精确地使用它母系豚群的叫声。

sentences.en: There's no input from the father,' says Barrett-Lennard.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特-伦纳德说：“没有来自父亲的输入。”

sentences.en: F The question still remains – is this culture?
sentences.zh: 问题仍然存在——这是文化吗？

sentences.en: It is, according to Frans de Waal of Emory University in Atlanta, who argues that culture is just another biological adaptation that has evolved in many creatures.
sentences.zh: 据亚特兰大埃默里大学的弗朗斯·德瓦尔说，是的，他主张文化只不过是另一种已在许多生物身上进化出来的生物学适应。

sentences.en: One benefit of viewing culture in this way is that you can start to understand how and why it might have arisen in these creatures.
sentences.zh: 以这种方式看待文化的一个好处是，你可以开始理解它可能如何、以及为何会在这些生物身上出现。

sentences.en: Whales have several biological attributes that give them an advantage in social learning.
sentences.zh: 鲸有几种生物学特性，给它们在社会学习上带来优势。

sentences.en: Apart from their advanced mental abilities, they are adept at recognising sounds: ideal for communicating in the marine environment.
sentences.zh: 除了它们高级的智力之外，它们擅长识别声音：这对在海洋环境中交流来说很理想。

sentences.en: Many species spend years rearing their offspring, and live in small, stable, multi-generational societies, a social system that provides ample opportunity for teaching and learning.
sentences.zh: 许多物种花数年时间抚养后代，并生活在小型、稳定、多代同堂的社会里，这种社会制度为教与学提供了充足的机会。

sentences.en: G But why have cetaceans evolved the ability to learn from other group members?
sentences.zh: 但鲸类为什么进化出了从其他群体成员那里学习的能力呢？

sentences.en: Experts in whale biology believe that ecological factors and the need to adapt to sudden changes in the environment played a large part in the emergence of culture.
sentences.zh: 鲸类生物学的专家相信，生态因素以及适应环境突变的需要，在文化的出现中起了很大的作用。

sentences.en: Although the ocean is a relatively stable habitat in many ways, it is highly changeable in one crucial respect – the availability of food.
sentences.zh: 尽管海洋在许多方面是一个相对稳定的生境，但它在一个关键方面是高度多变的——食物的可获得性。

sentences.en: One moment there might be a plentiful supply of fish, the next they've disappeared.
sentences.zh: 这一刻也许有充足的鱼供应，下一刻它们就消失了。

sentences.en: When that happens, the past experience of senior members of the group – and the ability to share this knowledge – is a huge asset.
sentences.zh: 当那发生时，群体中年长成员过去的经验——以及分享这一知识的能力——是一笔巨大的财富。

sentences.en: The dialects of killer whales allow members of the group to identify each other, enabling them to share information about food hot spots.
sentences.zh: 虎鲸的方言使群体成员能够彼此识别，使它们能够分享关于食物热点的信息。

sentences.en: Among resident killer whales, it also allows females to avoid inbreeding by picking out a mate with a strange dialect from outside their pod, says Barrett-Lennard.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特-伦纳德说，在定居型虎鲸当中，它还使雌鲸能够通过从自己豚群之外挑选一个有陌生方言的配偶来避免近亲繁殖。

sentences.en: H The importance of sharing information seems to have led to biological changes in at least some species of whale.
sentences.zh: 分享信息的重要性似乎已导致至少某些鲸种发生生物学上的变化。

sentences.en: Female killer whales, like humans, are very unusual in that they live up to a quarter of a century after they have had their descendants.
sentences.zh: 雌虎鲸和人类一样，非常不寻常地在生下后代之后还能活上四分之一个世纪。

sentences.en: And what whale matriarchs offer is the most important thing of all – cultural knowledge, vital for the group's survival, passed directly from one generation to the next.
sentences.zh: 而鲸类的女族长所提供的，是最重要的东西——文化知识，它对群体的生存至关重要，直接从一代传给下一代。

sentences.en: A Ever since its elevation to the status of an academic discipline, history has been very largely concerned with problems of its own making.
sentences.zh: 自从被提升为一门学科以来，历史在很大程度上一直在关注它自己制造出来的问题。

sentences.en: These may be gaps which the young researcher is advised by supervisors to fill; or established views which he or she is encouraged to challenge.
sentences.zh: 这些可能是年轻研究者被导师建议去填补的空白；也可能是他或她被鼓励去挑战的既有观点。

sentences.en: In either case, the need for the researcher to provide new insights in order to gain professional advancement often counts for more than the intrinsic interest of the topic.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种情况，研究者为获得职业晋升而需要提供新见解，往往比这个题目本身的内在趣味更重要。

sentences.en: Social history is quite different.
sentences.zh: 社会史则截然不同。

sentences.en: It touches on, and arguably helps to focus, major issues of public debate.
sentences.zh: 它触及、并且可以说有助于聚焦公共辩论的重大议题。

sentences.en: It mobilises popular enthusiasm and engages popular passions.
sentences.zh: 它调动起大众的热情、激发起大众的激情。

sentences.en: It prides itself on being concerned with everyday things rather than sensational events and is directed against the 'Great Man' theories that originally characterised history, and the tedious focus on bureaucratic issues that subsequently dominated the 1920s and 30s.
sentences.zh: 它以关注日常事物而非耸人听闻的事件而自豪，并针对最初赋予历史特色的“伟人”理论、以及随后在20世纪二三十年代占主导地位的对官僚事务的乏味聚焦。

sentences.en: This is also reflected in the way it is taught, through the adoption of multi-disciplinary perspectives rather than a narrow historical interpretation.
sentences.zh: 这也反映在它的教学方式上，即采用多学科的视角、而不是狭隘的历史诠释。

sentences.en: B Social history emerged, both as a popular enthusiasm and as a scholarly practice, from the cultural revolution of the 1960s in North America and Europe, and reproduces its leading inspirations.
sentences.zh: 社会史，作为一种大众热情、也作为一种学术实践，从20世纪60年代北美和欧洲的文化革命中涌现出来，并再现了它的主要灵感。

sentences.en: The spirit of social history was pre-eminently a modernising one, as reflected in its choice of subject matter.
sentences.zh: 社会史的精神首先是一种现代化的精神，这反映在它对题材的选择上。

sentences.en: Whereas traditional history had focused on the 12th to 17th centuries, social history was apt to make its historical homeland in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 传统历史曾聚焦于十二到十七世纪，而社会史往往把它的历史家园安在十九世纪。

sentences.en: Latterly, it has even begun to extend its inquiry up to contemporary events and movements.
sentences.zh: 近来，它甚至开始把探究延伸到当代的事件和运动。

sentences.en: The subject matter favoured by the new social history, with its move away from the aristocracy and the establishment, corresponds to other cultural manifestations of the 1960s, such as New Wave British cinema, with its working-class protagonists, or 'Pop art', with its use of everyday artefacts.
sentences.zh: 新社会史所青睐的题材，随着它从贵族和当权派移开，与20世纪60年代其他的文化表现相呼应，比如有着工人阶级主角的英国新浪潮电影、或运用日常物品的“波普艺术”。

sentences.en: Similarly, the anti-institutional bias of the new social history—the renewed determination to write the history of 'ordinary' people as against that of statecraft—could be said to echo a much more widespread collapse of social deference, and a questioning of authority figures of all kinds.
sentences.zh: 同样，新社会史反建制的倾向——重新下定决心去书写“普通”人的历史、而非治国之术的历史——可以说呼应了一种广泛得多的社会恭顺的崩塌、以及对各种权威人物的质疑。

sentences.en: C Another major 1960s influence on the new social history—very different in its origins and effects—was the 'nostalgia industry', which focused on the sale of memorabilia and artefacts from recent history.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代对新社会史的另一个重大影响——其起源和效果都非常不同——是“怀旧产业”，它聚焦于出售近代史的纪念品和器物。

sentences.en: This emerged as a kind of negative counterpart to the otherwise dominant modernisation of the decade and reflected a disenchantment, no less apparent on the Left of the political spectrum than on the Right, with post-war social change.
sentences.zh: 这作为那十年里原本占主导地位的现代化的一种消极对应物而出现，反映出一种幻灭，这种幻灭在政治光谱的左翼和右翼都同样明显，是对战后社会变化的幻灭。

sentences.en: Industrial archaeology, an invention of the 1960s, elevated disused factories and mills to the status of national monuments.
sentences.zh: 工业考古学，20世纪60年代的一项发明，把废弃的工厂和磨坊提升到了国家纪念物的地位。

sentences.en: Following in the same track, property restorers turned houses built for 19th-century factory workers—once emblems of poverty, overcrowding, and ill-health—into picturesque residences.
sentences.zh: 沿着同样的轨迹，房产修复者把为十九世纪工厂工人建造的房屋——曾经是贫困、拥挤和疾病的象征——变成了风景如画的住宅。

sentences.en: In another sphere, one could point to the proliferation of folk clubs and the discovery of industrial folk songs, prefiguring one of the major themes of the new social history—the dignity of labour.
sentences.zh: 在另一个领域，人们可以指出民谣俱乐部的激增和工业民谣的发现，预示着新社会史的一个主要主题——劳动的尊严。

sentences.en: D So far as historical work was concerned, by the 1970s the sense of disenchantment had crystallised into an idealised view of the past, fostering a nostalgic regard for disappearing communities.
sentences.zh: 就历史工作而言，到20世纪70年代，这种幻灭感已凝结成一种对过去理想化的看法，滋养了一种对正在消失的社区的怀旧之情。

sentences.en: The restoration of vanished components of 'the world we have lost' became a major impetus in historical writing and research.
sentences.zh: 对“我们已失去的世界”中消失部分的修复，成了历史写作和研究的一大推动力。

sentences.en: The dignity of ordinary people could be said to be the unifying theme of this line of historical inquiry and retrieval—a celebration of everyday life, even, perhaps especially, when it involved hardship and suffering.
sentences.zh: 普通人的尊严可以说是这条历史探究与追寻路线的统一主题——一种对日常生活的礼赞，甚至，也许尤其是在它涉及艰辛和苦难的时候。

sentences.en: E Despite the novelty of its subject matter, social history reproduces many of the characteristic biases of its predecessors.
sentences.zh: 尽管题材新颖，社会史还是再现了它前辈的许多特征性偏见。

sentences.en: Social historians are good at amassing details on household artefacts, budgets, daily purchases, but at times the evidence is assumed to speak for itself, and the simple reproduction of fact masquerades as explanation.
sentences.zh: 社会史学家善于积累关于家庭器物、预算、日常采购的细节，但有时这些证据被假定为不言自明，而对事实的简单再现就冒充了解释。

sentences.en: The facts accumulated may leave no conceptual space for the great absences, for the many areas where the documentary record is silent.
sentences.zh: 所积累的事实可能没有为那些重大的缺席、为那许多文献记录沉默的领域留下概念上的空间。

sentences.en: F The indulgence which social historians extend towards their subjects, and the desire to establish 'empathy'—seeing the past in terms of its own values rather than those of today— can also serve to flatter our self-esteem, making history a field in which, at no great cost to ourselves, we can demonstrate our enlarged sympathies and benevolence.
sentences.zh: 社会史学家对他们研究对象所抱的纵容、以及建立“共情”的渴望——以过去自身的价值观、而非今天的价值观来看待过去——也可以用来满足我们的自尊，使历史成为一个我们可以不费多大代价就展示我们扩大了的同情和仁慈的领域。

sentences.en: Recognising our kinship to people in the past, and tracing, or discovering, their likeness to ourselves, we are flattered in the belief that underneath we are all lovable; eccentric perhaps and even absurd, but large-hearted, generous and frank.
sentences.zh: 认识到我们与过去的人的亲缘关系、并追溯或发现他们与我们的相似之处，我们就在这样一种信念中得到满足，即在表象之下我们都是可爱的；也许古怪、甚至荒唐，但宽宏大量、慷慨而坦率。

sentences.en: This sense of integration with the past can thus serve as a comfortable alternative to critical awareness and self-questioning, allowing us to dignify the present by illegitimate association with the past.
sentences.zh: 这种与过去融为一体的感觉，因而可以充当批判意识和自我质疑的一种舒适替代品，让我们通过与过去不正当的关联来美化现在。

sentences.en: G Social history, if it is to fulfil its subversive potential, needs to be a great deal more disturbing.
sentences.zh: 社会史，如果要实现它颠覆性的潜力，就需要更加令人不安得多。

sentences.en: If it is to celebrate a common humanity, and to bring past and present closer together, far more weight needs to be given to the effects of insecurities and emergencies—the fears that shadow the growing up of children, the oppositions we encounter during our lives—experiences which may be hard for an individual to categorise but which nevertheless have a significance which goes beyond that individual.
sentences.zh: 如果它要礼赞一种共同的人性、并把过去与现在拉得更近，就需要给不安全感和紧急状况的影响赋予多得多的分量——那些笼罩着孩子成长的恐惧、我们一生中遇到的种种对立——这些经历对个人来说也许难以归类，但其意义却超越了那个个人。

sentences.en: Perhaps too we might recognise that there is a profound condescension in the notion of 'ordinary people'—that unified totality in which social historians are apt to deal.
sentences.zh: 或许我们也可以认识到，“普通人”这个概念中有一种深刻的居高临下——社会史学家往往打交道的那个统一的整体。

sentences.en: Implicitly, it is a category from which we tend to exclude ourselves, although in fact we are exceptional only by our privilege of hindsight.
sentences.zh: 隐含地，它是一个我们往往把自己排除在外的范畴，尽管事实上我们只是因为有事后之明的特权而显得例外。

sentences.en: no masses,' Raymond Williams wrote, 'only ways of seeing people as masses.'
sentences.zh: 什么大众，”雷蒙德·威廉斯写道，“只有把人看作大众的种种方式。”

sentences.en: It is perhaps time for historians to scrutinise the term 'ordinary people' in the same way.
sentences.zh: 也许是时候让历史学家以同样的方式来审视“普通人”这个词了。

sentences.en: A During your childhood, there will have been some kind of craze which affected all the people in your school.
sentences.zh: 在你的童年里，一定有过某种风潮席卷了你学校里的所有人。

sentences.en: It may have been to do with a particular toy or possibly a must-have item of clothing.
sentences.zh: 它可能与某款特定玩具有关，或者可能是一件必须拥有的服装。

sentences.en: It may have been something as simple as a type of pen or as expensive as an electronic games console.
sentences.zh: 它可能像某种笔那么简单，也可能像电子游戏机那么昂贵。

sentences.en: Fashion designers, toy manufacturers and anyone else involved in the retail trade love conformity.
sentences.zh: 时装设计师、玩具制造商以及零售业其他相关人员都喜欢从众。

sentences.en: Set up a craze, especially in the young, and everyone will go for it.
sentences.zh: 挑起一种风潮，尤其在年轻人中，所有人都会去追。

sentences.en: In fact, it's an ideal way to sell huge quantities of merchandise.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是售出大量商品的理想方式。

sentences.en: The levels of conformity in consumerism are phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 消费主义中的从众水平惊人。

sentences.en: When you actually stand back and consider how easily we are persuaded that having certain items is the only way we can ensure peace of mind, you see what an important concept conformity is.
sentences.zh: 当你真的退一步，思考我们被多么轻易地说服——以为拥有某些物品是我们能确保内心安宁的唯一方式——你就会明白“从众”是多么重要的概念。

sentences.en: B Conformity has been described as “yielding to group pressure” (Crutchfield, 1962).
sentences.zh: 从众被描述为“屈服于群体压力”（Crutchfield，1962 年）。

sentences.en: However, this implies that other people put pressure on us to make us conform and this is not always the case.
sentences.zh: 然而，这暗示是别人向我们施压让我们从众；而事实并不总是如此。

sentences.en: A better definition is given by Aronson (1976) who said it was a “change in a person's behaviour or opinions as a result of real or imagined pressure from a person or group of people”.
sentences.zh: 阿伦森（Aronson，1976 年）给出了一个更好的定义，他说从众是“个人行为或观点的改变，因为受到一个人或一群人真实的或想象的压力”。

sentences.en: This would make more sense, as often the pressure we feel is imagined.
sentences.zh: 这更有道理，因为我们感受到的压力常常是想象的。

sentences.en: The person or group he refers to would have to be important to us at the time, regardless of their status.
sentences.zh: 他所指的那个人或那群人，在当时必须对我们而言是重要的，不论其地位如何。

sentences.en: C There has been considerable research on conformity.
sentences.zh: 关于从众的研究相当多。

sentences.en: One of the first studies looked at the answers people gave when asked to estimate the number of beans in a bottle (Jenness, 1932).
sentences.zh: 最早的一项研究考察了人们在被要求估计一瓶中豆子数量时所给的答案（詹尼斯，Jenness，1932 年）。

sentences.en: If you have ever entered a “guess the number” competition, you probably looked at the previous estimates made and based your judgment on what other people had guessed.
sentences.zh: 如果你曾参加过“猜数字”比赛，你大概看过先前的估算，并基于别人的猜测来作出自己的判断。

sentences.en: This is more or less what happened in the Jenness study.
sentences.zh: 詹尼斯的研究中发生的差不多就是这种情况。

sentences.en: First of all, he asked the respondents to give their own estimates, and then he asked them to decide a group estimate.
sentences.zh: 首先，他要求受访者给出自己的估计；然后要求他们决定一个群体估计。

sentences.en: Finally, he asked them alone again and discovered that they had stayed with the group answer.
sentences.zh: 最后，他再次单独询问他们，发现他们都坚持了群体的答案。

sentences.en: D Probably the most famous study on conformity was undertaken by Asch (1951) when he created a situation where many of his subjects gave answers which were blatantly untrue, rather than contradict the people they were with.
sentences.zh: 关于从众最著名的研究大概是阿希（Asch，1951 年）做的——他制造了一种情境，他的许多受试者给出了明显不真实的答案，而非与同处一室的人意见相左。

sentences.en: He did this by getting his subject to sit round a table with six stooges (colleagues of the experimenter) so that the subject was second to last.
sentences.zh: 他的做法是让受试者与六个“托儿”（实验者的同事）一起围桌而坐，使受试者排在倒数第二个回答。

sentences.en: He showed them all a large card which had three lines of different lengths drawn on it, labelled A, B and C.
sentences.zh: 他向所有人展示一张大卡片，上面画着三条长度不同的线，分别标为 A、B 和 C。

sentences.en: He then gave them a card with a single line and asked them to match this in terms of length to one of the lines A, B or C.
sentences.zh: 然后他给他们一张只画了一条线的卡片，并要他们把这条线在长度上与 A、B 或 C 中的一条匹配。

sentences.en: E The stooges gave untrue responses in a number of the trials and the subjects were left in the situation where they either reported what they saw with their own eyes or conformed to the norm of the group.
sentences.zh: 在若干轮试验中，托儿给出了不真实的回应，受试者就陷入这种处境：要么报告自己亲眼所见，要么遵从群体的规范。

sentences.en: When the results were assessed, Asch found that in one out of every three trials where the wrong answer was given, the subject gave the same wrong answer as the stooges.
sentences.zh: 在评估结果时，阿希发现：在给出错误答案的每三次试验中，有一次受试者会和托儿给出相同的错误答案。

sentences.en: This led to an average level of conformity of 32 per cent.
sentences.zh: 这导致的平均从众率为 32%。

sentences.en: Asch interviewed his subjects after the trials to try to find out why they conformed to an answer which was so obviously wrong.
sentences.zh: 阿希在试验结束后采访了受试者，以试图找出为何他们会服从一个如此明显错误的答案。

sentences.en: Most of them said that they did not want to cause problems within the group, although they also stated that when they did give wrong answers it made them anxious.
sentences.zh: 他们中大多数人说，他们不想在群体中惹麻烦，尽管也说当他们确实给出错误答案时会感到焦虑。

sentences.en: (Asch found that when there was just one other person present who did not go along with the majority, no matter how many others there were, it was sufficient to make the subject give the right answer.)
sentences.zh: （阿希发现，只要现场还有一个不附和多数的人——不管其他人有多少——就足以让受试者给出正确答案。）

sentences.en: F Kelman (1953) outlined three processes which can explain social conformity.
sentences.zh: 凯尔曼（Kelman，1953 年）勾勒了三种可以解释社会从众的过程。

sentences.en: The first is compliance, where subjects go along with the crowd to prevent any in-group hostility or bad feeling and to maintain group harmony.
sentences.zh: 第一种是顺从——受试者随大流，以避免群体内的敌意或不满，并维持群体和谐。

sentences.en: However, they do not change their own private belief.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们并不改变自己内心的信念。

sentences.en: If we look back to the Asch study, we can see that the subjects were simply complying with the demands of the experimental situation but hadn't actually internalized the group's norms.
sentences.zh: 如果回看阿希的研究，可以看到受试者只是在顺应实验情境的要求，而并未真正把群体的规范内化。

sentences.en: They agreed in public, but dissented in private.
sentences.zh: 他们公开同意，私下却不同意。

sentences.en: In a process known as internalization, however, subjects do actually see the view of the group as the more valid one.
sentences.zh: 然而，在一种被称为内化的过程中，受试者确实把群体的观点视为更有效的观点。

sentences.en: They may be able to do this, for example, by convincing themselves that their eyesight is poor.
sentences.zh: 他们可能通过例如说服自己视力不好等方式做到这一点。

sentences.en: Sometimes, however, subjects actually seem to change their beliefs because they want to become more like their heroes.
sentences.zh: 不过有时受试者似乎真的改变了自己的信念，因为他们想变得更像自己的英雄。

sentences.en: If they really want to become part of an in-group, they will start to identify with that group and take on the group's values and beliefs, even if they are different to their own.
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的想成为某个内群体的一员，就会开始与该群体认同，接受该群体的价值观和信念——即便这些与自己原来的不同。

sentences.en: Kelman calls this identification.
sentences.zh: 凯尔曼把这称作“认同”。

sentences.en: It frequently happens with teenagers who want to become more like a peer group in order to be accepted, and suddenly seem to go against all the values and beliefs of their parents.
sentences.zh: 这在希望变得更像某个同伴群体以被接纳的青少年身上经常发生——他们似乎突然反对父母的全部价值观和信念。

sentences.en: G So why is it that we have to conform?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们为什么不得不从众呢？

sentences.en: Some people feel confident most of the time, have high self-esteem and do not have to go along with the majority.
sentences.zh: 有些人大多数时候都自信，自尊高，无须随大流。

sentences.en: For most of us, though, how confident we feel varies from day to day, depending on the situation we are in, and this can influence behaviour.
sentences.zh: 但对我们大多数人而言，自信程度因日而异，取决于所处情境，而这可以影响行为。

sentences.en: A Few people would consider mastering more than one language a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 很少有人会认为掌握不止一门语言是个坏主意。

sentences.en: Consequently, parents who speak different languages from each other are generally keen for their children to learn both.
sentences.zh: 因此，彼此说不同语言的父母通常都热切希望自己的孩子两门都学。

sentences.en: They understand that the family setting they create is central to this, and seek ways to ensure their children thrive bilingually.
sentences.zh: 他们明白，他们所营造的家庭环境是这件事的核心，并寻找办法来确保自己的孩子在双语中茁壮成长。

sentences.en: One of the best-known approaches is the 'one-parent-one-language' strategy (OPOL).
sentences.zh: 最广为人知的方法之一是“一人一语”策略，简称OPOL。

sentences.en: Each parent uses their native language when communicating with their children, so the children learn both simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 每位父母在与孩子交流时使用自己的母语，这样孩子就同时学会两门。

sentences.en: OPOL emphasises consistency – each parent sticking to one language – as key to its approach.
sentences.zh: OPOL强调一致性——每位父母坚持使用一门语言——作为其方法的关键。

sentences.en: But this creates the myth that mixing languages should always be avoided.
sentences.zh: 但这制造了一个误区，即混用语言应该总是被避免。

sentences.en: My recent study, part of a new wave of multilingualism studies, would suggest that this received wisdom is just that: a myth.
sentences.zh: 我最近的研究，作为新一波多语研究的一部分，会表明这种公认的智慧不过就是：一个误区。

sentences.en: My research looked at Japanese-British families living in the UK with pre- and early school-age children who were following a more-or-less strict OPOL language policy.
sentences.zh: 我的研究考察了生活在英国、有学龄前及学龄初期孩子、遵循着或多或少严格OPOL语言政策的日英家庭。

sentences.en: I was particularly interested in examining the impact of OPOL in the family home – how does this unique language environment affect the way children use languages?
sentences.zh: 我尤其有兴趣考察OPOL在家庭中的影响——这种独特的语言环境如何影响孩子使用语言的方式？

sentences.en: B Most of the Japanese mothers who participated were fluent in Japanese and English, while the fathers possessed merely an elementary grasp of Japanese.
sentences.zh: 大多数参与的日本母亲能流利地说日语和英语，而父亲对日语只有初步的掌握。

sentences.en: This made English the primary language of communication between the parents and outside the home.
sentences.zh: 这使英语成了父母之间以及家庭之外的主要交流语言。

sentences.en: For this reason, the mothers were careful to carve out additional space for more sustained Japanese language learning with their children.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些母亲会留意为与孩子进行更持续的日语学习开辟出额外的空间。

sentences.en: In other words, this dedicated space for communicating in Japanese was time the children spent exclusively with their mother.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这个专门用来用日语交流的空间，是孩子专门和母亲一起度过的时间。

sentences.en: This seemed to create a connection between 'Japanese language' and 'motherhood' in the children's perception.
sentences.zh: 这似乎在孩子的感知中、在“日语”和“母亲身份”之间建立起一种联系。

sentences.en: This link became apparent in the way the children used Japanese as a means of emotional bonding with their mother.
sentences.zh: 这种联系在孩子把日语用作与母亲情感联结手段的方式中变得明显。

sentences.en: In addition, they adopted a broader behavioural repertoire than that which is usually associated with a language.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们采用了一套比通常与一门语言相关联的更宽广的行为方式。

sentences.en: For example, switching to Japanese could sometimes serve as a method to appease Mum when she seemed unhappy.
sentences.zh: 比如，切换到日语有时可以充当一种在妈妈看起来不高兴时安抚她的方法。

sentences.en: At other times, refusing to communicate in Japanese was a useful means of defiance, even when the dispute was not related to language.
sentences.zh: 另一些时候，拒绝用日语交流是一种有用的反抗手段，即便争执与语言无关。

sentences.en: C The OPOL approach emphasises the need for parents to monitor children's language closely and correct them if they mix the two languages.
sentences.zh: OPOL方法强调父母需要密切监控孩子的语言、并在他们混用两门语言时纠正他们。

sentences.en: In practice, many parents speaking the minority language are bilingual themselves – so they understand what their children are saying even when they do mix the two.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，许多说少数语言的父母自己就是双语者——所以即便孩子确实混用两门语言，他们也明白孩子在说什么。

sentences.en: In addition, parents feel it's problematic to keep correcting children when they mix languages.
sentences.zh: 此外，父母觉得不停地纠正混用语言的孩子是有问题的。

sentences.en: This is particularly the case when children show annoyance at being corrected.
sentences.zh: 当孩子对被纠正表现出恼怒时尤其如此。

sentences.en: The parents believe it is a lot more important to have a meaningful conversation with their children.
sentences.zh: 父母相信，与孩子进行一场有意义的对话要重要得多。

sentences.en: D But what if a child uses language that cannot readily be categorised as either one language or the other?
sentences.zh: 但如果一个孩子使用的语言无法轻易归类为这门或那门语言，会怎样呢？

sentences.en: An example from my study involved the use of English words adapted to accommodate Japanese pronunciation.
sentences.zh: 我研究中的一个例子涉及使用经过改造以适应日语发音的英语单词。

sentences.en: One of these borrowed words, 'ice cream', is usually pronounced 'aisukurimu'.
sentences.zh: 这些借词之一，“ice cream”，通常被读作“aisukurimu”。

sentences.en: The distinction between singular and plural does not exist in Japanese nouns in the English language sense, so whether using singular or plural, even in a borrowed word, 'aisukurimu' is the form normally used.
sentences.zh: 在英语意义上的单复数区别在日语名词中不存在，所以无论用单数还是复数，即便是在一个借词里，“aisukurimu”都是通常使用的形式。

sentences.en: But one of my child participants showed his mother a drawing of two cones of ice cream and described them as 'aisukurimuzu', with a Japanese pronunciation but in English plural form.
sentences.zh: 但我的一个儿童参与者给他母亲看了一幅两个冰激凌甜筒的画，并把它们描述为“aisukurimuzu”，发音是日语的、却用了英语的复数形式。

sentences.en: The child had created something in between.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子创造出了某种介于两者之间的东西。

sentences.en: E Another example from my study focused on the interaction between Japanese-English bilingual siblings.
sentences.zh: 我研究中的另一个例子聚焦于日英双语兄妹之间的互动。

sentences.en: In one case, a six-year-old girl was trying to convince her four-year-old brother to let her play with his toys.
sentences.zh: 在一个案例中，一个六岁的女孩试图说服她四岁的弟弟让她玩他的玩具。

sentences.en: Following firm rejections by her brother, the girl drew on her communicative repertoire to convince him.
sentences.zh: 在弟弟坚决拒绝之后，女孩动用了她的交流方式库来说服他。

sentences.en: To start with, she shifted from an authoritative demand to a softer and humbler appeal.
sentences.zh: 一开始，她从一种命令式的要求转为一种更柔和、更谦卑的恳求。

sentences.en: She rephrased the question by using various polite forms.
sentences.zh: 她用各种礼貌的形式把问题重新表述了一遍。

sentences.en: Then, her voice became more nasal, suggesting she was about to burst into tears.
sentences.zh: 然后，她的声音变得更带鼻音，暗示她快要哭出来了。

sentences.en: Even more interestingly, while the negotiation had begun in English, in the middle she shifted to Japanese.
sentences.zh: 更有意思的是，虽然这场谈判是用英语开始的，但中途她切换到了日语。

sentences.en: Although this may give the impression of language mixing, a considerably more complex process was taking place.
sentences.zh: 尽管这可能给人语言混用的印象，但实际上正在发生一个复杂得多的过程。

sentences.en: The shift was accompanied by the incorporation of Japanese cultural elements, such as honorific titles that emphasise emotional attachment, a relationship of dependence between sister and brother, and an assumed obligation to care on the part of the brother.
sentences.zh: 这种切换伴随着日语文化元素的融入，比如强调情感依恋的敬语称谓、姐弟之间一种依赖的关系、以及弟弟一方被假定的照顾义务。

sentences.en: She succeeded.
sentences.zh: 她成功了。

sentences.en: F These examples show how creatively and strategically human beings use language in their daily communication.
sentences.zh: 这些例子表明人类在日常交流中如何富有创造性、有策略地使用语言。

sentences.en: Whether bilingual or not, we all constantly select from our repertoire anything that will best serve our purpose.
sentences.zh: 无论是不是双语者，我们都不断地从自己的方式库中挑选任何最能服务于我们目的的东西。

sentences.en: For instance, imagine you want to ask a neighbour a favour.
sentences.zh: 比如，想象你想请一位邻居帮个忙。

sentences.en: You would use polite language in a friendly voice.
sentences.zh: 你会用礼貌的语言、配上友好的声音。

sentences.en: But what about your facial expression?
sentences.zh: 但你的面部表情呢？

sentences.en: Your body language?
sentences.zh: 你的肢体语言呢？

sentences.en: It is likely you would make appropriate choices.
sentences.zh: 你很可能会做出恰当的选择。

sentences.en: For bilinguals, shifting between languages is all part of their repertoire.
sentences.zh: 对双语者来说，在语言之间切换全都是他们方式库的一部分。

sentences.en: G Our language repertoires are shaped by meaning, based on knowledge gathered throughout our lives, and the ways we use language also shape its meaning.
sentences.zh: 我们的语言方式库由意义所塑造，建立在我们一生中积累的知识之上，而我们使用语言的方式也塑造着它的意义。

sentences.en: The use of OPOL in the family brings specific meaning to language used at home, and children make full use of emergent meaning in their own interactions.
sentences.zh: 在家庭中使用OPOL为家里所用的语言带来了特定的意义，而孩子在他们自己的互动中充分利用这种新生的意义。

sentences.en: H The popularity of OPOL amongst parents rests on the simplicity of its message, which is that it should be applied consistently.
sentences.zh: OPOL在父母中的受欢迎，建立在它信息的简单之上，即它应当被一致地应用。

sentences.en: But when we see a child actively using, adapting and negotiating their repertoire, it casts doubt on the belief that it's bad for children to mix languages.
sentences.zh: 但当我们看到一个孩子主动地使用、改造和协商他们的方式库时，它就让那种认为混用语言对孩子有害的信念受到了质疑。

sentences.en: What they could actually be doing is demonstrating high-level flexibility and interpersonal skills.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上可能在做的，是展现高水平的灵活性和人际交往技能。

sentences.en: Being bilingual isn't simply about an ability to speak two languages.
sentences.zh: 双语并不仅仅是关于一种说两门语言的能力。

sentences.en: Rigidly policing consistency in the OPOL approach could actually inhibit bilingual children's linguistic ability and creativity.
sentences.zh: 在OPOL方法中僵硬地强行要求一致性，实际上可能抑制双语孩子的语言能力和创造力。

sentences.en: And in the same way, it could also limit their parents' ability to reveal their own bilingual skills, using their own repertoires.
sentences.zh: 而同样地，它也可能限制他们父母运用自己的方式库、展现自身双语技能的能力。

sentences.en: A Maps codify the miracle of existence.
sentences.zh: 地图将存在的奇迹编码记录下来。

sentences.en: And the man who wrote the codes for the maps we use today was Gerard Mercator, a cobbler’s son born 500 years ago on a muddy floodplain in northern Europe.
sentences.zh: 而为我们今天所用之地图书写这套编码的人，正是赫拉德·墨卡托——一位 500 年前出生于北欧泥泞泛滥平原上的鞋匠之子。

sentences.en: Mercator was a humble man with a universal vision.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托其人谦逊，却怀有放眼世界的眼光。

sentences.en: In his own time he was ‘the prince of modern geographers’, his depictions of the planet and its regions unsurpassed in accuracy, clarity and consistency.
sentences.zh: 在他生活的年代里，他被誉为“现代地理学家之王”，他对地球及其各区域的描绘在准确性、清晰度和一致性上无人能及。

sentences.en: More recently, he was crowned by the American scholar Robert W.
sentences.zh: 近些年，他又被美国学者罗伯特·W·

sentences.en: Karrow as ‘the first modern, scientific cartographer’.
sentences.zh: 卡罗（Karrow）誉为“第一位现代的、科学的制图学家”。

sentences.en: Where his predecessors had adopted a piecemeal approach to cartography, Mercator sought to wrap the world in systematic overlapping maps.
sentences.zh: 前人对制图采取的是零碎的方式，墨卡托则力图以系统化、相互衔接的地图将世界尽数包裹其中。

sentences.en: Along the way he erected a number of historic milestones.
sentences.zh: 在这一过程中，他树立了若干历史性的里程碑。

sentences.en: He participated in the naming and mapping of ‘America’, he constructed the two most important globes of the 16th century, and the title of his pioneering ‘modern geography’, the Atlas, became the standard term for a volume of maps.
sentences.zh: 他参与了“美洲”的命名与制图工作，建造了 16 世纪最重要的两座地球仪，而他那本开创性“现代地理学”著作的标题《地图集》（Atlas）也成为“一册地图汇编”的通用代名词。

sentences.en: Mercator also devised a new method - ‘a projection’ - of converting the spherical world into a two-dimensional map.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托还设计了一种新方法——所谓“投影法”——把球面世界转换成二维地图。

sentences.en: Mercator was born in 1512 and died in 1594.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托生于 1512 年，卒于 1594 年。

sentences.en: His world was one of military conflict, social upheaval, religious revolution - and geographical discovery.
sentences.zh: 他所处的世界充斥着军事冲突、社会动荡、宗教变革——以及地理上的大发现。

sentences.en: He was ten years old when the survivors of the world’s first circumnavigation returned to Spain in their leaking caravel.
sentences.zh: 当世界首次环球航行的幸存者们驾着漏水的卡拉维尔帆船回到西班牙时，他年仅十岁。

sentences.en: No better example is required of genius arising from turmoil.
sentences.zh: 再没有比这更好的、关于天才于乱世中崛起的例证了。

sentences.en: He knew poverty, plague, war and persecution.
sentences.zh: 他经历过贫穷、瘟疫、战争和迫害。

sentences.en: He was imprisoned for his ideas yet patronised by an emperor.
sentences.zh: 他曾因思想而身陷囹圄，却又得到一位皇帝的庇护。

sentences.en: His life was one of brilliant breakthroughs and abrupt reversals.
sentences.zh: 他的一生既有耀眼的突破，也有突如其来的逆转。

sentences.en: In its telling, his is the story of the poor boy made good: the pauper who embraced the world, found fame, faced death, yet triumphed through fortitude.
sentences.zh: 讲述出来，他的故事是一个穷小子翻身的故事：一个胸怀世界、获得声望、直面死亡，却又凭刚毅意志取得胜利的穷人。

sentences.en: Variously described by his peers as honest, calm, candid, sincere and peaceable, Mercator wore an aura of calm in troubled times.
sentences.zh: 同时代的人对他评价各异，有的称他诚实、沉静、坦率、真诚、温和——墨卡托在那个动荡的时代里始终自带一种平和的气场。

sentences.en: His attitude to his geographical calling was described by his friend and neighbour, William Ghim, as ‘indefatigable’.
sentences.zh: 他对地理事业的投入，被其友人兼邻居威廉·吉姆（William Ghim）形容为“不知疲倦”。

sentences.en: Some 40 or so of Mercator’s letters have survived, together with examples of virtually all of his printed maps and globes.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托留存至今的信件约有 40 余封，此外几乎他全部印制地图和地球仪都有实物存世。

sentences.en: B Mercator’s most significant work was a project of cosmic proportions.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托最重要的著作是一项规模堪比宇宙的工程。

sentences.en: A multi-part cosmography, the work would include a section on astronomy, a chronology of world events and a modern geography, which would eventually contain over 100 maps.
sentences.zh: 这是一部由多个部分组成的宇宙志，包含天文学部分、世界事件年表和一部现代地理学，后者最终将收录 100 多幅地图。

sentences.en: Before he commenced the great work, Mercator produced in 1569 an enormous world map on a new projection.
sentences.zh: 在着手这项大业之前，墨卡托于 1569 年绘制了一幅采用全新投影法的巨型世界地图。

sentences.en: His method for converting the spherical globe into a two-dimensional map helped to solve the greatest cartographic riddle of the day: how could the course of a ship following a constant compass bearing be represented as a straight line on a map which had been constructed on a grid of latitude and longitude?
sentences.zh: 他将球形地球转换为二维地图的方法，帮助解决了当时制图界最大的难题：在以经纬度网格构建的地图上，怎样才能把沿恒定罗盘方位航行的船只航迹表示为一条直线？

sentences.en: Mercator’s solution was to progressively increase the space between his lines of latitude, away from the equator.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托的解决办法，是随着远离赤道，把纬线之间的间距逐步拉大。

sentences.en: The effect was to straighten the lines of constant compass bearing (also known as rhumbs or loxodromes).
sentences.zh: 这样做的效果，是把恒定罗盘方位的航线（即所谓等角航线，又称恒向线）拉直为直线。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, straightening the rhumbs caused areal distortion: at the map’s northern and southern extremities, the polar regions occupied the full width of the map, while North America appeared to fill half the circumference of the world.
sentences.zh: 可惜的是，拉直恒向线会带来面积上的失真：在地图的南北两端，极地区域占据了地图的全部宽度，而北美洲看上去几乎填满了世界周长的一半。

sentences.en: C Few of Mercator’s contemporaries understood what he was up to, despite the map’s title explaining that it was intended ‘for use in navigation’.
sentences.zh: 尽管这幅地图的标题已说明它是“供航海之用”，但墨卡托同时代的人几乎没有谁理解他的用意。

sentences.en: Mercator knew that his projection was unsuitable as an areal description of the world, but it would be several decades before the map’s true navigational value would be recognised.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托自己清楚，他的投影法并不适合用来描述世界各地的面积，但要等到几十年后，这幅地图真正的航海价值才被世人所认识。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Mercator was marshalling and editing all the geographical data he needed for his modern regional maps of the world.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，墨卡托正在整理和编辑他为现代世界区域地图所需的全部地理资料。

sentences.en: His sources were wide-ranging and multitudinous, including an imperial physician in Vienna and his competitor, the Viceroy of Holstein.
sentences.zh: 他的资料来源既广泛又繁多，其中包括维也纳一位皇家御医，以及他的竞争对手——荷尔斯泰因的总督。

sentences.en: He was still working on these maps when he died.
sentences.zh: 直到去世时，他仍在继续这些地图的工作。

sentences.en: The great cosmography that Mercator had already titled ‘Atlas’ would never be finished.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托早已为这部宏大的宇宙志取名《地图集》（Atlas），然而它永远未能完成。

sentences.en: In the Atlas, Mercator had embodied the principles of future mapmaking: his italic lettering, his identical map overlaps, his complete coverage of regions at more than one scale, his consistent use of grids of latitude and longitude, his singular editorial control, were all adopted as cartographic standards.
sentences.zh: 在这部《地图集》中，墨卡托体现了后世制图的若干原则：他使用的斜体字、统一的图幅重叠方式、对各区域以多种比例尺的完整覆盖、对经纬度网格的一贯使用，以及独到的编辑把控，全都被后人采纳为制图标准。

sentences.en: ‘Atlas’, the cosmography, became ‘atlas’, the (Oxford English Dictionary) term for ‘a collection of maps in a volume.’
sentences.zh: 作为宇宙志的 Atlas 一名，最终变成了《牛津英语词典》中表示“一册地图汇编”的 atlas 一词。

sentences.en: D The projection assumed a life of its own.
sentences.zh: 这套投影法此后有了自己的生命。

sentences.en: So powerful a cartographic tool did it become that Mercator the man became subsumed by his own device.
sentences.zh: 它成为一种如此强大的制图工具，以至于墨卡托其人也被自己创造的工具所吞没。

sentences.en: By the 20th century, Mercator’s Projection had been adopted by state cartographers to map the land that he had named ‘North America’.
sentences.zh: 到 20 世纪，墨卡托投影已被各国官方制图师采用，用以绘制他当年命名为“北美洲”的那片土地。

sentences.en: In 1938, Mercator’s Projection was selected by the Ordnance Survey to map Britain anew.
sentences.zh: 1938 年，墨卡托投影被英国军械测量局选中，用以重新绘制英国地图。

sentences.en: And in 1974, the American cartographer Alden P.
sentences.zh: 1974 年，美国制图师奥尔登·P·

sentences.en: Colvocoresses used the Space Oblique Mercator Projection for the first satellite map of the USA.
sentences.zh: 科沃克雷斯（Colvocoresses）使用斜轴空间墨卡托投影，制作了美国第一张卫星地图。

sentences.en: When the Jet Propulsion Laboratory sent Mariner 8 and Mariner 9 to map Mars, they undertook their Martian cartography on a standard Mercator Projection.
sentences.zh: 当美国喷气推进实验室派出水手 8 号和水手 9 号去为火星制图时，他们采用的是标准的墨卡托投影来完成火星地图。

sentences.en: One by one, the mappable orbs of our solar system are appearing on the worldwide web, flattened for our screens according to Mercator’s cartographic principles.
sentences.zh: 我们太阳系中可被绘制的天体，正一个接一个地出现在互联网上——它们都按墨卡托的制图原理被压平，呈现在我们的屏幕上。

sentences.en: Mercator’s Projection succeeded in reconciling the sphere and the plane, while his Atlas enveloped the world with an integrated system of maps.
sentences.zh: 墨卡托投影成功调和了球面与平面，而他的《地图集》则以一套相互衔接的地图系统将整个世界包容其中。

sentences.en: (A) Want to devise a new form of alternative medical treatment?
sentences.zh: 想发明一种新的另类医疗方法吗？

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Here’s the recipe.
sentences.zh: 配方在此。

sentences.en: As a practitioner, be warm, sympathetic, reassuring and enthusiastic.
sentences.zh: 作为施治者，你要热情、有同情心、令人安心，而且充满干劲。

sentences.en: Your treatment should involve physical contact, and each session with your patients should take at least half an hour.
sentences.zh: 你的治疗要有身体接触，与患者的每次诊疗至少要花上半小时。

sentences.en: Encourage your patients to take an active part in their treatment and understand how their disorders relate to the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 鼓励患者主动参与自己的治疗，并理解他们的病症与其整个生活之间的关联。

sentences.en: Tell them that their own bodies possess the true power to heal.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们，真正的疗愈之力就在他们自己的身体里。

sentences.en: Get them to pay you well.
sentences.zh: 让他们付给你丰厚的报酬。

sentences.en: Describe your treatment in familiar words, but embroidered with a hint of mysticism: energy fields, energy flows, energy blocks, meridians, forces, auras, rhythms and the like.
sentences.zh: 用大家熟悉的词语来描述你的疗法，但要缀上一丝神秘色彩：能量场、能量流、能量阻滞、经络、力、气场、节律等等。

sentences.en: Refer to the knowledge of an earlier age: wisdom carelessly swept aside by the rise of blind mechanistic science.
sentences.zh: 援引更早年代的知识：那些被盲目的机械论科学的兴起随手扫到一边的智慧。

sentences.en: Oh, come off it, you’re saying.
sentences.zh: 得了吧，你会这么说。

sentences.en: Something like that couldn’t possibly work, could it?
sentences.zh: 这种东西根本不可能有用，对吧？

sentences.en: (B) Well, yes, it could and often well enough to earn you a living.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还真可能有用，而且往往足以让你以此谋生。

sentences.en: And a very good living if you are sufficiently convincing or, better still, really believe in your therapy.
sentences.zh: 如果你足够有说服力，或者更妙的是你真心相信自己的疗法，那还能过得相当滋润。

sentences.en: Many illnesses get better on their own, so if you are lucky and administer your treatment at just the right time you’ll get the credit.
sentences.zh: 许多疾病本来就会自行好转，所以只要你运气好，在恰当的时机施治，功劳就归你了。

sentences.en: But that’s only part of it.
sentences.zh: 但这只是其中一部分原因。

sentences.en: Some of the improvement really would be down to you.
sentences.zh: 有些好转确实要归功于你。

sentences.en: Not necessarily because you’d recommended ginseng rather than chamomile tea or used this crystal as opposed to that pressure point.
sentences.zh: 这未必是因为你推荐了人参而不是甘菊茶，或者用了这块水晶而不是那个穴位。

sentences.en: Nothing so specific.
sentences.zh: 不是这么具体的东西。

sentences.en: Your healing power would be the outcome of a paradoxical force that conventional medicine recognizes but remains oddly ambivalent about: the placebo effect.
sentences.zh: 你的疗愈之力来自一种矛盾的作用，主流医学承认它，却又对它态度奇怪地含糊：安慰剂效应。

sentences.en: (C) Placebos are treatments that have no direct effect on the body, yet still work because the patient has faith in their power to heal.
sentences.zh: 安慰剂是对身体没有直接作用的疗法，但由于患者相信它有疗愈之力，它照样奏效。

sentences.en: Most often the term refers to a dummy pill, but it applies just as much to any device or procedure, from a sticking plaster to a crystal.
sentences.zh: 这个词最常指假药片，但同样适用于任何器具或操作，从一贴创可贴到一块水晶都算。

sentences.en: The existence of the placebo effect implies that even a complete fraud could make a difference to someone’s health, which is why some practitioners of alternative medicine are sensitive about any mention of the subject.
sentences.zh: 安慰剂效应的存在意味着，哪怕是彻头彻尾的骗术也可能改变一个人的健康状况，正因如此，某些另类医学从业者一提到这个话题就很敏感。

sentences.en: In fact, the placebo is a powerful part of all medical care, orthodox or otherwise, though its role is often neglected and misunderstood.
sentences.zh: 事实上，无论正统与否，安慰剂都是一切医疗照护中很有分量的一环，只是它的作用常被忽视和误解。

sentences.en: (D) At one level, it should come as no surprise that our state of mind can influence our physiology: anger opens the superficial blood vessels of the face; sadness pumps the tear glands.
sentences.zh: 从某种层面上说，心理状态能影响生理并不奇怪：愤怒会让面部浅层血管扩张；悲伤会让泪腺分泌。

sentences.en: But exactly how placebos work their medical magic is still largely unknown.
sentences.zh: 但安慰剂究竟如何施展其医学魔力，至今仍大多不为人知。

sentences.en: Most of the scant research to date has focused on the control of pain, because it’s one of the commonest complaints and lends itself to experimental study.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止为数不多的研究大多聚焦于疼痛的控制，因为疼痛是最常见的主诉之一，也便于做实验研究。

sentences.en: Here, attention has turned to the endorphins, natural substances produced in the brain that are known to help control pain.
sentences.zh: 在这方面，人们把注意力转向了内啡肽，这是大脑产生的天然物质，已知有助于控制疼痛。

sentences.en: Any of the neurochemicals involved in transmitting pain impulses or modulating them might also be involved in generating the placebo response, says Don Price, an oral surgeon at the University of Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达大学口腔外科医生唐·普赖斯说，凡是参与传递或调节痛觉冲动的神经化学物质，都有可能参与产生安慰剂反应。

sentences.en: (E) That case has been strengthened by the recent work of Fabrizio Benedetti of the University of Turin, who showed that the placebo effect can be abolished by a drug, naloxone, which blocks the effects of endorphins.
sentences.zh: 都灵大学的法布里齐奥·贝内代蒂近来的研究强化了这一论点，他发现纳洛酮这种阻断内啡肽作用的药物可以消除安慰剂效应。

sentences.en: Benedetti induced pain in a pressure cuff on the forearm.
sentences.zh: 贝内代蒂用前臂上的压力袖带诱发疼痛。

sentences.en: He did this several times a day for several days, using morphine each time to control the pain.
sentences.zh: 他连续数日、每天做上几次，每次都用吗啡来控制疼痛。

sentences.en: On the final day, without saying anything, he replaced the morphine with a saline solution.
sentences.zh: 到最后一天，他一言不发地把吗啡换成了生理盐水。

sentences.en: This still relieved the subjects’ pain: a placebo effect.
sentences.zh: 这仍然缓解了受试者的疼痛：这就是安慰剂效应。

sentences.en: But when he added naloxone to the saline, and blocked the endorphins, the pain relief disappeared.
sentences.zh: 但当他往生理盐水中加入纳洛酮、阻断内啡肽后，止痛效果就消失了。

sentences.en: Here was direct proof that the relief of pain by a placebo is carried out, at least in part, by these natural opiates.
sentences.zh: 这直接证明了安慰剂的镇痛作用至少有一部分是由这些天然阿片类物质完成的。

sentences.en: (F) Though scientists don’t know exactly how placebos work, they have accumulated a fair bit of knowledge about how to trigger the effect.
sentences.zh: 尽管科学家并不清楚安慰剂究竟如何起效，他们对如何触发这一效应倒是积累了不少认识。

sentences.en: A London rheumatologist found, for example, that red dummy capsules made more effective painkillers than blue, green or yellow ones.
sentences.zh: 举例来说，伦敦一位风湿病学家发现，红色的假胶囊比蓝色、绿色或黄色的止痛效果更好。

sentences.en: Research on American students revealed that blue pills make better tranquillisers than pink, a colour more suitable for stimulants.
sentences.zh: 一项针对美国学生的研究显示，蓝色药片比粉色更适合当镇静剂，而粉色更适合用作兴奋剂。

sentences.en: Even branding can make a difference: if Aspro or Tylenol are what you like to take for a headache; their chemically identical generic equivalents may be less effective.
sentences.zh: 甚至品牌也会造成差别：如果你头痛时惯用 Aspro 或 Tylenol，那么化学成分完全相同的仿制药可能效果更差。

sentences.en: (G) It matters too how the treatment is delivered.
sentences.zh: 疗法如何实施同样重要。

sentences.en: Decades ago, when the major tranquilliser chlorpromazine was being introduced, a doctor in Kansas categorised his colleagues according to whether they were keen on it, openly sceptical of its benefits, or took a let's-try-and-see attitude.
sentences.zh: 几十年前，主要镇静剂氯丙嗪刚投入使用时，堪萨斯州一位医生按同事对它的态度把他们分了类：热衷的、公开质疑其疗效的，以及抱着试试看态度的。

sentences.en: His conclusion: the more enthusiastic the doctor, the better the drug performed.
sentences.zh: 他的结论是：医生越热情，药效就越好。

sentences.en: A recent survey by Ernst on doctors’ bedside manners turned up one consistent finding: physicians who adopt a warm, friendly, reassuring manner are more effective than those whose consultations are formal and do not offer reassurance.
sentences.zh: 恩斯特近来对医生问诊态度所做的一项调查得出了一个一致的结论：举止热情、友善、能让人安心的医生，比那些问诊刻板、不给予安抚的医生更为有效。

sentences.en: (H) Warm, friendly and reassuring are precisely what alternative treatment is all about, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，热情、友善、令人安心，恰恰正是另类疗法的看家本领。

sentences.en: Many of the ingredients of that opening recipe — the physical contact, the generous swaths of time, the strong hints of supernormal healing power — are just the kind of thing likely to impress patients.
sentences.zh: 开头那份配方里的许多成分——身体接触、大把大把的时间、对超常疗愈之力的强烈暗示——正是最容易打动患者的那类东西。

sentences.en: It’s hardly surprising then, that complementary practitioners are generally best at mobilising the placebo effect, says Arthur Kleinman, professor of social anthropology at Harvard University.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学社会人类学教授阿瑟·克莱曼说，因此辅助疗法从业者通常最擅长调动安慰剂效应，这一点毫不奇怪。

sentences.en: (A) Language is a powerful tool that humans use for a wide variety of purposes—from expressing emotions and sharing ideas to passing down cultural values and acquiring knowledge.
sentences.zh: 语言是人类用于多种用途的强大工具——从表达情感、分享想法，到传递文化价值与获取知识。

sentences.en: It is not limited to spoken words; gestures, facial expressions, and even posture all contribute to how we communicate.
sentences.zh: 它不只限于口头词语；手势、面部表情甚至姿态都参与了我们的沟通方式。

sentences.en: Language, whether signed or spoken, plays a vital role in how we engage with the world around us.
sentences.zh: 语言——无论是手语还是口语——在我们如何与周围世界互动中起着关键作用。

sentences.en: (B) In recent years, many American schools have begun to recognize American Sign Language (ASL) as a valid foreign language credit, just like Spanish or French.
sentences.zh: 近年来，许多美国学校开始把美国手语（ASL）认定为合规的外语学分，与西班牙语或法语并列。

sentences.en: This change has opened the door for hearing students to choose ASL as an academic subject, which not only gives them a practical skill but also increases their awareness of and empathy toward the Deaf community.
sentences.zh: 这一变化为听力正常的学生选择 ASL 作为学术课程打开了大门，不仅给他们一项实用技能，也增强了他们对聋人社区的了解和共情。

sentences.en: Some educators believe this early exposure may even influence students to pursue careers in special education, speech therapy, or interpreting.
sentences.zh: 一些教育者相信，这种早期接触甚至可能影响学生进入特殊教育、言语治疗或口译等职业。

sentences.en: (C) One clear benefit of learning ASL for hearing children is the opportunity for broader social interaction.
sentences.zh: 听力正常的儿童学习 ASL 的一个明显好处是，能进行更广泛的社交互动。

sentences.en: Children who understand ASL can communicate with deaf peers, making their social circles more inclusive.
sentences.zh: 懂 ASL 的儿童可以与聋人同龄人交流，让自己的社交圈更具包容性。

sentences.en: Additionally, they may find it easier to express complex ideas or emotions non-verbally, which is helpful in noisy environments or when verbal speech isn't possible.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们可能发现非言语地表达复杂想法或情绪更容易——这在嘈杂环境或无法说话时很有帮助。

sentences.en: (D) Dr. Marilyn Daniels, a researcher and advocate for baby sign language, has spent over two decades studying the impact of signing on early communication.
sentences.zh: 玛丽琳·丹尼尔斯博士（Dr. Daniels），婴儿手语的研究者和倡导者，已花了二十多年研究手语对早期沟通的影响。

sentences.en: While she promotes the use of sign language with infants, she emphasizes that there is no need for parents to invent their own signs.
sentences.zh: 虽然她推广在婴儿身上使用手语，但她强调家长不必自创手势。

sentences.en: Instead, she suggests that parents use ASL or another standardized system to ensure consistency and eventual recognition by others.
sentences.zh: 她建议家长使用 ASL 或另一种标准化体系，以确保一致性、并最终让别人也能识别。

sentences.en: (E) Very young children often develop motor skills before verbal skills.
sentences.zh: 非常小的儿童往往先于言语技能发展出动作技能。

sentences.en: Dr. Daniels notes that even babies as young as six months can learn to use simple signs like “milk” or “more” with their hands, long before they can articulate those words.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯博士指出，甚至 6 个月大的婴儿都能学会用手做一些简单手势，如“milk”（奶）或“more”（更多），远早于他们能清晰说出这些词。

sentences.en: This early form of communication can reduce frustration—for both babies and their parents—and may even accelerate speech development.
sentences.zh: 这种早期形式的沟通可以减少挫败感——对婴儿和家长都是——甚至可能加快言语发展。

sentences.en: (F) Studies have shown that hearing children exposed to sign language from an early age tend to have stronger reading skills by the time they enter primary school.
sentences.zh: 研究显示，从小接触手语的听力正常儿童，到上小学时往往阅读能力更强。

sentences.en: It is believed that learning sign language can strengthen understanding of symbolic representation and grammar, both of which are foundational to literacy.
sentences.zh: 人们相信，学习手语可以加强对符号表征和语法的理解，这两者都是读写素养的基础。

sentences.en: These cognitive advantages suggest that signing benefits not only communication but academic success as well.
sentences.zh: 这些认知优势表明，做手语不仅有益于沟通，也有益于学业成功。

sentences.en: (G) There remains some debate about the best approach to language instruction for deaf children.
sentences.zh: 关于对聋童语言教学的最佳路径，仍存在一些争论。

sentences.en: Some educators argue that speech and lip-reading should come first, while others advocate for immediate exposure to sign language.
sentences.zh: 一些教育者主张应先学口语和读唇，而另一些人则主张立即接触手语。

sentences.en: Dr. Daniels believes the latter is more effective and less frustrating for the child.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔斯博士相信后者对孩子更有效、也更不令人挫败。

sentences.en: She calls the idea that children must learn to lip-read before learning sign language “an outdated notion.”
sentences.zh: 她把“孩子必须先学会读唇、再学手语”的看法称为“过时的观念”。

sentences.en: She, along with other advocates, stresses that deaf children have a right to a full, accessible language from birth—and that language is often sign.
sentences.zh: 她与其他倡导者一起强调，聋童从出生起就有权获得一种完整、可达的语言——而那门语言往往就是手语。
