sentences.en: A Long known as the “Queen of Gems”, pearls possess a history and allure far beyond what today’s wearer may recognize.
sentences.zh: 长期以来被誉为“宝石中的女王”的珍珠，其历史和魅力远远超出今天佩戴者所能体会到的。

sentences.en: Throughout much of recorded history, a natural pearl necklace comprised of matched spheres was a treasure of almost incomparable value, in fact, the most expensive jewelry in the world.
sentences.zh: 在有记录的历史的大部分时间里，由匹配球粒组成的天然珍珠项链是几乎无与伦比的珍宝，事实上是世界上最昂贵的珠宝。

sentences.en: Before the creation of cultured pearls in the early 1900s, natural pearls were so rare and expensive that they were reserved almost exclusively for the noble and very rich.
sentences.zh: 在 1900 年代初养殖珍珠诞生之前，天然珍珠如此稀有且昂贵，几乎专为贵族和富豪所享用。

sentences.en: The ancient Egyptians were particularly fond of their pearls.
sentences.zh: 古埃及人尤其珍爱他们的珍珠。

sentences.en: Many Egyptian leaders treasured pearls so much that they were often buried along with their cherished pearl collection.
sentences.zh: 许多埃及统治者对珍珠如此珍视，以至于常常和心爱的珍珠收藏一起下葬。

sentences.en: In the Orient and Persian Empire, pearls were ground into costly powders to cure anything from heart disease to epilepsy, with possible aphrodisiac uses as well.
sentences.zh: 在东方和波斯帝国，珍珠被磨成昂贵的粉末，用以治疗从心脏病到癫痫的各种病症，也可能被用作春药。

sentences.en: China’s long recorded history also provides ample evidence of the importance of pearls.
sentences.zh: 中国漫长的历史记载也充分证明了珍珠的重要性。

sentences.en: B Pearls usually fall into three categories—natural pearls, cultured pearls and simulated pearls.
sentences.zh: 珍珠通常分为三类——天然珍珠、养殖珍珠和仿珍珠。

sentences.en: A natural pearl forms when an irritant, such as a piece of sand, works its way into a particular species of oyster, mussel, or clam.
sentences.zh: 当沙粒等异物进入特定种类的牡蛎、蚌或蛤时，便会形成天然珍珠。

sentences.en: As a defense mechanism, the mollusk secretes a fluid to coat the irritant.
sentences.zh: 作为防御机制，软体动物分泌一种液体来包裹异物。

sentences.en: Layer upon layer of this coating is deposited on the irritant until a lustrous pearl is formed.
sentences.zh: 这种包裹层一层又一层地沉积在异物之上，直到形成一颗光泽华美的珍珠。

sentences.en: A cultured pearl undergoes the same process.
sentences.zh: 养殖珍珠经历同样的过程。

sentences.en: The only difference between natural pearls and cultured pearls is that the irritant is a surgically implanted bead or piece of shell called Mother of Pearl.
sentences.zh: 天然珍珠与养殖珍珠的唯一区别在于：异物是经外科手术植入的珠核或贝壳片，称为珍珠母（Mother of Pearl）。

sentences.en: Often, these shells are ground oyster shells that are worth significant amounts of money in their own right as irritant-catalysts for quality pearls.
sentences.zh: 通常，这些贝壳本身就是磨碎的牡蛎壳，作为优质珍珠的异物催化剂，本身就值不少钱。

sentences.en: The resulting core is much larger than in a natural pearl.
sentences.zh: 由此形成的珠核比天然珍珠中的要大得多。

sentences.en: Imitation pearls are a different story altogether.
sentences.zh: 仿珍珠则完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: In most cases, a glass bead is dipped into a solution made from fish scales.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，一颗玻璃珠被浸入由鱼鳞制成的溶液中。

sentences.en: This coating is thin and may eventually wear off.
sentences.zh: 这种镀层很薄，最终可能磨损脱落。

sentences.en: One can usually tell an imitation by biting on it.
sentences.zh: 通常可以通过咬一下来判断是不是仿制珍珠。

sentences.en: The island of Mallorca in Spain is known for its imitation pearl industry.
sentences.zh: 西班牙的马洛卡岛以其仿珍珠产业而闻名。

sentences.en: C Regardless of the method used to acquire a pearl, the process usually takes several years.
sentences.zh: 无论采用何种方式获得珍珠，这个过程通常都需要好几年。

sentences.en: Mussels must reach a mature age, which can take up to 3 years, and then be implanted or naturally receive an irritant.
sentences.zh: 贝类必须长到成熟年龄——这可能需要长达 3 年——然后被植入或自然接受异物。

sentences.en: Once the irritant is in place, it can take up to another 3 years for the pearl to reach its full size.
sentences.zh: 一旦异物到位，珍珠长到完整尺寸又可能需要再过 3 年。

sentences.en: Often, the irritant may be rejected, the pearl will be terrifically misshapen, or the oyster may simply die from disease or countless other complications.
sentences.zh: 异物常常会被排斥，珍珠也会变得非常畸形，或者牡蛎可能因疾病或无数其他并发症而死亡。

sentences.en: By the end of a 5 to 10 year cycle, only 50% of the oysters will have survived.
sentences.zh: 到 5 至 10 年的周期结束时，只有 50% 的牡蛎能活下来。

sentences.en: And of the pearls produced, only approximately 5% are of a quality substantial enough for top jewelry makers.
sentences.zh: 而在产出的珍珠中，只有约 5% 的质量足以达到顶级珠宝制作者的标准。

sentences.en: D How can untrained eyes determine a pearl’s worth?
sentences.zh: 未经训练的眼睛如何判断一颗珍珠的价值？

sentences.en: Luster and size are generally considered the two main factors to look for.
sentences.zh: 光泽和大小通常被视为要看的两个主要因素。

sentences.en: Luster, for instance, depends on the fineness and evenness of the layers.
sentences.zh: 光泽，例如，取决于层次的细腻程度和均匀程度。

sentences.en: The deeper the glow, the more perfect the shape and surface, the more valuable they are.
sentences.zh: 光泽越深沉、形状和表面越完美，价值就越高。

sentences.en: Size, on the other hand, has to do with the age of the oyster that created the pearl (the more mature oysters produce larger pearls) and the location in which the pearl was cultured.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，大小则与产出珍珠的牡蛎年龄（越成熟的牡蛎产出更大的珍珠）和珍珠养殖的地点有关。

sentences.en: The South Sea waters of Australia tend to produce the larger pearls; probably because the water along the coastline is supplied with rich nutrients from the ocean floor.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的南海水域往往出产较大的珍珠；这可能是因为沿海水域接收了海床带来的丰富养分。

sentences.en: Also, the type of mussel being common to the area seems to possess a predilection for producing comparatively large pearls.
sentences.zh: 此外，该区域常见的贝类品种似乎也具有产出相对较大珍珠的倾向。

sentences.en: E In general, cultured pearls are less valuable than natural pearls, whereas imitation pearls have almost no value.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，养殖珍珠价值不及天然珍珠，而仿珍珠几乎没什么价值。

sentences.en: One way that jewelers can determine whether a pearl is cultured or natural is to have a gem lab perform an X-ray of the pearl.
sentences.zh: 珠宝商判断一颗珍珠是养殖还是天然的方法之一，是请宝石实验室对珍珠做 X 光检查。

sentences.en: If the X-ray reveals a nucleus, the pearl is likely a bead nucleated saltwater pearl.
sentences.zh: 如果 X 光显示出一个核，珍珠很可能是植入珠核的海水珍珠。

sentences.en: If no nucleus is present, but irregular and small dark inner spots indicating a cavity are visible, combined with concentric rings of organic substance, the pearl is likely a cultured freshwater pearl.
sentences.zh: 如果没有核存在，但可以看到指示一个空腔的、不规则的小暗内斑点，再加上同心环状有机物质，那么这颗珍珠很可能是养殖淡水珍珠。

sentences.en: Among cultured pearls, Akoya pearls from Japan are some of the most lustrous.
sentences.zh: 在养殖珍珠中，日本的 Akoya 珍珠是光泽最高的之一。

sentences.en: Although imitation pearls look the part, they do not have the same weight or smoothness as real pearls, and their luster will also dim greatly.
sentences.zh: 尽管仿珍珠外观相似，但它们没有真珍珠那样的重量或光滑度，光泽也会大幅黯淡。

sentences.en: F Historically, the world’s best pearls came from the Persian Gulf, especially around what is now Bahrain.
sentences.zh: 在历史上，世界上最好的珍珠来自波斯湾，尤其是今天巴林一带。

sentences.en: The pearls of the Persian Gulf were naturally created and collected by breath-hold divers.
sentences.zh: 波斯湾的珍珠是天然形成的，由屏息潜水者采集。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the natural pearl industry of the Persian Gulf ended abruptly in the early 1930s with the discovery of large deposits of oil.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，波斯湾的天然珍珠产业在 1930 年代初随着大型石油矿藏的发现而突然终结。

sentences.en: The water pollution resulting from spilled oil and indiscriminate overfishing of oysters essentially ruined the pristine waters of the Gulf that once produced pearls.
sentences.zh: 溢出石油造成的水污染以及对牡蛎的肆意过度捕捞，从根本上毁掉了海湾那一度产出珍珠的清澈水域。

sentences.en: Still, Bahrain remains one of the foremost trading centers for high quality pearls.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，巴林仍是高品质珍珠最重要的交易中心之一。

sentences.en: In fact, cultured pearls are banned from the Bahrain pearl market, in an effort to preserve the location’s heritage.
sentences.zh: 事实上，巴林珍珠市场禁止养殖珍珠，以此保护当地的传统。

sentences.en: Nowadays, the largest stock of natural pearls probably resides in India.
sentences.zh: 如今，最大的天然珍珠库存可能存放在印度。

sentences.en: Ironically, much of India’s stock of natural pearls came originally from Bahrain.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，印度的天然珍珠库存大多最初来自巴林。

sentences.en: Unlike Bahrain, which has essentially lost its pearl resource, traditional pearl fishing is still practiced on a small scale in India.
sentences.zh: 与巴林（其珍珠资源已基本耗尽）不同，传统采珠在印度仍以小规模延续着。

sentences.en: G Pearls also come in many colours.
sentences.zh: 珍珠也有多种颜色。

sentences.en: The most popular colours are white, cream, and pink.
sentences.zh: 最受欢迎的颜色是白、奶油色和粉色。

sentences.en: Silver, black, and gold are also gaining interest.
sentences.zh: 银色、黑色和金色也越来越受到关注。

sentences.en: In fact, a deep lustrous black pearl is one of the rarest finds in the pearling industry, usually only being found in the South Sea near Australia.
sentences.zh: 事实上，光泽深沉的黑珍珠是采珠业最罕见的发现之一，通常只在澳大利亚附近的南海能见到。

sentences.en: Thus, they can be one of the more costly items.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们可能是较为昂贵的物件之一。

sentences.en: Nowadays, pearls predominantly come from Japan, Australia, Indonesia, Myanmar, China, India, the Philippines, and Tahiti.
sentences.zh: 如今，珍珠主要来自日本、澳大利亚、印度尼西亚、缅甸、中国、印度、菲律宾和大溪地。

sentences.en: Japan, however, controls roughly 80% of the world pearl market, with Australia and China coming in second and third, respectively.
sentences.zh: 然而，日本控制着约 80% 的世界珍珠市场，澳大利亚和中国分列第二、第三。

records.title: Report on a university drama project

sentences.en: (A) This project was born from discussions I had with other drama students about the kind of theatre productions we’d like to create.
sentences.zh: 这个项目源于我和其他戏剧专业的学生讨论我们想要创作什么样的戏剧作品。

sentences.en: Although we had previously been involved in various university productions where we took on specific roles, such as costume designer, producer, director and so on, we now wanted to take a collaborative approach that was new to all of us.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们此前都参与过各种大学演出，在其中担任服装设计、制片、导演等具体角色，但这一次我们想尝试一种对我们所有人来说都很新鲜的协作方式。

sentences.en: We wanted a project in which every voice would carry equal weight and everyone would be able to contribute to every aspect of the show.
sentences.zh: 我们想要一个这样的项目：每个人的声音都同等重要，每个人都能为演出的方方面面贡献力量。

sentences.en: We decided that the way to achieve this feeling of collaboration would be to concentrate on the process by which the work emerged during auditions and rehearsals.
sentences.zh: 我们认定，要实现这种协作感，办法就是把重心放在作品于试镜和排练过程中逐渐成形的那个过程上。

sentences.en: We chose a play that we felt allowed varied interpretations – Harold Pinter’s The Lover, a modern one-act play with just two characters.
sentences.zh: 我们选了一部我们觉得能有多种诠释空间的剧——哈罗德·品特的《情人》，一部只有两个角色的现代独幕剧。

sentences.en: We decided we would use six actors cast as three different couples, and each pair would have a turn to perform on one of the three nights that the play was to be staged.
sentences.zh: 我们决定起用六名演员，组成三对不同的伴侣，每一对将在这部剧上演的三个晚上中各演一场。

sentences.en: (B) The next step was to hold auditions in order to find six actors who felt the same way about the project as we did.
sentences.zh: 下一步是举行试镜，以便找到六名对这个项目的想法与我们一致的演员。

sentences.en: We were anxious not to create an “us-and-them” feeling to the auditions, since collective ownership of the project was crucial to our ideas.
sentences.zh: 我们很在意不要让试镜产生一种“我们和他们”的隔阂感，因为对项目的集体共有，对我们的理念至关重要。

sentences.en: So we ran the first round of auditions as a series of workshops, which we kept very informal and relaxed.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们把第一轮试镜办成了一系列工作坊，把气氛弄得非常随意而轻松。

sentences.en: Then we recalled fifteen actors for the second round of auditions.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们召回了十五名演员参加第二轮试镜。

sentences.en: At this stage we wanted the reactions and ideas to flow and be explored by the group in the form of a discussion.
sentences.zh: 在这一阶段，我们希望各种反应和想法能够自由迸发，并由大家以讨论的形式加以探究。

sentences.en: We were looking for actors who could encourage other people’s ideas but who were also eager to input their own thoughts.
sentences.zh: 我们要找的演员，既能鼓励他人的想法，又渴望表达自己的见解。

sentences.en: Possibly the hardest part of the whole process was sitting down afterwards and deciding on the final six actors who would take part in the project.
sentences.zh: 整个过程中也许最难的部分，就是事后坐下来，敲定最终参加项目的那六名演员。

sentences.en: (C) Our initial rehearsals were dedicated to creating a strong group dynamic and to exploring some of the themes of the play without explicit reference to the script.
sentences.zh: 我们最初的排练，致力于营造一种紧密的团队默契，并在不直接援引剧本的情况下探讨剧中的一些主题。

sentences.en: One of the strongest tools we used for this was freewriting – an exercise in which one person would read out a list of unconnected words and the rest of the group would clear their minds and simply write something in response to those words.
sentences.zh: 为此我们用到的最有力的手段之一是自由写作——这是一种练习，由一个人念出一串毫不相关的词语，其余人则清空思绪，只管写下对这些词语的回应。

sentences.en: We found it helped us to gain insight into the different ways our minds work.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，这有助于我们洞察各自思维方式的不同。

sentences.en: It also meant that we got to know each other very well, very quickly!
sentences.zh: 它还意味着我们彼此很快就十分熟络了！

sentences.en: (D) It was only during the next phase of rehearsals that we finally began to work with the script.
sentences.zh: 直到下一阶段的排练，我们才终于开始处理剧本。

sentences.en: We had not yet decided on the pairings for the six actors at this point, and we had the non-actors on the team reading in addition to the people who would be doing the final performances.
sentences.zh: 这时我们还没有定下六名演员的配对，除了将参加最终演出的人之外，团队里不演戏的成员也参与了读本。

sentences.en: The whole team finally decided on the pairings of the actors by a vote, and, miraculously, it was a unanimous decision.
sentences.zh: 整个团队最终通过投票确定了演员的配对，而奇迹般地，这是一个一致通过的决定。

sentences.en: The casting of the roles worked well and felt more natural than it had in any other show I’ve worked on.
sentences.zh: 角色的分配效果很好，比我参与过的任何其他演出都来得自然。

sentences.en: I think the dynamic that we developed over the early rehearsals was crucial in giving us three such strong onstage relationships.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我们在早期排练中培养起来的默契，对于造就台上这三段如此紧密的关系起到了关键作用。

sentences.en: (E) Other decisions were made in much the same way.
sentences.zh: 其他决定也大体以同样的方式做出。

sentences.en: The publicity was the responsibility of one member of the team, but she asked everyone what they thought would be effective.
sentences.zh: 宣传由团队中的一名成员负责，但她会征询每个人觉得怎样才有效果。

sentences.en: She then made several different versions, and from these we chose the design we liked the most.
sentences.zh: 随后她做出了好几个不同的版本，我们从中选出了最喜欢的设计。

sentences.en: The stage set was left more to the individual pairs of actors, but since a large part of the later rehearsals was observing and feeding back on the individual performances being created by each pair, everyone was able to help with set design.
sentences.zh: 舞台布景则更多地交给各对演员自己来定，但由于后期排练有很大一部分是观摩各对演员所创作的表演并给予反馈，因此每个人都能为布景设计出一份力。

sentences.en: We initially planned that each pair would use the same stage set.
sentences.zh: 我们最初计划让每一对都使用相同的舞台布景。

sentences.en: However, due to the different ways they interpreted the script, it became important for the set to be adapted for each couple.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于他们诠释剧本的方式各不相同，针对每一对演员对布景加以调整就变得重要起来。

sentences.en: (F) In the final performances, it was surprising that despite the collaborative nature of the project, a range of very different interpretations emerged.
sentences.zh: 在最终的演出中，令人惊讶的是，尽管项目本身具有协作性质，呈现出来的诠释却大相径庭。

sentences.en: This is, of course, partly due to the tragicomic nature of Pinter’s text, which allowed the pairs of actors to exploit these two disparate elements, tragedy and comedy, to different degrees.
sentences.zh: 这当然在一定程度上要归因于品特剧本的悲喜剧性质，它让各对演员得以把悲剧与喜剧这两种迥异的元素发挥到不同的程度。

sentences.en: (G) The question-and-answer session held after the show was perhaps the most rewarding part of the project.
sentences.zh: 演出结束后举行的问答环节，也许是整个项目最有收获的部分。

sentences.en: The questions that the audience asked were interesting and insightful, and certainly made everyone in the team think about what we’d been doing, what we’d wanted to achieve and whether we’d achieved it.
sentences.zh: 观众提出的问题既有趣又有见地，无疑让团队里的每个人都去思考我们一直在做什么、我们想要达到什么，以及我们是否做到了。

sentences.en: We were asked, among other things, about how successful our collaborative ethic had been, how we’d ended up with three such different shows, how we’d overcome the initial “production-team-versus-cast” divide, and how we would continue in the future.
sentences.zh: 他们问到的问题包括：我们的协作理念有多成功、我们怎么会排出三场如此不同的演出、我们如何弥合起初那种“制作团队对演员”的隔阂，以及我们今后会如何继续下去。

sentences.en: A Today’s environmental scientists are in no doubt that the world’s resources of fertile soil are rapidly deteriorating, and that new land for agriculture is becoming ever more sparse.
sentences.zh: 今天的环境科学家毫不怀疑，世界肥沃土壤的资源正在迅速退化，而可供农业使用的新土地正变得越来越稀少。

sentences.en: Intensive farming, urbanisation, desertification and sea-level rises are all putting growing pressure on the planet’s agricultural land and therefore on food supplies.
sentences.zh: 集约农业、城市化、荒漠化和海平面上升都在给地球的农业用地、进而给食物供应带来越来越大的压力。

sentences.en: Currently 24 per cent of the world’s 11.5 billion hectares of cultivated land has already undergone human-induced soil degradation, particularly through erosion, according to a recent study by the UK Government Office for Science.
sentences.zh: 据英国政府科学办公室最近的一项研究，目前世界115亿公顷耕地中已有24%经历了人为造成的土壤退化，尤其是通过侵蚀。

sentences.en: B The global population is expected to exceed nine billion by 2050 — up a third from today’s level — and studies suggest that food production will have to go up by 70 per cent if we are to feed all of those new mouths.
sentences.zh: 预计到2050年全球人口将超过90亿——比今天的水平高出三分之一——研究表明，如果我们要养活所有这些新增的人口，食物产量将不得不提高70%。

sentences.en: This means that scientists will have to develop new ways of growing crops if we are to avoid a humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果我们要避免一场人道主义危机，科学家将不得不开发种植作物的新方法。

sentences.en: Indeed, UN Food and Agriculture Organization figures suggest that the number of under-nourished people is already growing, and with escalating climate change, crop yields in many areas have been projected to decline.
sentences.zh: 事实上，联合国粮农组织的数据表明，营养不良的人数已在增长，而随着气候变化加剧，许多地区的作物产量已被预测会下降。

sentences.en: C With this in mind, some scientists and agricultural experts are advocating an innovative alternative to traditional farming whereby skyscrapers packed with shelf-based systems for growing vegetables on each storey — known as ‘vertical farms’ — could hold the key to revolutionising agriculture.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，一些科学家和农业专家正在倡导一种取代传统农业的创新替代方案，其中挤满了每层用搁架系统种菜的摩天大楼——被称为“垂直农场”——可能是革新农业的关键。

sentences.en: Columbia University professor Dickson Despommier claims that vertical farming could boost crop yields many times over.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚大学教授Dickson Despommier声称，垂直农业能把作物产量提高许多倍。

sentences.en: A single 20-storey vertical farm could theoretically feed 50,000 people.
sentences.zh: 单单一座20层的垂直农场理论上就能养活50000人。

sentences.en: And if the theory translates into reality as proposed, 160 skyscraper-sized vertical farms could feed the entire population of New York City, while 180 would be needed for London, 289 for Cairo and 302 for Kolkata.
sentences.zh: 而如果这个理论像所提议的那样变成现实，160座摩天大楼大小的垂直农场就能养活纽约市的全部人口，而伦敦需要180座、开罗需要289座、加尔各答需要302座。

sentences.en: D It’s a compelling vision, and one that has already been put into practice in Asia — albeit on a smaller scale.
sentences.zh: 这是个引人入胜的愿景，也是一个已经在亚洲付诸实践的愿景——尽管规模较小。

sentences.en: ‘But there are problems, such as initial investment and operating costs that are too great,’ says a spokesman for Japan’s Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
sentences.zh: “但有一些问题，比如初始投资和运营成本过高，”日本农林水产省的一位发言人说。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Tokyo-based mushroom producer Hokuto Corporation is a model example of how a vertical farm can be profitable.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，总部位于东京的蘑菇生产商Hokuto公司是一个垂直农场如何能盈利的典范例子。

sentences.en: With 28 vertical mushroom farms operating across the country, it produces some 68,000 tonnes of mushrooms annually.
sentences.zh: 它在全国运营着28座垂直蘑菇农场，每年生产约68000吨蘑菇。

sentences.en: ‘Vertical mushroom farms have more advantages than ground-level farms,’ says Hokuto’s Ted Yamanoko, who highlights the relative cost-effectiveness of his organisation’s farming practices together with reduced emissions of greenhouse gases.
sentences.zh: “垂直蘑菇农场比地面农场有更多优势，”Hokuto的Ted Yamanoko说，他强调了他所在机构种植做法相对的成本效益以及温室气体排放的减少。

sentences.en: E And the impact of vertical farms could extend beyond feeding established urban populations.
sentences.zh: 而垂直农场的影响可能超出养活既有的城市人口。

sentences.en: Despommier sees them as being capable of helping centres of displaced persons — such as refugee camps — in much the same way that Mobile Army Surgical Hospital (MASH) units are deployed in emergencies.
sentences.zh: Despommier认为它们能够帮助流离失所者的安置点——比如难民营——其方式与流动陆军外科医院（MASH）单位在紧急情况下部署的方式大体相同。

sentences.en: ‘Developing an emergency response system for crop production inside specially constructed modular and highly transportable greenhouses would allow for humanitarian interventions,’ he says.
sentences.zh: “为在专门建造的、模块化且高度可运输的温室内进行作物生产开发一套应急响应系统，将允许进行人道主义干预，”他说。

sentences.en: ‘If you have three or four storeys of food already growing someplace, they could become mobile units that could be picked up by helicopters and dropped into the middle of a crisis zone.’
sentences.zh: “如果你已经有三四层的食物在某处生长，它们就能成为可由直升机吊起、投放到危机区中心的移动单元。”

sentences.en: F But it isn’t only about increasing food production.
sentences.zh: 但这不只是关于增加食物产量。

sentences.en: Despommier is concerned about the harm that farming has done to the world’s landscape over a relatively short time span, particularly the elimination of hardwood forests.
sentences.zh: Despommier担心农业在相对短的时间跨度内对世界地貌造成的危害，尤其是硬木森林的消失。

sentences.en: ‘Farming is only 12,000 years old,’ he points out.
sentences.zh: “农业只有12000年历史，”他指出。

sentences.en: ‘Vertical farming could allow us for the first time to feed everyone on Earth and still return land to its original ecological function.’
sentences.zh: “垂直农业可能让我们第一次既能养活地球上的每一个人、又能把土地归还给它原本的生态功能。”

sentences.en: Natalie Jeremijenko of New York University agrees.
sentences.zh: 纽约大学的Natalie Jeremijenko表示同意。

sentences.en: Reducing the land needed for food production could enrich biodiversity, which in turn can raise the productivity of conventional farms.
sentences.zh: 减少食物生产所需的土地能丰富生物多样性，而这反过来又能提高传统农场的生产力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, vertical farming could dramatically cut fossil-fuel use and reduce geopolitical tensions in regions where poor farming conditions drive conflict and malnutrition.
sentences.zh: 此外，垂直农业能大幅削减化石燃料的使用，并在那些恶劣农业条件引发冲突和营养不良的地区减少地缘政治紧张。

records.title: Who wrote Shakespeare's plays?
records.titleZh: 谁创作了莎士比亚的戏剧？

sentences.en: (A) Even today, almost 400 years after his death, the works of the famous English dramatist William Shakespeare have lost none of their appeal, nor have questions about the source of his genius.
sentences.zh: 即便在今天，在他去世近400年之后，英国著名剧作家威廉·莎士比亚的作品依然魅力不减，围绕其天才之源的种种疑问也丝毫未消。

sentences.en: For is it really credible that an ordinary actor from the small town of Stratford-upon-Avon should metamorphose into so extraordinary a dramatist?
sentences.zh: 一个来自埃文河畔斯特拉特福小镇的普通演员，竟能蜕变为如此非凡的剧作家，这真的可信吗？

sentences.en: For some, the answer is obvious: Shakespeare was a genius whose gift is no more suspicious than that of the physicist Albert Einstein, the German salesman's son who devised the theory of relativity.
sentences.zh: 在一些人看来，答案显而易见：莎士比亚就是个天才，他的天赋并不比物理学家阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦的更可疑；爱因斯坦是德国一名推销员之子，却创立了相对论。

sentences.en: But others have insisted that a mere school leaver simply could not have penned such sophisticated works.
sentences.zh: 但另一些人坚持认为，一个仅有中学学历的人根本不可能写出如此精深的作品。

sentences.en: They believe that Shakespeare was a pseudonym for someone with far more impressive qualifications who wrote the plays that still play to packed theatres today.
sentences.zh: 他们相信，“莎士比亚”只是一个笔名，真正写出这些至今仍令剧院座无虚席的剧作的，是另一位资历远为显赫的人。

sentences.en: But after long and largely fruitless debate, researchers are now turning to scientific methods to resolve the controversies surrounding Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 但经过长期且大多徒劳无功的争论之后，研究者如今转向科学方法，以求化解围绕莎士比亚的种种争议。

sentences.en: Ways of identifying the literary ‘fingerprint’ of writers are currently being developed using computers.
sentences.zh: 借助计算机，识别作家文学“指纹”的方法正在开发之中。

sentences.en: This analysis of features of literary style is known as 'stylometry' and with it researchers can recognise the work of Shakespeare and his contemporaries with impressive reliability.
sentences.zh: 这种对文学风格特征的分析被称为“文体计量学”，凭借它，研究者能以惊人的可靠度辨认出莎士比亚及其同时代人的作品。

sentences.en: (B) The idea of using these basic scientific techniques to probe questions of authorship dates back to 1851, when the Victorian mathematician Augustus de Morgan suggested that different authors might be identified through the frequency with which they used words of different lengths.
sentences.zh: 用这些基本科学手段探究作者归属问题的设想，可追溯到1851年——当时维多利亚时代的数学家奥古斯都·德·摩根提出，或许可以通过不同作者使用不同长度词语的频率来加以辨别。

sentences.en: His idea attracted the attention of Thomas Mendenhall, an American physicist who decided to use word length to investigate one of the oldest controversies about the works of Shakespeare: were they actually written by someone else?
sentences.zh: 他的设想引起了美国物理学家托马斯·门登霍尔的注意，后者决定用词语长度来研究有关莎士比亚作品最古老的争议之一：它们究竟是不是出自他人之手？

sentences.en: (C) As long ago as 1785, the Elizabethan writer and philosopher Sir Francis Bacon was identified as a possible contender for having written Shakespeare's works.
sentences.zh: 早在1785年，伊丽莎白时代的作家兼哲学家弗朗西斯·培根爵士便被指认为撰写莎士比亚作品的可能人选之一。

sentences.en: Bacon's possible motivation for not wanting to be known as the author of such masterpieces is far from clear, but Mendenhall believed his methods might at least reveal telltale signs of Bacon's hand in the plays.
sentences.zh: 培根为何不愿被人知晓是这些杰作的作者，其动机远未明朗，但门登霍尔相信，自己的方法至少能揭示出剧作中培根手笔的蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: However, his results, published in 1901, revealed Bacon's writing style to be quite unlike that of Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 然而，他于1901年发表的结果显示，培根的写作风格与莎士比亚大不相同。

sentences.en: But Mendenhall's methods also revealed some key concerns.
sentences.zh: 但门登霍尔的方法也暴露出一些关键问题。

sentences.en: Recognising the need to include large samples of writing from both authors, Mendenhall lumped all their works together, despite the fact that literary style can vary enormously between plays, poetry and philosophy, for example.
sentences.zh: 门登霍尔意识到必须纳入两位作者大量的文字样本，便将他们的全部作品笼统地合在一起，尽管文学风格在戏剧、诗歌与哲学等不同体裁之间可能差异极大。

sentences.en: His focus on word length as the sole ‘fingerprint’ of writing style was also questionable - for how could he be sure that some other characteristics would not give different results?
sentences.zh: 他仅以词语长度作为写作风格唯一的“指纹”，这一点也值得商榷——他又如何能确定其他某些特征不会得出不同的结果呢？

sentences.en: But Mendenhall’s biggest fault was perhaps simply that he was too far ahead of his time - he was attempting a task that cried out for the kind of computers not even conceivable over 100 years ago.
sentences.zh: 但门登霍尔最大的失误，也许只是他太过超前于时代——他所尝试的工作亟需那种在100多年前甚至无从想象的计算机。

sentences.en: More recently with their development scholars have been able to look for subtle peculiarities among the complete works of authors, which, in Shakespeare's case, amount to over 800,000 words.
sentences.zh: 晚近随着计算机的发展，学者得以在作者的全集中寻找细微的特异之处；就莎士比亚而言，其全集多达逾80万词。

sentences.en: (D) One of the key controversies now being probed is Shakespeare's relationship with other dramatists.
sentences.zh: 如今正被探究的关键争议之一，是莎士比亚与其他剧作家的关系。

sentences.en: Was he a lone genius or was his work the result of collaboration?
sentences.zh: 他是一位孤独的天才，还是其作品乃合作的产物？

sentences.en: Traditional methods of investigating such questions have relied on traits like the use of metaphor, but these may be shared by different authors simply on cultural grounds.
sentences.zh: 研究此类问题的传统方法依赖于诸如比喻运用之类的特征，但仅出于文化方面的缘由，不同作者也可能共有这些特征。

sentences.en: In contrast, modern stylometry focuses on far more fundamental characteristics which are less likely to be shared by others.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，现代文体计量学关注的是更为根本、且不太可能为他人所共有的特征。

sentences.en: The text-crunching power of computers allows researchers to pinpoint phrases, words or even individual letters by their frequency in the work of different authors.
sentences.zh: 计算机强大的文本处理能力，使研究者能够依据短语、单词乃至单个字母在不同作者作品中出现的频率，将其精确定位。

sentences.en: Pattern recognition techniques are then used to develop a ‘fingerprint’ for each author.
sentences.zh: 随后再运用模式识别技术，为每位作者建立一个“指纹”。

sentences.en: (E) Stylometry has come up with little to encourage the continual number of experts who insist Shakespeare was simply too uneducated to create works of enduring brilliance.
sentences.zh: 一直有为数不少的专家坚称莎士比亚学识太浅，根本写不出经久不衰的辉煌之作，但文体计量学几乎没有为他们提供什么佐证。

sentences.en: In 1996, literary scholar Ward Elliott and mathematician Robert Valenza of Claremont McKenna College, California, published the results of a stylometric comparison of the works of Shakespeare with those of over 30 of the proposed 'real' authors.
sentences.zh: 1996年，加利福尼亚州克莱蒙特·麦肯纳学院的文学学者沃德·埃利奥特与数学家罗伯特·瓦伦扎发表了一项研究结果：他们用文体计量学方法，将莎士比亚的作品与30多位被提名的“真正”作者的作品进行了比较。

sentences.en: Elliott and Valenza applied a battery of 51 tests to computerised texts and found that none of the claimants had a stylometric ‘fingerprint’ similar to that of Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 埃利奥特与瓦伦扎对电子化文本施加了一整套共51项测试，发现没有一位声称者的文体计量学“指纹”与莎士比亚相似。

sentences.en: “I think these claims were driven initially by a sense that Shakespeare is too ‘important’ to be an ordinary person,” says Professor Kate McCluskey, director of the Shakespeare Institute at the University of Birmingham.
sentences.zh: “我认为，这些说法最初源于一种感觉：莎士比亚太‘重要’了，不可能只是个普通人。”伯明翰大学莎士比亚研究所所长凯特·麦克拉斯基教授如是说。

sentences.en: (F) Elliott and Valenza's research found something else too.
sentences.zh: 埃利奥特与瓦伦扎的研究还有另一项发现。

sentences.en: Some of the earliest plays, notably Henry VI and the notoriously violent Titus Andronicus, seem to be a combination of Shakespeare and his brilliant contemporary the playwright Christopher Marlowe, who was born in the same year as Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 一些最早期的剧作，尤其是《亨利六世》和以暴力著称的《泰特斯·安德洛尼克斯》，似乎是莎士比亚与其才华横溢的同代人、剧作家克里斯托弗·马洛共同创作的产物；马洛与莎士比亚生于同一年。

sentences.en: 'Traditional scholars accept that Marlowe influenced Shakespeare's early work,' says Dr Thomas Merriam, one of Britain's leading stylometry experts.
sentences.zh: “传统学者承认马洛影响了莎士比亚的早期作品，”英国顶尖文体计量学专家之一托马斯·梅里亚姆博士说道。

sentences.en: He explains that, provisionally at least, stylometric studies suggest some of Marlowe's actual text exists within the early plays of Shakespeare.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，至少就初步而言，文体计量学研究表明，莎士比亚早期剧作中存在着马洛的某些实际文字。

sentences.en: (G) Some scholars remain cautious about basing new views of Shakespeare’s career on stylometric analysis of centuries-old texts.
sentences.zh: 一些学者对于仅凭对数百年前文本的文体计量学分析，便对莎士比亚的创作生涯提出新看法，仍持谨慎态度。

sentences.en: “If they have been edited, amended or shortened, then the data from them is highly compromised,” says Dr Markus Dahl of London University.
sentences.zh: “如果这些文本曾被编辑、修改或删节，那么从中得出的数据就会大打折扣。”伦敦大学的马库斯·达尔博士说。

sentences.en: Even so, the results to date are in line with the growing view of Shakespeare as a hardworking professional who perfected his skills throughout his career.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，迄今为止的结果与一种日益流行的看法相吻合：莎士比亚是一位勤奋的专业人士，在整个生涯中不断臻于完善其技艺。

sentences.en: (A) The law influences all of us virtually all the time.
sentences.zh: 法律几乎无时无刻不在影响着我们所有人。

sentences.en: It governs almost all aspects of our behaviour, and even what happens to us when we are no longer alive.
sentences.zh: 它管辖着我们行为的几乎所有方面，甚至包括我们不再活着之后发生在我们身上的事。

sentences.en: It affects us from the embryo onwards.
sentences.zh: 它从胚胎阶段起就影响我们。

sentences.en: It governs the air we breathe, the food and drink we consume, our travel, family relationships, and our property.
sentences.zh: 它管辖着我们呼吸的空气、我们吃喝的食物和饮料、我们的出行、家庭关系和我们的财产。

sentences.en: It applies at the bottom of the ocean and in space.
sentences.zh: 它适用于海洋的底部和太空之中。

sentences.en: Each time we examine a label on a food product, engage in work as an employee or employer, travel on the roads, go to school to learn or to teach, stay in a hotel, borrow a library book, create or dissolve a commercial company, play sports, or engage the services of someone for anything from plumbing a sink to planning a city, we are in the world of law.
sentences.zh: 每当我们查看食品上的标签、作为雇员或雇主工作、在路上出行、去学校学习或教书、住酒店、借图书馆的书、创立或解散一家商业公司、从事运动，或者请人做从给水槽接水管到规划一座城市的任何事时，我们都身处法律的世界。

sentences.en: (B) Law has also become much more widely recognised as the standard by which behaviour needs to be judged.
sentences.zh: 法律也已被远为广泛地公认为衡量行为需要据以评判的标准。

sentences.en: A very telling development in recent history is the way in which the idea of law has permeated all parts of social life.
sentences.zh: 近代史上一个很能说明问题的发展，是法律的观念渗透进社会生活所有部分的方式。

sentences.en: The universal standard of whether something is socially tolerated is progressively becoming whether it is legal, rather than something that has always been considered acceptable.
sentences.zh: 某件事是否被社会容忍，其普遍标准正逐渐变成它是否合法，而非某件一向被认为可接受的事。

sentences.en: In earlier times, most people were illiterate.
sentences.zh: 在更早的时代，大多数人不识字。

sentences.en: Today, by contrast, a vast number of people can read, and it is becoming easier for people to take an interest in law, and for the general population to help actually shape the law in many countries.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，今天大量的人能读书识字，人们对法律产生兴趣、以及在许多国家普通民众帮助实际塑造法律，都变得更容易了。

sentences.en: However, law is a versatile instrument that can be used equally well for the improvement or the degradation of humanity.
sentences.zh: 然而，法律是一种用途广泛的工具，既能很好地用于人类的改善，也能同样很好地用于人类的退化。

sentences.en: (C) This, of course, puts law in a very significant position.
sentences.zh: 这当然把法律置于一个非常重要的位置。

sentences.en: In our rapidly developing world, all sorts of skills and knowledge are valuable.
sentences.zh: 在我们这个迅速发展的世界里，各种各样的技能和知识都很有价值。

sentences.en: Those people, for example, with knowledge of computers, the internet, and communications technology are relied upon by the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 比如，那些懂电脑、互联网和通信技术的人就被我们其余的人所倚赖。

sentences.en: There is now someone with IT skills or an IT help desk in every UK school, every company, every hospital, every local and central government office.
sentences.zh: 如今在每一所英国学校、每一家公司、每一家医院、每一个地方和中央政府办公室里，都有一个有IT技能的人或一个IT帮助台。

sentences.en: Without their knowledge, many parts of commercial and social life today would seize up in minutes.
sentences.zh: 没有他们的知识，今天商业和社会生活的许多部分几分钟内就会停摆。

sentences.en: But legal understanding is just as vital and as universally needed.
sentences.zh: 但法律方面的理解同样至关重要、同样被普遍需要。

sentences.en: The American comedian Jerry Seinfeld put it like this, ‘We are all throwing the dice, playing the game, moving our pieces around the board, but if there is a problem, the lawyer is the only person who has read the inside of the top of the box.’
sentences.zh: 美国喜剧演员Jerry Seinfeld是这样说的，“我们都在掷骰子、玩游戏、在棋盘上移动我们的棋子，但如果出了问题，律师是唯一读过盒盖内侧的人。”

sentences.en: In other words, the lawyer is the only person who has read and made sense of the rules.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，律师是唯一读过规则并弄懂它们的人。

sentences.en: (D) The number of laws has never been greater.
sentences.zh: 法律的数量从未如此之多。

sentences.en: In the UK alone, about 35 new Acts of Parliament are produced every year, thereby delivering thousands of new rules.
sentences.zh: 仅在英国，每年就产生约35部新的议会法案，从而带来数千条新规则。

sentences.en: The legislative output of the British Parliament has more than doubled in recent times from 1,100 pages a year in the early 1970s, to over 2,500 pages a year today.
sentences.zh: 英国议会的立法产出近来已增加一倍多，从20世纪70年代初每年1100页，到如今每年超过2500页。

sentences.en: Between 1997 and 2006, the legislature passed 365 Acts of Parliament and more than 32,000 legally binding statutory instruments.
sentences.zh: 在1997到2006年间，立法机关通过了365部议会法案和超过32000份具有法律约束力的成文法规。

sentences.en: In a system with so much law, lawyers do a great deal not just to vindicate the rights of citizens and organisations but also to help develop the law through legal arguments, some of which are adapted by judges to become laws.
sentences.zh: 在一个有这么多法律的体系里，律师做的事情很多，不仅维护公民和组织的权利，还通过法律论证帮助发展法律，其中一些被法官采纳而成为法律。

sentences.en: Law courts can and do produce new law and revise old law, but they do so having heard the arguments of lawyers.
sentences.zh: 法院能够而且确实会产生新法律、修订旧法律，但它们这么做是在听取了律师的论证之后。

sentences.en: (E) However, despite their important role in developing the rules, lawyers are not universally admired.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管律师在发展规则方面扮演着重要角色，他们并不普遍受人钦佩。

sentences.en: Anti-lawyer jokes have a long history going back to the ancient Greeks.
sentences.zh: 反律师的笑话有着可追溯到古希腊人的悠久历史。

sentences.en: More recently, the son of a famous Hollywood actor was asked at his junior school what his father did for a living, to which he replied, ‘My daddy is a movie actor, and sometimes he plays the good guy, and sometimes, he plays the lawyer.’
sentences.zh: 更近的例子是，一位著名好莱坞演员的儿子在小学里被问到他父亲以什么为生，他回答说，“我爸爸是电影演员，有时他演好人，有时，他演律师。”

sentences.en: For balance, though, it is worth remembering that there are and have been many heroic and revered lawyers such as the Roman philosopher and politician Cicero, and Mahatma Gandhi, the Indian campaigner for Independence.
sentences.zh: 不过，为求平衡，值得记住的是，曾经有过、现在也有许多英勇而受人敬重的律师，比如罗马哲学家兼政治家西塞罗，以及印度独立运动的倡导者圣雄甘地。

sentences.en: (F) People sometimes make comments that characterise lawyers as professionals whose concerns put personal reward above truth, or who gain financially from misfortune.
sentences.zh: 人们有时会发表一些评论，把律师描绘成那种把个人回报置于真相之上、或从不幸中获取经济利益的专业人士。

sentences.en: There are undoubtedly lawyers that would fit that bill, just as there are some scientists, journalists and others in that category.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，确实有符合那种描述的律师，就像那一类人中也有一些科学家、记者和其他人一样。

sentences.en: But, in general, it is no more just to say that lawyers are bad because they make a living from people’s problems than it is to make the same accusation in respect of nurses or IT consultants.
sentences.zh: 但总体上，说律师因为靠人们的问题谋生就是坏人，并不比对护士或IT顾问提出同样的指控更公正。

sentences.en: A great many lawyers are involved in public law work, such as that involving civil liberties, housing and other issues.
sentences.zh: 大量律师从事公法工作，比如涉及公民自由、住房和其他问题的工作。

sentences.en: Such work is not lavishly remunerated and the quality of the service provided by these lawyers relies on considerable professional dedication.
sentences.zh: 这类工作报酬并不优厚，这些律师所提供服务的质量依赖于相当大的职业奉献精神。

sentences.en: Moreover, much legal work has nothing to do with conflict or misfortune, but is primarily concerned with drafting documents.
sentences.zh: 而且，许多法律工作与冲突或不幸毫无关系，而主要是关于起草文件。

sentences.en: Another source of social disaffection for lawyers, and disaffection for the law, is a limited public understanding of how law works and how it could be changed.
sentences.zh: 律师招致社会不满、以及人们对法律不满的另一个根源，是公众对法律如何运作、以及它如何能被改变的理解有限。

sentences.en: Greater clarity about these issues, maybe as a result of better public relations, would reduce many aspects of public dissatisfaction with the law.
sentences.zh: 对这些问题有更大的清晰认识，也许通过更好的公共关系来实现，会减少公众对法律不满的许多方面。

records.title: New filter promises clean water for millions
records.titleZh: 新型过滤器有望为数百万民众提供清洁水源

sentences.en: (A) A handful of clay, yesterday’s coffee grounds and some cow manure are the ingredients that could bring clean, safe drinking water to many developing countries.
sentences.zh: 一把黏土、昨天的咖啡渣和一些牛粪，是可能为许多发展中国家带来清洁、安全饮用水的原料。

sentences.en: The simple new technology, developed by Australian National University (ANU) materials scientist and potter Tony Flynn, allows water filters to be made from commonly available materials and fired (or baked) using cow manure as the source of heat, without the need for a kiln (an oven for baking or drying pottery).
sentences.zh: 这项简单的新技术，由澳大利亚国立大学（ANU）材料科学家兼陶艺家Tony Flynn开发，可以用常见的可得材料制作滤水器，并用牛粪作热源烧制（或烘烤），无需窑炉（一种用于烘烤或干燥陶器的炉子）。

sentences.en: The filters have been tested and shown to remove common pathogens (disease-producing organisms) including E.
sentences.zh: 这些过滤器已经过测试，证明能去除常见病原体（致病生物），包括E.

sentences.en: coli.
sentences.zh: coli。

sentences.en: (B) The invention was born out of a project involving the Manatuto community in East Timor.
sentences.zh: 这项发明诞生于一个涉及东帝汶Manatuto社区的项目。

sentences.en: A charity operating there wanted to help set up a small industrial site manufacturing water filters, but initial research found the local clay to be too fine — a problem solved by the addition of organic material.
sentences.zh: 一家在那里运营的慈善机构想帮忙建立一个小型工业点来制造滤水器，但初步研究发现当地的黏土太细——这个问题通过添加有机材料得到解决。

sentences.en: While the problems of producing a working ceramic filter in East Timor were overcome, the solution was kiln-based and particular to that community’s materials and couldn’t be applied elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 虽然在东帝汶生产一个能用的陶瓷过滤器的难题被克服了，但解决方案是基于窑炉的、针对那个社区的材料，没法用到别处。

sentences.en: Flynn’s technique for manure firing, with no requirement for a kiln, has made this zero-technology approach available anywhere it is needed.
sentences.zh: Flynn用牛粪烧制、无需窑炉的技术，让这种零技术的方法在任何需要的地方都能用上。

sentences.en: (C) Other commercial clay filters do exist, but, even if available, with prices starting at US$5 each, they are often outside the budgets of most people in the developing world.
sentences.zh: 其他商用黏土过滤器确实存在，但即便买得到，价格每个起步就5美元，往往超出发展中世界大多数人的预算。

sentences.en: Unlike other water filtering devices, Flynn’s filters are inexpensive and simple to produce.
sentences.zh: 与其他滤水装置不同，Flynn的过滤器既便宜又简单易制。

sentences.en: Take a handful of clay, mix it with a handful of organic material such as used tea leaves, coffee grounds or rice hulls, add water in a sufficient quantity to make a stiff mixture and form a cylindrical pot that has one end closed, then dry it in the sun.
sentences.zh: 取一把黏土，和一把有机材料如用过的茶叶、咖啡渣或稻壳混合，加入足量的水做成黏稠的混合物，做成一端封闭的圆柱形罐子，然后在太阳下晒干。

sentences.en: According to Flynn, used coffee grounds have given the best results to date.
sentences.zh: 据Flynn说，用过的咖啡渣迄今给出了最好的效果。

sentences.en: The walls of the filter can be measured using the width of an adult finger as the standard.
sentences.zh: 过滤器的壁可以用一个成年人手指的宽度作标准来量。

sentences.en: Next, surround the pots with straw, put them in a mound of cow manure, light the straw and then top up the burning manure as required.
sentences.zh: 接下来，用稻草把这些罐子围起来，放进一堆牛粪里，点燃稻草，然后按需添加正在燃烧的牛粪。

sentences.en: The filters are finished in 45 to 60 minutes.
sentences.zh: 过滤器在45到60分钟内就做好了。

sentences.en: (D) The properties of cow manure are vital, as the fuel can reach a temperature of 700 degrees in half an hour, and will be up to 950 degrees after another 20 to 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 牛粪的特性至关重要，因为这种燃料能在半小时内达到700度，再过20到30分钟会高达950度。

sentences.en: The manure makes a good fuel because it is very high in organic material that burns readily and quickly.
sentences.zh: 牛粪是很好的燃料，因为它有机材料含量极高，容易且迅速燃烧。

sentences.en: The manure has to be dry and is best used exactly as found in the field; there is no need to break it up or process it any further.
sentences.zh: 牛粪必须是干的，最好就用田里捡到的原样使用；没必要把它弄碎或进一步加工。

sentences.en: In contrast, a potter’s kiln is an expensive item and can take up to four or five hours to get up to 800 degrees.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，陶工的窑炉是个昂贵的东西，要达到800度可能要花四五个小时。

sentences.en: It needs expensive, scarce fuel, such as gas or wood to heat it, and experience to use it.
sentences.zh: 它需要昂贵、稀缺的燃料，比如燃气或木柴来加热，还需要经验才能使用。

sentences.en: With no technology, no insulation and nothing other than a pile of cow manure and a match, none of these requirements apply.
sentences.zh: 没有技术、没有保温、除了一堆牛粪和一根火柴别无他物，这些要求一概不适用。

sentences.en: (E) It is also helpful that, like clay and organic material, cow manure is freely available across the developing world.
sentences.zh: 同样有帮助的是，和黏土及有机材料一样，牛粪在整个发展中世界都能免费获得。

sentences.en: A cow is a natural fuel factory.
sentences.zh: 一头牛就是一座天然的燃料工厂。

sentences.en: Manure is a mixture of vegetable materials of different sizes, and cow manure as a fuel is the same wherever it is found.
sentences.zh: 牛粪是不同大小的植物材料的混合物，作为燃料的牛粪无论在哪里找到都是一样的。

sentences.en: (F) Just as using manure as a fuel for domestic use is not a new idea, the fact that liquid can pass through clay objects is something that potters have always known, and clay’s porous nature is something that, as a former ceramics lecturer in the ANU School of Art, Flynn is well aware of.
sentences.zh: 正如把牛粪用作家用燃料不是什么新主意，液体能透过黏土物体这一事实也是陶工们一向知道的，而黏土的多孔性质，作为ANU艺术学院前陶瓷讲师的Flynn十分清楚。

sentences.en: The difference is that, rather than viewing the porous nature of the material as a problem — after all, not many people want a pot that won’t hold water — his filters capitalize on this property.
sentences.zh: 区别在于，他的过滤器不是把材料的多孔性质视为问题——毕竟，没多少人想要一个盛不住水的罐子——而是利用了这个特性。

sentences.en: (G) The filtration process is simple, but effective.
sentences.zh: 过滤过程很简单，却很有效。

sentences.en: The basic principle is that there are passages through the filter that are wide enough for water droplets to pass through, but too narrow for pathogens.
sentences.zh: 基本原理是，过滤器里有一些通道，宽到足以让水滴通过，却窄到病原体无法通过。

sentences.en: Tests with the deadly E.
sentences.zh: 用致命的E.

sentences.en: coli bacterium have seen the filters remove 96.4 to 99.8 per cent of the pathogen — well within safe levels.
sentences.zh: coli细菌做的测试显示，过滤器去除了96.4到99.8%的病原体——远在安全水平之内。

sentences.en: The thickness of the clay container needs to be the same thickness as an adult finger for the process to be effective.
sentences.zh: 要让这个过程有效，黏土容器的厚度需要和一个成年人手指一样厚。

sentences.en: If this is the case, using only one filter, a liter of water can be obtained in two hours.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，只用一个过滤器，两小时内就能得到一升水。

sentences.en: (H) The use of organic material, which burns away leaving cavities after firing, helps produce the structure in which pathogens will become trapped.
sentences.zh: 使用有机材料，它在烧制后会烧尽、留下空腔，有助于形成病原体会被困住的那种结构。

sentences.en: It overcomes the potential problems of finer clays that may not let water through and also means that cracks are soon halted.
sentences.zh: 它克服了较细黏土可能不透水的潜在问题，也意味着裂缝很快就会被止住。

sentences.en: And like clay and cow manure, organic material is universally available in the developing communities that need the most assistance, as tea, coffee and rice are grown in these areas.
sentences.zh: 而且和黏土、牛粪一样，有机材料在最需要援助的发展中社区里普遍可得，因为茶、咖啡和稻米就种在这些地区。

sentences.en: (I) With all the components being widely available, Flynn says there is no reason the technology couldn’t be applied throughout the developing world.
sentences.zh: 由于所有组成部分都广泛可得，Flynn说，没有理由这项技术不能在整个发展中世界推广。

sentences.en: He has no plans to exploit his idea financially by registering ownership through a patent.
sentences.zh: 他没有计划通过申请专利登记所有权来在经济上利用他的主意。

sentences.en: If he did, any commercial copying would legally entitle him to a share in any profits made.
sentences.zh: 如果他那么做，任何商业仿制在法律上都会让他有权分享所赚的任何利润。

sentences.en: Without a patent, there will be no illegality in it being adopted in any community that needs it.
sentences.zh: 没有专利，它被任何需要它的社区采用都不会有违法之处。

sentences.en: “Everyone has a right to clean water, and these filters have the potential to enable anyone in the world to drink water safely,” says Flynn.
sentences.zh: “人人都有获得清洁水的权利，而这些过滤器有潜力让世界上任何人都能安全地喝水，”Flynn说。

sentences.en: (A) Dr William Masters was reading a book about mosquitoes when an idea struck him.
sentences.zh: 威廉·马斯特斯（William Masters）博士在读一本关于蚊子的书时，脑中忽然闪过一个念头。

sentences.en: ‘There was this anecdote about the yellow fever epidemic that hit Philadelphia in 1793,’ Masters recalls.
sentences.zh: “书里讲了一则轶事，说的是1793年袭击费城的黄热病疫情，”马斯特斯回忆道。

sentences.en: ‘This epidemic decimated the city until the first frost came.’
sentences.zh: “这场疫情重创了这座城市，直到第一场霜降来临。”

sentences.en: The sub-zero temperatures froze out the insects, allowing Philadelphia to recover.
sentences.zh: 零下的气温冻死了蚊虫，使费城得以恢复。

sentences.en: If weather could be the key to a city’s fortunes, Masters thought, then why not to the historical fortunes of nations?
sentences.zh: 马斯特斯心想，如果天气能成为一座城市命运的关键，那为什么不能成为一个个国家历史命运的关键呢？

sentences.en: And could frost lie at the heart of one of the most enduring economic mysteries of all – why are almost all the wealthy, industrialised nations to be found where the climate is cooler?
sentences.zh: 霜冻会不会正是一个最为长久的经济谜题的核心所在——为什么几乎所有富裕的工业化国家都位于气候较为凉爽的地方？

sentences.en: (B) After two years of research, he thinks that he has found a piece of the puzzle.
sentences.zh: 经过两年的研究，他认为自己已经找到了这道谜题的一块拼图。

sentences.en: Masters, an agricultural economist from Purdue University in Indiana, and Margaret McMillan at Tufts University, Boston, show that annual frosts are among the factors that distinguish rich nations from poor ones.
sentences.zh: 马斯特斯是印第安纳州普渡大学的农业经济学家，他与波士顿塔夫茨大学的玛格丽特·麦克米伦（Margaret McMillan）的研究表明，每年的霜冻是区分富国与穷国的因素之一。

sentences.en: Their study is published this month in the Journal of Economic Growth.
sentences.zh: 他们的研究本月发表于《Journal of Economic Growth》。

sentences.en: The pair speculate that cold snaps have two main benefits – they freeze pests that would otherwise destroy crops, and also freeze organisms, such as those carried by mosquitoes, that carry disease.
sentences.zh: 两人推测，寒潮主要有两大好处——它们冻死了本会毁坏庄稼的害虫，也冻死了携带疾病的生物，比如由蚊子携带的那些。

sentences.en: The result is agricultural abundance and a big workforce.
sentences.zh: 其结果便是农业富足和庞大的劳动力。

sentences.en: (C) The academics took two sets of information.
sentences.zh: 这两位学者采用了两组数据。

sentences.en: The first was average income for countries, the second was climate data provided by the University of East Anglia.
sentences.zh: 第一组是各国的平均收入，第二组是由东英吉利大学提供的气候数据。

sentences.en: They found a curious tally between the sets.
sentences.zh: 他们发现两组数据之间存在一种奇特的吻合。

sentences.en: Countries having five or more frosty days in the winter months are uniformly rich; those with fewer than five are impoverished.
sentences.zh: 冬季月份有五天或更多霜冻日的国家无一例外都很富裕；而霜冻日少于五天的国家则十分贫困。

sentences.en: The authors speculate that the five-day figure is important: it could be the minimum time needed to kill pests in the soil.
sentences.zh: 作者推测，五天这一数字很重要：它可能是冻死土壤中害虫所需的最短时间。

sentences.en: To illustrate this, Masters notes: ‘Finland is a small country that is growing quickly, but Bolivia is a small country that isn’t growing at all.
sentences.zh: 为说明这一点，马斯特斯指出：“芬兰是一个发展迅速的小国，而玻利维亚同样是个小国，却几乎毫无增长。

sentences.en: Perhaps climate has something to do with that.’
sentences.zh: 也许这与气候不无关系。”

sentences.en: (D) Other minds have applied themselves to the split between poor and rich nations, citing anthropological, climatic and zoological reasons for why temperate nations are the most affluent.
sentences.zh: 还有其他一些人也曾致力于研究贫国与富国之间的分化，从人类学、气候学和动物学等角度解释为何温带国家最为富庶。

sentences.en: Jared Diamond, from the University of California at Los Angeles, pointed out in his book Guns, Germs and Steel that Eurasia is broadly aligned east-west, while Africa and the Americas are aligned north-south.
sentences.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的贾雷德·戴蒙德（Jared Diamond）在其著作《枪炮、病菌与钢铁》中指出，欧亚大陆大体呈东西走向，而非洲和美洲则呈南北走向。

sentences.en: So in Europe crops could move quickly across latitudes because climates are similar.
sentences.zh: 因此在欧洲，由于各地气候相近，农作物能够迅速地跨纬度传播。

sentences.en: One of the first domesticated crops, einkorn wheat, extended quickly from the Middle East into Europe; it took twice as long for it to get from Mexico to what is now the eastern United States.
sentences.zh: 最早被驯化的农作物之一——一粒小麦——很快便从中东扩展到欧洲；而它从墨西哥传播到如今的美国东部，所花的时间却是前者的两倍。

sentences.en: This easy movement along similar latitudes in Eurasia would also have meant a faster dissemination of other technologies, such as the wheel and writing, Diamond speculates.
sentences.zh: 戴蒙德推测，在欧亚大陆沿相近纬度如此便利的传播，也意味着轮子和文字等其他技术得以更快地散播开来。

sentences.en: (E) There are exceptions to the ‘cold equals rich’ argument.
sentences.zh: “寒冷即富裕”这一论点也有例外。

sentences.en: There are well-heeled tropical countries such as Singapore, a result of its superior trading position.
sentences.zh: 也有像新加坡这样富裕的热带国家，这得益于其优越的贸易地位。

sentences.en: Likewise, not all European countries are moneyed.
sentences.zh: 同样，并非所有欧洲国家都很富有。

sentences.en: Masters stresses that climate will never be the overriding factor – the wealth of nations is too complicated to be attributable to just one factor.
sentences.zh: 马斯特斯强调，气候永远不会是决定性因素——一个国家的财富过于复杂，无法归因于单一因素。

sentences.en: Climate, he feels, somehow combines with other factors – such as the presence of institutions, including governments, and access to trading routes – to determine whether a country will do well.
sentences.zh: 他认为，气候会以某种方式与其他因素——例如制度（包括政府）的存在，以及对贸易路线的可及性——结合在一起，共同决定一个国家是否能够繁荣。

sentences.en: (F) In the past, Masters says, economists thought that institutions had the biggest effect on the economy, because they brought order to a country in the form of, for example, laws and property rights.
sentences.zh: 马斯特斯说，过去经济学家认为制度对经济的影响最大，因为制度以法律和产权等形式为一个国家带来了秩序。

sentences.en: With order, so the thinking went, came affluence.
sentences.zh: 按照这种思路，有了秩序，随之而来的便是富裕。

sentences.en: ‘But there are some problems that even countries with institutions have not been able to get around,’ he says.
sentences.zh: “但有些问题，即便是拥有完善制度的国家也未能绕过，”他说。

sentences.en: ‘My feeling is that, as countries get richer, they get better institutions.
sentences.zh: “我的感觉是，国家越富裕，制度就越完善。

sentences.en: And the accumulation of wealth and improvement in governing institutions are both helped by a favourable environment, including climate.’
sentences.zh: 而财富的积累和治理制度的改善，都得益于有利的环境，其中也包括气候。”

sentences.en: (G) This does not mean, he insists, that tropical countries are beyond economic help and destined to remain penniless.
sentences.zh: 他坚持认为，这并不意味着热带国家在经济上无可救药、注定将一贫如洗。

sentences.en: Instead of aid being geared towards improving administrative systems, it should be spent on technology to improve agriculture and to combat disease.
sentences.zh: 援助不应着力于改善行政体系，而应用于发展技术，以提升农业、防治疾病。

sentences.en: Masters cites one example: ‘There are regions in India that have been provided with irrigation – agricultural productivity has gone up and there has been an improvement in health.’
sentences.zh: 马斯特斯举了一个例子：“印度有些地区已经用上了灌溉——农业生产率提高了，健康状况也有所改善。”

sentences.en: Supplying vaccines against tropical diseases and developing crop varieties that can grow in the tropics would break the poverty cycle.
sentences.zh: 提供防治热带疾病的疫苗，并培育能在热带生长的作物品种，将能打破贫困的循环。

records.title: Growing more for less
records.titleZh: 以更少投入获得更多产出

sentences.en: A For farmers, working out the optimal amount of seed, fertiliser, pesticide and water to scatter on a field can make, or break, the subsequent harvest.
sentences.zh: 对农民来说，算出撒到一块田里的种子、化肥、农药和水的最佳用量，能成就、也能毁掉随后的收成。

sentences.en: Regular laboratory analyses of soil and plant samples from various parts of the field can help – but such expertise is costly, and often unavailable.
sentences.zh: 对来自田里不同部分的土壤和植物样本定期做实验室分析会有帮助——但这种专业服务成本高昂，而且往往得不到。

sentences.en: However, a new and cheaper method of doing this analysis is now on offer.
sentences.zh: 然而，现在有了一种新的、更便宜的做这种分析的方法。

sentences.en: Precise prescriptions for growing crops can be obtained quickly, and less expensively, by calculating the amount of electromagnetic radiation reflected from agricultural land.
sentences.zh: 通过计算从农田反射的电磁辐射量，可以又快又便宜地获得种植作物的精确处方。

sentences.en: The data is collected by orbiting satellites.
sentences.zh: 这些数据由环绕轨道的卫星收集。

sentences.en: B Examining the wavelength of the radiation that is reflected can reveal, with surprising precision, the properties of the soil, the quantity of crop being grown, and the levels in those crops of chlorophyll*, various minerals, moisture and other indicators of their quality.
sentences.zh: 检查被反射辐射的波长，能以惊人的精度揭示土壤的性质、所种作物的数量，以及这些作物中叶绿素*、各种矿物质、水分和其他品质指标的水平。

sentences.en: If recent and forecast weather data is added to the mix, detailed maps can be produced indicating exactly how, where and when crops should be grown.
sentences.zh: 如果把近期和预报的天气数据也加进来，就能生成详细的地图，准确指出作物应该如何、在哪里、何时种植。

sentences.en: The service usually costs less than US$15 per hectare for a handful of readings a year, and can increase yields by as much as 10%.
sentences.zh: 这项服务一年提供几次读数，通常每公顷成本不到15美元，并能使产量提高多达10%。

sentences.en: C Such precision farming using satellite-based intelligence is a relatively new technique.
sentences.zh: 这种利用卫星情报的精准农业是一种相对较新的技术。

sentences.en: Even so, it is catching on quickly.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，它正迅速流行起来。

sentences.en: Five times a year, for example, a French cereal-growers’ co-operative called Sevépi purchases satellite data and makes it available to its members in the form of maps of their fields, divided into three or four colour-coded zones per hectare.
sentences.zh: 比如，一个叫Sevépi的法国谷物种植者合作社一年五次购买卫星数据，并以其田地地图的形式提供给社员，地图按每公顷分成三到四个用颜色编码的区域。

sentences.en: For each zone, one of about 50 fertiliser formulas is recommended.
sentences.zh: 对于每个区域，会推荐约50种化肥配方中的一种。

sentences.en: On top of this, if the wheat in the field has already grown quite high early in the season, and heavy showers are expected, an appropriate dose of growth regulator is recommended for each zone.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，如果田里的小麦在生长季早期就长得相当高，而且预计会有大雨，就会为每个区域推荐一个适当剂量的生长调节剂。

sentences.en: (Long, fragile stems break more easily in downpours.)
sentences.zh: （又长又脆的茎在倾盆大雨中更容易折断。）

sentences.en: Then, farm vehicles equipped with global-positioning system locators automatically mix and apply the prescribed dose to each area.
sentences.zh: 然后，配有全球定位系统定位器的农用车辆会自动配制并把规定的剂量施用到每个区域。

sentences.en: D France is the pioneer in this sort of surveillance.
sentences.zh: 法国是这类监测的先驱。

sentences.en: More farmland is analysed by satellite there than in any other country, according to Infoterra (a subsidiary of EADS Astrium), the firm that is France’s largest provider of such information, supplying data to companies such as Sevépi.
sentences.zh: 据法国此类信息最大的提供商、向Sevépi等公司供应数据的Infoterra公司（EADS Astrium的子公司）说，那里用卫星分析的农田比任何其他国家都多。

sentences.en: Moreover, Henri Douche, head of Infoterra’s agriculture sales in Toulouse, reckons the amount of monitored farmland will increase as weather patterns change and farmers can no longer rely on the past as a guide to the future.
sentences.zh: 而且，Infoterra在图卢兹的农业销售主管Henri Douche估计，随着天气模式改变、农民不能再依靠过去作为对未来的指引，被监测的农田数量会增加。

sentences.en: When confounded by the yield variations that these new weather patterns will bring, even farmers who are afraid of new technology will sign up, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，当被这些新天气模式带来的产量波动搞糊涂时，即便是害怕新技术的农民也会签约。

sentences.en: E Inexpensive data on the productivity of land is advantageous to governments, too.
sentences.zh: 关于土地生产力的廉价数据对政府也有好处。

sentences.en: Areas where fertilisers and pesticides are being applied excessively can be pinpointed, studied and regulated by environmental and land-use agencies.
sentences.zh: 化肥和农药施用过度的地区可以被环境和土地利用机构精确指出、研究并加以监管。

sentences.en: Guy Lafond, an agronomist with Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, a government agency, says the satellite data it purchases is proving useful for the study of fields with declining productivity in the province of Saskatchewan.
sentences.zh: 加拿大农业及农业食品部（一个政府机构）的农艺师Guy Lafond说，它购买的卫星数据正被证明对研究萨斯喀彻温省生产力下降的田地很有用。

sentences.en: Overkill with nitrate fertilisers (which are also a source of greenhouse gases) appears partly responsible.
sentences.zh: 过度使用硝酸盐化肥（它也是温室气体的来源）似乎是部分原因。

sentences.en: And according to RapidEye, a German satellite operator, insurance companies are also studying satellite data with a view to selling insurance policies to governments of famine-prone countries that might be threatened by crop failure.
sentences.zh: 而据德国卫星运营商RapidEye说，保险公司也在研究卫星数据，意图向那些可能受作物歉收威胁的饥荒易发国家的政府出售保险。

sentences.en: F In March, RapidEye began selling data that helps forecast harvests.
sentences.zh: 三月，RapidEye开始出售有助于预测收成的数据。

sentences.en: ‘Too often, farmers limit productivity by managing fields uniformly,’ says Fredrick Jung-Rothenhaüsler, head of product development at the firm’s headquarters in Brandenburg an der Havel.
sentences.zh: “农民往往因为对田地一刀切地管理而限制了生产力，”该公司在哈弗尔河畔勃兰登堡总部的产品开发主管Fredrick Jung-Rothenhaüsler说。

sentences.en: ‘Our satellites are the first commercial satellites to include the Red-Edge band of the light spectrum, which is sensitive to changes in chlorophyll content.
sentences.zh: “我们的卫星是首批纳入光谱中红边波段的商用卫星，该波段对叶绿素含量的变化很敏感。

sentences.en: More research will be necessary to realise the full potential of the Red-Edge band.
sentences.zh: 要发挥红边波段的全部潜力，还需要更多研究。

sentences.en: However, this band can assist in monitoring vegetation health, improving species separation and also help in measuring protein and nitrogen content in biomass.’
sentences.zh: 不过，这个波段能帮助监测植被健康、改善物种区分，也有助于测量生物量中的蛋白质和氮含量。”

sentences.en: The company’s data, which comes from both Europe and the Americas, breaks field productivity down into patches just five metres square.
sentences.zh: 该公司的数据来自欧洲和美洲，把田地生产力细分到仅仅五米见方的小块。

sentences.en: G The advantages that satellite technology provides in terms of precision farming do not have to be restricted to rich countries.
sentences.zh: 卫星技术在精准农业方面提供的优势不必局限于富国。

sentences.en: In Africa, where many soils have become badly depleted of nutrients, better fertiliser management would greatly improve the situation.
sentences.zh: 在非洲，那里许多土壤养分已严重耗竭，更好的化肥管理会大大改善局面。

sentences.en: As a consequence, the charitable trust World Agroforestry Centre, in the city of Nairobi, in Kenya, has begun to build up a catalogue of the radiation patterns derived from around 100,000 samples of African soils.
sentences.zh: 因此，位于肯尼亚内罗毕市的慈善信托机构世界农林业中心已开始建立一个目录，收录从约100000份非洲土壤样本得出的辐射模式。

sentences.en: The information is the key to understanding the potential of these soils to be more agriculturally productive.
sentences.zh: 这些信息是理解这些土壤在农业上更高产之潜力的关键。

sentences.en: Once passed on to the International Centre for Tropical Agriculture, based in Colombia, South America, it is intended that the information be used to build a database called the ‘Digital Soil Map’.
sentences.zh: 一旦传给设在南美洲哥伦比亚的国际热带农业中心，人们打算用这些信息建立一个叫“数字土壤地图”的数据库。

sentences.en: When ready, this will provide farmers with free forecasts, developed with regularly updated satellite imagery, across farmland in a number of countries in Africa.
sentences.zh: 建成后，它将利用定期更新的卫星图像，为非洲若干国家农田上的农民提供免费的预测。

sentences.en: This is information which will almost certainly assist in improving crop yields.
sentences.zh: 这是几乎肯定会有助于提高作物产量的信息。

sentences.en: For a hunger-ravaged continent, that is good news indeed.
sentences.zh: 对一个饱受饥饿摧残的大陆来说，那确实是个好消息。

sentences.en: A The development of robots that interact socially with people and assist them in everyday life has been an elusive goal of modern science.
sentences.zh: 开发能与人进行社交互动、并在日常生活中为人提供帮助的机器人，一直是现代科学一个难以企及的目标。

sentences.en: Despite impressive advances in the mechanical aspects of this problem, producing robots that bond and socialize with people for sustained periods of time has proven difficult.
sentences.zh: 尽管在这个问题的机械方面取得了令人瞩目的进展，但要制造出能与人建立情感纽带、长时间相处的机器人，事实证明困难重重。

sentences.en: The most successful robots so far have been storytellers, but they have only been able to maintain human interest for a limited time and typically rely on the robot telling stories that change over time.
sentences.zh: 迄今最成功的机器人一直是讲故事的机器人，但它们只能在有限的时间内维持人的兴趣，而且通常依靠机器人讲述会随时间变化的故事。

sentences.en: In practice, commercially available robots seldom cross the 10-hour barrier (i.e., individual users tend to spend less than a combined total of 10 hours with the robots before losing interest).
sentences.zh: 在实践中，市售机器人很少能突破10小时的门槛（也就是说，单个用户在失去兴趣之前，与机器人相处的累计时间往往不到10小时）。

sentences.en: This observation is in sharp contrast to the long-term interactions and bonding that commonly develop between humans and their pets.
sentences.zh: 这一观察结果，与人和宠物之间通常会建立起来的长期互动和情感纽带形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: B In a recent study, researchers from the Institute for Neural Computation in California introduced a state-of-the-art social robot into a classroom of 18-to-24-month-olds for five months as a way of studying human/robot interactions.
sentences.zh: 在最近的一项研究中，加利福尼亚神经计算研究所的研究者把一台最先进的社交机器人引入一间18到24个月大幼儿的教室，为期五个月，以此来研究人机互动。

sentences.en: The researchers, including Fumihide Tanaka and Javier R.
sentences.zh: 包括田中文英和哈维尔·R·

sentences.en: Movellan, introduced a toddler-sized humanoid robot into a classroom at a childhood education center.
sentences.zh: 莫韦兰在内的研究者，把一台学步儿大小的人形机器人引入了一所幼儿教育中心的教室。

sentences.en: One of the QRIO series of robots, the 58 cm machine, was originally developed by Sony.
sentences.zh: 这台QRIO系列机器人中的一员，是一台58厘米高的机器，最初由索尼公司研发。

sentences.en: ‘Children of toddler age were chosen because they have no preconceived notions of robots,’ according to Tanaka.
sentences.zh: “之所以选择学步期的儿童，是因为他们对机器人没有先入为主的观念，”田中说。

sentences.en: One of the goals of the study was to establish whether it was possible for social robots to maintain the interest of children beyond the 10-hour barrier.
sentences.zh: 该研究的目标之一，是确定社交机器人能否把孩子们的兴趣维持在10小时门槛之外。

sentences.en: C The researchers sent instructions to the robot about every two minutes to do things like giggle, dance, sit down, fall down, or walk in a certain direction.
sentences.zh: 研究者大约每两分钟就向机器人发送一次指令，让它做诸如咯咯笑、跳舞、坐下、摔倒，或朝某个方向走之类的事。

sentences.en: The 45 sessions were videotaped, and interactions between toddlers and the robot were later analyzed.
sentences.zh: 这45次活动都被录了像，幼儿与机器人之间的互动随后被加以分析。

sentences.en: The results showed that the quality of those interactions improved steadily over 27 sessions.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，这些互动的质量在27次活动中稳步提升。

sentences.en: The interactions deteriorated quickly over the next 15 sessions, when the robot was ordered to behave in a more limited, predictable manner.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的15次活动中，当机器人被命令以一种更受限、更可预测的方式行动时，互动迅速恶化。

sentences.en: Finally, the human/robot relations improved in the last three sessions, after the robot had been instructed to display its full range of behaviors.
sentences.zh: 最后，在机器人被指示展示其全部行为之后，人机关系在最后三次活动中有所改善。

sentences.en: D ‘Initially, the children treated the robot very differently from the way they treated each other,’ Tanaka said.
sentences.zh: “起初，孩子们对待机器人的方式与他们彼此相待的方式很不一样，”田中说。

sentences.en: ‘Early in the study, some children cried when QRIO fell.
sentences.zh: “研究早期，有些孩子在QRIO摔倒时会哭。

sentences.en: But a month into the study, the toddlers helped QRIO stand up by pushing its back or pulling its hands.’
sentences.zh: 但研究进行到一个月时，幼儿们会推它的背或拉它的手，帮助QRIO站起来。”

sentences.en: ‘The most important aspect of interaction was touch,’ Tanaka said.
sentences.zh: “互动中最重要的一个方面是触摸，”田中说。

sentences.en: ‘At first, the toddlers would touch the robot on its face, but later on they would touch it only on its hands and arms, like they would with other humans.
sentences.zh: “起初，幼儿会去摸机器人的脸，但后来他们就只摸它的手和胳膊，就像对待其他人一样。

sentences.en: Another robot-like toy named Robby, which resembled QRIO but did not move, was used as a control in the study.
sentences.zh: 研究中用了另一个名叫罗比的机器人式玩具作为对照，它和QRIO很像，但不会动。

sentences.en: While hugging of QRIO increased, hugging of Robby decreased throughout the study.
sentences.zh: 在整个研究过程中，对QRIO的拥抱越来越多，而对罗比的拥抱却越来越少。

sentences.en: Furthermore, when QRIO laid down on the floor, caretaking behaviors were frequently observed toward QRIO but seldom toward Robby.’
sentences.zh: 此外，当QRIO躺到地上时，人们经常观察到针对QRIO的照料行为，针对罗比的却很少见。”

sentences.en: E The study concluded that after 45 days of immersion in a childcare center over a period of five months, long-term bonding and socialization occurred between toddlers and a state-of-the-art social robot.
sentences.zh: 该研究得出结论：在五个月里于一所幼儿托管中心沉浸式相处45天之后，幼儿与一台最先进的社交机器人之间产生了长期的情感纽带和社会化。

sentences.en: Overall, the interaction between children and the robot improved over time and the children progressively treated it more as a peer than a plaything.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，孩子与机器人之间的互动随时间不断改善，孩子们越来越把它当作同伴而非玩物。

sentences.en: ‘To my knowledge, this is the first long-term study of this sort,’ said Ronald Arkin, a roboticist at the Georgia Institute of Technology in the US.
sentences.zh: “据我所知，这是首个此类的长期研究，”美国佐治亚理工学院的机器人专家罗纳德·阿金说。

sentences.en: F Tanaka and Movellan are now developing autonomous robots for the toddler classroom.
sentences.zh: 田中和莫韦兰如今正在为幼儿教室研发自主机器人。

sentences.en: ‘It could have great potential in educational settings, assisting teachers and enriching the classroom environment,’ Tanaka said.
sentences.zh: “它在教育场景中可能有巨大的潜力，能协助老师、丰富课堂环境，”田中说。

sentences.en: The researchers hope that more advanced versions of robots like QRIO could become personalized tutors to assist teachers in classrooms.
sentences.zh: 研究者希望，像QRIO这样更先进版本的机器人，有朝一日能成为个性化的辅导员，在课堂上协助老师。

sentences.en: A robotic tutor could react on the spot to social cues and approximate social skills like facial expression and eye gaze, they said.
sentences.zh: 他们说，一个机器人辅导员可以当场对社交线索做出反应，并近似地表现出面部表情和目光注视等社交技能。

sentences.en: ‘It is becoming clear that, to achieve this goal, we are going to endow machines with something similar to emotion, not just traditional forms of intelligence,’ said Movellan.
sentences.zh: “越来越清楚的是，要实现这一目标，我们将要赋予机器某种类似情感的东西，而不仅仅是传统形式的智能，”莫韦兰说。

sentences.en: G Associate Professor David Powers, an expert in artificial intelligence and cognitive science at Flinders University in South Australia, commented, ‘In this study, it is clearly demonstrated that a limited range of robot behaviors, however impressive, is nowhere near as important to human/robot interaction as being able to make appropriate responses from a broad repertoire of behaviors.’
sentences.zh: 南澳大利亚弗林德斯大学人工智能与认知科学专家、副教授戴维·鲍尔斯评论道：“这项研究清楚地表明，一套有限的机器人行为，无论多么令人印象深刻，对人机互动的重要性都远不及能够从广泛的行为库中做出恰当的回应。”

sentences.en: Ronald Arkin was not surprised by the affection demonstrated by the toddlers toward the robot.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·阿金对幼儿们对机器人表现出的喜爱之情并不感到意外。

sentences.en: ‘Humans have a tremendous propensity to bond with artifacts, whether it be a car, a doll, or a robot,’ he said.
sentences.zh: “人类有一种极强的倾向，会与人造物建立情感纽带，无论它是一辆车、一个玩偶，还是一个机器人，”他说。

sentences.en: But he also cautioned that researchers do not yet understand the consequences of increased human/robot interaction.
sentences.zh: 但他也告诫说，研究者尚不了解人机互动增多所带来的后果。

sentences.en: ‘Studying how robots and humans work together can give us insight into whether this is a good thing or a bad thing for society,’ Arkin said.
sentences.zh: “研究机器人与人如何协作，可以让我们洞察这对社会究竟是好事还是坏事，”阿金说。

sentences.en: ‘We need to find out what the consequences are of introducing a robot into a cadre of children.
sentences.zh: “我们需要弄清楚，把一个机器人引入一群孩子中会带来什么后果。

sentences.en: How will that enhance, or potentially interfere with, their social development?
sentences.zh: 那将如何促进、或可能干扰他们的社会性发展？

sentences.en: Do we really understand the long-term impact of having a robot as a childhood friend?’
sentences.zh: 我们真的了解把机器人当作童年伙伴所带来的长期影响吗？”

sentences.en: (A) Who studies children’s literature and what is it that they study?
sentences.zh: 谁在研究儿童文学？他们研究的又是什么？

sentences.en: The answers to this question are complex and messy, because of the many confounding factors which exist in this field.
sentences.zh: 对这个问题的回答既复杂又繁琐，因为该领域中存在许多相互纠缠的因素。

sentences.en: (B) Firstly, unlike literature for adults, children’s literature is not generally written by its own readers.
sentences.zh: 首先，与成人文学不同，儿童文学一般不是由其读者自己写就的。

sentences.en: Adults write for children, and thus adult perceptions of what children are and of what they could and should become are woven into the literature.
sentences.zh: 成人为儿童写作，因此成人对“儿童是什么”以及“儿童可以变成、应当变成什么”的看法被编织进这种文学。

sentences.en: (C) Furthermore, some of those who study children’s literature (and those who write certain kinds of children’s books) are less interested in literary values than in the kinds of lessons it can teach- either in terms of creating better children or in terms of serving a particular curriculum.
sentences.zh: 此外，部分研究儿童文学的人（以及部分写作某些类型儿童读物的人）对文学价值的兴趣不如对儿童文学所能传达的“教训”的兴趣大——无论是培养更好的儿童，还是服务于某种课程。

sentences.en: The issue of how a teacher can use a children’s book is often contentious, but even outside the classroom, much material for children is still didactic.
sentences.zh: 教师如何使用一本儿童读物的问题常常富有争议，但即便走出课堂，许多面向儿童的材料仍带有说教意味。

sentences.en: (D) Thirdly, while almost all literature is currently promoted within a strong commercial matrix, children’s literature is often especially targeted for marketing initiatives.
sentences.zh: 第三，虽然几乎所有文学目前都在一个强大的商业体系中被推广，但儿童文学常常是营销举措的特别目标。

sentences.en: This fact means that readers are often recruited with a message that is negligibly literary and significantly oriented to ideas of consumption.
sentences.zh: 这一事实意味着，读者常常是被一种几乎不带文学意味、却显著面向消费观念的信息所招募而来的。

sentences.en: Daniel Hade (2002) has raised useful questions about whether children’s experience of reading is altered when their books are part of a larger marketing framework involving the movie, the game, and the toy of a popular children’s book.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·黑德（Daniel Hade，2002 年）提出了一些有益的问题：当儿童的书籍是一个更大营销框架的一部分（这个框架还包括根据一本热门儿童读物制作的电影、游戏和玩具）时，儿童的阅读体验是否会因此被改变？

sentences.en: How children perceive and respond to their stories in this new context is an important question.
sentences.zh: 儿童在这种新语境中如何感知和回应他们的故事，是一个重要的问题。

sentences.en: (E) It is also important to note that texts in an ever-increasing range of new media compete with print media for the attention of the child reader, and create definitional issues for scholars.
sentences.zh: 同样值得注意的是，一类不断扩展的新媒体文本在争夺儿童读者的注意力上与印刷媒体竞争，这给学者带来了定义上的问题。

sentences.en: Does the term literature’ exclusively imply a verbal text?
sentences.zh: “文学”这一术语是否仅仅指言语文本？

sentences.en: If not, where are the limits?
sentences.zh: 如果不是，边界在哪里？

sentences.en: Could a literary computer game ever be considered a work of literature?
sentences.zh: 一款文学性的电脑游戏可以被视作一部文学作品吗？

sentences.en: If not, what kind of attention should be paid to it, since children themselves undoubtedly perceive their print literature as part of a broader continuum?
sentences.zh: 如果不行，又应给予它何种关注？毕竟，儿童自己无疑会把他们的印刷文学视为更广阔连续体的一部分。

sentences.en: The internet provides one forum through which children now communicate with each other.
sentences.zh: 互联网为儿童相互交流提供了一个论坛。

sentences.en: (In 2003, the internet search engine Google listed 7,920,000 sites relating to the Harry Potter novels; even allowing for duplication and dead ends, that is a number with revolutionary implications.)
sentences.zh: （2003 年，搜索引擎谷歌列出了 7920000 个与《哈利·波特》小说相关的网站；即便考虑到重复和无效链接，这个数字也具有革命性意义。）

sentences.en: (F) Finally, in the context of the higher education institutions where the formal study of children’s literature is often located, at least three disciplinary frameworks (English, education, and librarianship) fragment the focus of scholarly study of children’s literature.
sentences.zh: 最后，在高等教育机构（儿童文学的正式研究常在这里进行）的语境中，至少有三个学科框架（英文、教育和图书馆学）让对儿童文学的学术研究焦点变得分散。

sentences.en: How is the value of the imaginative encounter with the work of literature sustained and honored among such a welter of conflicting interests?
sentences.zh: 在如此众多相互冲突的兴趣之中，与文学作品相遇的想象性体验的价值如何被守护与尊重？

sentences.en: One route through this maze is to ask the child readers for help.
sentences.zh: 穿越这一迷宫的一条路径，是去向儿童读者寻求帮助。

sentences.en: As David Lewis (2001) has perceptively noted, what children think of reading is not usually the same as what adults think, whether teachers or parents.
sentences.zh: 正如戴维·刘易斯（David Lewis，2001 年）敏锐地指出，儿童对阅读的看法通常并不与成人——无论老师还是家长——的看法相同。

sentences.en: As Lewis points out, children ‘sometimes see more and they often see differently’.
sentences.zh: 正如刘易斯所指出，儿童“有时看得更多，而且常常以不同的方式看”。

sentences.en: If those who study reading can explore children’s perceptions as well as those of adults, their understanding of the nature of reading will be enhanced.
sentences.zh: 如果研究阅读的人能够探究儿童的感受，而不只是成人的感受，他们对阅读本质的理解就会得到深化。

sentences.en: (G) Lewis makes a further valid point when he adds that exploring children’s perceptions is usually justified for educational reasons: “It is true that a better understanding of how children read and how they learn to read, is a prerequisite to improved approaches to teaching.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯进一步指出了一个有效的观点：他补充说，探究儿童的感受通常是出于教育上的理由：“确实，更好地理解儿童如何阅读、以及他们如何学习阅读，是改进教学方式的前提。

sentences.en: However, it can also be argued, as Lewis rightly does, that when children’s responses to literature are accessed and interpreted, they frequently lead to an understanding of how picture books appeal to children.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如刘易斯正确指出的那样，当儿童对文学的反应被获取并被解读时，它们也常常引导我们理解图画书是如何吸引儿童的。

sentences.en: (H) Young people’s accounts of what and how they read also enable a more sophisticated description of many of the complex processes involved in reading.
sentences.zh: 年轻人对自己读什么、怎么读的讲述，也能让人对阅读所涉及的许多复杂过程作出更为精细的描述。

sentences.en: All descriptions of reading runs the risk of solipsism: i.e. this is how I read so this is what reading is for everyone.
sentences.zh: 对阅读的一切描述都面临唯我论的风险：即“我是这样读的，所以对每个人来说阅读都是这样的”。

sentences.en: Asking other readers how they read, however, reduces that risk.
sentences.zh: 然而，询问其他读者他们如何阅读，可以降低这种风险。

sentences.en: For example, if I am a strong visualizer as I read, I may consider that visualization is a key component of successful reading and I may judge books by their capacity to evoke a vivid visual response.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果我在阅读时是一个强图像化的读者，我可能会认为图像化是成功阅读的关键组成部分，并且可能根据书唤起生动视觉反应的能力来评判它们。

sentences.en: Other readers, however, may help me to realize that not everyone reads with mental pictures.
sentences.zh: 然而，其他读者可能让我意识到，并非每个人都借助心中图像来阅读。

sentences.en: Some readers respond to the patterns of the words, ‘hearing’ them inaudibly like a subliminal radio program.
sentences.zh: 一些读者对词语的模式作出反应，像潜意识里收听的电台广播一样无声地“听见”它们。

sentences.en: Others respond to the patterns of feelings in the story, responding with an emotional connection.
sentences.zh: 另一些人对故事中情感的模式作出反应，以情感联结的方式回应。

sentences.en: Talking to competent readers, of all ages, provides a better understanding of reading experiences.
sentences.zh: 与各年龄段的能干读者交流，可以让人对阅读体验有更好的理解。

sentences.en: (I) Children’s insights are even more important when it comes to understanding the significance of print literature as one aspect of literary culture.
sentences.zh: 在理解印刷文学作为文学文化一种面向的重要性时，儿童的洞见更是举足轻重。

sentences.en: Too often adults assume that reading any book at all is a more worthwhile experience than playing a digital game of any kind.
sentences.zh: 成人常常以为，任何一本书的阅读都比任何一种数字游戏更有价值。

sentences.en: A humbler approach would include asking why the game appeals to the player.
sentences.zh: 一种更谦逊的取径，会包括询问游戏为何吸引玩家。

sentences.en: Many adults will probably never develop the automatic skills to process a game as readily as they can read a book.
sentences.zh: 许多成人很可能永远都无法发展出像读书那样自动处理一款游戏的技能。

sentences.en: This does not indicate that a book is better, but that a particular set of skills is absent.
sentences.zh: 这并不表示书更好，而只是说缺少某一组技能。

sentences.en: Non-players must acknowledge that some fictional universes are thus closed to them, and a logical response would be to find someone who can guide them to the pleasures and challenges of the gaming world.
sentences.zh: 非玩家必须承认，某些虚构宇宙因此对他们关闭；合乎逻辑的回应应当是找一个能引导他们进入游戏世界之乐趣与挑战的人。

sentences.en: Games need to be judged individually just as books do, and any evaluative framework needs to take this into account.
sentences.zh: 游戏需要像书一样被个别评判，任何评价框架都需要把这一点考虑在内。
