sentences.en: (A) International tourism presents itself as straightforward, passive and benign, yet it is complex, interesting and important, full of contradictions and depths.
sentences.zh: 国际旅游看上去直白、被动而无害，实则复杂、有趣而重要，充满矛盾与深意。

sentences.en: It has enormous growth potential; almost every country desires an expansion in this sector.
sentences.zh: 它具有巨大的增长潜力，几乎每个国家都希望这一部门有所扩张。

sentences.en: Yet whether and how to grow is not nearly as straightforward as one might hope.
sentences.zh: 然而，是否增长以及如何增长，远不像人们所希望的那样简单。

sentences.en: (B) Tourism can provide the ideal export for developing countries, which can capitalize on their unique cultures and natural environments.
sentences.zh: 对发展中国家来说，旅游可以是理想的出口产业，它们能借助自身独特的文化和自然环境。

sentences.en: However, to do this they need to have features such as airports, hotels, sanitation facilities, roads and medical facilities.
sentences.zh: 不过要做到这一点，它们需要具备机场、酒店、卫生设施、道路和医疗设施等条件。

sentences.en: A government can build these itself, using revenue from local taxes or getting finance from foreign lenders.
sentences.zh: 政府可以自行修建这些设施，动用本地税收，或向外国债权人融资。

sentences.en: Alternatively, the government may attract foreign investment, allowing others to pay for the building, thus relieving itself of providing capital but forgoing profits.
sentences.zh: 另一种做法是，政府吸引外国投资，让别人出钱建设，从而免去自己提供资本的负担，但也放弃了利润。

sentences.en: (C) Tourism is, however, a risky investment.
sentences.zh: 然而，旅游是一项有风险的投资。

sentences.en: It can gradually decline as a resort becomes seen as outdated, or it can be destroyed overnight by a single hurricane, or a political emergency.
sentences.zh: 当一处度假地被视为过时，它可能逐渐衰落，也可能被一场飓风或一次政治突发事件在一夜之间摧毁。

sentences.en: Even when successful, countries and localities are faced with a dilemma: keep it within limits, or extend its benefits but also deepen dependence on a single, fickle industry.
sentences.zh: 即便经营成功，国家和地方也会面临两难：是把它限定在一定范围内，还是扩大其收益、同时加深对单一而多变的产业的依赖。

sentences.en: (D) By definition, tourists travel to see and knowingly to encounter the different, the original, the authentic.
sentences.zh: 按定义，游客旅行就是为了去看、并有意去遭遇不同的、原初的、真实的东西。

sentences.en: In this increasingly global world, what they want is regional and unique.
sentences.zh: 在这个日益全球化的世界里，他们想要的是地方性的、独一无二的东西。

sentences.en: But only through artifice can the tourist demand for authenticity be met.
sentences.zh: 但游客对真实性的需求，只有通过人为设计才能得到满足。

sentences.en: An event such as a festival or ceremony needs to be brought to their attention and its importance and unique nature elaborated to them.
sentences.zh: 节庆或仪式这类活动需要被推到他们眼前，其重要性和独特性也需要向他们细加阐述。

sentences.en: Natural sites, too, need to be presented if they are to be regarded as noteworthy; gates, permits, and notices are required to set them apart from the mundane.
sentences.zh: 自然景点若要被视为值得一看，同样需要被呈现出来，需要用门、许可证和告示把它们与平凡之物区隔开来。

sentences.en: Complicated framing and staging allows tourists to recognize, by sight, "the actual thing".
sentences.zh: 复杂的框定与布置，让游客一眼就能认出“真正的东西”。

sentences.en: (E) Tourism places a premium on the parts of a culture that are visible, such as handicrafts and costume, and disregards those that are not, like the rules governing seating on a bus, attitudes to the elderly, or appropriate ways of addressing family members; in this way, tourism favours what can be commodified.
sentences.zh: 旅游把溢价给了文化中看得见的部分，比如手工艺品和服饰，却无视看不见的部分，比如公交车上座位的规矩、对待老人的态度或称呼家庭成员的恰当方式，如此一来，旅游偏爱那些可以被商品化的东西。

sentences.en: Yet commodities can be produced most efficiently using industrial machinery to take advantage of economies of scale, an option closed to village artisans.
sentences.zh: 然而商品用工业机器生产最有效率，因为可以利用规模经济，而这条路对乡村手艺人是关闭的。

sentences.en: This alienates the producers from what is being produced, and means the product no longer has any personal meaning to them.
sentences.zh: 这使生产者与所生产之物相疏离，也意味着产品对他们不再具有任何个人意义。

sentences.en: (F) In addition, cultural idiosyncrasies and natural spectacles change over time.
sentences.zh: 此外，文化上的独特之处和自然奇观都会随时间改变。

sentences.en: Tourists can’t be attracted, however, to an unstable and ambiguous culture, or to a natural site that is in the process of transforming itself.
sentences.zh: 然而游客不会被一种不稳定、含混的文化，或一处正在自我变形的自然景点所吸引。

sentences.en: As a consequence, efforts are made to fix and standardize: folk dances, tortilla-making, peace pipes, bird habitats and the course of the Amazon have all been bound and defined.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，人们努力去固定和标准化：民间舞蹈、玉米饼制作、和平烟斗、鸟类栖息地乃至亚马孙河的河道，都已被框定和界定。

sentences.en: Had they not been fixed, however, they would not be accessible.
sentences.zh: 不过，若不曾被固定下来，它们也就无从被接近。

sentences.en: (G) Tourism also promotes an external orientation.
sentences.zh: 旅游还助长一种向外的取向。

sentences.en: Like other exports, the "tourism experience" is produced by local people, and consumed by foreigners.
sentences.zh: 与其他出口品一样，“旅游体验”由当地人生产，由外国人消费。

sentences.en: To obtain loans and ultimately create revenue, a government of whatever size has to please outside investors and potential travelers.
sentences.zh: 为了获得贷款并最终创造收入，无论规模大小的政府都必须取悦外部投资者和潜在旅行者。

sentences.en: In these ways, tourism can result in a political system becoming more authoritarian and giving less consideration to the needs of individuals within the country.
sentences.zh: 通过这些途径，旅游可能导致政治体制变得更为威权，更少顾及国内个体的需求。

sentences.en: (H) In recent years, with increased awareness of some of these dangers, the phenomenon of ecotourism has developed.
sentences.zh: 近年来，随着对其中某些危险的认识增强，生态旅游这一现象发展了起来。

sentences.en: This has been seen as a way to prevent and reverse the environmental degradation resulting from tourism as well as from general human activity.
sentences.zh: 它被视为一种防止并扭转环境退化的方式，这种退化既来自旅游，也来自人类的一般活动。

sentences.en: Ecotourists distance themselves from mainstream hotel tourists, and also from adventure tourists like those who have, for example, left rubbish at the base of Mount Everest in Nepal.
sentences.zh: 生态旅游者与主流的住店游客拉开距离，也与冒险型游客区分开来，比如那些在尼泊尔珠穆朗玛峰大本营留下垃圾的人。

sentences.en: They want to do things like sleep in tents on platforms in tropical rainforests, swim among the fish on coral reefs, or walk over a tree canopy on a net bridge.
sentences.zh: 他们想做的是在热带雨林的平台上搭帐篷过夜、在珊瑚礁间与鱼群同游，或走过悬在树冠之上的绳网桥。

sentences.en: They value the ecosystem as it is and are willing to pay for its preservation.
sentences.zh: 他们珍视生态系统的原貌，并愿意为其保护付费。

sentences.en: In this way, they create an incentive for local people to refrain from using natural resources for short-term gain.
sentences.zh: 如此一来，他们为当地人放弃以短期获利方式利用自然资源提供了激励。

sentences.en: (I) However, what is fortunate for the birds is not always so fortunate for the local people.
sentences.zh: 然而，对鸟儿来说幸运的事，对当地人未必总是幸运。

sentences.en: In order to be environmentally sustainable, ecotourists have to be few in number.
sentences.zh: 要在环境上可持续，生态旅游者的人数就必须很少。

sentences.en: The economies of scale that allow tourism to be profitable cannot operate in a small bush camp.
sentences.zh: 让旅游有利可图的规模经济，在一个小小的丛林营地里无法运转。

sentences.en: Camping doesn’t generate much revenue.
sentences.zh: 露营带不来多少收入。

sentences.en: Ecotourism proves that tourism does not have to be in conflict with environmental preservation.
sentences.zh: 生态旅游证明，旅游未必与环境保护相冲突。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it also proves that the realm in which the environment and the economy can be mutually supporting is tiny.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，它也证明，环境与经济能够相互支撑的那个领域小得可怜。

sentences.en: (J) Furthermore, Westerners’ interest in biodiversity often means that the tourist wants to listen to a parrot, not a local elder, and that dollars bypass beggars on their way to support trees.

sentences.en: Thus ecotourists’ environmental awareness can stand in contrast to their indifference to the local human community.

records.title: The Effectiveness Of An Online Course

sentences.en: (A) As access to the internet has continued to grow, web-based learning has continued to expand.
sentences.zh: 随着上网机会持续增加，网络学习也不断扩展。

sentences.en: With approximately half of the households in the United States, or 150 million people, connected to the Internet, an estimated 2 million students are taking post-secondary courses that are fully delivered online.
sentences.zh: 美国约有一半家庭、即1.5亿人接入了互联网，估计有200万名学生正在修读完全以在线方式授课的高等教育课程。

sentences.en: Millions of other students at all educational levels, primary, secondary, post-secondary, participate in online courses.
sentences.zh: 另有数以百万计各学段的学生，包括小学、中学和高等教育阶段，都参与了在线课程。

sentences.en: However, the effectiveness of online courses, particularly in relation to individual student needs, perceptions, and student outcomes, is sometimes questioned.
sentences.zh: 然而，在线课程的成效，尤其是在学生个体需求、感受和学习结果方面的成效，有时会受到质疑。

sentences.en: (B) Common elements for learning in a typical classroom environment are the social and communicative interactions between student and teacher, and student and student.
sentences.zh: 在典型课堂环境中，学习的共同要素是师生之间以及学生之间的社交与交流互动。

sentences.en: The ability to ask a question, to share an opinion with a fellow student, or to disagree with the point of view in a reading assignment are all fundamental learning activities.
sentences.zh: 能够提出问题、与同学分享看法，或对阅读作业中的观点表示不同意，都是最基本的学习活动。

sentences.en: However, effective web-based learning requires adjustments on the part of students and teachers for successful interactions to occur, for example.
sentences.zh: 不过，举例来说，有效的网络学习需要学生和教师双方作出调整，互动才能顺利发生。

sentences.en: Many online courses provide students and faculty, and students and students with the ability to interact with each other via an electronic bulletin or discussion board.
sentences.zh: 许多在线课程为师生之间以及学生之间提供了通过电子公告板或讨论区相互交流的功能。

sentences.en: (C) While most studies show a link between interaction and satisfaction in web-based courses, some observers have cautioned that this is not always the case.
sentences.zh: 虽然多数研究显示网络课程中的互动与满意度之间存在关联，一些观察者却提醒说情况并非总是如此。

sentences.en: Ruberg, Taylor and Moore, for example, observe that in order to interact successfully, students must adjust to the nonlinear nature of web-based learning.
sentences.zh: 例如，鲁伯格、泰勒和穆尔就指出，要成功互动，学生必须适应网络学习的非线性特征。

sentences.en: In linear, focusing on a single discussion thread.
sentences.zh: 在呈线性的讨论中，注意力集中在单一的讨论线索上。

sentences.en: Web-based learning sessions can have multiple threads with several discussions and interactions progressing simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 网络学习环节可能有多条线索，若干讨论和互动同时推进。

sentences.en: Students respond to a teacher but also to other students, depending on the interest and points of view.
sentences.zh: 学生既回应教师，也回应其他学生，视兴趣和观点而定。

sentences.en: (D) Sproull and Kiesler caution about discussions based on misinformation, that continue because an instructor cannot necessarily immediately correct or clarify a comment.
sentences.zh: 斯普劳尔和基斯勒提醒人们注意基于错误信息的讨论，这类讨论之所以持续，是因为教师未必能立即纠正或澄清某条发言。

sentences.en: As a result, students need to have the experience and knowledge base to sift through the discussion for misinformation.
sentences.zh: 因此，学生需要具备相应的经验和知识基础，才能在讨论中筛出错误信息。

sentences.en: In online learning, the amount of student interaction and the number of comments can easily lead to what is described as information overload.
sentences.zh: 在在线学习中，学生互动的数量和发言的条数很容易造成所谓的信息过载。

sentences.en: Furthermore, comments in online discussions tend to be lengthier than in face-to-face situations.
sentences.zh: 此外，在线讨论中的发言往往比面对面场合更冗长。

sentences.en: With more information from many sources, students need to be more attentive to both the who and what of a discussion.
sentences.zh: 面对来自众多来源的更多信息，学生需要更留意讨论中“谁在说”和“说了什么”。

sentences.en: Herbert Simon, an economist, cautions that, "a wealth of information creates a poverty of attention."
sentences.zh: 经济学家赫伯特·西蒙提醒说：“信息的富足造成注意力的贫乏。”

sentences.en: (E) In examinations of interaction, the concept of "presence", or a sense of being in a place and belonging to a group, has received attention.
sentences.zh: 在对互动的考察中，“在场感”这一概念受到了关注，它指身处某地并归属于某个群体的感觉。

sentences.en: It is generally assumed that when a student is physically present in a face-to-face course, he or she has a sense of belonging to the class or group enrolled in the course and this sense of belonging is greater than that experienced in an online course.
sentences.zh: 人们通常假定，当学生身体在场参加面对面课程时，他或她会有归属于该课程班级或群体的感觉，而且这种归属感强于在线课程中的体验。

sentences.en: He or she listens to and may choose to raise a hand to comment, answer or ask a question.
sentences.zh: 他或她会聆听，也可能选择举手发表意见、回答或提问。

sentences.en: Furthermore, this same student may develop a relationship with other students in the class during a break.
sentences.zh: 此外，同一名学生还可能在课间与班上其他同学建立起关系。

sentences.en: However, this is an assumption and not always true.
sentences.zh: 然而，这只是一种假定，并不总是成立。

sentences.en: For reasons, some students can also feel alienated in a face-to-face class and not feel part of a group.
sentences.zh: 出于某些原因，有些学生在面对面的课堂上同样会感到疏离，觉得自己不属于某个群体。

sentences.en: (F) The idea of presence has been redefined in relation to an online course.
sentences.zh: 在线课程语境下，在场感这一概念已被重新界定。

sentences.en: The simplest definition of presence for an online course refers to a student’s sense of being registered and belonging in a course, and the ability to interact with other students and an instructor even though physical contact is not available.
sentences.zh: 就在线课程而言，在场感最简单的定义指学生感到自己已注册并归属于某门课程，并且即便无法进行身体接触，也能与其他学生和教师互动。

sentences.en: However, as this concept is studied, the definition is expanding and being refined to include telepresence, cognitive presence, social presence, teaching presence, and other forms of presence.
sentences.zh: 不过，随着这一概念被不断研究，其定义正在扩展和细化，纳入了远程在场、认知在场、社会在场、教学在场等多种形式的在场。

sentences.en: The term "community" is related to presence, and refers to a group of individuals who belong to a social unit, such as students in a class.
sentences.zh: “共同体”一词与在场感相关，指归属于某个社会单元的一群人，例如一个班级里的学生。

sentences.en: In an online course, however, terms such as communities of inquiry, communities of learners, and knowledge-building communities have evolved.
sentences.zh: 然而在在线课程中，探究共同体、学习者共同体和知识建构共同体等说法已经演化出来。

sentences.en: (G) As the definition of presence has expanded and evolved, a distinction has been made between interaction and presence, emphasizing that they are not the same.
sentences.zh: 随着在场感的定义不断扩展和演变，人们开始区分互动与在场感，强调二者并不相同。

sentences.en: Interaction may indicate presence but it is also possible for a student to interact by posting a message on an electronic bulletin board, while not necessarily feeling that he or she is part of a group or a class.
sentences.zh: 互动可能表明存在在场感，但学生也可能只是在电子公告板上发帖进行互动，却未必觉得自己属于某个群体或班级。

sentences.en: (H) A study conducted by Professor Anthony Picciano used questionnaires to determine students’ attitudes in relation to their interactions and sense of purpose in online courses.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·皮恰诺教授所做的一项研究，用问卷考察学生对在线课程中互动与目的感的态度。

sentences.en: An attempt was made to go beyond student perceptions to include performance and to perceptions of social presence, as well as actual participation in class activities.
sentences.zh: 该研究试图超越学生的主观感受，把学业表现、对社会在场的感受以及课堂活动的实际参与情况都纳入进来。

sentences.en: In addition, data was collected on performance measures that related specifically to course objectives.
sentences.zh: 此外，研究还收集了与课程目标直接相关的表现指标数据。

sentences.en: While much of the research, including this study, supports the strong relationship between students’ perception of interaction and perceived learning, the results of the study indicated that the relationship of actual measures of interaction and performance is mixed.
sentences.zh: 尽管包括这项研究在内的大量研究都支持学生对互动的感受与其感知到的学习之间存在紧密关系，该研究结果却表明，互动的实际测量指标与学业表现之间的关系是好坏参半的。

sentences.en: (I) The success of many online courses is dependent upon the nature of student-to-student and student-to-faculty interaction.
sentences.zh: 许多在线课程的成功，取决于学生与学生之间以及学生与教师之间互动的性质。

sentences.en: However, how interaction affects learning outcomes and what the relationships between the two are, is in need of further study.
sentences.zh: 然而，互动如何影响学习结果，以及两者之间存在何种关系，仍有待进一步研究。

sentences.en: A About 20 years ago I had one of those wonderful moments when research takes an unexpected but fruitful turn.
sentences.zh: 大约20年前，我经历了那种美妙的时刻，研究出人意料却富有成果地转了个弯。

sentences.en: I had been studying toddler memory and was beginning a new experiment with two-and-a-half- and three-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 我一直在研究幼儿记忆，当时正着手一项针对两岁半和三岁孩子的新实验。

sentences.en: For the project, I had built a model of a room that was in my laboratory.
sentences.zh: 为这个项目，我搭了一个我实验室里那个房间的模型。

sentences.en: The real space contained basic furniture such as a couch and table.
sentences.zh: 真实的空间里有沙发和桌子之类的基本家具。

sentences.en: The miniature version was as similar as possible to its larger counterpart: the furniture was the same shape and material and was arranged in the same position.
sentences.zh: 微缩版本尽可能与其放大的对应物相似：家具形状和材质相同，摆放位置也一样。

sentences.en: For the study, a child watched as we hid a miniature toy - a plastic dog we called Little Snoopy* - in the model.
sentences.zh: 实验中，孩子看着我们把一个微缩玩具藏进模型，那是一只我们称作“小史努比”的塑料狗。

sentences.en: We then encouraged the child to find 'Big Snoopy, a large version of the toy hiding in the same place in his big room.'
sentences.zh: 随后我们鼓励孩子去找“大史努比”，也就是藏在他那个大房间同一位置上的该玩具的大号版本。

sentences.en: B The three-year-olds were very successful.
sentences.zh: 三岁的孩子非常成功。

sentences.en: After they observed the small toy being placed behind the miniature couch, they ran into the room and found the large toy behind the real couch.
sentences.zh: 在看到小玩具被放到微缩沙发后面之后，他们跑进房间，在真沙发后面找到了大玩具。

sentences.en: But the two-and-a-half-year-olds failed abysmally.
sentences.zh: 但两岁半的孩子彻底失败了。

sentences.en: They cheerfully ran into the room to retrieve the large toy, but most had no idea where to look, even though they remembered where the tiny toy was hidden in the miniature room and could readily find it there.
sentences.zh: 他们兴冲冲地跑进房间去取那个大玩具，多数人却根本不知道该往哪儿找，尽管他们记得小玩具藏在微缩房间的什么地方，也能在那里轻易找到它。

sentences.en: C Their failure to use what they knew about the model to draw an inference about the real room indicated that they did not appreciate the relation between the model and the room.
sentences.zh: 他们无法用自己关于模型的知识对真实房间作出推断，这表明他们并不理解模型与房间之间的关系。

sentences.en: I realised my memory study was instead a study of symbolic understanding and that the children's failure might be telling us something about how and when children acquire the ability to understand that one object stands for another.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，我这项记忆研究其实成了一项关于符号理解的研究，而孩子们的失败也许在告诉我们，儿童是如何以及何时获得理解一物代表另一物的能力的。

sentences.en: D The first type of symbolic object that infants and young children master is the picture.
sentences.zh: 婴幼儿最先掌握的符号性物体是图画。

sentences.en: No symbols seem simpler to adults, but infants initially find pictures perplexing.
sentences.zh: 在成人看来，没有哪种符号比图画更简单，但婴儿起初却觉得图画令人困惑。

sentences.en: The problem stems from the duality inherent in all symbolic objects: they are real in themselves and also representations of something else.
sentences.zh: 问题源于一切符号性物体固有的二重性：它们本身是实物，同时又是别的东西的表征。

sentences.en: A few years ago I became intrigued by anecdotes suggesting that infants do not appreciate this duality-stories of a baby trying to pick up a depicted object or to put on a hat from a picture book, for example.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我被一些轶事吸引，它们表明婴儿并不理解这种二重性，比如有婴儿试图去拿画中的物体，或想把图画书里的帽子戴到头上。

sentences.en: E My colleagues and I decided to explore infants' understanding of pictures.
sentences.zh: 于是我和同事们决定探究婴儿对图画的理解。

sentences.en: In one study, we presented nine-month-olds with a brightly coloured picture of a toy and then tested their manual search for the toy.
sentences.zh: 在一项研究中，我们给九个月大的婴儿看一张色彩鲜艳的玩具图片，然后测试他们用手寻找该玩具的行为。

sentences.en: We placed the picture on the floor of a small room, and the infants sat on their parents' laps in front of the picture.
sentences.zh: 我们把图片放在一个小房间的地板上，婴儿坐在父母腿上，面朝图片。

sentences.en: We showed them the toy and then slid it behind the picture.
sentences.zh: 我们把玩具给他们看，然后把它滑到图片后面。

sentences.en: The infants were then encouraged to retrieve the toy.
sentences.zh: 接着鼓励婴儿去把玩具取回来。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, they consistently reached for the picture instead of the actual toy.
sentences.zh: 出人意料的是，他们总是去够那张图片，而不是真正的玩具。

sentences.en: They did this even though they were quite capable of picking up the toy when it was not behind the picture.
sentences.zh: 即便在玩具不在图片后面时他们完全有能力把它拿起来，他们仍然如此。

sentences.en: It was as if the picture, as a representation, interfered with their ability to see it as a real object.
sentences.zh: 这就好像图片作为一种表征，干扰了他们把它看作实物的能力。

sentences.en: F We have since replicated this finding in several studies, and it seems that infants' difficulty with pictures is quite robust.
sentences.zh: 此后我们在多项研究中重复了这一发现，看来婴儿在图画上遇到的困难相当稳固。

sentences.en: It is not until about 18 months of age that children clearly understand that a picture is both an object and a representation of something else.
sentences.zh: 直到大约18个月大，儿童才清楚地理解一幅图画既是物体，又是别的东西的表征。

sentences.en: This developmental progression is similar to what we observed with the scale model.
sentences.zh: 这一发展进程与我们在缩尺模型上观察到的情况相似。

sentences.en: The younger children treated the model as an interesting object in its own right, but they did not see it as a symbol for the room.
sentences.zh: 年幼一些的孩子把模型当作本身就有趣的物体，却没有把它看作房间的符号。

sentences.en: The older children, in contrast, immediately understood the relation and used it to find the hidden toy.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，年长一些的孩子立刻理解了这层关系，并用它找到了藏起来的玩具。

sentences.en: G What, then, allows children to begin to understand symbols?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么让儿童开始理解符号的呢？

sentences.en: We believe that a key factor is something called dual representation.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，一个关键因素是所谓的双重表征。

sentences.en: To understand a symbol, a child must mentally represent both the symbol itself and its relation to the thing it stands for.
sentences.zh: 要理解一个符号，儿童必须在心里同时表征符号本身，以及它与其所代表之物的关系。

sentences.en: For younger children, the concrete object is so salient that it overwhelms the child's ability to represent the abstract relation.
sentences.zh: 对年幼的孩子来说，具体的物体过于突出，压倒了他们表征这种抽象关系的能力。

sentences.en: As children develop, they become better at holding two representations in mind at once, which allows them to appreciate the symbolic nature of objects like models and pictures.
sentences.zh: 随着儿童发展，他们越来越善于同时在头脑中持有两种表征，这使他们得以领会模型和图画这类物体的符号性质。

sentences.en: (A) As Daniel Haworth is settled into a high chair and wheeled behind a black screen, a sudden look of worry furrows his 9-month-old brow.
sentences.zh: 当Daniel Haworth被安置到高脚椅上、被推到黑色屏幕后面时，一股突如其来的忧虑让他9个月大的眉头皱了起来。

sentences.en: His dark blue eyes dart left and right in search of the familiar reassurance of his mother's face.
sentences.zh: 他深蓝色的眼睛左右转动，寻找妈妈面庞上那份熟悉的安抚。

sentences.en: She calls his name and makes soothing noises, but Daniel senses something unusual is happening.
sentences.zh: 她叫着他的名字，发出安抚的声音，但Daniel感觉到有什么不寻常的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: He sucks his fingers for comfort, but, finding no solace, his mouth crumples, his body stiffens, and he lets rip an almighty shriek of distress.
sentences.zh: 他吸吮手指寻求安慰，但没能找到慰藉，他的嘴一瘪，身体一僵，放声发出一声极度痛苦的尖叫。

sentences.en: This is the usual expression when babies are left alone or abandoned.
sentences.zh: 婴儿被独自留下或被丢下时，通常就是这种表现。

sentences.en: Mom picks him up, reassures him, and two minutes later, a chortling and alert Daniel returns to the darkened booth behind the screen and submits himself to baby lab, a unit set up in 2005 at the University of Manchester in northwest England to investigate how babies think.
sentences.zh: 妈妈把他抱起来安抚，两分钟后，咯咯笑着、精神饱满的Daniel回到屏幕后面昏暗的隔间，把自己交给baby lab——那是2005年设于英格兰西北部University of Manchester的一个旨在研究婴儿如何思考的机构。

sentences.en: (B) Watching infants piece life together, seeing their senses, emotions and motor skills take shape, is a source of mystery and endless fascination—at least to parents and developmental psychologists.
sentences.zh: 看着婴儿一点点拼凑出生活，看着他们的感官、情绪和运动技能逐渐成形，是一种充满神秘、令人着迷不已的事情——至少对父母和发展心理学家而言如此。

sentences.en: We can decode their signals of distress or read a million messages into their first smile.
sentences.zh: 我们能解读他们痛苦的信号，或者从他们的第一个微笑中读出千言万语。

sentences.en: But how much do we really know about what's going on behind those wide, innocent eyes?
sentences.zh: 但对那双睁得大大的、天真无邪的眼睛背后正在发生的事，我们究竟了解多少呢？

sentences.en: How much of their understanding of and response to the world comes preloaded at birth?
sentences.zh: 他们对世界的理解和回应中，有多少是出生时就预装的？

sentences.en: How much is built from scratch by experience?
sentences.zh: 又有多少是靠经验从零构建起来的？

sentences.en: Such are the questions being explored at baby lab.
sentences.zh: 这些正是baby lab正在探索的问题。

sentences.en: Though the facility is just 18 months old and has tested only 100 infants, it's already challenging current thinking on what babies know and how they come to know it.
sentences.zh: 尽管该机构成立仅18个月，且只测试了100名婴儿，它已经在挑战关于婴儿知道什么以及如何获知这些知识的现有看法。

sentences.en: (C) Daniel is now engrossed in watching video clips of a red toy train on a circular track.
sentences.zh: Daniel此刻正入神地观看环形轨道上红色玩具小火车的视频片段。

sentences.en: The train disappears into a tunnel and emerges on the other side.
sentences.zh: 小火车消失在隧道里，又从另一头冒出来。

sentences.en: A hidden device above the screen is tracking Daniel's eyes as they follow the train and measuring the diametre of his pupils 50 times a second.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上方的一台隐藏装置追踪着Daniel跟随小火车移动的双眼，并以每秒50次的频率测量他的瞳孔直径。

sentences.en: As the child gets bored—or "habituated", as psychologists call the process— his attention level steadily drops.
sentences.zh: 当孩子感到厌倦时——也就是心理学家所说的“习惯化”过程——他的注意力水平会稳步下降。

sentences.en: But it picks up a little whenever some novelty is introduced.
sentences.zh: 但每当引入某种新奇事物时，注意力又会稍有回升。

sentences.en: The train might be green, or it might be blue.
sentences.zh: 小火车可能是绿色的，也可能是蓝色的。

sentences.en: And sometimes an impossible thing happens— the train goes into the tunnel one color and comes out another.
sentences.zh: 而有时还会发生不可能的事情——小火车进隧道时是一种颜色，出来时却变成了另一种颜色。

sentences.en: (D) Variations of experiments like this one, examining infant attention, have been a standard tool of developmental psychology ever since the Swiss pioneer of the field, Jean Piaget, started experimenting on his children in the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 自该领域的瑞士先驱Jean Piaget于20世纪20年代开始在自己的孩子身上做实验以来，这类考察婴儿注意力的实验及其各种变式一直是发展心理学的标准工具。

sentences.en: Piaget's work led him to conclude that infants younger than 9 months have no innate knowledge of how the world works or any sense of "object permanence" (that people and things still exist even when they're not seen).
sentences.zh: Piaget的研究使他得出结论：9个月以下的婴儿对世界如何运转没有任何先天知识，也没有任何“客体永久性”概念（即人和事物即使看不见也依然存在）。

sentences.en: Instead, babies must gradually construct this knowledge from experience.
sentences.zh: 相反，婴儿必须从经验中逐步构建这些知识。

sentences.en: Piaget's "constructivist" theories were massively influential on postwar educators and psychologist, but over the past 20 years or so they have been largely set aside by a new generation of "nativist" psychologists and cognitive scientists whose more sophisticated experiments led them to theorise that infants arrive already equipped with some knowledge of the physical world and even rudimentary programming for math and language.
sentences.zh: Piaget的“建构主义”理论对战后教育工作者和心理学家产生了巨大影响，但在过去20年左右的时间里，这些理论已在很大程度上被新一代“先天论”心理学家和认知科学家束之高阁，他们更为精密的实验使他们提出理论认为，婴儿一出生就已具备关于物理世界的某些知识，甚至具备数学和语言的初步程序设定。

sentences.en: Baby lab director Sylvain Sirois has been putting these smart-baby theories through a rigorous set of tests.
sentences.zh: baby lab主任Sylvain Sirois一直在对这些“聪明婴儿”理论进行一套严格的检验。

sentences.en: His conclusions so far tend to be more Piagetian: "Babies," he says, "know nothing."
sentences.zh: 他迄今为止的结论更倾向于Piaget的观点：“婴儿，”他说，“什么都不知道。”

sentences.en: (E) What Sirois and his postgraduate assistant Lain Jackson are challenging is the interpretation of a variety of classic experiments begun in the mid-1980s in which babies were shown physical events that appeared to violate such basic concepts as gravity, solidity and contiguity.
sentences.zh: Sirois和他的研究生助手Lain Jackson所质疑的，是对20世纪80年代中期开始的一系列经典实验的解读，在这些实验中，婴儿们被展示了似乎违背重力、坚固性和邻接性等基本概念的物理事件。

sentences.en: In one such experiment, by University of Illinois psychologist Renee Baillargeon, a hinged wooden panel appeared to pass right through a box.
sentences.zh: 在其中一个由University of Illinois心理学家Renee Baillargeon设计的实验中，一块带铰链的木板看起来径直穿过了一个盒子。

sentences.en: Baillargeon and M.I.T's Elizabeth Spelke found that babies as young as 3 1/2 months would reliably look longer at the impossible event than at the normal one.
sentences.zh: Baillargeon和M.I.T的Elizabeth Spelke发现，小到只有3个半月大的婴儿都会稳定地花更长时间注视那个不可能的事件，而不是正常的事件。

sentences.en: Their conclusion: babies have enough built-in knowledge to recognise that something is wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们的结论是：婴儿拥有足够的先天知识，能够识别出有地方不对劲。

sentences.en: (F) Sirois does not take issue with the way these experiments were conducted.
sentences.zh: Sirois并不质疑这些实验的实施方式。

sentences.en: "The methods are correct and replicable," he says, "it's the interpretation that's the problem."
sentences.zh: “这些方法是正确且可重复的，”他说，“问题出在解读上。”

sentences.en: In a critical review to be published in the forthcoming issue of the European Journal of Developmental Psychology, he and Jackson pour cold water over recent experiments that claim to have observed innate or precocious social cognition skills in infants.
sentences.zh: 在即将出版的下一期European Journal of Developmental Psychology上发表的一篇批判性综述中，他和Jackson给近期那些宣称观察到婴儿具有先天或早熟社会认知技能的实验泼了冷水。

sentences.en: His own experiments indicate that a baby's fascination with physically impossible events merely reflects a response to stimuli that are novel.
sentences.zh: 他自己的实验表明，婴儿对物理上不可能事件的着迷，仅仅反映出对新异刺激的一种反应。

sentences.en: Data from the eye tracker and the measurement of the pupils (which widen in response to arousal or interest) show that impossible events involving familiar objects are no more interesting than possible events involving novel objects.
sentences.zh: 来自眼动追踪仪和瞳孔测量（瞳孔会因觉醒或兴趣而扩大）的数据显示，涉及熟悉物体的不可能事件并不比涉及新异物体的可能事件更有趣。

sentences.en: In other words, when Daniel had seen the red train come out of the tunnel green a few times, he gets as bored as when it stays the same color.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，当Daniel几次看到红色小火车驶出隧道时变成了绿色，他就会像火车颜色一直没变时一样感到无聊。

sentences.en: The mistake of previous research, says Sirois, has been to leap to the conclusion that infants can understand the concept of impossibility from the mere fact that they are able to perceive some novelty in it.
sentences.zh: Sirois说，以往研究的错误在于贸然断定：仅仅因为婴儿能够从中感知到某种新奇性，他们就能理解“不可能”这一概念。

sentences.en: "The real explanation is boring," he says.
sentences.zh: “真正的解释很乏味，”他说。

sentences.en: (G) So how do babies bridge the gap between knowing squat and drawing triangles—a task Daniel's sister Lois, 2 1/2, is happily tackling as she waits for her brother?
sentences.zh: 那么，婴儿如何跨越从一无所知到会画三角形之间的鸿沟——Daniel的姐姐Lois今年两岁半，正一边等着弟弟一边开开心心地做着这项任务呢？

sentences.en: "Babies have to learn everything, but as Piaget was saying, they start with a few primitive reflexes that get things going," said Sirois.
sentences.zh: “婴儿必须学习一切，但正如Piaget所言，他们从少数几个使一切启动起来的原始反射开始，”Sirois说。

sentences.en: For example, hardwired in the brain is an instinct that draws a baby's eyes to a human face.
sentences.zh: 例如，大脑中天生就固有一种本能，会把婴儿的目光引向人的面孔。

sentences.en: From brain imaging studies we also know that the brain has some sort of visual buffer that continues to represent objects after they have been removed—a lingering perception rather than conceptual understanding.
sentences.zh: 从脑成像研究中我们还知道，大脑具有某种视觉缓冲区，在物体被移走之后仍会继续呈现它们——这是一种残留的知觉，而非概念性的理解。

sentences.en: So when babies encounter novel or unexpected events, Sirois explains, "there's a mismatch between the buffer and the information they're getting at that moment.
sentences.zh: 因此Sirois解释道，当婴儿遇到新奇或出乎意料的事件时，“缓冲区与他们那一刻接收到的信息之间就出现了不匹配。

sentences.en: And what you do when you've got a mismatch is you try to clear the buffer.
sentences.zh: 而出现不匹配时，你要做的就是设法清空缓冲区。

sentences.en: And that takes attention."
sentences.zh: 而这就需要注意力。”

sentences.en: So learning, says Sirois, is essentially the laborious business of resolving mismatches.
sentences.zh: 因此Sirois说，学习从本质上讲就是解决不匹配的费心过程。

sentences.en: "The thing is, you can do a lot of it with this wet sticky thing called a brain.
sentences.zh: “问题在于，用这个叫做大脑的湿乎乎、黏糊糊的东西，你能完成其中很多事。

sentences.en: It's a fantastic, statistical-learning machine".
sentences.zh: 它是一台了不起的统计学习机器”。

sentences.en: Daniel, exams ended, picks up a plastic tiger and, chewing thoughtfully upon its heat, smiles as if to agree.
sentences.zh: 考试结束了，Daniel拿起一只塑料老虎，若有所思地啃着它的头，微笑着，仿佛表示赞同。

sentences.en: (A) Aromatherapy is the most widely used complementary therapy in the National Health Service, and doctors use it most often for treating dementia.
sentences.zh: 芳香疗法是英国国民保健服务体系中使用最广泛的辅助疗法，医生最常用它来治疗痴呆症。

sentences.en: For elderly patients who have difficulty interacting verbally, and to whom conventional medicine has little to offer, aromatherapy can bring benefits in terms of better sleep, improved motivation, and less disturbed behaviour.
sentences.zh: 对于言语交流困难、常规医学又难有作为的老年患者，芳香疗法能带来睡眠改善、动力提升、行为紊乱减少等益处。

sentences.en: So the thinking goes.
sentences.zh: 至少人们是这么想的。

sentences.en: But last year, a systematic review of health care databases found almost no evidence that aromatherapy is effective in the treatment of dementia.
sentences.zh: 但去年一项对医疗数据库的系统性回顾发现，几乎没有证据表明芳香疗法对痴呆症治疗有效。

sentences.en: Other findings suggest that aromatherapy works only if you believe it will.
sentences.zh: 另一些研究结果表明，芳香疗法只有在你相信它有效时才起作用。

sentences.en: In fact, the only research that has unequivocally shown it to have an effect has been carried out on animals.
sentences.zh: 事实上，唯一明确显示其具有效果的研究是在动物身上进行的。

sentences.en: (B) Behavioural studies have consistently shown that odours elicit emotional memories far more readily than other sensory cues.
sentences.zh: 行为学研究一贯表明，气味比其他感官线索更容易唤起带有情绪的记忆。

sentences.en: And earlier this year, Rachel Herz, of Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, and colleagues peered into people’s heads using functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) to corroborate that.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，罗德岛普罗维登斯布朗大学的雷切尔·赫兹及其同事用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）观察人的大脑，以印证这一点。

sentences.en: They scanned the brains of five women while they either looked at a photo of a bottle of perfume that evoked a pleasant memory for them, or smelled that perfume.
sentences.zh: 他们扫描了五名女性的大脑，她们或是看着一瓶能唤起愉快回忆的香水的照片，或是闻着那款香水。

sentences.en: One woman, for instance, remembered how as a child living in Paris she would watch with excitement as her mother dressed to go out and sprayed herself with that perfume.
sentences.zh: 例如，其中一位女性回忆起儿时住在巴黎，她曾兴奋地看着母亲梳妆外出，并往身上喷洒那款香水。

sentences.en: The women themselves described the perfume as far more evocative than the photo, and Herz and co-workers found that the scent did indeed activate the amygdala and other brain regions associated with emotion processing far more strongly than the photograph.
sentences.zh: 这些女性自己都表示香水远比照片更能唤起回忆，赫兹和同事也发现，气味确实比照片更强烈地激活了杏仁核以及其他与情绪加工有关的脑区。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing was that the memory itself was no better recalled by the odour than by the picture.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，气味唤起的记忆本身并不比图片唤起的更清晰。

sentences.en: "People don’t remember any more detail or with any more clarity when the memory is recalled with an odour," she says.
sentences.zh: “当记忆由气味唤起时，人们并不会记起更多细节，也不会记得更清楚。”她说。

sentences.en: "However, with the odour, you have this intense emotional feeling that’s really visceral."
sentences.zh: “然而，有了气味，你会产生一种非常发自肺腑的强烈情绪感受。”

sentences.en: (C) That’s hardly surprising, Herz thinks, given how the brain has evolved.
sentences.zh: 赫兹认为，考虑到大脑的演化方式，这一点并不令人意外。

sentences.en: "The way I like to think about it is that emotion and olfaction are essentially the same things," she says.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢这样理解：情绪和嗅觉本质上是同一回事。”她说。

sentences.en: "The part of the brain that controls emotion literally grew out of the part of the brain that controls smell."
sentences.zh: “大脑中控制情绪的部分，实际上正是从控制嗅觉的部分中生长出来的。”

sentences.en: That, she says, probably explains why memories for odours that are associated with intense emotions are so strongly entrenched in us, because the smell was initially a survival skill: a signal to approach or to avoid.
sentences.zh: 她说，这大概可以解释，为什么与强烈情绪相关联的气味记忆在我们身上如此根深蒂固，因为嗅觉最初是一种生存技能：一个靠近或回避的信号。

sentences.en: (D) Eric Vermetten, a psychiatrist at the University of Utrecht in the Netherlands, says that doctors have long known about the potential of smells to act as traumatic reminders, but the evidence has been largely anecdotal.
sentences.zh: 荷兰乌得勒支大学精神病学家埃里克·韦尔梅滕说，医生早就知道气味可能充当创伤提示物，但相关证据大多只是个案传闻。

sentences.en: Last year, he and others set out to document it by describing three cases of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in which patients reported either that a certain smell triggered their flashbacks, or that smell was a feature of the flashback itself.
sentences.zh: 去年，他和其他人着手记录这一现象，描述了三例创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）病例，患者或是报告某种气味触发了闪回，或是说气味本身就是闪回的一部分。

sentences.en: The researchers concluded that odours could be made use of in exposure therapy, or for reconditioning patients’ fear responses.
sentences.zh: 研究者的结论是，气味可以用于暴露疗法，或用来重塑患者的恐惧反应。

sentences.en: (E) After Vermetten presented his findings at a conference, doctors in the audience told him how they had turned this association around and put it to good use.
sentences.zh: 韦尔梅滕在一次会议上介绍研究结果后，听众席中的医生告诉他，他们如何反过来利用这种关联，让它派上用场。

sentences.en: PTSD patients often undergo group therapy, but the therapy itself can expose them to traumatic reminders.
sentences.zh: 创伤后应激障碍患者常接受团体治疗，但治疗本身就可能让他们接触到创伤提示物。

sentences.en: "Some clinicians put a strip of vanilla or a strong, pleasant, everyday odorant such as coffee under their patients’ noses, so that they have this continuous olfactory stimulation," says Vermetten.
sentences.zh: “有些临床医生会在患者鼻子下面放一条香草，或者咖啡这类气味浓郁、令人愉快的日常气味源，让他们持续受到嗅觉刺激。”韦尔梅滕说。

sentences.en: So armed, the patients seem to be better protected against flashbacks.
sentences.zh: 有了这层防护，患者似乎更不容易出现闪回。

sentences.en: It’s purely anecdotal, and nobody knows what’s happening in the brain, says Vermetten, but it’s possible that the neural pathways by which the odour elicits the pleasant, everyday memory override the fear-conditioned neural pathways that respond to verbal cues.
sentences.zh: 韦尔梅滕说，这纯属个案观察，也没人知道大脑里究竟发生了什么，但有一种可能是：气味唤起愉快日常记忆所经由的神经通路，压过了对言语线索作出反应、由恐惧条件化形成的神经通路。

sentences.en: (F) According to Herz, the therapeutic potential of odours could lie in their very unreliability.
sentences.zh: 赫兹认为，气味的治疗潜力也许恰恰在于它们并不可靠。

sentences.en: She has shown with her perfume-bottle experiment that they don’t guarantee any better recall, even if the memories they elicit feel more real.
sentences.zh: 她用香水瓶实验表明，即便气味唤起的记忆感觉更真实，它们也并不保证回忆得更准确。

sentences.en: And there’s plenty of research to show that our noses can be tricked, because being predominantly visual and verbal creatures, we put more faith in those other modalities.
sentences.zh: 而且有大量研究表明我们的鼻子会被骗，因为我们主要是依赖视觉和语言的生物，对这些其他感觉通道更为信赖。

sentences.en: In 2001, for instance, Gil Morrot, of the National Institute for Agronomic Research in Montpellier, tricked 54 oenology students by secretly colouring a white wine with an odourless red dye just before they were asked to describe the odours of a range of red and white wines.
sentences.zh: 例如在 2001 年，蒙彼利埃法国国家农艺研究所的吉尔·莫罗骗过了 54 名酿酒学专业的学生：在请他们描述一系列红葡萄酒和白葡萄酒的气味之前，他悄悄用一种无味的红色染料把一款白葡萄酒染成了红色。

sentences.en: The students described the coloured wine using terms typically reserved for red wines.
sentences.zh: 学生们用通常只用于红葡萄酒的词汇来描述那款被染色的酒。

sentences.en: What’s more, just like experts, they used terms alluding to the wine’s redness and darkness--visual rather than olfactory qualities.
sentences.zh: 更有甚者，他们和专家一样，使用了暗示酒色红润与深沉的词汇——那是视觉而非嗅觉的属性。

sentences.en: Smell, the researchers concluded, cannot be separated from the other senses.
sentences.zh: 研究者的结论是，嗅觉无法与其他感觉分割开来。

sentences.en: (G) Last July, Jay Gottfried and Ray Dolan of the Wellcome Department of Imaging Neuroscience in London took that research a step further when they tested people’s response times in naming an odour, either when presented with an image that was associated with the odour or one that was not.
sentences.zh: 去年七月，伦敦韦尔科姆影像神经科学系的杰伊·戈特弗里德和雷·多兰把这项研究又推进了一步：他们测试人们在看到与某种气味相关或不相关的图像时，说出这种气味名称所需的反应时间。

sentences.en: So, they asked them to sniff vanilla and simultaneously showed them either a picture of ice cream or of cheese, while scanning their brains in a fMRI machine.
sentences.zh: 于是他们让受试者闻香草味，同时给他们看冰淇淋或奶酪的图片，并用功能性磁共振成像仪扫描他们的大脑。

sentences.en: People named the smells faster when the picture showed something semantically related to them, and when that happened, a structure called the hippocampus was strongly activated.
sentences.zh: 当图片所示之物与气味在语义上相关时，人们说出气味名称的速度更快，而此时一个叫作海马体的结构被强烈激活。

sentences.en: The researchers’ interpretation was that the hippocampus plays a role in integrating information from the senses--information that the brain then uses to decide what it is perceiving.
sentences.zh: 研究者的解读是，海马体在整合各感觉通道的信息上发挥作用——大脑随后用这些信息来判断自己感知到的是什么。

sentences.en: A FIRE and flood are two of humanity's worst nightmares.
sentences.zh: 火灾与洪水是人类最可怕的两个梦魇。

sentences.en: People have, therefore, always sought to control them.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们一直设法控制它们。

sentences.en: Forest fires are snuffed out quickly.
sentences.zh: 森林火灾被迅速扑灭。

sentences.en: The flow of rivers is regulated by weirs and dams.
sentences.zh: 河流的水量由堰坝加以调节。

sentences.en: At least, that is how it used to be.
sentences.zh: 至少过去是这样。

sentences.en: But foresters have learned that forests need fires to clear out the brush and even to get seeds to germinate.
sentences.zh: 但林业人员已经明白，森林需要火来清除灌丛，甚至需要火才能让种子萌发。

sentences.en: And a similar revelation is now dawning on hydrologists.
sentences.zh: 如今，水文学家也开始领悟到类似的道理。

sentences.en: Rivers – and the ecosystems they support – need floods.
sentences.zh: 河流以及它们所支撑的生态系统，都需要洪水。

sentences.en: That is why a man-made torrent has been surging down the Grand Canyon.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么一股人造洪流一直奔涌于大峡谷之中。

sentences.en: By Thursday, March 6th it was running at full throttle, which was expected to be sustained for 60 hours.
sentences.zh: 到 3 月 6 日星期四，放水已开到最大，预计要持续 60 个小时。

sentences.en: B Floods once raged through the canyon every year.
sentences.zh: 从前，洪水每年都要在峡谷中肆虐一回。

sentences.en: Spring Snow from as far away as Wyoming would melt and swell the Colorado river to a flow that averaged around 1,500 cubic metres (50,000 cubic feet) a second.
sentences.zh: 远至怀俄明州的春季积雪融化，会让科罗拉多河的流量涨到平均每秒约 1500 立方米（5 万立方英尺）。

sentences.en: Every eight years or so, that figure rose to almost 3,000 cubic metres.
sentences.zh: 大约每八年，这个数字会升到近 3000 立方米。

sentences.en: These floods infused the river with sediment, carved its beaches and built its sandbars.
sentences.zh: 这些洪水为河流注入泥沙，冲刷出河滩，堆积起沙洲。

sentences.en: C However, in the four decades since the building of the Glen Canyon dam, just upstream of the Grand Canyon, the only sediment that it has collected has come from tiny, undammed tributaries.
sentences.zh: 然而，自大峡谷上游的格伦峡谷大坝建成以来的四十年里，河流所积聚的泥沙只来自未筑坝的细小支流。

sentences.en: Even that has not been much use as those tributaries are not powerful enough to distribute the sediment in an ecologically valuable way.
sentences.zh: 就连这点泥沙也没多大用处，因为那些支流的力量不足以把泥沙以对生态有价值的方式分布开来。

sentences.en: D This lack of flooding has harmed local wildlife.
sentences.zh: 洪水的缺失伤害了当地野生动物。

sentences.en: The humpback chub, for example, thrived in the rust-red waters of Colorado.
sentences.zh: 例如，驼背亚口鱼曾在科罗拉多河锈红色的水中繁盛一时。

sentences.en: Recently, though, its population has crashed.
sentences.zh: 但近来它的种群数量骤降。

sentences.en: At first sight, it looked as if the reason was that the chub were being eaten by trout introduced for sport fishing in the mid-20th century.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，原因似乎是这种鱼被 20 世纪中叶为休闲垂钓引入的鳟鱼吃掉了。

sentences.en: But trout and chub co-existed until the Glen Canyon dam was built, so something else is going on.
sentences.zh: 但在格伦峡谷大坝建成之前，鳟鱼和驼背亚口鱼一直共存，所以另有原因。

sentences.en: Steve Gloss, of the United States Geological Survey (USGS), reckons that the chub's decline is the result of their losing their most valuable natural defense, Colorado's rusty sediment.
sentences.zh: 美国地质调查局的史蒂夫·格洛斯认为，驼背亚口鱼数量减少，是因为它们失去了最宝贵的天然屏障——科罗拉多河那锈红色的泥沙。

sentences.en: The chub were well adapted to the poor visibility created by the chick, red water which gave the river its name and depended on it to hide from predators.
sentences.zh: 这种鱼很适应浑浊红水造成的低能见度，河流之名正来源于这红水，而它们正是靠这浑水躲避捕食者。

sentences.en: Without the cloudy water, the chub became vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 没有了浑浊的河水，驼背亚口鱼就变得脆弱。

sentences.en: E And the chub are not alone.
sentences.zh: 而且遭殃的不只是驼背亚口鱼。

sentences.en: In the years since the Glen Canyon dam was built, several species have vanished altogether.
sentences.zh: 格伦峡谷大坝建成后的这些年里，有好几个物种彻底消失了。

sentences.en: These include the Colorado pike-minnow, the razorback sucker and the roundtail chub.
sentences.zh: 其中包括科罗拉多梭鲈鲤、锐背亚口鱼和圆尾亚口鱼。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, aliens including fathead minnows, channel catfish and common carp, which would have been hard, put to survive in the savage waters of the undammed canyon, have moved in.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，肥头鲦、斑点叉尾鮰和鲤鱼等外来物种迁入了；在未筑坝时那湍急凶险的峡谷水流中，它们本来很难存活。

sentences.en: F So flooding is the obvious answer.
sentences.zh: 因此，放洪是显而易见的办法。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it is easier said than done.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: Floods were sent down the Grand Canyon in 1996 and 2004 and the results were mixed.
sentences.zh: 1996 年和 2004 年都曾向大峡谷放过洪水，结果好坏参半。

sentences.en: In 1996 the flood was allowed to go on too long.
sentences.zh: 1996 年那次放水时间太长。

sentences.en: To start with, all seemed well.
sentences.zh: 起初，一切似乎都很顺利。

sentences.en: The floodwaters built up sandbanks and infused the river with sediment.
sentences.zh: 洪水堆起了沙洲，也为河流注入了泥沙。

sentences.en: Eventually, however, the continued flow washed most of the sediment out of the canyon.
sentences.zh: 然而到最后，持续的水流又把大部分泥沙冲出了峡谷。

sentences.en: This problem was avoided in 2004, but unfortunately, on that occasion, the volume of sand available behind the dam was too low to rebuild the sandbanks.
sentences.zh: 2004 年避免了这个问题，但可惜那一次坝后可用的沙量太少，不足以重建沙洲。

sentences.en: This time, the USGS is convinced that things will be better.
sentences.zh: 这一次，美国地质调查局确信情况会更好。

sentences.en: The amount of sediment available is three times greater than it was in 2004.
sentences.zh: 可用泥沙的数量是 2004 年的三倍。

sentences.en: So if a flood is going to do some good, this is the time to unleash one.
sentences.zh: 所以如果放洪真能带来好处，现在正是放水的时候。

sentences.en: G Even so, it may turn out to be an empty gesture.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这也可能只是一场徒劳的姿态。

sentences.en: At less than 1,200 cubic metres a second, this flood is smaller than even an average spring flood, let alone one of the mightier deluges of the past.
sentences.zh: 这次洪水的流量不到每秒 1200 立方米，比一场普通的春汛还小，更别提过去那些更为浩大的洪流了。

sentences.en: Those glorious inundations moved massive quantities of sediment through the Grand Canyon, wiping the slate dirty, and making a muddy mess of silt and muck that would make modern river rafters cringe.
sentences.zh: 那些壮观的泛滥曾把巨量泥沙推过大峡谷，把一切重新弄得浑浊不堪，留下淤泥与污泥混成的一片泥泞——那景象会让今天的漂流客直皱眉头。

sentences.en: A Jethro Tull was a major pioneer in the modernisation of agriculture.
sentences.zh: 杰思罗·塔尔是农业现代化的一位重要先驱。

sentences.en: He was born in 1674 in Berkshire, southern England, into a family of land-owning gentry.
sentences.zh: 他 1674 年生于英格兰南部伯克郡一个拥有土地的乡绅家庭。

sentences.en: He studied first at Oxford University and then at the Inns of Court, London, in preparation for a legal or political career.
sentences.zh: 他先在牛津大学求学，后又进入伦敦的律师学院，为从事法律或政治事业做准备。

sentences.en: However, ill health caused him to postpone these plans, and after qualifying as a barrister in 1699, he made a tour of Europe, in the hope that the milder climates of France and Italy would alleviate his breathing problems.
sentences.zh: 然而健康不佳迫使他推迟了这些计划；1699 年取得出庭律师资格后，他游历欧洲，希望法国和意大利较为温和的气候能缓解他的呼吸问题。

sentences.en: In every country through which he passed, he made careful observations of the soil and agricultural production, and on his return to England, the young Tull married, then began farming with his father at Howberry Farm in Oxfordshire.
sentences.zh: 每到一国，他都仔细观察当地的土壤和农业生产；回到英格兰后，年轻的塔尔成了家，随后与父亲一起在牛津郡的豪伯里农场务农。

sentences.en: B Tull was determined to improve farming methods and increase crop yield on the family land, and pursued a number of agricultural experiments there.
sentences.zh: 塔尔决心改进耕作方法、提高自家田地的产量，并在那里做了许多农业试验。

sentences.en: He particularly wanted to increase efficiency in the sowing of seeds.
sentences.zh: 他尤其想提高播种的效率。

sentences.en: At that time seeds were still thrown by hand across the field in a haphazard manner, in a traditional method known as broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 当时播种仍然是用手把种子随意撒遍田间，这种传统做法叫作撒播。

sentences.en: Tull soon realised this method of random distribution was inefficient, being wasteful of both seed and labour, so he instructed his staff to sow seeds at very precise, low densities.
sentences.zh: 塔尔很快意识到这种随机撒播的方式效率低下，既浪费种子又浪费人工，于是他吩咐雇工按很精确的低密度播种。

sentences.en: But by 1701, his frustration with their lack of co-operation prompted him to invent a machine to do the work for him.
sentences.zh: 但到 1701 年，雇工的不配合让他备感沮丧，促使他发明一台机器来替自己干这活。

sentences.en: C Earlier in his life, Tull had once dismantled a pipe-organ, and the application of the technology behind this musical instrument inspired him to devise a drill that would distribute precise amounts of seed into pre-cut channels.
sentences.zh: 早年间，塔尔曾拆解过一台管风琴，把这件乐器背后的技术加以应用，启发他设计出一种条播机，能把精确数量的种子送入预先开好的沟槽。

sentences.en: Basic seeding devices had been known for almost 2000 years, but Tull took the concept a stage further.
sentences.zh: 简单的播种装置已有近 2000 年的历史，但塔尔把这一构想又向前推进了一步。

sentences.en: In his device, as the main wheels of the drill turned, the cylinder rotated against a spring-held tongue.
sentences.zh: 在他的装置中，随着条播机主轮转动，圆筒会抵着一片弹簧压住的舌片旋转。

sentences.en: This allowed seed to pass evenly from the hopper above to a funnel below.
sentences.zh: 这样，种子就能从上方的种斗均匀地落入下方的漏斗。

sentences.en: From here, the seed was directed at regular intervals into three channels, or furrows, in the earth.
sentences.zh: 从这里，种子被按固定间隔送入地里的三条沟槽即犁沟中。

sentences.en: These were dug to a specific depth by the blades at the front of the machine.
sentences.zh: 这些沟槽由机器前部的刀片按特定深度开出。

sentences.en: Spikes at the back of the machine then turned the soil over to immediately cover the seeds.
sentences.zh: 机器后部的尖齿随即翻起泥土，立刻把种子覆盖住。

sentences.en: Tull's 'seed drill' would limit the wastage of seed, and as the seedlings grew in uniform rows, it would also make it easier to remove any unwanted weeds growing among the crop.
sentences.zh: 塔尔的“条播机”能减少种子浪费；由于幼苗成整齐的行列生长，清除混在作物中的杂草也更容易。

sentences.en: Accordingly, each plant would have more space to grow, and although there would be fewer plants, the net yield would be greater.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，每株作物都有更大的生长空间；虽然株数减少了，净产量却更高。

sentences.en: D Initially the machine was only a limited success, and in 1711 Tull decided to travel around Europe again, both to improve his health and to study agricultural techniques there.
sentences.zh: 起初这台机器只取得有限的成功；1711 年，塔尔决定再次游历欧洲，一来调养身体，二来考察当地的农业技术。

sentences.en: Upon his return in 1714, he perfected both his system and machinery.
sentences.zh: 1714 年归国后，他把自己的体系和机械都完善了。

sentences.en: Following practices he had observed in the vine-growing methods of southern Europe, he used an animal-drawn hoe to turn over and pulverise the earth between the rows.
sentences.zh: 他借鉴在南欧葡萄种植中观察到的做法，用畜力中耕器翻松并打碎行间的泥土。

sentences.en: He wrongly believed that this practice would release enough nutrients in the soil to nourish the crop, and so eliminate the need for manure to be used to fertilise the soil.
sentences.zh: 他错误地相信这种做法能释放出足够的土壤养分来滋养作物，从而不必再用厩肥来肥田。

sentences.en: His experiments were apparently successful, as he did manage to grow wheat in the same field for 13 successive years without the use of manure.
sentences.zh: 他的试验表面上是成功的，因为他确实在同一块田里连续 13 年不施厩肥而种出了小麦。

sentences.en: However, it is more likely that it was the turning over and pulverisation of the soil that cut down on the volume of weeds competing with the seed.
sentences.zh: 不过更可能的原因是，翻土和碎土减少了与作物争养分的杂草数量。

sentences.en: E Tull's complete system eventually proved to be a major influence in the agricultural revolution, and its impact can still be seen in today's methods.
sentences.zh: 塔尔这一整套体系最终被证明对农业革命影响重大，其影响在今天的耕作方法中仍能看到。

sentences.en: Most subsequent drilling and hoeing implements have been either copies of, or improvements upon his inventions, and his modifications to the basic model of the plough continue to be visible in modern versions.
sentences.zh: 后来的条播和中耕农具大多要么是他发明的仿制品，要么是在其基础上的改进，而他对基本犁型所作的改动在现代犁具上依然可见。

sentences.en: Tull also advocated the use of horses over the oxen, more traditionally used to pull farm machinery, and published a book in 1731 outlining this and other ideas to enhance agricultural efficiency.
sentences.zh: 塔尔还提倡用马取代传统上用来拉农机的牛，并于 1731 年出版了一本书，阐述这一主张以及其他提高农业效率的构想。

sentences.en: The book caused great controversy when it appeared, and resistance to his revolutionary theories persisted for many decades.
sentences.zh: 这本书问世时引发极大争议，对他革命性理论的抵触持续了数十年之久。

sentences.en: Another century would pass before his eventual vindication.
sentences.zh: 又过了一个世纪，他才终于得以正名。

sentences.en: It was only following the editing of his writings in 1822, and the subsequent translations and acceptance in France, that Tull's ideas finally achieved recognition in his native land.
sentences.zh: 直到 1822 年他的著作被重新编订，随后被译介到法国并获得接受，塔尔的思想才终于在故土得到认可。

sentences.en: Although in his lifetime Tull's methods and inventions were dismissed and ridiculed, they were gradually adopted by large landowners, and in time, came to form the basis of modern agriculture.
sentences.zh: 尽管塔尔的方法和发明在其生前遭到轻视与嘲笑，它们还是逐渐被大地主采用，并最终成为现代农业的基础。

sentences.en: A Studies from numerous countries suggest that IQ scores have been rising fast since at least the 1950s - enough to mean that someone with an IQ classed as average at that time could be labelled as having low Intelligence today.
sentences.zh: 来自许多国家的研究表明，至少自 20 世纪 50 年代以来智商分数一直在快速上升——升幅之大，意味着当年被归为中等智商的人，今天可能会被贴上智力偏低的标签。

sentences.en: However, psychologists disagree about what the upward trend in scores really means.
sentences.zh: 然而，心理学家对于分数的这种上升趋势究竟意味着什么并无共识。

sentences.en: Some researchers argue that people are not getting more intelligent overall, but just getting better at a particular sort of problem solving.
sentences.zh: 有些研究者认为，人们的智力整体上并没有提高，只是在某一类问题解决上变得更擅长而已。

sentences.en: Others say they have found echoes of rising IQ scores in 'real world' measures of intelligence.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则说，他们在衡量智力的“现实世界”指标中也发现了智商上升的回响。

sentences.en: To confuse things still more, there are hints that the trend may be about to grind to a halt.
sentences.zh: 更令人困惑的是，有迹象显示这一趋势可能即将停滞。

sentences.en: B James Flynn, a professor of political science, first showed that IQ scores were rising in the mid-1980s, and became famous after others dubbed the pattern he had observed the 'Flynn effect.
sentences.zh: 政治学教授詹姆斯·弗林在 20 世纪 80 年代中期首次指出智商分数正在上升，后来别人把他观察到的这一现象称为“弗林效应”，他也因此出名。

sentences.en: In a landmark paper he made detailed comparisons across fourteen countries of trends in the results of tests that measure reasoning power.
sentences.zh: 在一篇里程碑式的论文中，他详细比较了十四个国家在推理能力测验成绩上的变化趋势。

sentences.en: Overall, these showed a real growth in scores of up to 25 points in a generation.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这些数据显示一代人之内分数实实在在地上升了多达 25 分。

sentences.en: To find out more, Flynn went on to look at scores for each type of reasoning that IQ tests set out to measure, such as verbal, numerical and visuo-spatial.
sentences.zh: 为了解得更多，弗林接着考察了智商测验所要测量的各类推理的分数，例如语言推理、数字推理和视觉空间推理。

sentences.en: This last test category usually includes 'Raven's matrices' - sequential patterns with one piece missing.
sentences.zh: 最后这一类测验通常包含“瑞文推理矩阵”——缺了一块的连续图形序列。

sentences.en: The candidate has to choose, from a set of alternatives, which shape to put in the empty space.
sentences.zh: 应试者必须从一组备选图形中选出应当填入空缺处的那一个。

sentences.en: When Flynn took a closer look at the scores, the pattern was clear.
sentences.zh: 弗林更仔细地审视这些分数后，规律就很清楚了。

sentences.en: The strongest gains in almost every case were on Raven's matrices and similar tests, while verbal and arithmetical scores showed more modest rises.
sentences.zh: 几乎每一次，涨幅最大的都是瑞文推理矩阵及类似测验，而语言和算术分数的上升则要温和得多。

sentences.en: Since presenting his original paper, Flynn has looked at data from further countries and found the same upward trend, with the same skills responsible for most of the increase.
sentences.zh: 自最初那篇论文发表以来，弗林又考察了更多国家的数据，发现了同样的上升趋势，而且增长大多同样来自这几项能力。

sentences.en: C Flynn feels that his eponymous effect is meaningful, but does not interpret it as evidence that people are becoming cleverer.
sentences.zh: 弗林认为以他命名的这一效应是有意义的，但并不把它解读为人们变得更聪明的证据。

sentences.en: Our grandparents were not retarded and we are not geniuses, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们的祖辈并不迟钝，我们也不是天才。

sentences.en: More likely we have simply developed the skills and habits of mind that make us better at solving abstract problems, and - just as importantly - we take such problems seriously.
sentences.zh: 更可能的情况是，我们只是发展出了让自己更擅长解决抽象问题的技能和思维习惯，而且同样重要的是，我们把这类问题当回事。

sentences.en: Flynn believes that demands of visuo-spatial abilities have grown because of TV, computers and cars, and also that in societies where intelligence has become something people focus on excessively abstract problem-solving skills develop faster than other skills.
sentences.zh: 弗林认为，由于电视、计算机和汽车的普及，对视觉空间能力的需求增加了；他还认为，在那些人们过度关注智力的社会里，抽象问题解决能力的发展会快于其他能力。

sentences.en: D Others have different views about what might account for the increase in IQ scores.
sentences.zh: 关于智商分数上升的原因，另一些人持不同看法。

sentences.en: John Rust of the University of London suggests that it is not just an increase in visuo-spatial activities that is pushing up IQ scores.
sentences.zh: 伦敦大学的约翰·拉斯特认为，推高智商分数的不只是视觉空间活动的增加。

sentences.en: He believes that there are several factors, including the fact that, in more complex societies, people have to think harder to find solutions to problems they face.
sentences.zh: 他相信其中有若干因素，包括在更复杂的社会里，人们必须更费脑筋才能为面临的问题找到解决办法。

sentences.en: He also points out that if just one mind grasps a new concept, such as Einstein and the theory of relativity, it may then be easier for society in general to think in a more complex way.
sentences.zh: 他还指出，只要有一个头脑掌握了某个新概念，比如爱因斯坦与相对论，整个社会之后就可能更容易以更复杂的方式思考。

sentences.en: Others, such as experimental psychologist Robert Howard, argue that overall Intelligence really has risen, helped by better nutrition, smaller families, wider access to education and other environmental changes.
sentences.zh: 实验心理学家罗伯特·霍华德等人则认为，在更好的营养、更小的家庭规模、更广泛的受教育机会以及其他环境变化的助推下，整体智力确实提高了。

sentences.en: E Howard's latest research has sent him on a different line of enquiry.
sentences.zh: 霍华德最新的研究把他带上了另一条探究路线。

sentences.en: Controversially, he now believes that the rise in IQ scores might have peaked in industrialised countries.
sentences.zh: 他如今提出了一个颇有争议的观点：智商分数的上升在工业化国家可能已经见顶。

sentences.en: To support this view, he cites data from Denmark.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一看法，他引用了来自丹麦的数据。

sentences.en: The Danish military still summons virtually all young men before a draft board to identify who is suitable to do military service.
sentences.zh: 丹麦军方至今仍会把几乎所有年轻男性召到征兵委员会面前，以确定谁适合服兵役。

sentences.en: Since 1957, all 17-year-olds there have taken exactly the same qualifying IQ tests - including ones similar to Raven's matrices.
sentences.zh: 自 1957 年以来，那里所有 17 岁的人都参加完全相同的资格智商测验，其中包括与瑞文推理矩阵类似的题目。

sentences.en: Candidates must also be able to answer verbal questions such as 'Sun is to day as Moon is to ?', and number-series questions such as '2, 3, 5, 8, ?'.
sentences.zh: 应试者还必须能回答语言类题目，比如“太阳之于白天，正如月亮之于？”，以及数列类题目，比如“2、3、5、8、？”。

sentences.en: Results in these tests have been carefully analysed by Thomas Teasdale, a neuropsychologist.
sentences.zh: 神经心理学家托马斯·蒂斯代尔对这些测验结果作了仔细分析。

sentences.en: He found that during the 1960s and '70s, scores showed gains on a scale similar to those of other countries, but by the 1990s the rate of Improvement had slowed right down to about one IQ point over the decade.
sentences.zh: 他发现，在 20 世纪 60 年代和 70 年代，分数上升的幅度与其他国家相仿，但到了 90 年代，提升速度已大幅放缓，十年间只涨了约 1 分。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the scores were improving only on the visuo-spatial questions; verbal and numerical performance was flattening out.
sentences.zh: 而且，分数只在视觉空间题目上有所提高；语言和数字方面的表现正趋于平缓。

sentences.en: Most intriguingly, however, scores from 1999 onwards show an overall downturn.
sentences.zh: 然而最耐人寻味的是，1999 年以后的分数显示出整体下滑。

sentences.en: One explanation might be that there is some absolute ceiling to people's abilities to perform these tasks, no matter how much the prevailing culture encourages them.
sentences.zh: 一种解释可能是，无论主流文化如何鼓励，人们完成这些任务的能力都存在某个绝对上限。

sentences.en: However, as Teasdale points out, if such a ceiling had been reached, the test results should show scores pushing against it rather than actually falling.
sentences.zh: 不过蒂斯代尔指出，如果真的触及了这样的上限，测验结果应当显示分数在顶住上限，而不是实际下降。

sentences.en: F Flynn is keeping a close eye on the findings, but is not jumping to conclusions until data from other countries is available.
sentences.zh: 弗林密切关注这些发现，但在拿到其他国家的数据之前不急于下结论。

sentences.en: However, he does wonder whether the conditions leading to dramatic improvements in mental ability disappear as societies become more prosperous.
sentences.zh: 不过他确实在想，随着社会日益富裕，那些导致心智能力大幅提升的条件是否会消失。

sentences.en: He points out that in human history, prosperity often led to decadence, and argues that the case of ancient Rome can be viewed as an illustration of this.
sentences.zh: 他指出，在人类历史上，富足常常导致颓靡，并认为古罗马的例子可以看作这方面的一个写照。

sentences.en: A The way we think about architecture in schools has come along way.
sentences.zh: 我们看待学校中建筑课程的方式已经走过了很长一段路。

sentences.en: Once, studying architecture in the art class meant learning to appreciate great buildings art-history style, through slide presentations.
sentences.zh: 从前，在美术课上学习建筑意味着通过幻灯片演示，以艺术史的方式去欣赏伟大的建筑。

sentences.en: In recent years, though, the American Institute of Architects has fostered the idea that the process of architectural design, not just the appreciation of architecture, is a beneficial aspect of the art curriculum (Sadler, 1989).
sentences.zh: 不过近年来，美国建筑师学会推动了这样一种观念：建筑设计的过程本身，而不只是对建筑的欣赏，才是美术课程中有益的一环（萨德勒，1989）。

sentences.en: B The value of architectural design is that it is the concrete training ground for a broadly applicable creative process.
sentences.zh: 建筑设计的价值在于，它是一种适用面很广的创造性过程的具体训练场。

sentences.en: Architectural training can help people design structures to meet needs.
sentences.zh: 建筑训练可以帮助人们设计出满足需求的结构。

sentences.en: It can help farmers design crop rotations to meet needs.
sentences.zh: 它也可以帮助农民设计出满足需求的轮作方案。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it provides hands-on experiences that reinforce learning in various other subjects, from math to social studies.
sentences.zh: 此外，它提供动手实践的经验，能强化从数学到社会研究等多门其他学科的学习。

sentences.en: C In the ongoing dialogue about architecture in the middle school art curriculum, many believe students should actually build the structures they design in their courses.
sentences.zh: 在关于中学美术课程中建筑教学的持续讨论中，许多人认为学生应当真正把自己在课上设计的结构建造出来。

sentences.en: Although the technology and expertise required of modern architecture can prohibit students from actually realizing their designs, traditional architectural materials and methods remain quite accessible to the art classroom.
sentences.zh: 尽管现代建筑所需的技术和专业知识可能使学生无法真正实现自己的设计，传统建筑材料和方法对美术课堂而言仍然相当易得。

sentences.en: Traditional architectural materials, such as earth, clay and straw, are cheap, easy to work with and readily available.
sentences.zh: 泥土、黏土和稻草等传统建筑材料价格低廉、易于加工，而且随手可得。

sentences.en: Further, when students participate in the construction or preservation of a traditional earthen structure in their local community, they engage in a form of experiential learning and they are motivated to invest in the project.
sentences.zh: 再者，当学生参与建造或保护本地社区的一座传统土坯建筑时，他们进行的是一种体验式学习，并会有动力投入到项目中去。

sentences.en: This is evident in a case study of an adobe* conservation project with middle school students in the town of Zuni, New Mexico, in the Southwestern United States.
sentences.zh: 这一点在美国西南部新墨西哥州祖尼镇一项与中学生合作的土坯保护项目案例研究中体现得很清楚。

sentences.en: D Traditional architecture reaches back to preindustrial America, when local resources and cultures produced structures in styles unique to each region.
sentences.zh: 传统建筑可以追溯到工业化之前的美国，当时本地的资源与文化造就了各地独有风格的建筑。

sentences.en: In New Mexico, examples of hand-built earthen structures still abound.
sentences.zh: 在新墨西哥州，手工建造的土质建筑实例至今随处可见。

sentences.en: The region has seen some decline in traditional architecture as industrialization has brought new building codes and materials; however, the traditional, non-industrial home, either preserved from earlier generations or newly built, remains in use.
sentences.zh: 随着工业化带来新的建筑规范和材料，这一地区的传统建筑有所式微；然而，无论是自早年保存下来的还是新建的传统非工业化住宅，都仍在使用。

sentences.en: Traditional building materials and the land that supplies them are so accessible that handcrafting a house still remains feasible.
sentences.zh: 传统建筑材料以及提供这些材料的土地都非常易得，手工建造一栋房子至今仍然可行。

sentences.en: E Thus, with no technical expertise and little cost, middle school students can participate in the construction or preservation of a traditional earthen structure.
sentences.zh: 因此，中学生无需专业技术、花费也很少，就能参与传统土质建筑的建造或保护。

sentences.en: During the project, a student will get to know the materials, understand the chemistry, solve problems, work with classmates, and exercise muscles.
sentences.zh: 在项目过程中，学生会熟悉材料、理解其中的化学原理、解决问题、与同学协作，并锻炼肌肉。

sentences.en: The student can apply knowledge of design principles and the creative process while participating in a cooperative effort.
sentences.zh: 学生可以在参与协作的同时，运用有关设计原则和创造性过程的知识。

sentences.en: But most significantly, this type of project-based activity motivates students to invest intellectually and emotionally in the outcome.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，这类基于项目的活动能激励学生在智力和情感上都投入到成果中去。

sentences.en: F The town of Zuni, where I taught art, was surrounded by adobe construction, new and old.
sentences.zh: 我教美术的祖尼镇，四周环绕着新旧不一的土坯建筑。

sentences.en: Behind our main high school building there was a one-room adobe structure which was once used for teaching.
sentences.zh: 在我们高中主楼后面有一座单间的土坯建筑，曾经用于教学。

sentences.en: Now it served as a place where old furniture could be kept.
sentences.zh: 如今它成了存放旧家具的地方。

sentences.en: I sent my class home with the oral history assignment to ask their family, friends and neighbors questions to find out about that building.
sentences.zh: 我给全班布置了一项口述史作业，让他们回家去问家人、朋友和邻居，弄清那座建筑的来历。

sentences.en: From their research we compiled a sketchy history: it began as a kindergarten classroom; it later became an art classroom; now it was full of broken desks.
sentences.zh: 根据他们的调查，我们拼凑出一段粗略的历史：它最初是一间幼儿园教室；后来变成美术教室；如今堆满了破课桌。

sentences.en: G The building's design kept it relatively warm in the winter, even without heating, due to its broad south face, and it stayed cool in the summer due to its spacious, ventilated attic and massive earthen walls.
sentences.zh: 由于南向面宽阔，这座建筑即使不供暖，冬天也相对温暖；又因为阁楼宽敞通风、土墙厚重，夏天也保持凉爽。

sentences.en: Because of this, my students agreed it was worth preserving and were enthusiastic about helping.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我的学生一致认为它值得保护，并热心地想要出力。

sentences.en: Preservationist Shalie Gasper arrived in the fall to help with an assessment of the building's needs.
sentences.zh: 保护专家沙莉·加斯珀在秋天到来，协助评估这座建筑的修缮需求。

sentences.en: She recommended replacing the stucco** that encased the original adobe walls with a traditional mud plaster.
sentences.zh: 她建议把包覆在原有土坯墙外的水泥灰泥换成传统的泥灰。

sentences.en: She showed us where to find local supplies of sand and clay soil for the plaster mix.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们到哪里能找到本地的沙子和黏土，用来调配灰泥。

sentences.en: We began work on the stucco removal in late fall.
sentences.zh: 我们在深秋开始铲除水泥灰泥的工作。

sentences.en: The next spring the students were ready to replaster.
sentences.zh: 到了第二年春天，学生们已准备好重新抹灰。

sentences.en: To teach the traditional skills, Gasper and other local specialists joined us.
sentences.zh: 为了教授传统技艺，加斯珀和其他本地专家加入了我们。

sentences.en: They gave my class three full mornings of intensive workshops on history and preservation as well as mud-plastering technique, and the building got a new coat of traditional mud plaster.
sentences.zh: 他们为我的班级上了整整三个上午的密集工作坊，内容涵盖历史与保护以及抹泥灰的技法，这座建筑也披上了一层新的传统泥灰。

sentences.en: H Small design-and-build projects such as this can be seen through to the finish when working with earth in the art curriculum.
sentences.zh: 在美术课程中与泥土打交道时，像这样的小型设计建造项目是可以从头做到尾的。

sentences.en: A simple landscape feature such as a wall, entryway, or arch can draw students into important aspects of design that involve the structure's interaction with people, the surrounding landscape, and natural elements.
sentences.zh: 一堵墙、一个门廊或一道拱门这样简单的景观构件，就能把学生引入设计中的重要方面，涉及建筑与人、与周边景观以及与自然要素之间的互动。

sentences.en: The same project may provide an opportunity to focus on the chemistry of soil or the structural dynamics of construction.
sentences.zh: 同一个项目还可能提供机会，让学生聚焦于土壤的化学性质或建造中的结构力学。

sentences.en: Design goals might guide students to involve traditional forms, consider formal aspects, or integrate math skills of measuring and estimating.
sentences.zh: 设计目标可以引导学生采用传统形式、考虑形式方面的问题，或者融入测量和估算的数学技能。

sentences.en: I During our traditional architecture unit, the students realized that something old and almost forgotten is valuable and worth preserving.
sentences.zh: 在我们的传统建筑单元中，学生们意识到，一些古老且几近被遗忘的东西是有价值、值得保护的。

sentences.en: Many others in the community and around the country share this renewal of interest in traditional earthen technologies.
sentences.zh: 社区里以及全国各地还有许多人同样重新燃起了对传统土质建造技术的兴趣。

sentences.en: It is the connection to a cultural heritage that interests some; the quality of living within massive, natural walls that attracts others; or for others, the sustainability of the process and the minimal energy spent in construction.
sentences.zh: 有人感兴趣的是与文化遗产之间的联系；有人被厚重天然墙体内的居住品质所吸引；对另一些人来说，则是这一过程的可持续性以及建造中极低的能耗。

sentences.en: The value of adobe in general is becoming more and more known, but little has been said about its value in the art curriculum until now.
sentences.zh: 土坯的整体价值正日益为人所知，但直到现在，关于它在美术课程中的价值却几乎无人提及。

sentences.en: This experiment in adobe conservation with middle school students convinced me that traditional architecture deserves a place in the regular curriculum.
sentences.zh: 这次与中学生合作的土坯保护实践让我确信，传统建筑理应在常规课程中占有一席之地。

sentences.en: (A) The family of mammals called bovids belongs to the Artiodactyl class, which also includes giraffes.
sentences.zh: 被称为牛科的哺乳动物属于偶蹄目，长颈鹿也属于该类群。

sentences.en: Bovids are a highly diverse group consisting of 137 species, some of which are man’s most important domestic animals.
sentences.zh: 牛科是一个高度多样化的类群，包含 137 个物种，其中一些是人类最重要的家畜。

sentences.en: (B) Bovids are well represented in most parts of Eurasia and Southeast Asian islands, but they are by far the most numerous and diverse in the latter.
sentences.zh: 牛科动物在欧亚大陆大部分地区和东南亚岛屿都有广泛分布，但在后者数量最多、种类也最为丰富。

sentences.en: Some species of bovid are solitary, but others live in large groups with complex social structures.
sentences.zh: 有些牛科物种独居，另一些则成大群生活，并具有复杂的社会结构。

sentences.en: Although bovids have adapted to a wide range of habitats, from arctic tundra to deep tropical forest, the majority of species favour open grassland, scrub or desert.
sentences.zh: 尽管牛科动物已适应从北极苔原到热带密林的各种生境，多数物种仍偏好开阔草原、灌丛或荒漠。

sentences.en: This diversity of habitat is also matched by great diversity in size and form: at one extreme is the royal antelope of West Africa, which stands a mere 25 cm at the shoulder; at the other, the massively built bison of North America and Europe, growing to a shoulder height of 2.2m.
sentences.zh: 生境的多样也对应着体型与形态的巨大差异：一端是西非的倭羚，肩高仅 25 厘米；另一端是体格壮硕的北美和欧洲野牛，肩高可达 2.2 米。

sentences.en: (C) Despite differences in size and appearance, bovids are united by the possession of certain common features.
sentences.zh: 尽管体型和外貌各异，牛科动物仍因具备某些共同特征而归为一类。

sentences.en: All species are ruminants, which means that they retain undigested food in their stomachs, and regurgitate it as necessary.
sentences.zh: 所有物种都是反刍动物，也就是说它们会把未消化的食物留在胃中，并在需要时反刍上来。

sentences.en: Bovids are almost exclusively herbivorous.
sentences.zh: 牛科动物几乎完全以植物为食。

sentences.en: Typically, their teeth are highly modified for browsing and grazing: grass or foliage is cropped with the upper lip and lower incisors (the upper incisors are usually absent), and then ground down by the cheek teeth.
sentences.zh: 它们的牙齿通常为采食嫩枝和啃食青草而高度特化：草或叶片先由上唇和下门齿切断（上门齿通常缺失），再由颊齿磨碎。

sentences.en: As well as having cloven, or split hooves, the males of all bovid species and the females of most carry horns.
sentences.zh: 除了具有偶蹄即分趾的蹄之外，所有牛科物种的雄性以及多数物种的雌性都长角。

sentences.en: Bovid horns have bony cores covered in a sheath of horny material that is constantly renewed from within; they are unbranched and never shed.
sentences.zh: 牛科动物的角以骨质为芯，外覆角质鞘，角质由内部不断更新；角不分叉，也从不脱落。

sentences.en: They vary in shape and size: the relatively simple horns of a large Indian buffalo may measure around 4 m from tip to tip along the outer curve, while the various gazelles have horns with a variety of elegant curves.
sentences.zh: 角的形状和大小各不相同：大型印度水牛那种相对简单的角，沿外弯从一端到另一端可达约 4 米，而各种瞪羚的角则呈现出多样而优雅的弧线。

sentences.en: (D) Five groups, or sub-families, may be distinguished: Bovinae, Antelope, Caprinae, Cephalophinae and Antilocapridae.
sentences.zh: 可以区分出五个类群或亚科：牛亚科、羚羊类、羊亚科、麂羚亚科和叉角羚科。

sentences.en: The sub-family Bovinae comprises most of the larger bovids, including the African bongo, nilgai, eland, bison and cattle.
sentences.zh: 牛亚科包含体型较大的多数牛科动物，其中有非洲的紫羚、蓝牛羚、大羚羊、野牛和家牛。

sentences.en: Unlike most other bovids, they are all non-territorial.
sentences.zh: 与其他多数牛科动物不同，它们都不占据领域。

sentences.en: The ancestors of the various species of domestic cattle (such as banteng, gaur, yak and water buffalo) are generally rare and endangered in the wild, while the auroch (the ancestor of the domestic cattle of Europe) is extinct.
sentences.zh: 各种家养牛的祖先（如爪哇野牛、印度野牛、牦牛和水牛）在野外普遍稀少且濒危，而原牛（欧洲家牛的祖先）已经灭绝。

sentences.en: (E) The term ‘antelope’ is not a very precise zoological name – it is used to loosely describe a number of bovids that have followed different lines of development.
sentences.zh: “羚羊”这个词并不是一个很精确的动物学名称——它被宽泛地用来指称若干沿不同演化路线发展的牛科动物。

sentences.en: Antelopes are typically long-legged, fast-running species, often with long horns that may be laid along the back when the animal is in full flight.
sentences.zh: 羚羊通常四肢修长、奔跑迅速，往往长着长角，全速奔逃时角可以贴伏在背上。

sentences.en: There are two main sub-groups of antelope: Hippotraginae, which includes the oryx and the addax, and Antilopinae, which generally contains slighter and more graceful animals such as gazelle and the springbok.
sentences.zh: 羚羊主要分为两个亚类群：马羚亚科，包含长角羚和旋角羚；以及羚羊亚科，其成员一般更为纤细优雅，如瞪羚和跳羚。

sentences.en: Antelopes are mainly grassland species, but many have adapted to flooded grasslands: pukus, waterbucks and lechwes are all good at swimming, usually feeding in deep water, while the sitatunga has long, splayed hooves that enable it to walk freely on swampy ground.
sentences.zh: 羚羊主要是草原物种，但许多种类已适应季节性淹水的草地：普库羚、水羚和驴羚都擅长游泳，通常在深水中取食，而沼泽羚长着修长而张开的蹄，使它能在沼泽地上自如行走。

sentences.en: (F) The sub-family Caprinae includes the sheep and the goat, together with various relatives such as the goral and the tahr.
sentences.zh: 羊亚科包含绵羊和山羊，以及斑羚、塔尔羊等各种近亲。

sentences.en: Most are woolly or have long hair.
sentences.zh: 多数种类被覆羊毛或长毛。

sentences.en: Several species, such as wild goats, chamois and ibex, are agile cliff and mountain-dwellers.
sentences.zh: 有几个物种，如野山羊、岩羚羊和北山羊，是敏捷的崖壁与高山栖居者。

sentences.en: Tolerance of extreme conditions is most marked in this group: barbary and bighorn sheep have adapted to arid deserts, while Rocky Mountain sheep survive high up in mountains and musk oxen in arctic tundra.
sentences.zh: 对极端条件的耐受在这一类群中最为突出：巴巴里羊和大角羊已适应干旱荒漠，落基山大角羊能在高山上生存，麝牛则生活在北极苔原。

sentences.en: (G) The duiker of Africa belongs to the Cephalophinae sub-family.
sentences.zh: 非洲的麂羚属于麂羚亚科。

sentences.en: It is generally small and solitary, often living in thick forest.
sentences.zh: 它一般体型小、独居，常栖息在茂密森林中。

sentences.en: Although mainly feeding on grass and leaves, some duikers – unlike most other bovids – are believed to eat insects and feed on dead animal carcasses, and even to kill small animals.
sentences.zh: 虽然主要取食青草和树叶，但据信有些麂羚——与其他多数牛科动物不同——会吃昆虫、取食动物尸体，甚至捕杀小型动物。

sentences.en: (H) The pronghorn is the sole survivor of a New World sub-family of herbivorous ruminants, the Antilocapridae in North America.
sentences.zh: 叉角羚是新大陆一个草食性反刍亚类群即北美叉角羚科的唯一幸存者。

sentences.en: It is similar in appearance and habits to the Old World antelope.
sentences.zh: 它在外貌和习性上都与旧大陆的羚羊相似。

sentences.en: Although greatly reduced in numbers since the arrival of Europeans, and the subsequent enclosure of grasslands, the pronghorn is still found in considerable numbers throughout North America, from Washington State to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 尽管自欧洲人到来以及随后草原被围圈以来数量大减，叉角羚在北美各地仍有相当数量，从华盛顿州一直分布到墨西哥。

sentences.en: When alarmed by the approach of wolves or other predators, hairs on the pronghorn’s rump stand erect, so showing and emphasising the white patch there.
sentences.zh: 当狼或其他捕食者靠近而受到惊动时，叉角羚臀部的毛会竖起，从而显露并突出那里的白色斑块。

sentences.en: At this signal, the whole herd gallops off at speed of over 60 km per hour.
sentences.zh: 收到这个信号，整群叉角羚便以每小时超过 60 公里的速度疾驰而去。
