sentences.en: (A) At 2 a.m. on 18 July, 2011, inhabitants of the Drâa valley in southern Morocco witnessed a ball of fire streak across the sky, followed by a series of sonic booms.
sentences.zh: 2011年7月18日凌晨2点，摩洛哥南部Drâa山谷的居民目睹一团火球划过天空，随后是一连串的音爆。

sentences.en: Scientists soon established that this was a meteorite, and what's more, that it came from Mars.
sentences.zh: 科学家很快确定这是一块陨石，而且它还来自火星。

sentences.en: Such meteorites fall to Earth extremely infrequently and the Moroccan meteorite — which was named Tissint after a village near where it landed — was particularly exciting because of the excellent condition it was in. 'It's as if it was blast[ed] off Mars yesterday,' says Dr Caroline Smith, Meteorite Curator at the Natural History Museum in London, where the largest Tissint fragment is now located.
sentences.zh: 这类陨石极少坠落到地球，而这颗摩洛哥陨石——它以坠落点附近一座村庄的名字被命名为Tissint——因保存状态极佳而格外令人兴奋。伦敦自然历史博物馆的陨石策展人Caroline Smith博士说：“它就好像是昨天才从火星上被炸飞下来似的。”目前最大的Tissint碎片正收藏于该博物馆。

sentences.en: But the institution's path to purchasing the fragment embodies some of the oddities of the international meteorite market.
sentences.zh: 但该机构购买这块碎片的历程，恰恰体现了国际陨石市场的种种怪异之处。

sentences.en: (B) As our sole source of non-microscopic space material, meteorites have much to teach us.
sentences.zh: 作为我们获取非微观太空物质的唯一来源，陨石有许多可以教给我们的东西。

sentences.en: 'We're still building a catalogue of everything that's out there,' says Dr Ralph P.
sentences.zh: “关于外太空的一切，我们仍在编制一份目录，”Ralph P.博士说。

sentences.en: Harvey, a geologist at Case Western Reserve University in the USA.
sentences.zh: Harvey是美国凯斯西储大学的一名地质学家。

sentences.en: 'Meteorite science is where biology was 200 years ago with people saying, "Oh, here's a strange, long-necked beast, I wonder if it's related to the turtle?"'
sentences.zh: “陨石科学正处在生物学200年前所处的阶段，人们会说：‘哦，这是一只奇怪的长颈野兽，不知道它和乌龟有没有亲缘关系？’”

sentences.en: Yet scientists don't necessarily get first choice of the meteorites that plummet to Earth.
sentences.zh: 然而，科学家未必能优先挑选坠落到地球上的陨石。

sentences.en: 'There is a market out there that treats these [meteorites] as collectibles, almost as though they were fine art,' Dr Harvey explains.
sentences.zh: Harvey博士解释说：“市面上有一个把陨石当作收藏品的市场，几乎把它们当成艺术品来对待。”

sentences.en: The market value of meteorites began to rise in the late 1990s.
sentences.zh: 陨石的市场价值在20世纪90年代末开始上涨。

sentences.en: Some attribute this to the advent of online businesses, which made meteorites easily available to the public.
sentences.zh: 一些人将此归因于网络业务的兴起，这使得公众很容易买到陨石。

sentences.en: But collector Darryl Pitt, curator of the largest collection of meteorites in the world, known as the Macovich Collection, attributes it to several headline-grabbing purchases whose steep prices were unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 但收藏家Darryl Pitt——全球最大的陨石收藏“Macovich Collection”的策展人——则将其归因于几桩占据头条的收购，其高昂的价格前所未有。

sentences.en: At a New York City auction in 1998, a single slice of a meteorite sold for a record-breaking $137,000.
sentences.zh: 在1998年纽约市的一场拍卖会上，一块陨石切片以破纪录的13.7万美元售出。

sentences.en: Weeks later, another meteorite was sold for $97,000.
sentences.zh: 几周后，另一块陨石以9.7万美元售出。

sentences.en: 'Word was being disseminated throughout the world about the high prices that meteorites were attaining,' says Pitt, who put both samples up for sale.
sentences.zh: “陨石正卖出高价的讯息正在全世界传开，”Pitt说，这两件标本正是由他拿出来出售的。

sentences.en: 'This served as a catalyst for a new generation of meteorite hunters.'
sentences.zh: “这成为新一代陨石猎人的催化剂。”

sentences.en: (C) Eric Twelker is an online meteorite retailer who purchases meteorites from dealers around the world.
sentences.zh: Eric Twelker是一名网络陨石销售商，他从世界各地的经销商那里购买陨石。

sentences.en: When asked how he determines the legality of the meteorites he purchases, Twelker pauses.
sentences.zh: 当被问及如何判断自己所购陨石的合法性时，Twelker停顿了一下。

sentences.en: 'There's some degree of concern,' he says.
sentences.zh: “在某种程度上确实存在顾虑，”他说。

sentences.en: 'To a large extent — and I would say this is for dealers and institutions, as well — the question [of legality] isn't asked or it isn't pursued.'
sentences.zh: “在很大程度上——我想说，对经销商和机构来说也是如此——这个问题无人提出，也无人深究。”

sentences.en: The law governing meteorite acquisition is diffuse.
sentences.zh: 与陨石获取相关的法律是分散的。

sentences.en: Every country has its own way of determining meteorite ownership.
sentences.zh: 每个国家都有自己确定陨石归属的方式。

sentences.en: In Switzerland, meteorites are the property of the government — but the finder is compensated with a sum of money suitable to the value of the object.
sentences.zh: 在瑞士，陨石归政府所有——但发现者会得到一笔与该物件价值相称的金钱补偿。

sentences.en: In India, Denmark, and most Australian states, meteorites must be handed over to a museum.
sentences.zh: 在印度、丹麦和澳大利亚的大多数州，陨石必须上交给博物馆。

sentences.en: If you stumble upon a space rock in Japan, however, finders-keepers applies.
sentences.zh: 然而在日本，如果你偶然捡到一块太空岩石，那么谁捡到就归谁。

sentences.en: Twelker acknowledges that many meteorites are 'probably exported illegally', and that some institutions have chosen not to purchase meteorites from certain regions as a result.
sentences.zh: Twelker承认，许多陨石“可能是被非法出口的”，因此一些机构已选择不购买来自某些地区的陨石。

sentences.en: The Natural History Museum, for example, only purchases meteorites that have documentation giving all the relevant details.
sentences.zh: 例如，自然历史博物馆只购买有文件完整载明相关细节的陨石。

sentences.en: 'The institutions that have taken the so-called "principled" point of view have found themselves left in the dust by people who didn't,' says Twelker.
sentences.zh: “那些秉持所谓‘有原则’立场的机构发现，自己已被那些不这么做的人远远甩在身后，”Twelker说。

sentences.en: (D) Yet Twelker insists that the interests of science and private collection are not at odds.
sentences.zh: 不过，Twelker坚持认为，科学与私人收藏的利益并不冲突。

sentences.en: Collectors typically have meteorites listed publicly by the Meteoritical Society in an abstract that describes the sample's geochemical qualities and where it was found on Earth, among other characteristics.
sentences.zh: 收藏者通常会让Meteoritical Society公开登记其陨石，登记摘要会描述样本的地球化学特性、在地球上的发现地点等其他特征。

sentences.en: 'It's basically a label of authenticity,' says Twelker.
sentences.zh: “这基本上是一种真品标识，”Twelker说。

sentences.en: To get listed, collectors have to give a sample to a reputable researcher, who will analyse it free of charge and submit his or her analysis to the Meteoritical Society.
sentences.zh: 要获得登记，收藏者必须把一份样本交给一位有声望的研究人员，后者会免费进行分析，并将其分析结果提交给Meteoritical Society。

sentences.en: 'The availability of meteorites is much greater than when I started this business — and one of the reasons is that there is a major financial incentive to go out and get them,' Twelker points out.
sentences.zh: “如今陨石的获取渠道比我刚开始做这行时多得多——原因之一是，出去寻找陨石有巨大的金钱激励，”Twelker指出。

sentences.en: (E) Approximately 5,000–17,000 meteorites plummet to Earth every year — some the size of a washing machine, some as small as a golf ball.
sentences.zh: 每年约有5000至17000颗陨石坠落到地球——有的像洗衣机那么大，有的则小如高尔夫球。

sentences.en: But when a scientifically valuable example like Tissint lands, institutions must contend with private collectors for the prize.
sentences.zh: 但当像Tissint这样具有科学价值的陨石坠落时，各机构就必须与私人收藏家争夺这一珍宝。

sentences.en: 'We are competing within a commercial market, although we have extremely limited finances,' says Dr Smith.
sentences.zh: “我们是在一个商业市场中竞争，尽管我们的经费极为有限，”Smith博士说。

sentences.en: 'There's a danger in the price hiking of the market.
sentences.zh: “市场价格的不断攀升存在一种危险。

sentences.en: Institutions without much money to purchase things may be priced out.'
sentences.zh: 没有多少资金用于收购的机构可能会被高价挤出市场。”

sentences.en: The Tissint meteorite was sold to the Natural History Museum in the UK by Pitt and Dave Gheesling, another collector.
sentences.zh: Tissint陨石由Pitt和另一位收藏家Dave Gheesling卖给了英国的自然历史博物馆。

sentences.en: 'We could have made a lot more money,' says Pitt.
sentences.zh: “我们本可以赚到多得多的钱，”Pitt说。

sentences.en: 'There are a lot of private collectors in Asia and the Middle East that would have paid far more.'
sentences.zh: “亚洲和中东有很多私人收藏家，他们本愿意出高得多的价钱。”

sentences.en: Asked why he and Gheesling chose to sell it to the museum, Pitt answers: 'There exists a social obligation to make the extraordinary accessible.
sentences.zh: 当被问到他和Gheesling为何选择把它卖给博物馆时，Pitt回答说：“让非凡之物为大众所及是一种社会责任。

sentences.en: I would not have been able to sleep at night knowing that this object was in someone's private vault.'
sentences.zh: 如果知道这件东西躺在某人的私人金库里，我晚上会无法入睡的。”

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the sum exceeded the museum's annual budget.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这笔款项还是超出了该博物馆的年度预算。

sentences.en: Half of the money was put up by an anonymous philanthropist with a keen interest in the museum's collection.
sentences.zh: 其中一半的资金由一位对该博物馆藏品怀有浓厚兴趣的匿名慈善家出资。

sentences.en: Does a reliance on deep-pocketed donors spell doom for the meteorite collections of museums and other educational institutions?
sentences.zh: 依赖财力雄厚的捐赠者，对博物馆及其他教育机构的陨石收藏而言是否意味着厄运？

sentences.en: Dr Smith doesn't think so: 'There are enough good guys out there who are very generous when it comes to selling stones to institutions, or providing material for free.'
sentences.zh: Smith博士不这么认为：“市面上有足够多的好人，他们在向机构出售陨石或免费提供材料时非常慷慨。”

sentences.en: A The difference between companies is people.
sentences.zh: 企业之间的差别在于人。

sentences.en: With capital and technology in plentiful supply, the critical resource for companies in the knowledge era will be human talent.
sentences.zh: 在资本和技术供应充足的情况下，知识时代企业的关键资源将是人才。

sentences.en: Companies full of 'star' achievers will, by definition, outperform organisations without them.
sentences.zh: 充满“明星”式成功者的公司，按定义就会胜过没有他们的组织。

sentences.en: So firms should compete for the most talented people, attract them from other companies, pay them very well, and get rid of second-raters.
sentences.zh: 因此，企业应当争夺最有才华的人，从其他公司把他们挖过来，付给他们非常优厚的报酬，并淘汰二流角色。

sentences.en: This in essence has been the recruitment of the ambitious companies of the past decade, given definitive form by the consultancy McKinsey in the book The War for Talent.
sentences.zh: 这实质上就是过去十年雄心勃勃的公司所奉行的招聘之道，McKinsey咨询公司在《The War for Talent》一书中将其定形。

sentences.en: Although the intensity of the warfare subsequently subsided, it has been warming up again as the economy tightens: labour shortages, for example, are the reason that many governments are welcoming workers from abroad.
sentences.zh: 尽管这场战争的激烈程度随后有所消退，但随着经济趋紧，它又再次升温：例如，劳动力短缺正是许多政府欢迎外国劳工的原因。

sentences.en: B The diagnosis — people are important — is so obvious it scarcely needs saying, but the apparently logical prescription — hire the best — is, like so much in management, profoundly wrong.
sentences.zh: “人很重要”这一诊断显而易见，几乎无需多说，但那个看似合乎逻辑的药方——雇用最优秀的人——却像管理领域的许多东西一样，错得离谱。

sentences.en: The point was illuminated by the collapse of the major American company Enron, whose leaders, as a New Yorker article called 'The Talent Myth' related, were so convinced of their own cleverness that they believed that collective intelligence is the sum of a lot of individual intelligences.
sentences.zh: 美国大公司Enron的崩溃阐明了这一点：正如《New Yorker》一篇题为“The Talent Myth”的文章所述，其领导者对自己的聪明深信不疑，以至于他们相信集体智能就是众多个人智能的总和。

sentences.en: In fact, in a profound sense the two are opposites.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从深层的意义上说，这两者是对立的。

sentences.en: Enron believed in stars, noted author Malcolm Gladwell, because they didn't believe in systems.
sentences.zh: 著名作家Malcolm Gladwell指出，Enron相信明星，是因为他们不相信体系。

sentences.en: But companies don't just create: 'they execute and compete and co-ordinate the efforts of many people, and the organisations that are most successful at that task are the ones where the system is the star'.
sentences.zh: 但公司不只是创造：“它们还要执行、竞争并协调许多人的努力，而在这项任务上最成功的组织，正是那些以体系为明星的组织。”

sentences.en: C The truth is that a company can't win the talent war by hiring stars — only lose it.
sentences.zh: 事实是，公司靠雇用明星无法赢得人才战争——只会输掉它。

sentences.en: New light is thrown on why this should be so by a study of the careers of 1,000 top analysts, published in the Harvard Business Review.
sentences.zh: 《Harvard Business Review》上发表的一项针对1000名顶尖分析师职业生涯的研究，为个中缘由提供了新的解释。

sentences.en: The researchers found that when a company recruited a star performer, three things happened.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，当一家公司招募到一位明星员工时，会发生三件事。

sentences.en: D First, star quality didn't easily transfer from one organisation to another.
sentences.zh: 第一，明星特质并不容易从一个组织转移到另一个组织。

sentences.en: In many cases, when star performers switched employers, their performance dropped sharply and in some instances never recovered.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，明星员工跳槽后，他们的表现急剧下滑，有些甚至再也没有恢复。

sentences.en: Few people realise how much success is due to the working environment — systems, processes, leadership, accumulated embedded learning, which are absent in and can't be transported to the new firm.
sentences.zh: 很少有人意识到，成功有多少要归功于工作环境——体系、流程、领导力以及长期积累的内在经验——这些在新公司中并不存在，也无法搬运到新公司。

sentences.en: Moreover, precisely because of their past success, stars were unwilling to learn new tricks and antagonised those (on whom they now unknowingly depended) who could teach them.
sentences.zh: 此外，恰恰因为过去的成功，明星们不愿学习新本领，还得罪了那些能够指点他们的人——而他们如今在不知不觉中正依赖着这些人。

sentences.en: So they left, increasing their salary as they did so — a surprisingly high 36 per cent moved on within three years.
sentences.zh: 于是他们离开了，薪水也随之上涨——三年内就跳槽的比例高达36%，高得惊人。

sentences.en: E Secondly, the performance of their new team suffered as a result of the tensions and resentment created by their arrival.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们的到来所造成的紧张与怨恨，使新团队的表现受到损害。

sentences.en: Hiring a star has been compared to an organ transplant.
sentences.zh: 雇用明星曾被比作器官移植。

sentences.en: The new organ can damage others by taking most of the blood supply, other organs can start aching or threaten to stop working, or the body can reject the transplant altogether.
sentences.zh: 新器官可能因占据大部分血液供应而损害其他器官，其他器官可能开始疼痛或面临停止工作的危险，或者身体会完全排斥这个移植器官。

sentences.en: F Thirdly, the share price fell, as investors sold stock, evidently to punish the company for its extravagance in spending money on the expensive new appointee.
sentences.zh: 第三，股价下跌了，投资者抛售股票，显然是为了惩罚公司把钱挥霍在这位身价高昂的新任命者身上。

sentences.en: This is ironic, since the motive for importing stars was often to improve the share price.
sentences.zh: 这很讽刺，因为引进明星的动机往往就是为了提升股价。

sentences.en: G Everyone accepts the cliché that people make the organisation — but, in fact, to a far greater extent, the organisation makes the people.
sentences.zh: 人人都接受“人造就组织”这句老生常谈——但事实上，在更大的程度上，是组织造就了人。

sentences.en: This is as true in the world of football as in business.
sentences.zh: 这一点在足球界和在商界同样成立。

sentences.en: Some football clubs buy very good — and very expensive — players, but the team may be less than the sum of its parts.
sentences.zh: 一些足球俱乐部购买非常出色——也非常昂贵——的球员，但球队的表现可能还不及各部分之和。

sentences.en: Others put much more emphasis on developing systems: a setting within which less good players can improve, and which helps everyone to form an effective team.
sentences.zh: 另一些俱乐部则把重点更多地放在打造体系上：一个让较逊色的球员也能进步的环境，一个帮助每个人组成高效团队的环境。

sentences.en: These clubs are often more successful than those with the stars.
sentences.zh: 这些俱乐部往往比拥有明星的俱乐部更成功。

sentences.en: Similarly, a study of the performance of fund managers showed that just 30 per cent of variation in fund performance was due to the individual, compared to 70 per cent to the company-specific setting.
sentences.zh: 类似地，一项对基金经理业绩的研究表明，基金业绩的差异中仅有30%归因于个人，相比之下70%归因于公司特有的环境。

sentences.en: H That will be no surprise to those familiar with systems thinking.
sentences.zh: 对熟悉系统思维的人来说，这不会是什么意外。

sentences.en: Deming, the management thinker, used to say that there was no point in criticising people when 90 per cent of performance variation was down to the system within which they worked.
sentences.zh: 管理思想家Deming过去常说，当90%的绩效差异取决于人们所身处的工作体系时，批评人是没有意义的。

sentences.en: Consistent improvement, he said, is a matter not of raising the level of individual intelligence, but of the learning of the organisation as a whole.

sentences.en: A Dark chocolate is gaining a reputation as a heart-healthy food, and research suggests that there might be some substance behind those claims.
sentences.zh: 黑巧克力正作为有益心脏健康的食物而声名渐起，研究表明这些说法可能确实有一定依据。

sentences.en: Ginger Hultin, owner of Champagne Nutrition in Seattle and a spokesperson for the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics says, "Cocoa contains antioxidants in addition to magnesium, potassium, zinc, and iron.
sentences.zh: Seattle的Champagne Nutrition的所有者兼Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics发言人Ginger Hultin说：“可可除了含有镁、钾、锌和铁之外，还含有抗氧化剂。

sentences.en: Plus, studies have shown that there could be some benefit to consuming chocolate or cocoa for the cardiovascular system, including potentially lowering blood pressure."
sentences.zh: 此外，研究表明，食用巧克力或可可可能对心血管系统有一些益处，包括可能降低血压。”

sentences.en: B Dark chocolate's health benefits come from its cocoa – specifically its cocoa flavanols.
sentences.zh: 黑巧克力的健康益处来自其中的可可——具体来说是可可黄烷醇。

sentences.en: Flavanols are a type of polyphenol, and polyphenols are one group of phytochemicals.
sentences.zh: 黄烷醇是多酚的一种，而多酚是植物化学物质中的一类。

sentences.en: Many fruits and vegetables contain flavanols, but they are especially rich in tea, wine, and cocoa.
sentences.zh: 许多水果和蔬菜都含有黄烷醇，但茶、葡萄酒和可可中的含量尤其丰富。

sentences.en: During digestion, cocoa is broken down into smaller chemical compounds.
sentences.zh: 在消化过程中，可可被分解成更小的化合物。

sentences.en: Some research suggests that these compounds have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties and may help protect against cardiovascular disease, which affects both the heart and brain.
sentences.zh: 一些研究表明，这些化合物具有抗炎和抗氧化的特性，可能有助于预防心血管疾病，而这种疾病会同时影响心脏和大脑。

sentences.en: For example, research has found that even two weeks of eating dark chocolate or other flavanol-rich cocoa products is better than a placebo for lowering blood pressure in people who already have high blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 例如，研究发现，即使只吃两周黑巧克力或其他富含黄烷醇的可可产品，对于已经患有高血压的人来说，其降血压效果也优于安慰剂。

sentences.en: C Not all chocolate is created equal, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，并非所有巧克力都是一样的。

sentences.en: Milk chocolate and white chocolate undergo more processing and contain far less cocoa solids, meaning they have fewer flavanols.
sentences.zh: 牛奶巧克力和白巧克力经过的加工更多，所含可可固形物少得多，这意味着它们的黄烷醇含量也更低。

sentences.en: Additionally, dairy products added to milk chocolate may interfere with the absorption of antioxidants.
sentences.zh: 此外，牛奶巧克力中添加的乳制品可能会干扰抗氧化剂的吸收。

sentences.en: To obtain meaningful health benefits, consumers should look for dark chocolate with at least 70% cocoa content.
sentences.zh: 要获得切实的健康益处，消费者应选择可可含量至少为70%的黑巧克力。

sentences.en: Even then, the exact flavanol content is rarely listed on packaging, as manufacturers have no legal obligation to provide this information.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，包装上也很少标明确切的黄烷醇含量，因为制造商没有提供这一信息的法律义务。

sentences.en: Some specialist brands now produce high-flavanol chocolate, but these products tend to be significantly more expensive than regular dark chocolate.
sentences.zh: 一些专业品牌现在生产高黄烷醇巧克力，但这些产品往往比普通黑巧克力贵得多。

sentences.en: D The quantity of chocolate needed to produce health benefits has been a matter of debate.
sentences.zh: 要产生健康益处需要多少巧克力，这一问题一直存在争议。

sentences.en: Several studies have suggested that consuming 20 to 30 grams of dark chocolate per day – roughly two to three small squares – is associated with the greatest cardiovascular benefits.
sentences.zh: 几项研究表明，每天食用20到30克黑巧克力——大约两到三小块——与最大的心血管益处相关。

sentences.en: Consuming more than this amount may add extra calories, sugar, and saturated fat without providing additional protective effects.
sentences.zh: 食用超过这个量可能会带来额外的热量、糖和饱和脂肪，却不会提供额外的保护作用。

sentences.en: One large observational study involving over 20,000 participants found that those who ate modest amounts of dark chocolate had a 12% lower risk of developing heart disease compared to non-consumers.
sentences.zh: 一项涉及2万多名参与者的大型观察性研究发现，与不食用黑巧克力的人相比，适量食用黑巧克力的人患心脏病的风险降低了12%。

sentences.en: However, the same study noted that people who ate chocolate daily also tended to have higher overall calorie intakes and were more likely to be sedentary, suggesting that correlation does not necessarily equal causation.
sentences.zh: 然而，同一项研究也指出，每天吃巧克力的人总体热量摄入往往更高，也更可能久坐不动，这表明相关性并不一定等于因果性。

sentences.en: E Researchers have also investigated dark chocolate's potential effects on cognitive function and mood.
sentences.zh: 研究人员还研究了黑巧克力对认知功能和情绪的潜在影响。

sentences.en: A small randomised trial conducted in Italy gave healthy adults either high-flavanol chocolate or low-flavanol chocolate for five days.
sentences.zh: 一项在Italy进行的小型随机试验让健康成年人连续五天食用高黄烷醇巧克力或低黄烷醇巧克力。

sentences.en: Those receiving high-flavanol chocolate performed better on visual memory tests and reported feeling less mental fatigue.
sentences.zh: 食用高黄烷醇巧克力的那组人在视觉记忆测试中表现更好，并表示感觉到的精神疲劳更少。

sentences.en: Similarly, a study from Australia found that regular consumption of dark chocolate was associated with lower odds of clinical depression, though the authors cautioned that people with depression might simply turn to chocolate as a form of self-comfort.
sentences.zh: 类似地，一项来自Australia的研究发现，经常食用黑巧克力与患临床抑郁症的几率较低相关，不过作者提醒说，抑郁症患者可能只是把巧克力当作一种自我安慰的方式。

sentences.en: Further research with larger sample sizes is needed before firm conclusions can be drawn.
sentences.zh: 在得出确切的结论之前，还需要进行样本量更大的进一步研究。

sentences.en: F Despite the promising evidence, experts urge caution against overconsumption.
sentences.zh: 尽管证据令人鼓舞，专家们仍告诫人们不要过量食用。

sentences.en: Dark chocolate remains a calorie-dense food, typically containing around 600 calories per 100 grams.
sentences.zh: 黑巧克力仍然是一种高热量食物，通常每100克含有约600卡路里。

sentences.en: Excessive intake can contribute to weight gain, which in turn raises the risk of diabetes, hypertension, and heart disease – the very conditions that moderate consumption may help prevent.
sentences.zh: 过量食用会导致体重增加，进而增加患糖尿病、高血压和心脏病的风险——而这些恰恰是适量食用可能有助于预防的疾病。

sentences.en: Furthermore, some dark chocolate products contain high levels of heavy metals such as lead and cadmium, which accumulate in the body over time and can damage the kidneys and nervous system.
sentences.zh: 此外，一些黑巧克力产品含有高水平的铅和镉等重金属，它们会在体内逐渐蓄积，并可能损害肾脏和神经系统。

sentences.en: Consumer advocacy groups have called for stricter regulation and mandatory testing of heavy metal levels in cocoa products.
sentences.zh: 消费者权益倡导组织呼吁对可可产品中的重金属含量实施更严格的监管和强制性检测。

sentences.en: G In conclusion, while dark chocolate cannot be considered a medicine, incorporating a small amount into a balanced diet appears to offer genuine health benefits, particularly for cardiovascular health.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，虽然黑巧克力不能被视为药物，但将少量黑巧克力纳入均衡饮食似乎能带来真正的健康益处，尤其是对心血管健康而言。

sentences.en: The key is moderation, attention to cocoa percentage, and awareness of potential contaminants.
sentences.zh: 关键在于适度食用、留意可可百分比，并警惕潜在的污染物。

sentences.en: As Ginger Hultin notes, "Dark chocolate is not a magic bullet, but it can be a pleasant and potentially beneficial part of an overall healthy eating pattern."
sentences.zh: 正如Ginger Hultin所指出的：“黑巧克力不是灵丹妙药，但它可以成为整体健康饮食模式中令人愉悦且可能有益的组成部分。”

sentences.en: A The world's great deserts were formed by natural processes interacting over long intervals of time.
sentences.zh: 世界上的各大沙漠是由在漫长时间里相互作用的自然过程形成的。

sentences.en: During most of these times, deserts have grown and shrunk independent of human activities.
sentences.zh: 在其中的大部分时间里，沙漠的扩张与收缩都与人类活动无关。

sentences.en: Paleodeserts, large sand seas now inactive because they are stabilized by vegetation, extend well beyond the present margins of core deserts, such as the Sahara.
sentences.zh: 古沙漠——即因被植被固定而如今不再活动的大片沙海——所延伸的范围远远超出Sahara等核心沙漠的现今边缘。

sentences.en: In some regions, deserts are separated sharply from surrounding, less arid areas by mountains and other contrasting landforms that reflect basic structural differences in the regional geology.
sentences.zh: 在一些地区，山脉和其他反差鲜明的地貌将沙漠与周围较不干旱的区域截然分开，这些地貌反映了区域地质的基本结构差异。

sentences.en: In other areas, desert fringes form a gradual transition from a dry to a more humid environment, making it more difficult to define the desert border.
sentences.zh: 在另一些地区，沙漠边缘构成了从干燥环境向较为湿润环境的渐变过渡，这使得界定沙漠边界变得更加困难。

sentences.en: B These transition zones have very fragile, delicately balanced ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 这些过渡地带拥有极为脆弱、处于微妙平衡状态的生态系统。

sentences.en: Desert fringes often are a mosaic of microclimates.
sentences.zh: 沙漠边缘往往是各种微气候拼嵌而成的镶嵌体。

sentences.en: Small hollows support vegetation that picks up heat from the hot winds and protects the land from the prevailing winds.
sentences.zh: 小小的洼地上生长着植被，这些植被从热风中汲取热量，并保护土地免受盛行风的吹袭。

sentences.en: After rainfall, the vegetated areas are distinctly cooler than the surroundings.
sentences.zh: 降雨之后，有植被覆盖的区域明显比周围地区凉爽。

sentences.en: In these marginal areas, human activity may stress the ecosystem beyond its tolerance limit, resulting in degradation of the land.
sentences.zh: 在这些边际地区，人类活动可能给生态系统施加超出其承受极限的压力，从而导致土地退化。

sentences.en: By ponding the soil with their hooves, livestock compact the substrate, increase the proportion of fine material, and reduce the percolation rate of the soil, thus encouraging erosion by wind and water.
sentences.zh: 牲畜用蹄子践踏土壤，压实了基质，增加了细颗粒物质的比例，降低了土壤的渗透速度，从而助长了风和水的侵蚀。

sentences.en: Grazing and the collection of firewood reduce or eliminate plants that help to bind the soil.
sentences.zh: 放牧和采集柴火会减少或消灭那些有助于固结土壤的植物。

sentences.en: C This degradation of formerly productive land—desertification—is a complex process.
sentences.zh: 曾经富饶多产的土地出现的这种退化——荒漠化——是一个复杂的过程。

sentences.en: It involves multiple causes, and it proceeds at varying rates in different climates.
sentences.zh: 它涉及多种成因，并且在不同的气候条件下进展的速度各不相同。

sentences.en: Desertification may intensify a general climatic trend toward greater aridity, or it may initiate a change in local climate.
sentences.zh: 荒漠化可能会加剧气候总体上趋于更干旱的大趋势，也可能引发局部气候的变化。

sentences.en: D Desertification does not occur in linear, easily mappable patterns.
sentences.zh: 荒漠化并不以线性的、易于绘入地图的格局发生。

sentences.en: Deserts advance erratically, forming patches on their borders.
sentences.zh: 沙漠的推进毫无规律，会在其边缘形成一块块斑块。

sentences.en: Areas far from natural deserts can degrade quickly to barren soil, rock, or sand through poor land management.
sentences.zh: 远离天然沙漠的地区也可能因土地管理不善而迅速退化为贫瘠的土壤、岩石或沙地。

sentences.en: The presence of a nearby desert has no direct relationship to desertification.
sentences.zh: 附近是否存在沙漠，与荒漠化并没有直接关系。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, an area undergoing desertification is brought to public attention only after the process is well underway.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，一个正在经历荒漠化的地区，往往要等到这一进程已经充分展开之后才会引起公众的关注。

sentences.en: Often little or no data are available to indicate the previous state of the ecosystem or the rate of degradation.
sentences.zh: 通常几乎没有甚至完全没有数据可以表明生态系统先前的状态或退化的速率。

sentences.en: Scientists still question whether desertification, as a process of global change, is permanent or how and when it can be halted or reversed.
sentences.zh: 作为全球变化的一种过程，荒漠化是否永久存在、如何以及在何时才能被遏止或逆转，科学家们对此仍有疑问。

sentences.en: E Desertification became well known in the 1930s when part of the Great Plains in the United States turned into the "Dust Bowl" as a result of drought and poor practices in farming, although the term itself was not used until almost 1950.
sentences.zh: 20世纪30年代，United States大平原的一部分因干旱和不当的耕作方式而变成了“Dust Bowl”，荒漠化由此广为人知，尽管这个术语本身直到将近1950年才开始使用。

sentences.en: During the Dust Bowl period, millions of people were forced to abandon their farms and livelihoods.
sentences.zh: 在“Dust Bowl”时期，数百万人被迫抛弃了自己的农场和生计。

sentences.en: Greatly improved methods of agriculture and land and water management in the Great Plains have prevented that disaster from recurring, but desertification presently affects millions of people on almost every continent.
sentences.zh: Great Plains地区大幅改进的农业以及土地和水资源管理方法已经防止了那场灾难重演，但如今荒漠化仍影响着几乎每个大洲的数百万人。

sentences.en: Increased population and livestock pressure on marginal lands have accelerated desertification.
sentences.zh: 边际土地上日益加大的人口和牲畜压力加速了荒漠化。

sentences.en: In some areas, nomads moving to less arid areas disrupt the local ecosystem and increase the rate of erosion of the land.
sentences.zh: 在一些地区，迁往较不干旱地区的游牧民扰乱了当地生态系统，并加快了土地受侵蚀的速度。

sentences.en: Nomads are trying to escape the desert, but because of their land-use practices, they are bringing the desert with them.
sentences.zh: 游牧民正试图逃离沙漠，但由于他们的土地利用方式，他们把沙漠也一同带了过去。

sentences.en: F It is a misconception that drought causes desertification.
sentences.zh: 认为干旱会导致荒漠化是一种误解。

sentences.en: Droughts are common in arid and semiarid lands.
sentences.zh: 在干旱和半干旱的土地上，干旱很常见。

sentences.en: Well-managed lands can recover from drought when the rains return.
sentences.zh: 管理良好的土地在雨水回归时能够从干旱中恢复过来。

sentences.en: Continued land abuse during droughts, however, increases land degradation.
sentences.zh: 然而，干旱期间对土地的持续滥用会加重土地退化。

sentences.en: By 1973, the drought that began in 1968 in the Sahel of West Africa and the land-use practices there had caused the deaths of more than 100,000 people and 12 million cattle, as well as the disruption of social organizations from villages to the national level.
sentences.zh: 到1973年，始于1968年、发生在West Africa的Sahel地区的那场干旱，连同当地的土地利用方式，已夺去10万多人和1200万头牛的生命，并使从村庄到国家各个层面的社会组织陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: G At the local level, individuals and governments can help to reclaim and protect their lands.
sentences.zh: 在地方层面，个人和政府可以帮助开垦并保护自己的土地。

sentences.en: In areas of sand dunes, covering the dunes with large boulders or petroleum will interrupt the wind regime near the face of the dunes and prevent the sand from moving.
sentences.zh: 在沙丘地区，用大块砾石或石油覆盖沙丘，会扰乱沙丘表面附近的风况，从而阻止沙子移动。

sentences.en: Sand fences are used throughout the Middle East and the United States, in the same way snow fences are used in the north.
sentences.zh: Middle East和United States各地都在使用挡沙栅栏，其用法与北方使用防雪栅栏的方式相同。

sentences.en: Placement of straw grids, each up to a square meter in area, will also decrease the surface wind velocity.
sentences.zh: 设置稻草方格网——每个面积至多一平方米——也能降低地表风速。

sentences.en: Shrubs and trees planted within the grids are protected by the straw until they take root.
sentences.zh: 种植在方格网内的灌木和树木在扎根之前会受到稻草的保护。

sentences.en: In areas where some water is available for irrigation, shrubs planted on the lower one-third of a dune's windward side will stabilize the dune.
sentences.zh: 在有一些水源可供灌溉的地区，把灌木种在沙丘迎风坡的下三分之一处就能固定沙丘。

sentences.en: This vegetation decreases the wind velocity near the base of the dune and prevents much of the sand from moving.
sentences.zh: 这种植被会降低沙丘底部附近的风速，并防止大部分沙子移动。

sentences.en: H Oases and farmlands in windy regions can be protected by planting tree fences or grass belts.
sentences.zh: 多风地区的绿洲和农田可以通过种植树木屏障或草带来加以保护。

sentences.en: Sand that manages to pass through the grass belts can be caught in strips of trees planted as windbreaks 50 to 100 meters apart adjacent to the belts.
sentences.zh: 穿过草带的流沙可以被紧邻草带种植的防风树带截住，这些树带彼此相距50到100米。

sentences.en: Small plots of trees may also be scattered inside oases to stabilize the area.
sentences.zh: 绿洲内部还可以零星栽种小片树林，以稳固这一地区。

sentences.en: On a much larger scale, a "Green Wall," which will eventually stretch more than 5,700 kilometers in length, much longer than the famous Great Wall, is being planted in northeastern China to protect "sandy lands"—deserts believed to have been created by human activity.
sentences.zh: 在规模大得多的层面上，China东北正在种植一道“Green Wall”，它最终将绵延5700多公里，远比著名的Great Wall更长，用以保护“沙地”——那些被认为由人类活动造成的沙漠。

sentences.en: I More efficient use of existing water resources and control of salinization are other effective tools for improving arid lands.
sentences.zh: 更高效地利用现有水资源并控制盐碱化，是改良旱地的另一些有效手段。

sentences.en: New ways are being sought to use surface-water resources such as rainwater harvesting or irrigating with seasonal runoff from adjacent highlands.
sentences.zh: 人们正在寻求利用地表水资源的新途径，例如收集雨水，或利用邻近高地的季节性径流进行灌溉。

sentences.en: Research on the reclamation of deserts also is focusing on discovering proper crop rotation to protect the fragile soil, on understanding how sand-fixing plants can be adapted to local environments, and on how grazing lands and water resources can be developed effectively without being overused.
sentences.zh: 关于沙漠改良的研究还聚焦于发现适当的作物轮作方式以保护脆弱的土壤，了解固沙植物如何才能适应当地环境，以及探索如何在不被过度利用的前提下有效开发牧场和水资源。

sentences.en: (A) From ancient times to the present, historians have asked the question: How and why did an ordinary little town in central Italy grow so much bigger than any other in the ancient Mediterranean and come to control such a huge empire?
sentences.zh: 从古至今，历史学家们一直在问这样一个问题：Italy中部的一座普通小镇，究竟是如何以及为何发展到比古代Mediterranean地区的任何其他城镇都庞大得多，并进而控制了如此庞大的帝国的？

sentences.en: During the first century BCE, Roman writers themselves began systematically to study the earlier centuries of their city and their empire.
sentences.zh: 公元前1世纪，罗马作家们便开始系统地研究他们的城市和帝国此前的数个世纪。

sentences.en: Yet these historians had little more direct evidence of the earliest phases of Rome's history than modern writers have, and in some ways perhaps not as much, as there were no surviving documents or archives.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些历史学家所掌握的有关Rome历史最早阶段的直接证据，并不比现代作家掌握的多多少，在某些方面或许甚至更少，因为当时没有任何留存下来的文献或档案。

sentences.en: Their 'histories' about the foundation of ancient Rome tell us a good deal about how the Romans saw their city, their values, and their failings.
sentences.zh: 他们关于古代Rome建城的“历史”著作，让我们对罗马人如何看待自己的城市、自己的价值观和自身的缺点有了相当多的了解。

sentences.en: However, they tell us very little indeed about what they claim to inform us about: that is, what earliest Rome was actually like.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于它们声称要向我们说明的内容——也就是最早期的Rome究竟是什么样子——它们实际上告诉我们的却非常之少。

sentences.en: One fact is obvious.
sentences.zh: 有一个事实是显而易见的。

sentences.en: Rome was already a very old city by 63 BCE, the birth date of its first emperor.
sentences.zh: 到公元前63年——它的第一位皇帝的出生年份——Rome已经是一座非常古老的城市。

sentences.en: But how exactly are we to access reliable information about the origins of Rome?
sentences.zh: 但我们究竟要如何才能获取有关Rome起源的可靠信息呢？

sentences.en: (B) One way of doing this is by turning away from the histories of Roman writers and seeking out clues in the Latin language, or in later Roman institutions that might point back to features of earliest Rome.
sentences.zh: 做到这一点的一条途径，是避开罗马作家的历史著作，转而从拉丁语中寻找线索，或从那些或许能回溯到最早期Rome特征的后期罗马制度中寻找线索。

sentences.en: Much more tangible, however, is the evidence of archaeology.
sentences.zh: 然而，考古学的证据要具体得多。

sentences.en: Dig down deep in the city of Rome, below the visible ancient monuments, and a few traces of a much earlier settlement or settlements remain.
sentences.zh: 在Rome城向深处下挖，在肉眼可见的古代遗迹之下，还残留着某个或某些年代久远得多的居留地的一些痕迹。

sentences.en: Beneath the Forum itself (an ancient marketplace at the centre of the city) lie the remains of an early cemetery, which caused tremendous excitement when they were first unearthed at the start of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 就在Forum（城市中心的一座古代集市）的下方，埋藏着一处早期墓地的遗存，这些遗存在20世纪初首次出土时曾引起极大的轰动。

sentences.en: Cemeteries imply the existence of a community, and traces of that are presumably to be found in the groups of huts whose faint outlines have been detected under various parts of the later city, including on the Palatine (the centremost of the seven hills on which Rome is built).
sentences.zh: 墓地意味着聚落的存在，而聚落的踪迹想必能在那些棚屋群中找到——在后来城市的多个区域之下，人们已探测到这些棚屋依稀可辨的轮廓，其中包括Palatine山（Rome所坐落的七座山丘中最居中的一座）。

sentences.en: We have little idea of the nature of these huts beyond their construction in wood, clay, and thatch, and still less of the lifestyle they supported.
sentences.zh: 除了知道它们以木头、黏土和茅草建造之外，我们对这些棚屋的样貌知之甚少，而对它们所承载的生活方式就更加不了解了。

sentences.en: But we can fill in some of the gaps if we look just outside Rome.
sentences.zh: 但只要把目光投向Rome城外不远处，我们就能填补其中的一些空白。

sentences.en: One of the best preserved and most carefully excavated of these early structures was found at Fidenae, a few miles north of the city, in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 这些早期建筑中保存最完好、发掘也最细致的一座，是20世纪80年代在该城以北数英里处的Fidenae发现的。

sentences.en: It is a rectangular building, some six by five metres, made of wood and rammed earth - a construction method still utilised up to the present day - with a simple porch around it, formed by the overhanging roof.
sentences.zh: 它是一座长方形建筑，约6米乘5米，由木头和夯土建成——这种营造方法至今仍在使用——四周环绕着由出挑屋顶形成的简朴门廊。

sentences.en: Inside was a central hearth, some large pottery storage jars, and traces of predictable foodstuffs and domestic animals.
sentences.zh: 屋内有一个位于中央的火塘、几只大型陶制储罐，以及一些可以想见的食物和家畜的痕迹。

sentences.en: (C) There are vivid glimpses of human and other life here; the question is, what do those glimpses add up to?
sentences.zh: 在这里，人类和其他生命的生动片段隐约可见；问题是，这些片段加在一起究竟意味着什么？

sentences.en: The archaeological remains certainly demonstrate that there is a long and rich prehistory behind the ancient Rome we can still see, but quite how long that prehistory is is another matter.
sentences.zh: 这些考古遗存确实表明，在我们今天仍能看到的古代Rome背后，存在着一段漫长而丰富的史前史，但这段史前史究竟有多长则是另一回事。

sentences.en: (D) Part of the problem is the conditions of excavation in the city itself.
sentences.zh: 问题的部分原因在于这座城市自身的发掘条件。

sentences.en: The site of Rome has been so intensively built on for centuries that we find these traces of early occupation only in spots that happen not to have been disturbed.
sentences.zh: 数百年来，Rome城址上的建设一直非常密集，以至于我们只能在一些恰好未受扰动的地点发现这些早期居住的痕迹。

sentences.en: The foundations dug in the first and second centuries CE for the vast marble temples of the forum obliterated much of what then lay beneath the surface; the cellars of grand Renaissance houses cut through even more ancient remains in other parts of the city.
sentences.zh: 公元1世纪和2世纪时为广场上那些宏大的大理石神庙开挖的地基，摧毁了当时地表之下的许多遗存；宏伟的文艺复兴时期宅邸的地下室，则在城市的其他地方切穿了更为古老的遗迹。

sentences.en: So we have tiny snapshots, never the big picture.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们拥有的只是些微小的快照，而永远看不到全貌。

sentences.en: This is archaeology at its most difficult, and - although new fragments of evidence emerge all the time - its interpretation, and reinterpretation is almost always contested and often controversial.
sentences.zh: 这是考古学最为艰难之处，而且——尽管新的证据碎片不断涌现——对这些证据的解释和再解释几乎总会引发争论，并常常充满争议。

sentences.en: For example, there is an ongoing debate about whether the small pieces of wattle and daub found in excavations in the Forum in the mid-20th century indicate that there was an early hut settlement there too, or whether they were inadvertently introduced as part of the rubble used a few centuries later to provide a new raised surface for the area.
sentences.zh: 例如，围绕20世纪中叶在Forum发掘中发现的小片编条抹泥墙残块，人们至今仍在争论：它们究竟是表明那里也曾有过一处早期的棚屋聚落，还是它们在几个世纪之后作为垫高该区域所用的碎石填料的一部分被无意间混入其中。

sentences.en: It has to be said that this place, though fine for a cemetery, would have been rather damp and marshy for a village.
sentences.zh: 必须指出，这个地方虽然适合用作墓地，作为村落却会相当潮湿、遍布沼泽。

sentences.en: (E) Precise dating is even more contentious.
sentences.zh: 精确的断代则更具争议。

sentences.en: It cannot be stressed enough that there is no certain independent date for any of the archaeological material from earliest Rome or the area around, and that arguments still rage about the age of almost every major find.
sentences.zh: 无论怎样强调都不为过：来自最早期的Rome及其周边地区的考古材料，没有任何一件拥有确定的独立年代，而且围绕几乎每一项重大发现的年代，争论至今仍十分激烈。

sentences.en: It has taken decades of work over the past century or so - using such diagnostics as the existence of wheel-made pottery (assumed to be later than handmade), the occasional presence on graves of Greek ceramics (whose dating is better, but still not perfectly understood) and careful comparison from site to site - to produce a rough chronological scheme covering the period from around 1000 to 600 BCE.
sentences.zh: 在过去大约一个世纪里，人们耗费了数十年的功夫——利用诸如轮制陶器的存在（被假定晚于手制陶器）、墓葬中偶尔出现的希腊陶器（其断代依据较为完善，但仍未得到完全理解）以及各遗址之间的细致比对等断代依据——才得出了一个涵盖约公元前1000年至公元前600年这一时期的粗略年表。

sentences.en: (F) On that basis, the earliest burials in Rome would have been around 1000 BCE, and the earliest known settlements around 750-700 BCE.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，Rome最早的墓葬应在公元前1000年左右，而已知最早的居址则在约公元前750—前700年。

sentences.en: But even these dates are far from certain.
sentences.zh: 但即便是这些年代也远非确定。

sentences.en: Recent scientific methods - including radiocarbon dating, which calculates the age of any organic material - have suggested that they are all too 'young', by as much as a hundred years.
sentences.zh: 近来的科学方法——包括能够推算任何有机物质年代的放射性碳测年——表明这些年代全都过于“年轻”，可能年轻了多达一百年。

sentences.en: The building at Fidenae, for example, was dated around the middle of the eighth century BCE according to traditional archaeological criteria, but that is pushed back to around the end of the ninth century BCE if we follow radiocarbon analysis.
sentences.zh: 例如，依照传统的考古学标准，Fidenae的那座建筑被定年在公元前8世纪中叶前后，但若依照放射性碳分析，这一年代则要前推至大约公元前9世纪末。

sentences.en: If anything, Rome appears to be getting older.
sentences.zh: 如果非要说有什么不同，Rome反倒显得越来越古老了。

sentences.en: (A) Of the world’s 6,500 living languages, around half are expected to die out by the end of this century, according to UNESCO.
sentences.zh: 据UNESCO称，全球6500种现存语言中，约有一半预计将在本世纪末消亡。

sentences.en: Just 11 are spoken by more than half of the earth’s population, so it is little wonder that those used by only a few are being left behind as we become a more homogenous, global society.
sentences.zh: 仅有11种语言的使用者超过地球人口的一半，因此，随着我们成为一个更加同质化的全球社会，那些只有少数人使用的语言被甩在后面也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: In short, 95 percent of the world’s languages are spoken by only five percent of its population—a remarkable level of linguistic diversity stored in tiny pockets of speakers around the world.
sentences.zh: 简言之，全球95%的语言仅由5%的人口使用——世界各地零星的语言使用者群体中储存着惊人程度的语言多样性。

sentences.en: Mark Turin, a university professor, has launched WOLP (World Oral Language Project) to prevent the language from the brink of extinction.
sentences.zh: 大学教授Mark Turin发起了WOLP（World Oral Language Project），旨在使语言免遭灭绝。

sentences.en: (B) He is trying to encourage indigenous communities to collaborate with anthropologists around the world to record what he calls “oral literature” through video cameras, voice recorders and other multimedia tools by awarding grants from a £30,000 pot that the project has secured this year.
sentences.zh: 他正努力鼓励原住民社区与世界各地的人类学家合作，通过摄像机、录音机和其他多媒体工具记录他所说的“口头文学”，经费来自该项目今年争取到的3万英镑资助金。

sentences.en: The idea is to collate this literature in a digital archive that can be accessed on demand and will make the nuts and bolts of lost cultures readily available.
sentences.zh: 这一构想是将这些文献汇编成一个可按需访问的数字档案库，使那些已失落文化的基本细节触手可及。

sentences.en: (C) For many of these communities, the oral tradition is at the heart of their culture.
sentences.zh: 对许多这样的社区来说，口头传统是其文化的核心。

sentences.en: The stories they tell are creative as well as communicative.
sentences.zh: 他们讲述的故事不仅用于交流，还富有创造性。

sentences.en: Unlike the languages with celebrated written traditions, such as Sanskrit, Hebrew and Ancient Greek, few indigenous communities have recorded their own languages or ever had them recorded until now.
sentences.zh: 与梵语、希伯来语和古希腊语这类拥有辉煌书写传统的语言不同，迄今为止，很少有原住民社区记录过自己的语言，也几乎从未有人替它们记录过。

sentences.en: (D) The project suggested itself when Turin was teaching in Nepal.
sentences.zh: Turin在Nepal任教期间，这个项目的构想便自然而然地产生了。

sentences.en: He wanted to study for a PhD in endangered languages and, while discussing it with his professor at Leiden University in the Netherlands, was drawn to a map on his tutor’s wall.
sentences.zh: 他想攻读濒危语言方向的博士学位，在与Netherlands的Leiden University的教授讨论此事时，他的目光被导师墙上的一张地图吸引住了。

sentences.en: The map was full of pins of a variety of colours which represented all the world’s languages that were completely undocumented.
sentences.zh: 这张地图上插满了各种颜色的图钉，代表着世界上所有完全没有任何文献记录的语言。

sentences.en: At random, Turin chose a “pin” to document.
sentences.zh: Turin随机选择了一个“图钉”所代表的语言来进行记录。

sentences.en: It happened to belong to the Thangmi tribe, an indigenous community in the hills east of Kathmandu, the capital of Nepal.
sentences.zh: 它恰好属于Thangmi部族——一个位于Nepal首都Kathmandu以东山地中的原住民社区。

sentences.en: “Many of the choices anthropologists and linguists who work on these traditional field-work projects are quite random,” he admits.
sentences.zh: 他承认：“从事这类传统田野调查项目的人类学家和语言学家所做的许多选择都相当随机。”

sentences.en: (E) Continuing his work with the Thangmi community in the 1990s, Turin began to record the language he was hearing, realising that not only was this language and its culture entirely undocumented, it was known to few outside the tiny community.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代，Turin在继续与Thangmi社区合作的同时，开始记录他所听到的语言，并意识到这门语言及其文化不仅完全没有文献记录，而且在这个微小社区之外几乎无人知晓。

sentences.en: He set about trying to record their language and myth of origins.
sentences.zh: 他着手尝试记录他们的语言和起源神话。

sentences.en: “I wrote 1,000 pages of grammar in English that nobody could use—but I realised that wasn’t enough.
sentences.zh: “我用英语写了1000页的语法，却没有人能用——但我意识到这还不够。

sentences.en: It wasn’t enough for me, it wasn’t enough for them.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说不够，对他们来说也不够。

sentences.en: It simply wasn’t going to work as something for the community.
sentences.zh: 作为给社区使用的东西，这根本行不通。

sentences.en: So then I produced this trilingual word list in Thangmi, Nepali and English.”
sentences.zh: 于是后来我编出了这份用Thangmi语、尼泊尔语和英语写成的三语词汇表。”

sentences.en: (F) In short, it was the first ever publication of that language.
sentences.zh: 简言之，这是该语言有史以来的首个出版物。

sentences.en: That small dictionary is still sold in local schools for a modest 20 rupees, and used as part of a wider cultural regeneration process to educate children about their heritage and language.
sentences.zh: 那本小词典至今仍在当地学校以20卢比的低廉价格出售，并作为更广泛的文化复兴进程的一部分，用来教育儿童了解自己的遗产和语言。

sentences.en: The task is no small undertaking: Nepal itself is a country of massive ethnic and linguistic diversity, home to 100 languages from four different language families.
sentences.zh: 这项任务绝非小事：Nepal本身就是一个族群和语言高度多样的国家，拥有来自四个不同语系的100种语言。

sentences.en: What’s more, even fewer ethnic Thangmi speak the Thangmi language.
sentences.zh: 更何况，在Thangmi族人当中，会说Thangmi语的就更少了。

sentences.en: Many of the community members have taken to speaking Nepali, the national language taught in schools and spread through the media, and community elders are dying without passing on their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 许多社区成员已转而讲尼泊尔语——这门国家语言在学校里教授、并通过媒体传播——而社区的长者们正相继离世，未能把他们的知识传下去。

sentences.en: (G) Despite Turin’s enthusiasm for his subject, he is baffled by many linguists’ refusal to engage in the issue he is working on.
sentences.zh: 尽管Turin对自己的研究课题满怀热情，许多语言学家却拒绝参与他正在研究的议题，这令他大惑不解。

sentences.en: “Of the 6,500 languages spoken on Earth, many do not have written traditions and many of these spoken forms are endangered,” he says.
sentences.zh: 他说：“在地球上所说的6500种语言中，许多没有书写传统，而这些口语形式中有许多正濒临消亡。”

sentences.en: “There are more linguists in universities around the world than there are spoken languages—but most of them aren’t working on this issue.
sentences.zh: “世界各地大学里的语言学家比现存的语言还多——但他们当中的大多数并没有在研究这个问题。

sentences.en: To me it’s amazing that in this day and age, we still have an entirely incomplete image of the world’s linguistic diversity.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，令人惊讶的是，时至今日，我们所拥有的世界语言多样性图景仍然完全不完整。

sentences.en: People do PhDs on the apostrophe in French, yet we still don’t know how many languages are spoken.”
sentences.zh: 有人针对法语中的撇号做博士研究，可我们却仍然不知道现存多少种语言。”

sentences.en: (H) “When a language becomes endangered, so too does a cultural world view.
sentences.zh: “当一种语言变得濒危时，一种文化世界观也随之濒危。

sentences.en: We want to engage with indigenous people to document their myths and folklore, which can be harder to find funding for if you are based outside Western universities.”
sentences.zh: 我们希望与原住民合作，记录他们的神话和民间传说——而如果你不隶属于西方大学，这类工作会更难获得资助。”

sentences.en: (I) Yet, despite the struggles facing initiatives such as the World Oral Literature Project, there are historical examples that point to the possibility that language restoration is no mere academic pipe dream.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管World Oral Literature Project这样的项目面临种种困难，仍有一些历史先例表明，语言复兴绝非只是学术上的空想。

sentences.en: The revival of a modern form of Hebrew in the 19th century is often cited as one of the best proofs that languages long dead, belonging to small communities, can be resurrected and embraced by a large number of people.
sentences.zh: 19世纪现代希伯来语的复兴常被引为最有力的证明之一：属于小社群的早已消亡的语言，也能够复活并被大量的人所接纳使用。

sentences.en: By the 20th century, Hebrew was well on its way to becoming the main language of the Jewish population of both Ottoman and British Palestine.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪，希伯来语已在稳步成为Ottoman和British统治下的Palestine两地犹太人口的主要语言。

sentences.en: It is now spoken by more than seven million people in Israel.
sentences.zh: 如今在Israel，这种语言的使用者已超过700万。

sentences.en: (J) Yet, despite the difficulties these communities face in saving their languages, Dr Turin believes that the fate of the world’s endangered languages is not sealed, and globalisation is not necessarily the nefarious perpetrator of evil it is often presented to be.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管这些社区在拯救自己的语言方面面临种种困难，Turin博士相信，世界濒危语言的命运并非已成定局，全球化也未必像人们常常描绘的那样是作恶多端的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: “I call it the globalisation paradox: on the one hand globalisation and rapid socio-economic change are the things that are eroding and challenging diversity.
sentences.zh: “我称之为全球化悖论：一方面，全球化和快速的社会经济变化正是侵蚀并挑战多样性的因素。

sentences.en: But on the other, globalisation is providing us with new and very exciting tools and facilities to get to places to document those things that globalisation is eroding.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，全球化也为我们提供了令人振奋的新工具和新条件，让我们能够前往各地，记录那些正在被全球化侵蚀的东西。

sentences.en: Also, the communities at the coal-face of change are excited by what globalisation has to offer.”
sentences.zh: 此外，身处变革最前沿的社区对全球化所提供的东西也感到兴奋。”

sentences.en: (K) In the meantime, the race is on to collect and protect as many of the languages as possible, so that the Rai Shaman in eastern Nepal and those in the generations that follow him can continue their traditions and have a sense of identity.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一场尽可能多地收集和保护语言的竞赛已经开始，好让Nepal东部的Rai族萨满及其后代能够延续他们的传统，并保有一种身份认同感。

sentences.en: And it certainly is a race: Turin knows his project’s limits and believes it inevitable that a large number of those languages will disappear.
sentences.zh: 而这确实是一场竞赛：Turin深知自己项目的局限，并认为大量这样的语言终将消失是不可避免的。

sentences.en: “We have to be wholly realistic.
sentences.zh: “我们必须抱完全现实的态度。

sentences.en: A project like ours is in no position, and was not designed, to keep languages alive.
sentences.zh: 像我们这样的项目既没有能力、也不是为维持语言存续而设计的。

sentences.en: The only people who can help languages survive are the people in those communities themselves.
sentences.zh: 唯一能够帮助这些语言存活下来的，是那些社区中的人们自己。

sentences.en: They need to be reminded that it’s good to speak their own language and I think we can help them do that—becoming modern doesn’t mean you have to lose your language.”
sentences.zh: 需要提醒他们，说自己的语言是件好事，而我认为我们可以帮助他们做到这一点——走向现代化并不意味着必须失去自己的语言。”

sentences.en: A You may have wondered why so many supermarkets are virtually indistinguishable from each other.
sentences.zh: 你可能好奇过，为什么那么多超市几乎彼此难以区分。

sentences.en: It is not, as some might suspect, that the companies operating them lack imagination.
sentences.zh: 这并不像某些人可能猜疑的那样，是因为经营这些超市的公司缺乏想象力。

sentences.en: It is more that they are all well-versed in the science of persuading people to buy things - a science that, thanks to technological advances, is beginning to understand what motivates consumers when they make decisions on what to purchase.
sentences.zh: 更确切地说，是因为它们都精通说服人们购物的科学——得益于技术进步，这门科学正开始理解消费者在决定购买什么时的动机。

sentences.en: B It takes a while for the mind to get into a shopping mode.
sentences.zh: 人的大脑需要一段时间才能进入购物模式。

sentences.en: People need to make a gentle start and take stock of the surroundings.
sentences.zh: 人们需要一个平缓的开端，先熟悉一下周围的环境。

sentences.en: This is why some supermarkets have a so-called chill zone for browsing magazines, books and DVDs, an area which is also designed to catch the customer's eye and tempt them to make impulsive purchases.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么一些超市设有所谓的“休闲区”，供顾客翻阅杂志、书籍和DVD；这个区域的设计同时也是为了吸引顾客的目光，诱使他们进行冲动性购买。

sentences.en: But many will ignore it, in which case the first thing they encounter is the fresh fruit and vegetables section.
sentences.zh: 但很多顾客会无视这个区域，这样一来，他们最先遇到的就是新鲜果蔬区。

sentences.en: For shoppers, this makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 对购物者来说，这种安排毫无道理。

sentences.en: Fruit in particular can be easily bruised, so ideally should be bought at the end, not the beginning, of a shopping trip.
sentences.zh: 尤其是水果，很容易被碰伤，所以理想情况下应该在购物行程结束时购买，而不是在开始时。

sentences.en: But psychology is at work here: selecting wholesome fresh food is an uplifting way to start shopping, and it makes people feel less guilty about reaching for the less nutritious stuff later on.
sentences.zh: 但这里起作用的是心理学：挑选有益健康的新鲜食物是一个令人振奋的购物开场，也让人们稍后伸手去拿那些营养较少的食品时少一些负罪感。

sentences.en: C Shoppers have worked out that everyday items, like milk, will invariably be placed in an aisle towards the back of a store to provide more opportunity to tempt customers on their way there.
sentences.zh: 购物者们已经弄明白，牛奶之类的日常用品总是被摆放在靠近店铺后部的通道里，以便在顾客走过去的路上有更多机会诱惑他们。

sentences.en: This is also why pharmacies are generally at the rear, even in convenience stores.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么药房通常设在后部，即使在便利店里也是如此。

sentences.en: But supermarkets know shoppers know this, so they use other tricks, like placing popular items halfway along a section, thereby forcing people to walk along the aisle looking for them.
sentences.zh: 但超市知道购物者明白这一点，所以他们使用别的花招，比如把热门商品放在一段货架的中部，从而迫使人们沿着通道走动寻找。

sentences.en: The idea is to boost the length of time shoppers spend in a store.
sentences.zh: 这样做的目的是延长顾客在店里停留的时间。

sentences.en: D Having walked to the end of the fruit and vegetable aisle, shoppers arrive at counters of prepared food, the fishmonger and the butcher.
sentences.zh: 走到果蔬通道的尽头后，购物者便来到熟食柜台、鱼档和肉档。

sentences.en: Then there is the in-store bakery, which can be smelt before being seen.
sentences.zh: 然后是店内面包房，还没看见，就先闻到香味了。

sentences.en: Even small supermarkets now use in-store bakeries.
sentences.zh: 如今连小型超市也设有店内面包房。

sentences.en: Mostly these bake pre-prepared items, and they have boomed, although central bakeries that deliver to many stores are more efficient.
sentences.zh: 这些面包房大多烘烤预先制备好的半成品，而且发展得红红火火，尽管为多家门店配送的中央面包房效率更高。

sentences.en: The smell of freshly baked bread can make people hungry, encouraging them to buy not just bread but other food.
sentences.zh: 刚出炉面包的香味会让人产生饥饿感，促使他们不仅买面包，还购买其他食物。

sentences.en: E There are also numerous ways stores get shoppers to choose particular products.
sentences.zh: 此外，商店还有很多让购物者选择特定商品的办法。

sentences.en: For example, stores encourage customers to buy expensive branded products by arranging them at eye-level, with cheaper ones lower down.
sentences.zh: 例如，商店把昂贵的品牌产品摆在与视线齐平的高度，把较便宜的放在更低处，以此鼓励顾客购买昂贵品牌。

sentences.en: Often head offices specify where everything has to be placed and spot-checks are carried out to make sure instructions are followed to the letter.
sentences.zh: 总部常常规定每件商品必须摆放在什么位置，并进行突击抽查，以确保指示得到不折不扣的执行。

sentences.en: But shelf-positioning is extremely controversial.
sentences.zh: 但货架摆放是一个极具争议的问题。

sentences.en: Despite all the academic papers written on how best to stack shelves, retailers have their own views.
sentences.zh: 尽管关于如何最佳地摆放货架已有大量学术论文，零售商们仍有自己的看法。

sentences.en: While many stores consider eye-level to be the top spot, others think a little higher is better.
sentences.zh: 许多商店认为与视线齐平的位置是最佳位置，而另一些商店则认为稍高一点更好。

sentences.en: F Technology is making the process of monitoring shopper behaviour easier, which is why the security cameras in stores may be doing considerably more than watching out for theft.
sentences.zh: 技术正在使监控购物者行为的过程变得更加容易，这就是为什么店里的安保摄像头所做的可能远不止防盗。

sentences.en: Pictures showing shoppers while they are making their selections can now be analysed.
sentences.zh: 如今可以对这些拍下顾客挑选商品过程的画面进行分析。

sentences.en: It is possible to see how many shoppers went straight to one brand, the number that hesitated, and those that compared several brands.
sentences.zh: 由此可以看出有多少购物者径直走向某一个品牌，有多少人犹豫不决，又有多少人比较了好几个品牌。

sentences.en: However, despite the availability of sophisticated technology, researchers have found that simply talking to consumers as they exit the store can yield valuable insights.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管有精密的技术可用，研究人员发现，在顾客离开商店时简单地与他们交谈也能获得有价值的见解。

sentences.en: This low-tech approach has become widespread following comments from stores that data collected electronically tells them little about why so many customers leave without making a purchase.
sentences.zh: 这种低技术含量的方法之所以广为流行，是因为各门店反映，电子方式收集的数据几乎无法告诉他们，为什么这么多顾客不买东西就离开。

sentences.en: Face-to-face interviews reveal that customers leave shops empty-handed more often because they are unable to decide than because prices are too high.
sentences.zh: 面对面访谈显示，顾客空手离开商店，更多是因为拿不定主意，而不是因为价格太高。

sentences.en: G People tell market researchers that they make decisions about what to buy based on logic and common sense, considering issues such as price, quality or convenience.
sentences.zh: 人们对市场研究人员说，他们根据逻辑和常识来决定买什么，会考虑价格、质量或便利性等因素。

sentences.en: But there are clearly other factors which play a role, such as certain feelings and memories which individuals are not fully aware of.
sentences.zh: 但显然还有其他因素在起作用，例如人们并未完全意识到的某些情感和记忆。

sentences.en: Researchers hired by big stores are now conducting studies using functional magnetic resonance imaging, which detects changes in the brain corresponding to increases or decreases in mental activity.
sentences.zh: 大型商店聘请的研究人员目前正在利用功能性磁共振成像技术开展研究，这种技术可以检测大脑中与脑力活动增减相对应的变化。

sentences.en: Research participants are shown different products and asked questions about them, while scanners reveal their brain activity as they respond.
sentences.zh: 研究对象会被展示不同的产品并被问及相关问题，与此同时，扫描仪会显示他们作出回答时的大脑活动。

sentences.en: Often, major contradictions are apparent between what they say and what they are thinking.
sentences.zh: 他们所说的与他们所想之间常常存在明显的重大矛盾。

sentences.en: This is immensely valuable information.
sentences.zh: 这是极其宝贵的信息。

sentences.en: Eight out of ten new consumer products launched on the market do not succeed, despite having been tested on people who insist they would buy them but who, deep down, may have reservations about the desirability of these products.
sentences.zh: 每10种新上市的消费产品中就有8种会失败，尽管它们曾在一些坚称自己会购买的人身上做过测试——而这些人在内心深处，可能对这些产品是否可取存有保留。

sentences.en: H This shopping science probably has its limits, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，这门购物科学可能有其局限。

sentences.en: Dr Eric Spangenberg of the University of Washington argues that while it's unlikely that someone could be persuaded to buy something they don't need, they might be convinced to choose one brand in preference to another without being aware that this is happening.
sentences.zh: University of Washington的Eric Spangenberg博士认为，虽然不太可能说服一个人去购买自己不需要的东西，但却可能在他毫无察觉的情况下，让他选择一个品牌而非另一个品牌。

sentences.en: This claim is also borne out by numerous research findings.
sentences.zh: 这一论断也得到了大量研究结果的支持。

sentences.en: But if consumers were to realise quite how much research is being done into the many psychological factors influencing their choices, they might be much more wary of making purchases in the future.
sentences.zh: 但如果消费者意识到，针对影响自己选择的众多心理因素正在进行何等大量的研究，他们今后购物时可能会更加警惕。

sentences.en: (A) More than half of the world's languages are at risk, but an unlikely saviour is at hand.
sentences.zh: 全世界超过一半的语言正处于危险之中，但一位意想不到的救星即将出现。

sentences.en: What is an endangered language?
sentences.zh: 什么是濒危语言？

sentences.en: As a rough guide, any language with fewer than 10,000 speakers is in danger.
sentences.zh: 粗略的标准是，任何使用人数少于1万的语言都处于危险之中。

sentences.en: However, the total number of speakers is not always a clear indication of the health of a language.
sentences.zh: 然而，使用者的总人数并不总是能清楚地表明一种语言的健康状况。

sentences.en: In the South Andaman Islands, for example, fewer than 100 people speak Onge, but it is the primary language of those who do, and, critically, the first language of all the islands' children.
sentences.zh: 例如，在South Andaman Islands，讲Onge语的人不到100人，但它是这些人使用的主要语言，而且至关重要的是，它还是岛上所有儿童的第一语言。

sentences.en: Consequently, it would be considered less threatened than a language such as Chipewyan in Canada, where more than 4,000 belong to the ethnic group that uses the language, but there is little use among the new generation.
sentences.zh: 因此，Onge语会被认为所受的威胁小于Canada的Chipewyan语这类语言——在后者那里，使用该语言的族群有超过4000人，但新一代中几乎没有人使用这种语言。

sentences.en: (B) It could be argued that in today's globalised world, we would be better off all speaking the same language, be it Chinese, English or Spanish.
sentences.zh: 有人可能会说，在如今这个全球化的世界里，如果大家都讲同一种语言——无论是汉语、英语还是西班牙语——我们的处境会更好。

sentences.en: It might bring us closer together, and we would certainly be more likely to make our ideas comprehensible.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让我们彼此更加亲近，而且我们的想法无疑也更有可能被别人理解。

sentences.en: The majority of linguists argue, however, that when it comes to language, diversity matters.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数语言学家认为，谈到语言，多样性至关重要。

sentences.en: (C) “People's understanding of themselves, and their relationship with their environment are all framed in terms of concepts expressed in their own languages,” says Marcus Colchester, director of the Forest Peoples Programme.
sentences.zh: “人们对自己的理解，以及他们与环境的关系，都是用他们自己的语言所表达的概念来构建的，”Forest Peoples Programme的负责人Marcus Colchester说。

sentences.en: “Many indigenous peoples derive their identities from the way they live off their land.
sentences.zh: “许多原住民的身份认同来自于他们依靠土地谋生的方式。

sentences.en: Day-to-day activities such as hunting, fishing and farming are directly connected to the spirits and mythic beings whose stories make these people who they are.”
sentences.zh: 狩猎、捕鱼和耕作等日常活动与神灵和神话中的生灵直接相连，而正是这些生灵的故事塑造了这些人的身份。”

sentences.en: (D) Louisa Maffi of Terralingua, an organisation that protects cultural and biological diversity, believes linguistic diversity is of immense value to humanity as a whole.
sentences.zh: 供职于保护文化与生物多样性的组织Terralingua的Louisa Maffi认为，语言多样性对整个人类具有巨大的价值。

sentences.en: As we lose each language, we lose a repository of knowledge, values and beliefs that, in many cases, provide alternative solutions to human problems; we diminish that pool of creativity and inventiveness, and our ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
sentences.zh: 每失去一种语言，我们就失去一座蕴藏知识、价值观和信念的宝库，它们在很多情况下能为人类的问题提供其他的解决方案；我们也就削弱了那股创造力与发明力的储备，以及我们适应不断变化的环境的能力。

sentences.en: (E) Nicholas Ostler, chairman of the Foundation for Endangered Languages, points out the scientific interest in maintaining linguistic diversity.
sentences.zh: Foundation for Endangered Languages的主席Nicholas Ostler指出了维护语言多样性在科学上的价值。

sentences.en: To lose diversity will mean losing awareness of the many and varied features of human language — what part of our vocal tract we use for communication, the different ways we use words to reflect meaning, and so on.
sentences.zh: 失去多样性将意味着失去对人类语言众多而多样特征的认识——我们用声道的哪个部位来进行交流、我们用词语反映意义的各种不同方式，等等。

sentences.en: (F) Historically, colonial governments practised policies of compelling minority cultures to speak the majority language.
sentences.zh: 历史上，殖民政府实行过迫使少数文化群体讲多数语言的政策。

sentences.en: But even where there was little or no forced assimilation, imperialism still took its toll.
sentences.zh: 但即使在很少或根本没有强制同化的地方，帝国主义仍然造成了损害。

sentences.en: Ostler cites the example of the ancient Roman Empire, which had no specific policy of forcing subjects to speak Latin, but still greatly reduced linguistic diversity across Europe.
sentences.zh: Ostler举了古代Roman Empire的例子：它没有迫使臣民讲拉丁语的专门政策，却仍然大大降低了整个Europe的语言多样性。

sentences.en: There was some prestige associated with the language—it was the medium of trade and administration—and people who wanted to get on in life tended to learn it.
sentences.zh: 这种语言带有某种威望——它是贸易和行政的媒介——想要出人头地的人往往会学习它。

sentences.en: And similar processes are threatening minority languages today, says Ostler.
sentences.zh: Ostler说，类似的过程如今也在威胁着少数族群语言。

sentences.en: “The Romans succeeded in making people live in larger communities, what we now call urbanisation.
sentences.zh: “Roman人成功地让人们住进更大的社区，也就是我们如今所说的城市化。

sentences.en: And nowadays people move from the countryside to cities where regional languages aren't maintained.
sentences.zh: 而如今，人们从乡村搬到城市，而在城市里，地方语言得不到延续。

sentences.en: The new generation grows up with their lives focused on the wider community.
sentences.zh: 新一代人在成长过程中，生活重心放在更广阔的社区上。

sentences.en: It may take several generations for the traditional language to fall out of use completely.”
sentences.zh: 传统语言可能要经过好几代人才会完全停止使用。”

sentences.en: (G) “Many nation states see cultural diversity as a threat to national unity,” says Maffi, “so monolingualism is promoted in specific contexts, particularly schools, where there is no multilingual education offered, and in government, where politics is only conducted in the national language.
sentences.zh: “许多民族国家将文化多样性视为对国家统一的威胁，”Maffi说，“因此在特定的场合，尤其是不提供多语言教育的学校，以及只用国语开展政务的政府部门，单语主义得到推行。

sentences.en: Such implicit endorsement of monolingualism conspires to place pressure on minority peoples to assimilate.
sentences.zh: 这种对单语主义的隐性背书相互交织，给少数族群施加压力，迫使他们同化。

sentences.en: There is essentially a misconceived either/or ideology: either you maintain your mother tongue, in which case you can't participate in national life, or you forget your mother tongue and learn the majority language.”
sentences.zh: 从本质上说，这里存在一种被误解的非此即彼的观念：要么保留母语，但那样你就无法参与国家生活；要么忘掉母语，去学习多数人的语言。”

sentences.en: (H) In recent decades, the mass media have reinforced this process further and extended the penetration of metropolitan languages like English and Spanish beyond urban centres into smaller communities.
sentences.zh: 近几十年来，大众媒体进一步强化了这一进程，使英语和西班牙语这类大都会语言的渗透越过了城市中心，延伸到更小的社区。

sentences.en: The pervasive influence of the media has effectively created a cultural divide between the generations.
sentences.zh: 媒体无孔不入的影响实际上在两代人之间造成了一道文化鸿沟。

sentences.en: Ostler continues, where young people speak their traditional language with their elders, but English among themselves.
sentences.zh: Ostler接着说，年轻人与长辈交流时讲自己的传统语言，而在同龄人之间则讲英语。

sentences.en: Maffi describes similar trends among indigenous minority groups worldwide.
sentences.zh: Maffi描述了世界各地原住民少数群体中类似的趋势。

sentences.en: “All of the images children see in the media are of the glamorised lifestyle of the majority, and that lifestyle is communicated in the majority language.
sentences.zh: “孩子们在媒体上看到的形象全都是被美化的多数族群生活方式，而这种生活方式又是用多数族群的语言来传达的。

sentences.en: So it becomes very difficult for them to find a reason to value their own language.”
sentences.zh: 因此，他们很难找到一个重视自己语言的理由。”

sentences.en: (I) When the internet first took off during the mid-1990s, many feared it represented the end of the road for endangered languages.
sentences.zh: 当互联网在20世纪90年代中期开始兴起时，许多人担心它预示着濒危语言已经走到尽头。

sentences.en: Because it was only available to English-speakers, it would only serve to continue the decline.
sentences.zh: 由于当时只有讲英语的人才能使用互联网，它只会让这种衰退继续下去。

sentences.en: However, these fears proved to be unfounded, as the diversity of languages on the web increased rapidly in the years that followed.
sentences.zh: 然而，事实证明这些担忧是没有根据的，因为在随后的几年里，网络上的语言多样性迅速增加。

sentences.en: Peter Austin, of London's School of Oriental and African Studies, attributes this to the lack of control on the internet.
sentences.zh: 来自London的School of Oriental and African Studies的Peter Austin将这一点归因于互联网缺乏管控。

sentences.en: “Unlike most TV or radio, the web isn't in the hands of big media corporations.
sentences.zh: “与大多数电视或广播不同，网络并不掌握在大型媒体公司手中。

sentences.en: All you need is an internet account and a little technology, and you can produce information, news, videos, and so on, as much as you want.”
sentences.zh: 你只需要一个互联网账户和一点技术，就可以随心所欲地制作信息、新闻、视频等等。”

sentences.en: Minority groups around the world—in Hawaii, Mexico, Siberia, and many other places—are now taking advantage of this autonomy to document their language in written, audio and visual format.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的少数群体——无论是在Hawaii、Mexico、Siberia还是其他许多地方——如今正利用这种自主权，以书面、音频和视频的形式记录自己的语言。

sentences.en: And, crucially, it is in a form which appeals to young people.
sentences.zh: 而且，至关重要的是，它是以一种能吸引年轻人的形式呈现的。

sentences.en: It seems that the mass media could, after all, be the salvation of the world's most threatened languages.
sentences.zh: 看来，大众媒体终究还是有可能成为世界上那些最受威胁的语言的救星。

sentences.en: (A) According to game theory, our chances of success in negotiations are based on the choices of others.
sentences.zh: 根据博弈论，我们在谈判中成功的机会取决于他人的选择。

sentences.en: Computer models have been developed to work out how events will unfold as people and organisations act in what they perceive to be their own best interests.
sentences.zh: 人们已开发出计算机模型，用以推算当个人和组织按照自己认定的最大利益行事时，事态将如何发展。

sentences.en: Numerical values are placed on the goals, motivations and influence of players, and likely options are considered.
sentences.zh: 参与者的目标、动机和影响力都被赋予数值，并对各种可能的选择加以考虑。

sentences.en: Game-theory software then evaluates the ability of each of those players to influence others, and hence predicts the course of events.
sentences.zh: 然后，博弈论软件会评估其中每个参与者影响他人的能力，进而预测事件的进程。

sentences.en: (B) Although many individuals would feel uncomfortable having a computer make decisions for them, many organisations run such computer simulations for law firms, companies and governments.
sentences.zh: 尽管让计算机替自己做决定会令许多人感到不安，但许多机构会为律师事务所、公司和政府运行这类计算机模拟。

sentences.en: But feeding software with accurate data on all the players involved is especially tricky for political matters.
sentences.zh: 但是，就政治事务而言，要向软件提供所有相关参与方的准确数据尤其棘手。

sentences.en: Reinier van Oosten of Decide, a Dutch firm that models political negotiations, notes that predictions may become unreliable when people unexpectedly give in to ‘non-rational emotions’, such as hatred, rather than pursuing what is apparently in their best interests.
sentences.zh: Decide是一家为政治谈判建模的荷兰公司，该公司的Reinier van Oosten指出，当人们出人意料地屈服于仇恨等“非理性情绪”，而不是去追求表面上最符合自身利益的东西时，预测就可能变得不可靠。

sentences.en: However, sorting out people’s motivations is much easier when making money is the main object.
sentences.zh: 不过，当主要目标是赚钱时，理清人们的动机会容易得多。

sentences.en: Accordingly, modelling behaviour using game theory is proving especially useful when applied to economics.
sentences.zh: 因此，事实证明，将基于博弈论的行为建模应用于经济学时格外有用。

sentences.en: (C) Using game-theory software to model auctions can be very lucrative.
sentences.zh: 用博弈论软件为拍卖建模可能非常有利可图。

sentences.en: Consulting firms are entering the market to help clients design profitable auctions, or to win them less expensively.
sentences.zh: 咨询公司正进入这一市场，帮助客户设计有利可图的拍卖，或者以更低的代价赢得拍卖。

sentences.en: In 2006, in the run-up to an online auction of radio-spectrum licences by America’s Federal Communications Commission, Dr Paul Milgrom, a consultant and Stanford University professor in the United States, customised his game-theory software to assist a consortium of bidders.
sentences.zh: 2006年，在America的Federal Communications Commission举行无线电频谱许可证在线拍卖的筹备阶段，United States的顾问兼Stanford University教授Paul Milgrom博士定制了他的博弈论软件，以协助一个由竞标者组成的联合体。

sentences.en: He was apprehensive at first, but the result was a triumph.
sentences.zh: 起初他有些担忧，但结果大获成功。

sentences.en: When the auction began, Milgrom’s software tracked competitors’ bids to estimate their budgets for the 1,132 licences on offer.
sentences.zh: 拍卖开始后，Milgrom的软件追踪竞争对手的出价，以估算他们对全部1132份待拍许可证的预算。

sentences.en: Crucially, the software estimated the secret values bidders placed on specific licences, and determined that certain big licences were being over-valued.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，该软件估算了竞标者私下赋予特定许可证的价值，并判定某些大型许可证的价格被高估了。

sentences.en: Milgrom’s clients were then directed to obtain a collection of smaller, less-expensive licences instead.
sentences.zh: 随后，Milgrom的客户们得到指引，转而获取一批更小、更便宜的许可证。

sentences.en: Two of his clients paid about a third less than their competitors for an equivalent amount of spectrum, saving almost $1.2 billion.
sentences.zh: 他的两位客户为等量频谱支付的价格比竞争对手低约三分之一，节省了近12亿美元。

sentences.en: Such a saving makes one wonder why everyone isn’t using game-theory software.
sentences.zh: 如此可观的节省让人不禁纳闷，为什么不是所有人都在使用博弈论软件。

sentences.en: And, if they were, how would that affect the game?
sentences.zh: 再者，如果所有人都在用，那又会如何影响这场博弈呢？

sentences.en: (D) PA Consulting, a British firm, designs models for software based on game theory to help its clients solve specific problems in areas from pharmaceuticals to the production of television shows.
sentences.zh: PA Consulting是一家英国公司，它设计基于博弈论的软件模型，帮助客户解决从制药到电视节目制作等领域的具体问题。

sentences.en: British government agencies have asked PA Consulting to build models to test zoning rules that govern how many of a certain type of business should be allowed to operate in one area.
sentences.zh: 英国政府机构已请PA Consulting构建模型，以测试管控某类企业在同一区域内获准经营数量的区划规定。

sentences.en: To give a simple example: if two competing ice-cream sellers share a long beach, they will set up stalls back-to-back in the middle and stay put, explains Dr Stephen Black, a modeller for PA.
sentences.zh: PA的建模人员Stephen Black博士解释道：举一个简单的例子，如果两个相互竞争的冰淇淋售卖者共用一条长海滩，他们就会把摊位背靠背地设在中间，并且原地不动。

sentences.en: Unfortunately for potential customers at the far ends of the beach, each seller prevents the other from relocating—no other spot would be closer to more people.
sentences.zh: 对海滩两端的潜在顾客来说不幸的是，每个卖家都阻止对方搬迁——因为没有哪个其他位置能更靠近更多的人。

sentences.en: Introduce a third seller, however, and the stifling equilibrium is broken as relocations and pricing changes energise the market.
sentences.zh: 然而，只要引入第三个卖家，随着重新选址和价格调整盘活了市场，这种令人窒息的均衡就会被打破。

sentences.en: By studying a chain of events such as this, software designers can assess the effect of change and see the patterns in possible outcomes that may occur.
sentences.zh: 通过研究这样一连串的事件，软件设计者可以评估变化的影响，并看出可能出现的各种结果中的规律。

sentences.en: As a result, the use of modelling makes clients more inclined to look at future repercussions when making business decisions, Black says.
sentences.zh: Black说，因此，使用建模使客户在做出商业决策时更倾向于审视未来的后果。

sentences.en: (E) Where is all this heading?
sentences.zh: 这一切将走向何方？

sentences.en: Alongside the increasingly elaborate modelling software, there are also efforts to develop software that can assist in negotiation and mediation.
sentences.zh: 与日益精密的建模软件并行，人们还在努力开发能够协助谈判和调解的软件。

sentences.en: Two decades ago, Dr Clara Ponsatí, a Spanish academic, came up with a clever idea.
sentences.zh: 20年前，西班牙学者Clara Ponsatí博士想出了一个巧妙的办法。

sentences.en: She accepted that, as negotiators everywhere know, the first side to disclose the maximum amount that it is willing to pay loses considerable bargaining power.
sentences.zh: 她承认，正如世界各地的谈判者所知，最先透露自己愿意支付的最高金额的一方会失去相当大的议价能力。

sentences.en: Without leverage, it can be pushed backward in the bargaining process by a clever opponent.
sentences.zh: 而一旦没有筹码，这一方就可能在谈判过程中被狡猾的对手步步逼退。

sentences.en: But if neither side reveals the concessions it is prepared to make, negotiations can become very slow or collapse.
sentences.zh: 但如果双方都不透露自己准备作出的让步，谈判就可能变得非常缓慢，或者彻底破裂。

sentences.en: However, difficult negotiations can often be pushed along by neutral mediators, especially if they are entrusted with the secret bottom lines of all parties.
sentences.zh: 不过，困难的谈判往往可以由中立的调解人加以推进，尤其是当各方把各自秘密的底线托付给他们时。

sentences.en: Ponsatí’s idea was that if a human mediator was not trusted, affordable or available, a computer could do the job instead.
sentences.zh: Ponsatí的想法是，如果人类调解人得不到信任、费用高昂或是无法找到，计算机可以代为完成这项工作。

sentences.en: Negotiating parties would update the software with the confidential information on their bargaining positions after each round of talks.
sentences.zh: 谈判各方在每一轮会谈结束后，会把有关自身谈判立场的机密信息更新到软件中。

sentences.en: Once positions on both sides were no longer mutually exclusive, the software would be used to split the difference and propose an agreement.
sentences.zh: 一旦双方的立场不再相互排斥，就会用该软件来折中处理并提出一份协议。

sentences.en: Ponsatí, now head of the Institute of Economic Analysis at the Autonomous University of Barcelona in Spain, says such ‘mediation machines’ could be employed to push negotiations forward by unlocking information that would otherwise be withheld from an opponent.
sentences.zh: Ponsatí如今是Spain的Autonomous University of Barcelona的Institute of Economic Analysis的负责人，她说，这类“调解机器”可以用来推动谈判，使那些原本会被对手隐瞒的信息得以披露。

sentences.en: (F) Could mediation which has been achieved using software based on game theory spread from auction bids and utility pricing to resolving political and military disputes?
sentences.zh: 借助基于博弈论的软件实现的调解，能否从拍卖出价和公用事业定价扩展到解决政治和军事争端？

sentences.en: Today’s game-theory software is not yet sufficiently advanced to mediate between warring countries.
sentences.zh: 如今的博弈论软件还没有先进到可以在交战国之间进行调解的程度。

sentences.en: But one day opponents on the brink of war might be tempted to use it to exchange information without having to engage in conflict.
sentences.zh: 但总有一天，濒临开战的敌对双方可能会禁不住想用它来交换信息，而不必真的兵戎相见。

sentences.en: According to some game theorists, opponents could learn how a war would turn out, skip the fighting and strike a deal.
sentences.zh: 按照一些博弈论学者的说法，敌对双方可以预先了解一场战争会如何收场，从而跳过战斗，直接达成协议。

sentences.en: Over-optimistic, perhaps—but game theorists do have rather an impressive track record when it comes to predicting the future.
sentences.zh: 这也许过于乐观——但在预测未来方面，博弈论学者确实有着相当了不起的过往记录。
