sentences.en: (A) Being a responsible employer in New Zealand used to require a fairly short checklist: a regular salary or wages, a safe working environment, and that was about it.
sentences.zh: 在New Zealand，做一个负责任的雇主过去所要求的清单相当简短：定期发放的薪水或工资，再加上安全的工作环境，基本仅此而已。

sentences.en: But these days, the checklist is growing, and companies are increasingly expected to play a much greater role in the health and wellbeing of their employees.
sentences.zh: 但如今，这份清单正在不断加长，人们越来越期望公司在员工的健康与福祉方面发挥大得多的作用。

sentences.en: Definitions of workplace wellness or wellbeing vary, but the World Health Organisation's definition extends the employer's responsibilities beyond safety concerns and into the wider workplace environment.
sentences.zh: 关于职场健康或福祉的定义各不相同，但World Health Organisation的定义将雇主的责任扩展到安全问题之外，延伸到更广泛的工作场所环境中。

sentences.en: Today, this means things like the boss making sure their staff aren't bored or feeling undervalued, and company trying to minimise the pressure and tensions that are experienced in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 如今，这意味着诸如老板要确保员工不感到无聊或不觉得自己不受重视，公司要尽力将工作场所中经受的压力和紧张降到最低这样的事情。

sentences.en: It could also involve providing 'wellness programmes' that consider all these factors and help staff to lead healthier lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 它还可能包括提供“健康计划”，这类计划会考虑到所有这些因素，并帮助员工过上更健康的生活方式。

sentences.en: (B) This approach has found some support among employers in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 这种做法在New Zealand的雇主中获得了一些支持。

sentences.en: The organisation Business NZ conducted research in 2013 that found that 9 out of 10 businesses believed employee wellbeing and contentment was either desirable or a priority.
sentences.zh: Business NZ这一机构在2013年开展的研究发现，10家企业中有9家认为员工的健康与满足要么值得追求，要么属于优先事项。

sentences.en: It was also found that 61% of New Zealand companies with more than 100 employees now have a wellness programme.
sentences.zh: 研究还发现，在员工人数超过100人的New Zealand公司中，如今已有61%设有健康计划。

sentences.en: Others may join in since the Health and Safety at Work Act came into being.
sentences.zh: 自《Health and Safety at Work Act》出台以来，其他公司可能也会陆续加入。

sentences.en: The emphasis of the law is still on preventing physical injury at work, but a spokesperson says that a significant focus is now also the need for employers to take an active role in the wider health and wellbeing of staff.
sentences.zh: 这部法律的重点仍然放在预防工作中的身体伤害上，但一位发言人表示，如今另一个重要的关注点是雇主需要在员工更广泛的健康与福祉方面发挥积极作用。

sentences.en: (C) Kelly Davis Martin is the director of Achieve Wellness, which helps companies set up wellness programmes.
sentences.zh: Kelly Davis Martin是Achieve Wellness的总监，该机构帮助公司设立健康计划。

sentences.en: She says the increase in companies looking to set up programmes is positive, but she would like to see a lot more being done.
sentences.zh: 她说，希望设立此类计划的公司越来越多，这是积极的，但她希望能看到更多的实际行动。

sentences.en: ‘We need to make sure these programmes are worthwhile and contribute to real change,’ she says.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我们需要确保这些计划是值得的，并能促成真正的改变。”

sentences.en: This is supported by data from the Productivity Commission, which shows that New Zealanders work as hard as employees in other western countries, but produce less.
sentences.zh: 这一点得到了来自Productivity Commission的数据的支持：数据显示，New Zealand人像其他西方国家的员工一样努力工作，但产出却更少。

sentences.en: This means that they need to work smarter, not harder, and wellness programmes might help with that.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们需要更巧妙地工作，而不是一味苦干，而健康计划或许能对此有所帮助。

sentences.en: (D) Insurance provider Accident Compensation Corporation is one New Zealand organisation that has recently set up a wellness programme.
sentences.zh: 保险机构Accident Compensation Corporation就是最近设立了健康计划的New Zealand机构之一。

sentences.en: The first initiative involves the 2,000 staff taking part in a special challenge, where teams compete with each other to see who can walk the furthest in a week.
sentences.zh: 第一项活动是让2000名员工参加一项特别挑战，各团队相互比拼，看谁能在一周内走最远的距离。

sentences.en: A spokesperson says there is no single reason behind the programme, except that it is an essential part of keeping staff healthy.
sentences.zh: 一位发言人表示，这项计划背后并没有什么单一的原因，只是它是保持员工健康不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: Phone company 2degrees Mobile also began its first wellness programme recently.
sentences.zh: 电话公司2degrees Mobile最近也启动了它的首个健康计划。

sentences.en: Manager Sarah Friis says the company was looking to increase staff engagement and show employees they were of value.
sentences.zh: 经理Sarah Friis表示，公司当时希望提高员工的参与度，并向员工表明他们是有价值的。

sentences.en: The company has close to 800 employees, and its programme was established by eight volunteers from around the business.
sentences.zh: 该公司拥有近800名员工，其健康计划由来自公司各部门的八名志愿者创建。

sentences.en: A range of initiatives were included in the programme, such as sports events and team challenges, and vaccinations were offered against things like influenza for which there was no charge.
sentences.zh: 该计划包含了一系列活动，例如体育赛事和团队挑战，还免费提供流感等疫苗接种。

sentences.en: This year 2degrees has taken professional advice, but Friis says their programme is still internally run because this is vital to keeping the energy going and getting feedback on what is working and what needs to changed.
sentences.zh: 今年，2degrees已听取了专业建议，但Friis表示，他们的计划仍由内部运营，因为这对保持计划的活力至关重要，也有助于获得关于哪些做法有效、哪些需要改进的反馈。

sentences.en: It now has an online facility which allows employees to keep up to date with all the latest advice on health and wellness.
sentences.zh: 公司现在拥有一个在线平台，让员工能够随时了解有关健康与保健的所有最新建议。

sentences.en: Two years in, Friis says one of the obvious benefits is a sense of greater unity, which she believes has been achieved by all staff eating a healthy lunch as a group every now and again.
sentences.zh: 计划推行两年后，Friis表示，一个明显的好处是员工有了更强的团结感，她认为这是通过全体员工不时集体享用健康午餐实现的。

sentences.en: A more measurable benefit was shown in the 2degrees staff survey, which the company conducts every year, showing that more staff now recognise that 2degrees cares about the wellness of its employees.
sentences.zh: 一个更可衡量的好处体现在2degrees每年开展的员工调查中：调查显示，如今有更多员工认识到2degrees关心员工的健康。

sentences.en: (E) One further New Zealand company that is developing its wellness programme is Sovereign Insurance.
sentences.zh: 另一家正在发展其健康计划的New Zealand公司是Sovereign Insurance。

sentences.en: CEO Symon Brewis-Weston says that when he started at the company, the existing programme was satisfactory, with a number of employees using the opportunity to receive counselling.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官Symon Brewis-Weston表示，他刚加入公司时，原有的计划还是令人满意的，不少员工利用这一机会接受心理辅导。

sentences.en: But he wanted more people to become involved and decided to include activities that created more staff interest.
sentences.zh: 但他希望有更多人参与进来，于是决定加入一些更能激发员工兴趣的活动。

sentences.en: So the new scheme offers financial contributions for employee sports’ teams and discounts on the likes of dental treatment.
sentences.zh: 因此，新方案为员工运动队提供资金资助，并在牙科治疗等方面提供折扣。

sentences.en: The company also has quarterly wellbeing challenges, including one where staff cut down on sugar and got tips on ways to reduce their daily intake.
sentences.zh: 公司还开展季度健康挑战活动，其中包括一项让员工减少糖分摄入并获得降低每日摄入量建议的挑战。

sentences.en: About 50% of staff took part, says Brewis-Weston.
sentences.zh: Brewis-Weston表示，大约有50%的员工参加了这项活动。

sentences.en: (F) Interestingly, however, some research from the USA, where wellness programmes have been in place much longer, suggests that the initiatives are not always as impressive as you might think.
sentences.zh: 然而，有趣的是，健康计划在USA已实施了更长的时间，来自USA的一些研究表明，这些举措的效果并不总是像你可能以为的那么令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: One study suggests that participants lost an average of less than half a kilogram a year, and that there were no significant reductions in the costs involved when it is necessary for employees to go to hospital for care.
sentences.zh: 一项研究表明，参与者平均每年减重不足半公斤，而且在员工需要住院接受治疗时所涉及的费用方面也没有显著的降低。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the US book Surviving Workplace Wellness suggests that done badly, the programmes waste money and upset staff who feel they are made to take too many unnecessary tests.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，来自USA的书籍《Surviving Workplace Wellness》指出，如果实施不当，这类计划会浪费金钱，并让那些觉得自己被迫接受过多不必要检查的员工感到不满。

sentences.en: Given these findings, New Zealand companies will have to work hard to make sure their own wellness programmes achieve more success.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这些发现，New Zealand的公司将不得不努力确保自己的健康计划取得更大的成功。

sentences.en: (A) After the oil tanker Prestige spilt her cargo just off north-west Spain in November 2002, the beautiful beaches of the Galician coastline were covered by a metre-deep mixture of oil and seawater.
sentences.zh: 2002年11月，油轮Prestige号在Spain西北部近海泄漏了所载货物，Galician海岸线上美丽的海滩被一层深达一米的石油与海水混合物覆盖。

sentences.en: The Prestige was only one incident in a long series of accidents involving oil tankers.
sentences.zh: Prestige号事故只是涉及油轮的漫长事故系列中的一起。

sentences.en: But while each new incident, including that of the Prestige, brings environmental destruction and financial loss, it also improves our understanding of how to deal with oil spills.
sentences.zh: 但是，包括Prestige号在内的每一起新事故，在带来环境破坏与经济损失的同时，也增进了我们对如何应对漏油事故的认识。

sentences.en: This knowledge is hard-won, as people have often learned from mistakes made in dealing with oil spills.
sentences.zh: 这些知识来之不易，因为人们在应对漏油事故时常常是从所犯的错误中汲取教训的。

sentences.en: Aggressive clean-ups have sometimes caused more damage than the oil.
sentences.zh: 激进的清理行动有时造成的损害比石油还要大。

sentences.en: But such difficulties apart, a rough consensus on how to deal with the issues involved in cleaning up oil spills has begun to emerge.
sentences.zh: 不过，撇开这些困难不谈，关于如何处理清理漏油所涉各种问题的大致共识已开始形成。

sentences.en: (B) Oil is much less damaging at sea than on shore, so the best option is to skim the spilled oil off the surface of the water using specially equipped ships.
sentences.zh: 石油在海上造成的损害远比在岸上小，因此最佳选择是使用装有专门设备的船只，把泄漏的石油从水面撇除。

sentences.en: A series of wooden booms floating on the surface of the water can also be used to protect the coastline.
sentences.zh: 漂浮在水面的一系列木质围油栏也可以用来保护海岸线。

sentences.en: But the sea around the Prestige was too rough for the former, and much of the coast too exposed for booms to work, so there was little that could be done except watch the oil wash up onto the beaches.
sentences.zh: 但Prestige号周围的海面风浪太大，无法使用前一种方法，而大部分海岸又太过暴露，围油栏难以发挥作用，因此人们几乎无计可施，只能眼看着石油冲上海滩。

sentences.en: (C) When oil arrives onshore, the question becomes how best to save affected plants and animals, while minimizing damage to the surrounding ecosystem, without running up a huge bill.
sentences.zh: 石油上岸之后，问题就变成如何在不大笔花钱的前提下，最好地拯救受影响的动植物，同时把对周边生态系统的损害降到最低。

sentences.en: In large spills, leaving nature to do the job is a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 在大规模漏油事故中，听任大自然去完成这项工作是个糟糕的主意。

sentences.en: Even the oiliest shore will return to normal, but without human intervention this can take many years.
sentences.zh: 即使是被油污最严重的海岸也会恢复正常，但若没有人工干预，这可能需要许多年。

sentences.en: In the case of the Prestige, both the volume of oil spilt and the wildlife, fishing and tourist value of the Galician coast demanded action by specialists.
sentences.zh: 就Prestige号而言，泄漏石油的总量以及Galician海岸的野生动物、渔业和旅游价值都要求由专业人员采取行动。

sentences.en: (D) To decide what to do, specialists combined their own professional experience with local knowledge in an assessment process known as 'net environmental benefit analysis'.
sentences.zh: 为了决定该做什么，专业人员在一个被称为“net environmental benefit analysis”的评估过程中，把自身的专业经验与当地知识结合了起来。

sentences.en: Factors taken into account include possible environmental destruction, such as damage to an oiled beach which is home to a breeding colony of seals or seabirds.
sentences.zh: 纳入考虑的因素包括可能造成的环境破坏，例如某个沾油海滩受到损害，而那里是海豹或海鸟繁殖群的栖息地。

sentences.en: Less immediate socio-economic repercussions also come into play: local people may rely on shellfish beds, for example, or an affected beach could be a tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 不那么直接的社会经济影响也被纳入考量：例如，当地人可能以贝类养殖场为生，或者受影响的海滩可能是一处旅游目的地。

sentences.en: And such practical realities as the cost incurred by a particular clean-up option and how easy it will be to implement are also assessed.
sentences.zh: 此外，诸如某种清理方案所需费用以及实施难易程度之类的现实因素也在评估之列。

sentences.en: (E) Every intensive clean-up option has its drawbacks.
sentences.zh: 每一种高强度清理方案都有其缺点。

sentences.en: When oil from the Exxon Valdez polluted the Alaskan shoreline in 1989, hot water applied under high pressure was used to scrub the beaches.
sentences.zh: 1989年，当Exxon Valdez号的石油污染Alaskan海岸线时，人们用高压喷出的热水擦洗海滩。

sentences.en: But the parts of the shoreline that got this treatment recovered more slowly than those that did not.
sentences.zh: 但接受这种处理的海岸地段恢复得比未经处理的地段更慢。

sentences.en: In Spain, this technique has so far been used only on man-made structures such as harbour walls.
sentences.zh: 在Spain，这项技术迄今仅用于港口堤壁之类的人工建筑。

sentences.en: (F) Other methods have been even more aggressive than this.
sentences.zh: 还有一些方法比这更加激进。

sentences.en: When the Torrey Canyon ran aground off the south coast of England in March 1967, oiled beaches were treated with 10,000 tonnes of chemical sprays.
sentences.zh: 1967年3月，当Torrey Canyon号在England南部海岸外搁浅时，沾油的海滩被喷洒了1万吨化学喷剂。

sentences.en: These turned out to be more toxic than the oil: many seashore invertebrates died, and the nutrients in the dispersants caused an explosion of seaweed growth.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这些喷剂的毒性比石油还大：许多海岸无脊椎动物死亡，而分散剂中的养分又导致海藻疯长。

sentences.en: (G) In Galicia, local people wanted heavy machinery to come in and remove large quantities of oil quickly.
sentences.zh: 在Galicia，当地人希望重型机械开进来，迅速清除大量的石油。

sentences.en: But this has its own environmental cost.
sentences.zh: 但这样做也有其自身的环境代价。

sentences.en: There were no tracks to the worst-affected beaches and it was feared that building them would harm the surrounding landscape.
sentences.zh: 受灾最重的海滩没有便道可通，人们担心修建便道会损害周围的景观。

sentences.en: But in one of the areas affected, oil on the surface of the beaches was likely to be washed into the pipe that supplied water to a large fish farm.
sentences.zh: 但在其中一个受影响地区，海滩表面的石油很可能被冲入为一家大型养鱼场供水的管道。

sentences.en: In the end, the desire to safeguard the farm tipped the balance in favour of building tracks for bulldozers and earthmovers, which scooped up the oil from the beach.
sentences.zh: 最终，保护养鱼场的愿望使天平倾向于为推土机和挖土机修建便道，这些机械把石油从海滩上铲走。

sentences.en: Such equipment was not used in all areas affected by the Prestige spill, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，并非所有受Prestige号泄漏影响的地区都使用了这类设备。

sentences.en: Salt-marshes and estuaries are such delicate terrain that almost any activity does more damage than the oil.
sentences.zh: 盐沼和河口是极其脆弱的地带，几乎任何活动造成的损害都比石油更大。

sentences.en: (H) After the Amoco Cadiz disaster in 1978, when nearly a quarter of a million tonnes of oil were spilt off the coast of north-western France, heavy equipment was sent in to some polluted salt-marshes, where it scraped up the top half-metre of sediment.
sentences.zh: 1978年Amoco Cadiz号灾难之后——当时近25万吨石油泄漏于France西北部海岸附近海域——重型设备被开进一些受污染的盐沼，刮去了表层半米厚的沉积物。

sentences.en: Twelve years later, these areas had still not recovered, whereas the oiled marshes that went uncleaned seemed in good shape.
sentences.zh: 十二年之后，这些区域仍未恢复，而未经清理的沾油沼泽看起来却状态良好。

sentences.en: (I) After a short period of time, the Prestige spill moved from the emergency phase—high profile, high pressure—to a long-term painstaking project.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，Prestige号漏油事故便从紧急阶段——备受瞩目、压力巨大——转入一项长期而艰苦的工程。

sentences.en: Cleaning the beaches, for example, was a huge task.
sentences.zh: 例如，清理海滩就是一项巨大的任务。

sentences.en: At Carnota, one of the most heavily affected areas of Galicia, dozens of volunteers and soldiers worked their way along six kilometres of sand on hands and knees, scraping up the small lumps of solidified oil.
sentences.zh: 在Galicia受灾最严重的地区之一Carnota，数十名志愿者和士兵手脚并用地沿着六公里的沙滩艰难前行，刮起一块块凝固的小油块。

sentences.en: At other beaches nearby, people sifted the sand and combed seaside plants by hand to remove the oil and stop it becoming buried.
sentences.zh: 在附近的其他海滩，人们用手筛沙、梳理海边的植物，以清除石油并防止它被掩埋。

sentences.en: (J) Once workers there had done all they could, stubborn patches still remained on rocks and in crevices.
sentences.zh: 当那里的工人已竭尽全力之后，岩石上和缝隙里仍残留着顽固的油斑。

sentences.en: A possibility was to move oily rocks down the beach into the surf since this accelerates the natural cleaning process, as can 'flushing'—i.e.
sentences.zh: 一种办法是把沾油的石块搬到海滩下方有海浪拍打的地方，因为这样可以加速自然清洁过程，就像“冲洗法”那样，即：

sentences.en: pumping seawater over the shore and sifting the oil out of the run-off.
sentences.zh: 用泵把海水抽洒到岸上，再把石油从流出的水中筛出来。

sentences.en: But as the coastline became cleaner, the clean-up started to cost more for progressively less reward and more environmental damage.
sentences.zh: 但随着海岸线变得越来越干净，清理工作的代价越来越高，收益却越来越少，环境损害却越来越大。

sentences.en: The Galicians were then faced with perhaps their most difficult decision: when to stop.
sentences.zh: Galician人此时面临的大概是他们最艰难的决定：何时收手。

sentences.en: As with most such operations, this decision is usually taken by local politicians rather than by environmentalists.
sentences.zh: 与大多数这类行动一样，这一决定通常由当地政界人士而非环保人士作出。

sentences.en: A Ask most people when the movies began and they will point to the 1890s, but many historians trace the story back to 1824.
sentences.zh: 问大多数人电影始于何时，他们会指向19世纪90年代，但许多历史学家把这段历史的起点追溯到1824年。

sentences.en: In that year the British physician Peter Mark Roget described a curious property of human sight: when a series of still pictures is shown to the eye in quick succession, the brain holds each image for a fraction of a second, so that the pictures appear to blend into continuous movement.
sentences.zh: 就在那一年，British医生Peter Mark Roget描述了人类视觉的一种奇特特性：当一系列静止画面快速连续地呈现于眼前时，大脑会将每一幅影像保留几分之一秒，于是这些画面看上去便融合成了连续的运动。

sentences.en: This effect, later known as 'persistence of vision', was the principle behind every device that followed.
sentences.zh: 这种效应后来被称为“视觉暂留”，它是此后所有设备背后的原理。

sentences.en: B The most successful of the early devices was the Zoetrope, created in 1834 by another Briton, the mathematician William George Horner.
sentences.zh: 早期设备中最成功的是Zoetrope，由另一位British人、数学家William George Horner于1834年创造。

sentences.en: It consisted of a hollow drum, turned by means of a crank.
sentences.zh: 它由一个空心圆鼓构成，借助曲柄转动。

sentences.en: Around the inner surface of the drum ran a strip of paper carrying a sequence of drawings or paintings, each showing a slightly different stage of an action.
sentences.zh: 鼓的内壁上绕着一条纸带，上面画着一系列素描或绘画，每一幅表现某个动作略有不同的一个阶段。

sentences.en: Cut into the wall of the drum, at regular intervals, were narrow vertical slits.
sentences.zh: 鼓壁上按相等的间隔开有一道道狭窄的竖直狭缝。

sentences.en: When the drum was spun and the viewer looked through the slits, the pictures inside appeared to move.
sentences.zh: 当圆鼓旋转、观看者透过狭缝看去时，里面的画面便仿佛动了起来。

sentences.en: Sold as a toy from the 1860s onwards, the Zoetrope remained popular for decades.
sentences.zh: 从19世纪60年代起作为玩具出售的Zoetrope，流行了数十年。

sentences.en: C Photography, which arrived in 1839, soon replaced hand-drawn images.
sentences.zh: 1839年问世的摄影术很快取代了手绘图像。

sentences.en: In 1861 Coleman Sellers, an engineer from Philadelphia, patented the Kinematoscope, a device which presented a sequence of stereoscopic (3D) photographs on glass plates, mounted in order inside a viewing cabinet.
sentences.zh: 1861年，来自Philadelphia的工程师Coleman Sellers为Kinematoscope取得了专利，这种装置把一系列立体（3D）照片呈现在玻璃板上，玻璃板按顺序安装在一个观看柜内。

sentences.en: Nine years later, in the same city, the inventor Henry Renno Heyl went a step further and put his pictures on a screen.
sentences.zh: 九年后，还是在同一座城市，发明家Henry Renno Heyl更进一步，把他的影像搬上了银幕。

sentences.en: On 5 February 1870, at the Academy of Music in Philadelphia, Heyl used a machine he called the Phasmatrope to show an audience of around 1,500 people a series of photographs of dancers.
sentences.zh: 1870年2月5日，在Philadelphia的Academy of Music，Heyl用一台他称之为Phasmatrope的机器，向约1500名观众展示了一系列舞者的照片。

sentences.en: Projected in rapid succession, the pictures created a convincing illusion of motion.
sentences.zh: 这些照片被快速连续地投射出来，营造出令人信服的运动错觉。

sentences.en: D Meanwhile, in France, Charles Emile Reynaud had been working on an improved version of the Zoetrope.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在France，Charles Emile Reynaud一直在研制Zoetrope的改进版。

sentences.en: His Praxinoscope, devised in 1877, did away with the slits altogether; in their place Reynaud fixed a ring of mirrors at the centre of the drum, so that the spinning pictures were reflected to the viewer as a bright and steady image.
sentences.zh: 他于1877年设计的Praxinoscope完全取消了狭缝；Reynaud在圆鼓中央固定了一圈镜子，使旋转的画面以明亮而稳定的影像反射给观看者。

sentences.en: Two years later the British-born photographer Eadweard Muybridge produced the Zoopraxiscope.
sentences.zh: 两年后，British-born摄影师Eadweard Muybridge造出了Zoopraxiscope。

sentences.en: This was a true projector: images printed around the edge of a disc were thrown onto a screen as the disc turned, and a whole room could watch the result.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的放映机：印在圆盘边缘的影像随圆盘转动而被投射到银幕上，满屋子的人都能看到影像。

sentences.en: E All of these machines, however, were essentially animations – clever tricks that fooled the eye.
sentences.zh: 不过，所有这些机器本质上都是动画——愚弄眼睛的巧妙把戏。

sentences.en: True motion pictures, in which real movement is recorded and then replayed, could only come about once a camera existed that could take photographs fast enough.
sentences.zh: 真正的电影——把真实运动记录下来再重放——只有在出现了拍照速度足够快的摄影机之后才可能问世。

sentences.en: The first real progress was made in the 1880s by Etienne-Jules Marey, a Paris physiologist who wanted to understand how animals and people move.
sentences.zh: 第一个真正的进展出现在19世纪80年代，出自Paris生理学家Etienne-Jules Marey之手，他想弄清动物和人是如何运动的。

sentences.en: In 1882 he built a camera shaped like a rifle which could take twelve photographs per second, and he later refined the design until it could record as many as thirty images a second.
sentences.zh: 1882年，他制造了一台形似步枪、每秒可拍摄十二张照片的摄影机；后来他又不断改进设计，使其每秒最多能记录三十幅影像。

sentences.en: Marey called the results chronophotographs, and it was the speed at which they were recorded that made them so revolutionary.
sentences.zh: Marey把这些成果称为chronophotographs，而正是记录它们的速度使之具有如此革命性。

sentences.en: F Marey's cameras produced a handful of images at a time, but a film would need thousands.
sentences.zh: Marey的摄影机一次只能产生少量影像，而一部电影却需要成千上万幅。

sentences.en: In 1888 Louis Le Prince, a Frenchman working in the English city of Leeds, built and patented a camera that used long rolls of paper coated with photographic emulsion; two short fragments of the films he shot with it still survive.
sentences.zh: 1888年，在English城市Leeds工作的French人Louis Le Prince制造了一台使用涂有感光乳剂的长纸卷的摄影机并为其申请了专利；他用它拍摄的两小段影片至今仍存世。

sentences.en: The following year the American George Eastman offered a far more practical material – a flexible, transparent roll of celluloid film.
sentences.zh: 第二年，American人George Eastman提供了一种实用得多的材料——一种柔软透明的赛璐珞胶片卷。

sentences.en: Between them, Muybridge, Marey, Le Prince and Eastman had supplied all the ingredients from which cinema could be made.
sentences.zh: Muybridge、Marey、Le Prince和Eastman共同提供了制造电影所需的全部要素。

sentences.en: G It was at Thomas Edison's laboratory in New Jersey that the ingredients were first combined.
sentences.zh: 正是在Thomas Edison位于New Jersey的实验室里，这些要素首次被结合在一起。

sentences.en: In November 1890 Edison's British assistant, William Dickson, devised a simple but ingenious motor-powered camera known as the Kinetograph.
sentences.zh: 1890年11月，Edison的British助手William Dickson设计出一台简单而精巧的电动机驱动摄影机，也就是后来所说的Kinetograph。

sentences.en: Its most important feature was a sprocket system of Dickson's own design: the teeth of a rotating wheel engaged with holes punched along both edges of the 35mm-wide film, pulling it through the camera and holding each frame still for an instant in front of the shutter.
sentences.zh: 其最重要的特点是Dickson自行设计的一种齿轮输片系统：旋转轮的齿与沿35毫米宽胶片两侧打出的孔眼相啮合，把胶片拉过摄影机，并让每一帧画面在快门前静止一瞬间。

sentences.en: The Kinetograph was heavy, fixed in one position and needed a great deal of light, and its bulky electric motor was soon abandoned in favour of a lightweight hand-crank mechanism.
sentences.zh: Kinetograph笨重、只能固定在一个位置且需要大量光线，它那庞大的电动机很快便被弃用，取而代之的是轻便的手摇装置。

sentences.en: But although the motor itself did not last, the Kinetograph's film format and its method of advancing the film set the standard for the motion picture cameras that would be used for the next century.
sentences.zh: 不过，尽管电动机本身未能延续下来，Kinetograph的胶片格式及其输片方式却为此后一个世纪所使用的电影摄影机确立了标准。

sentences.en: H Dickson also designed an early viewing machine, the Kinetoscope: a tall cabinet in which a loop of film ran continuously past a lamp, watched from above by a single customer.
sentences.zh: Dickson还设计了一台早期观看设备——Kinetoscope：一个高柜，环形胶片在其中连续经过一盏灯旁，由一名顾客从上方观看。

sentences.en: In its earliest form the film was wrapped around a cylinder, and it was on this cylinder version that Dickson shot his first experimental test film, Monkeyshines No. 1 – a few seconds of a laboratory assistant waving his arms about.
sentences.zh: 在其最早的形式中，胶片绕在圆柱体上，Dickson正是用这种圆柱版本拍摄了他的第一部实验测试片Monkeyshines No. 1——几秒钟内一名实验室助手挥舞双臂的画面。

sentences.en: It is the only film from the cylinder Kinetoscope to have survived, and is generally regarded as the first motion picture ever produced on photographic film in the United States.
sentences.zh: 它是圆柱式Kinetoscope留存至今的唯一影片，并被普遍视为the United States有史以来第一部用摄影胶片制作的电影。

sentences.en: The Kinetoscope's design, however, meant that only one person could watch at a time.
sentences.zh: 然而，Kinetoscope的设计意味着每次只能有一个人观看。

sentences.en: I Meanwhile in Lyon, France, the brothers Louis and Auguste Lumière, whose family firm manufactured photographic plates, were following Edison and Dickson's work with great interest.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在France的Lyon，Louis和Auguste Lumière兄弟——他们的家族企业生产摄影底版——正饶有兴味地关注着Edison和Dickson的工作。

sentences.en: Rather than copy the Kinetoscope, they created a multi-purpose device which combined a camera, a printer and a projector in one lightweight box that could be carried by hand.
sentences.zh: 他们没有照搬Kinetoscope，而是创造出一种多功能设备，把摄影机、印片机和放映机结合在一个可手提的轻便箱子里。

sentences.en: They patented it in February 1895 as the Cinématographe.
sentences.zh: 1895年2月，他们以Cinématographe之名为其取得了专利。

sentences.en: Commercially it proved far more profitable than the Edison model, because a large number of spectators could watch the same film on a big screen at the same time.
sentences.zh: 在商业上，它远比Edison的模式更有利可图，因为大量观众可以同时在大银幕上观看同一部影片。

sentences.en: On 28 December 1895, in the Salon Indien of the Grand Café in Paris, the Lumières presented the first commercial exhibition of a projected motion picture to a paying public.
sentences.zh: 1895年12月28日，在Paris的Grand Café的Salon Indien，Lumière兄弟首次向付费观众进行了投影电影的商业放映。

sentences.en: The programme consisted of ten short films, including one of workers leaving the Lumière factory.
sentences.zh: 放映节目由十部短片组成，其中一部拍摄的是工人们走出Lumière工厂的情景。

sentences.en: The word 'cinema' itself comes from the name of their machine, and that December evening is generally regarded as the moment the movies were born.
sentences.zh: “cinema”一词本身就源自他们那台机器的名字，而那个十二月的夜晚被普遍视为电影的诞生时刻。

sentences.en: (A) New Zealand's reptiles come in three forms: the tuatara, the geckos and the skinks.
sentences.zh: New Zealand的爬行动物共有三种：楔齿蜥、壁虎和石龙子。

sentences.en: With their gleaming scales, long bodies and often surprisingly short limbs, skinks are instantly recognisable.
sentences.zh: 石龙子鳞片闪亮、身体细长、四肢往往短得出人意料，让人一眼就能辨认出来。

sentences.en: There are more than 90 species, half of which still await formal description.
sentences.zh: 石龙子共有90多个物种，其中一半仍等待正式描述。

sentences.en: Identification depends on where specimens are found, and such minutiae as the number of scales on their toes.
sentences.zh: 物种鉴定取决于标本发现的地点，以及诸如脚趾上鳞片数量之类的细微特征。

sentences.en: Two of the largest species of skink the grand and the Otago - are found only in Otago, in New Zealand's South Island.
sentences.zh: 两种体型最大的石龙子——grand石龙子和Otago石龙子——仅见于New Zealand南岛的Otago地区。

sentences.en: Skinks, being reptiles, need to regulate their temperature, and lie on sunny rocks to absorb heat.
sentences.zh: 石龙子是爬行动物，需要调节体温，会趴在阳光照射的岩石上吸收热量。

sentences.en: However, the grand and Otago are the only kinds that do not hibernate through winter; when snow can fall even in summer in Otago, there is no point in them lying dormant for extended periods.
sentences.zh: 然而，grand和Otago是唯一不冬眠过冬的种类；在Otago，就连夏天也可能下雪，它们长时间蛰伏不动毫无意义。

sentences.en: Like all other New Zealand reptiles except tuatara and the egg-laying Suter's skink, they give birth to tiny baby lizards.
sentences.zh: 与New Zealand其他所有爬行动物（楔齿蜥和产卵的Suter石龙子除外）一样，它们直接产下幼小的蜥蜴宝宝。

sentences.en: Today, the Otago and grand skinks are lucky to reach five years of age in the wild, although in zoos or research centres they can live beyond thirty.
sentences.zh: 如今，Otago石龙子和grand石龙子在野外能活到5岁已属幸运，不过在动物园或研究中心它们可以活过30岁。

sentences.en: (B) Unfortunately, extinction may loom for these reptiles.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，灭绝的阴影可能正笼罩着这些爬行动物。

sentences.en: With any decline in New Zealand fauna, predation is always suspected, so the efforts of the Department of Conservation (DOC) have focused on controlling specific pests.
sentences.zh: 每当New Zealand的野生动物数量出现下降，人们总会怀疑是捕食所致，因此保育部（DOC）的工作重点一直放在控制特定有害动物上。

sentences.en: An example was a six-year project to control the feral cats on the Otago Skink Reserve, launched in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 一个例子是20世纪90年代启动的为期6年的项目，旨在控制Otago石龙子保护区内的野猫。

sentences.en: Despite the capture of hundreds of cats, skinks showed no signs of recovery; indeed, there were further declines.
sentences.zh: 尽管捕获了数百只猫，石龙子却没有表现出任何恢复的迹象；事实上，数量还在进一步下降。

sentences.en: The trapping programme also revealed rats and hedgehogs to be predators.
sentences.zh: 诱捕计划还揭示出，老鼠和刺猬也是捕食者。

sentences.en: (C) Parasite infections are also thought to be on the rise.
sentences.zh: 寄生虫感染也被认为呈上升趋势。

sentences.en: Although no direct health implications have been detected the trend is a concern, as it may signal a subtle deterioration in the skinks’ living environment.
sentences.zh: 虽然尚未检测到对健康的直接影响，这一趋势仍令人担忧，因为它可能预示着石龙子居住环境正在悄然恶化。

sentences.en: Infection with mites is suspected of inhibiting reproduction among captive animals.
sentences.zh: 螨虫感染被怀疑会抑制圈养动物的繁殖。

sentences.en: (D) Another potential threat is habitat loss.
sentences.zh: 另一个潜在威胁是栖息地丧失。

sentences.en: Eight hundred years ago, Otago was covered in forest.
sentences.zh: 800年前，Otago曾被森林覆盖。

sentences.en: However, extensive burning produced wide open tussock country.
sentences.zh: 然而，大范围的焚烧造就了开阔的丛生草地带。

sentences.en: The skinks' response to this change isn't known, nor what their habitat was in the earlier environment, with its predominance of shrubs and trees.
sentences.zh: 石龙子对这一变化作何反应不得而知，也不清楚在早期以灌木和树木为主的环境中，它们的栖息地是什么样的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, recent intensive farming has led to poor soil.
sentences.zh: 此外，近来的集约化农业导致土壤贫瘠。

sentences.en: Even if we had the answer to the eradication of predators, we haven't a clue to the habitat we should be recreating for the skinks, or if where they persist is best for conservation.
sentences.zh: 即使我们有了根除捕食者的办法，对于应该为石龙子重建怎样的栖息地，或者它们如今存身的地方是否最有利于保护，我们也一无所知。

sentences.en: (E) It is also puzzling that grands and Otagos are disappearing more rapidly than other species in the same region.
sentences.zh: 同样令人费解的是，grand石龙子和Otago石龙子正比同一地区的其他物种消失得更快。

sentences.en: The explanation likely lies in their delayed sexual maturity.
sentences.zh: 解释可能在于它们性成熟较晚。

sentences.en: Taking five years before you can breed is a handicap, since there is little likelihood of surviving that long.
sentences.zh: 要等5年才能繁殖是一种不利条件，因为几乎没有可能活那么久。

sentences.en: If survivors have only two offspring annually, they do little to remedy the situation.
sentences.zh: 如果幸存者每年只有2只后代，它们对扭转局势无济于事。

sentences.en: The commoner skinks mature earlier and produce more offspring, thereby doing more to counter predator pressure.
sentences.zh: 较常见的石龙子成熟更早、产生的后代更多，从而在对抗捕食压力方面作用更大。

sentences.en: Not that there is room for complacency concerning these species.
sentences.zh: 不过，就这些物种而言，也没有自满的余地。

sentences.en: As more is learned about the size of skink populations, it becomes clear that even common species may be facing a doubtful future.
sentences.zh: 随着人们对石龙子种群规模的了解不断加深，越来越明显的是，就连常见物种的前景也可能难以乐观。

sentences.en: (F) So far, DOC's efforts to eliminate specific predators have not resulted in a recovery of skink numbers.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，DOC清除特定捕食者的努力并未带来石龙子数量的回升。

sentences.en: The prediction that less than six years is all the Otagos and grands have left is supported by data from surveys conducted outside the protected area between 1984 and 2002.
sentences.zh: Otago石龙子和grand石龙子剩余时间不足6年这一预测，得到了1984年至2002年间在保护区之外所做调查数据的支持。

sentences.en: These show that more than 50 per cent of sub-populations of both skinks have died out over the past years.
sentences.zh: 这些数据表明，过去数年间，两种石龙子超过50%的亚种群已经消亡。

sentences.en: Populations in other regions are believed to be smaller, although access issues on some properties limit knowledge.
sentences.zh: 据信其他地区的种群规模更小，不过一些地块的进入受限也限制了人们的了解。

sentences.en: No more than five years remain in which to turn things around a close call considering it will be at least three before detectable response in the populations can be expected owing to their low breeding rate.
sentences.zh: 扭转局面的时间只剩最多5年——考虑到其繁殖率低，预计至少要3年后种群才可能出现可检测的回应，这实在是千钧一发。

sentences.en: (G) DOC's recovery programme team has recently embarked upon an experiment to extend nearly two kilometres of mammal-proof fencing around a population of Otagos and grands in the Macraes Flat reserve.
sentences.zh: DOC恢复计划团队最近启动了一项实验，要在Macraes Flat保护区内一个Otago石龙子和grand石龙子种群周围延伸修建近2公里长的防哺乳动物围栏。

sentences.en: Choosing a site was difficult, as with a limited budget and the high cost of the fencing it had to be small.
sentences.zh: 选址十分困难，因为预算有限而围栏造价高昂，范围必须很小。

sentences.en: It also had to include vacant space and resources for a growing population.
sentences.zh: 它还必须包含供不断增长的种群所需的空余空间和资源。

sentences.en: An added complication was that grands and Otagos have subtly different environmental preferences, both of which need catering for.
sentences.zh: 另一个复杂因素是，grand石龙子和Otago石龙子对环境的偏好略有差异，两种偏好都需要照顾到。

sentences.en: (H) Because of the danger of imminent extinction, the team has also had to develop emergency captive-management techniques.
sentences.zh: 由于面临即将灭绝的危险，团队还不得不开发应急圈养管理技术。

sentences.en: Specially permitted breeders, who have had some success in breeding the Otago in captivity, are now developing techniques to breed grands.
sentences.zh: 获得特别许可的繁育者已经在圈养条件下繁殖Otago石龙子方面取得了一定成功，目前正在开发繁殖grand石龙子的技术。

sentences.en: Captive management, however, is a last resort.
sentences.zh: 然而，圈养管理只是万不得已的手段。

sentences.en: The priority is to manage and protect skinks in the wild.
sentences.zh: 首要任务是管理和保护野外的石龙子。

sentences.en: (I) Getting the public to understand the plight of these creatures is essential.
sentences.zh: 让公众了解这些生物的困境至关重要。

sentences.en: Without public support, their chances are slim.
sentences.zh: 没有公众支持，它们的机会就很渺茫。

sentences.en: Conservation is as much driven by public opinion as it is by political decisions.
sentences.zh: 保护工作既受政治决策驱动，也同样受公众舆论驱动。

sentences.en: In New Zealand, the situation is more pressing than just about anywhere else on the planet because many of its native birds and lizards have simply not evolved to defend themselves against species introduced in the last few hundred years.
sentences.zh: 在New Zealand，形势几乎比地球上任何其他地方都更为紧迫，因为当地许多本土鸟类和蜥蜴根本未曾进化出抵御近几百年来引入物种的能力。

sentences.en: In the once-isolated islands that form New Zealand, ecosystem collapse didn't happen 5000 years ago or even 500 years ago; it's happening now.
sentences.zh: 在构成New Zealand的这片曾经与世隔绝的群岛上，生态系统崩溃并非发生在5000年前，甚至也不是500年前；它就发生在现在。

sentences.en: (J) Fortunately, DOC no longer faces these problems alone.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，DOC不再需要独自面对这些问题。

sentences.en: The challenge has been taken up by a group of conservationists representing business, science and agriculture.
sentences.zh: 一群代表商界、科学界和农业界的自然保护人士已经迎接了这一挑战。

sentences.en: Central Otago Ecological Trust (COET) aims to establish a refuge for the reintroduction of native species.
sentences.zh: Central Otago Ecological Trust（COET）旨在建立一个庇护所，用于重新引入本土物种。

sentences.en: It has identified suitable habitat and, with the generous support of a local farmer with grazing land there, has begun the construction of a mammal-proof fence to protect a 24-hectare area.
sentences.zh: 该信托已经确定了合适的栖息地，并在一位在当地拥有放牧用地的农场主的慷慨支持下，开始修建防哺乳动物围栏，以保护一片24公顷的区域。

sentences.en: The recovery programme and COET provide hope that skinks might once again flourish.
sentences.zh: 恢复计划和COET带来了石龙子有望再度繁盛的希望。

sentences.en: A The best known model of animal learning behaviour is probably the so-called classical model associated with the Russian scientist Pavlov.
sentences.zh: 最广为人知的动物学习行为模型，大概就是与俄罗斯科学家Pavlov联系在一起的所谓经典模型。

sentences.en: The key features of this model are stimulus, outcome and repetition.
sentences.zh: 这一模型的关键要素是刺激、结果和重复。

sentences.en: Pavlov demonstrated that animals could be trained to associate a sensory stimulus with a particular outcome, even where no natural association exists.
sentences.zh: Pavlov证明，即使在感官刺激与特定结果之间不存在天然联系的情况下，动物也可以被训练得将二者联系起来。

sentences.en: In one famous experiment, dogs learned to associate the sound of a bell with the expectation of food.
sentences.zh: 在一项著名的实验中，狗学会了把铃声与对食物的期待联系起来。

sentences.en: Subsequent models, such as the ‘operant conditioning’ model, also involved observing animals in isolation.
sentences.zh: 此后的模型，例如“操作性条件反射”模型，同样涉及观察处于孤立状态的动物。

sentences.en: Recently, however, behavioural research has focused on how animals are equipped to learn in social settings.
sentences.zh: 然而近年来，行为研究的重点已转向动物如何具备在社会情境中学习的能力。

sentences.en: And interest in the concept of role modelling, already a popular notion for guiding child development, has spread to other species.
sentences.zh: 而榜样示范这一概念早已是指导儿童发展的流行理念，对它的兴趣如今已扩展到其他物种。

sentences.en: B Heyes and Galef (1996) have compiled some very interesting and accessible papers on social learning in mammals.
sentences.zh: Heyes和Galef（1996）汇编了一些关于哺乳动物社会学习的非常有趣且通俗易懂的论文。

sentences.en: One of these papers starts with an account of a school field trip to Israel.
sentences.zh: 其中一篇论文以一次学校赴Israel的实地考察作为开篇。

sentences.en: In a pine forest there, many pine cones were discovered which had been stripped to the central core.
sentences.zh: 在那里的松林中，人们发现许多松果已被啃剥到只剩中心的果芯。

sentences.en: So an investigation was started which had no weighty theoretical intent, but was directed initially at finding out what were eating the nutritious pine seeds, and how they managed to get them out of the cones.
sentences.zh: 于是一项调查展开了——它并没有什么重大的理论意图，起初只是想查明是什么在吃营养丰富的松子，以及它们是如何设法把松子从松果中弄出来的。

sentences.en: The culprit proved to be the versatile and athletic black rat.
sentences.zh: 结果证明，始作俑者正是本领多样、身手矫健的黑鼠。

sentences.en: The forest-dwelling rat used a standard technique, biting off each cone scale in sequence, from base to tip, following the spiral growth pattern of the cone.
sentences.zh: 栖居林间的黑鼠采用一种标准技术，顺着松果的螺旋生长纹路，从基部到尖端依次咬掉每一片果鳞。

sentences.en: C The investigation was then broadened, with the aim of determining how the rat acquires such a skill.
sentences.zh: 随后调查范围得到扩大，目的是查明这种鼠是如何习得这样一门技能的。

sentences.en: Urban black rats were found to lack the skill, and were unable to learn it even when they were housed with experienced cone strippers, such as those found in Israel.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，城市里的黑鼠缺乏这门技能，即使与经验丰富的剥松果能手——比如Israel的那些——养在一起，也无法学会。

sentences.en: However, infants of urban mothers who were fostered to forest mothers acquired the skill, whereas infants of forest mothers fostered by urban mothers did not.
sentences.zh: 然而，由森林母亲抚育的城市母亲幼鼠习得了这门技能，而由城市母亲抚育的森林母亲幼鼠却没有。

sentences.en: Clearly, the skill is not inherited, but has to be taught.
sentences.zh: 显然，这门技能并非遗传而来，而必须经过传授。

sentences.en: D Further elegant experiments showed that naive adult urban rats can develop the skill if they are provided with cones from which the first complete spiral of scales have been removed, rather as people can deduce how to use a new photocopier once they have been shown how to switch it on.
sentences.zh: 进一步的精巧实验表明，如果给毫无经验的成年城市黑鼠提供已被去掉第一圈完整果鳞的松果，它们也能掌握这门技能，这就好比人们一旦被演示了如何打开一台新复印机，便能自己琢磨出如何使用它。

sentences.en: In the case of forest rats, mothers supply their infants with cones which they have partially stripped, thereby providing the key for acquiring the complete stripping skill.
sentences.zh: 就林中黑鼠而言，母鼠会把经自己部分剥过的松果提供给幼鼠，从而为幼鼠掌握完整的剥果技能提供了钥匙。

sentences.en: E We might conclude that this is a good example of adaptive learning, but how economical is it?
sentences.zh: 我们或许会得出结论说这是适应性学习的一个很好的例子，但它究竟有多划算呢？

sentences.en: The researchers went on to determine this by measuring the oxygen uptake of a rat stripping a cone.
sentences.zh: 研究人员接着通过测量黑鼠剥松果时的摄氧量来测定这一点。

sentences.en: The rat was placed in a metabolic chamber so that the amount of energy used in the cone-stripping operation could be calculated.
sentences.zh: 黑鼠被放入一个代谢舱中，以便计算出剥松果这一操作所消耗的能量。

sentences.en: This was then compared with the energy benefit of the pine seeds, as measured by a machine known as a calorimeter.
sentences.zh: 随后再将其与松子的能量收益进行比较，后者由一台称为热量计的仪器测得。

sentences.en: The rat's energy expenditure proved to be less than 10% of the energetic value of the cone – an acceptable profit margin.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，黑鼠的能量消耗不足松果能量价值的10%——这是一个可以接受的利润率。

sentences.en: F A paper by Bednekoff and Balda (1996) provides another example of the adaptiveness of social learning, this time in birds.
sentences.zh: Bednekoff和Balda（1996）的一篇论文提供了社会学习适应性的另一个例子，这次发生在鸟类身上。

sentences.en: It concerns the seed caching behaviour of two birds: Clark's Nutcracker (Nucifraga columbiana) and the Mexican Jay (Aphelocoma ultramarina).
sentences.zh: 它涉及两种鸟类的贮藏种子行为：Clark星鸦（Nucifraga columbiana）和Mexican丛鸦（Aphelocoma ultramarina）。

sentences.en: The former is a specialist, caching 30,000 or so seeds in scattered locations, from where it recovers them over the winter months.
sentences.zh: 前者是这方面的行家，会把30000粒左右的种子分散藏在不同地点，并在冬季的几个月里从那里取回。

sentences.en: The Mexican Jay also caches food, but is not nearly as dependent on this as the Nutcracker.
sentences.zh: Mexican丛鸦也贮藏食物，但远不及星鸦那样依赖这一行为。

sentences.en: The two species also differ in their social structure, the Nutcracker being rather solitary, while the Jay forages in social groups.
sentences.zh: 这两个物种的社会结构也不同：星鸦相当独居，而丛鸦则成群觅食。

sentences.en: G An experiment was conducted to discover not just whether a bird can remember where it hid a seed itself, but also if it can remember where it saw another bird hide a seed.
sentences.zh: 一项实验旨在查明，鸟能否不仅记住自己把种子藏在了哪里，还能记住看见另一只鸟把种子藏在了哪里。

sentences.en: The design of the experiment is slightly comical, with a cacher bird wandering about a room with lots of holes in the floor and hiding food in some of them, while watched by an observer bird perched in a cage.
sentences.zh: 实验设计有几分滑稽：一只藏食鸟在一个地板上布满孔洞的房间里走来走去，把食物藏进其中一些孔洞，而一只观察鸟则栖于笼中注视着这一切。

sentences.en: Two days later, cachers and observers are tested for their discovery rate against an estimated random performance.
sentences.zh: 两天后，对藏食鸟和观察鸟的发现率进行测试，并与估算出的随机水平相对比。

sentences.en: In the role of cacher, not only the Nutcracker but also the less specialised Jay performed above the rate of chance.
sentences.zh: 在藏食者的角色中，不仅星鸦，就连专业化程度较低的丛鸦的表现也高于随机水平。

sentences.en: More surprisingly, however, Jay observers were as successful as Jay cachers, whereas Nutcracker observers did no better than chance.
sentences.zh: 然而更令人惊讶的是，丛鸦观察者的成绩与丛鸦藏食者一样好，而星鸦观察者的表现却并不比随机水平好。

sentences.en: So it seems that, whereas the Nutcracker is highly adapted for remembering where it hid its own seed, the gregarious Mexican Jay is more adept than the Nutcracker at remembering, and so exploiting, the caches of other birds.
sentences.zh: 如此看来，星鸦高度适应于记住自己藏种子的位置，而群居的Mexican丛鸦则比星鸦更擅长记住并进而利用其他鸟类的贮藏点。

sentences.en: (A) On January 30, 1998, an art auction was held in New York city.
sentences.zh: 1998年1月30日，New York市举行了一场艺术品拍卖会。

sentences.en: One drawing was of a pretty girl, but it attracted little attention.
sentences.zh: 其中有一幅描绘漂亮女孩的素描，但几乎没有引起关注。

sentences.en: The catalogue listed the work as a German drawing done in ink and with coloured chalk, dating back to the early 19th century, with styling borrowed from the much earlier Renaissance period.
sentences.zh: 拍卖图录将这件作品列为德国素描，以墨水及彩色粉笔绘制，年代可追溯至19世纪早期，风格借鉴了早得多的文艺复兴时期。

sentences.en: A New York dealer, Kate Ganz, purchased the picture for $21,850.
sentences.zh: New York的一位画商Kate Ganz以21850美元买下了这幅画。

sentences.en: The price had barely changed almost ten years later when a Canadian collector, Peter Silverman, bought it.
sentences.zh: 将近十年后，当加拿大收藏家Peter Silverman买下它时，价格几乎没有变化。

sentences.en: The drawing might actually date from the Renaissance, he thought.
sentences.zh: 他心想，这幅素描说不定真的创作于文艺复兴时期。

sentences.en: Ganz herself had mentioned Leonardo da Vinci as an influence on the artist.
sentences.zh: Ganz本人也曾提到，这位画家受到过Leonardo da Vinci的影响。

sentences.en: Silverman wondered whether it was the work of the great Leonardo himself, but discovery of a Da Vinci is truly rare.
sentences.zh: Silverman想知道它是否出自伟大的Leonardo本人之手，但发现一件Da Vinci真迹实在罕见。

sentences.en: At the time of Silverman’s purchase, it had been more than 75 years since the last authentication of one of the artist’s paintings.
sentences.zh: 在Silverman购得这幅画时，距离这位画家的一幅画作上一次获得鉴定已经过去了75年多。

sentences.en: It had never been recorded that Da Vinci ever made a major work like this, and neither were there any known copies.
sentences.zh: 从未有记载表明Da Vinci创作过这样一幅重要作品，也没有任何已知的摹本。

sentences.en: If this image was an authentic Leonardo, where had it been hiding for 500 years?
sentences.zh: 如果这幅画像是真正的Leonardo真迹，那它这500年里一直藏在哪里？

sentences.en: (B) Silverman emailed a digital image of the drawing to Martin Kemp, professor of art history at Oxford University and renowned Leonardo scholar.
sentences.zh: Silverman用电子邮件将这幅素描的数字图像发给了Oxford University艺术史教授、著名的Leonardo研究学者Martin Kemp。

sentences.en: Kemp immediately flew to Zurich, where Silverman kept the drawing in a bank vault.
sentences.zh: Kemp立即飞往Zurich，Silverman把这幅素描存放在那里的一家银行保险库中。

sentences.en: Kemp was excited and began his own investigation.
sentences.zh: Kemp十分兴奋，并开始了自己的调查。

sentences.en: He was aided by Pascal Cotte of Lumière Technology in Paris, who used high resolution multispectral scans which allowed Kemp to study the drawing’s different layers.
sentences.zh: Paris的Lumière Technology公司的Pascal Cotte为他提供了协助，后者使用高分辨率多光谱扫描，使Kemp得以研究这幅素描的各个层次。

sentences.en: The more Kemp looked, the more he saw what he considered evidence of Leonardo’s hand: the beautiful tone of the colours, the precise lines, and the fact that the shaded areas showed distinctive strokes just like Leonardo’s.
sentences.zh: Kemp看得越多，就越发看到他所认为的Leonardo手笔的证据：色彩的优美色调、精准的线条，还有阴影部分显示出与Leonardo如出一辙的独特笔触。

sentences.en: The subject’s expression was self-confident but thoughtful.
sentences.zh: 画中人的神情自信，却又若有所思。

sentences.en: She appeared to be someone growing up too fast, and conveyed Leonardo’s belief that a portrait should reveal ‘motion of the mind’.
sentences.zh: 她看上去像是一个成长得过快的人，并传达出Leonardo的信念：肖像应展现出“心灵的活动”。

sentences.en: (C) Kemp also needed proof that the portrait had been made during Leonardo's lifetime (1452-1519) and that its historical details fitted the artist's biography.
sentences.zh: Kemp还需要证据，证明这幅肖像创作于Leonardo在世期间（1452-1519年），并且其历史细节与这位画家的生平相符。

sentences.en: Material analysis strongly suggested that the artist had used calfskin, quite normal for the time, and this was then carbon-dated.
sentences.zh: 材料分析强烈表明，画家使用的是小牛皮，这在当时相当普遍，随后人们对其进行了碳年代测定。

sentences.en: Its origin was placed somewhere between 1440 and 1650.
sentences.zh: 其年代被定在1440年至1650年之间的某个时候。

sentences.en: Then costume research revealed that the girl belonged specifically to the Milanese court of the 1490s, with its fashion for elaborately bound hair.
sentences.zh: 随后，服饰研究表明，这个女孩确切属于15世纪90年代的Milan宫廷，当时流行精心盘束的发型。

sentences.en: Leonardo lived in Milan during this time, accepting commissions for portraits of people in the royal court.
sentences.zh: Leonardo当时正住在Milan，承接为宫廷中人绘制肖像的委托。

sentences.en: Stitch marks on the edge of the portrait suggested that it came from a book, possibly the sort, common at the time, that would commemorate a royal marriage.
sentences.zh: 肖像边缘的缝线痕迹表明它出自一本书，很可能是当时常见的那种用于纪念王室联姻的书。

sentences.en: (D) Kemp's detective work led him to a name, Bianca Sforza.
sentences.zh: Kemp的侦探式追查让他锁定了一个名字：Bianca Sforza。

sentences.en: A daughter of the Duke of Milan, she was married in 1496 to Galeazzo Sanseverino, commander of the Milanese troops and a patron of Leonardo's.
sentences.zh: 作为Milan公爵的女儿，她于1496年嫁给了Milan军队统帅、Leonardo的赞助人Galeazzo Sanseverino。

sentences.en: Tragically, she died a few months later.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，几个月后她便去世了。

sentences.en: In 2010 Kemp and Cotte published their findings in a book.
sentences.zh: 2010年，Kemp和Cotte在一本书中发表了他们的研究结果。

sentences.en: Several prominent Leonardo scholars agreed, others were sceptical.
sentences.zh: 几位著名的Leonardo研究学者表示认同，其他人则持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: The possibility of a high-quality forgery was raised.
sentences.zh: 有人提出了存在高质量赝品的可能性。

sentences.en: Doubt centred around the drawing’s sudden, almost miraculous appearance.
sentences.zh: 质疑的焦点是这幅素描突然的、近乎奇迹般的现身。

sentences.en: Where had it come from?
sentences.zh: 它究竟从何而来？

sentences.en: (E) Kemp didn’t know.
sentences.zh: Kemp并不知道。

sentences.en: Then, quite unexpectedly, a message came from David Wright, professor of art history at the University of South Florida.
sentences.zh: 随后，完全出乎意料的是，University of South Florida艺术史教授David Wright发来了消息。

sentences.en: Having followed the very public dispute, Wright suggested to Kemp, whom he had never met, that his answer might lie in the National Library of Poland in Warsaw, inside a book called the Sforziad.
sentences.zh: Wright一直关注着这场备受瞩目的争论，他向素未谋面的Kemp提出，答案也许就藏在Warsaw的National Library of Poland里一本名为《Sforziad》的书当中。

sentences.en: Wright, an expert on Renaissance iconography, described it as a commemorative volume for the marriage of Bianca Sforza, a suitable occasion for a Leonardo portrait.
sentences.zh: 作为文艺复兴图像学专家的Wright将其描述为纪念Bianca Sforza婚礼的卷册——这样的场合正适合一幅Leonardo肖像。

sentences.en: (F) Kemp and Cotte travelled to Warsaw.
sentences.zh: Kemp和Cotte前往了Warsaw。

sentences.en: Cotte’s macrophotography revealed that a page had been removed from the exact place in the Sforziad where a portrait would have been added.
sentences.zh: Cotte的微距摄影显示，《Sforziad》中恰好在本应加入肖像的位置有一页被移除了。

sentences.en: The moment arrived when they inserted a copy of Bianca’s portrait into the open book.
sentences.zh: 当他们把Bianca肖像的复制品插入摊开的书页时，关键时刻到来了。

sentences.en: It fitted perfectly.
sentences.zh: 它完美地契合了。

sentences.en: For Kemp, this was the proof.
sentences.zh: 对Kemp而言，这就是证据。

sentences.en: It was a single portrait by Leonardo that had gone into a book and then onto a shelf.
sentences.zh: 那是Leonardo的一幅单页肖像，它被放进一本书中，随后又被搁上了书架。

sentences.en: (G) According to Wright, the volume reached Poland in the early 1500s, when a member of the Sforza family married a Polish royal.
sentences.zh: 据Wright所说，这本书于16世纪初传入Poland，当时Sforza家族的一位成员与一位Poland王室成员联姻。

sentences.en: The page was removed, possibly at the time of the book’s rebinding in the 17th or 18th century.
sentences.zh: 那一页被移除，可能是在17或18世纪这本书重新装订之时。

sentences.en: The trail grows faint here.
sentences.zh: 线索至此变得模糊起来。

sentences.en: What is known is that at some point it was acquired by an Italian man, a specialist in art restoration, and that his widow put it up for sale at auction.
sentences.zh: 已知的是，它曾在某个时候被一名意大利男子购得，此人是一名艺术品修复专家，而他的遗孀后来将它送去拍卖。

sentences.en: (H) These are amazing times for Leonardo admirers.
sentences.zh: 对Leonardo的仰慕者来说，这是令人惊叹的时代。

sentences.en: Recently, London’s National Gallery exhibited Leonardo’s painting of Jesus Christ holding a globe, a work lost for centuries.
sentences.zh: 最近，London的National Gallery展出了Leonardo所绘的手持地球仪的Jesus Christ，一幅失传数百年的作品。

sentences.en: In Florence, researchers looking for Leonardo’s Battle of Anghiari, last seen in the mid-1500s, are using technology to find out if the painting might be hidden behind a wall in the Palazzo Vecchio, but the issue has not yet been resolved.
sentences.zh: 在Florence，寻找Leonardo《Battle of Anghiari》（最后一次见于16世纪中叶）的研究人员，正利用技术探查这幅画是否藏在Palazzo Vecchio的一面墙后，但这一问题尚未有定论。

sentences.en: (I) Authenticating a centuries-old artwork is seldom an objective process.
sentences.zh: 鉴定一件有数百年历史的艺术品，很少是一个客观的过程。

sentences.en: Ego, personal taste, and fear of legal cases all contribute to the judgement.
sentences.zh: 自我意识、个人品味以及对法律诉讼的顾虑，都会影响这种判断。

sentences.en: To reach wider consensus, Kemp sent his latest findings to a number of leading specialists, almost all of whom declined to comment.
sentences.zh: 为了达成更广泛的共识，Kemp把他最新的研究发现寄给了多位顶尖专家，但几乎所有人都拒绝置评。

sentences.en: Agreement ‘will take time’ concedes Kemp, ‘but I have clear confidence in the research we’ve done.
sentences.zh: Kemp坦言，达成共识“需要时间”，“但我对我们所做的研究有清晰的信心。

sentences.en: One thing is sure, should the day come when Bianca Sforza’s face hangs in a museum as a true Leonardo, everyone will stare.’
sentences.zh: 有一点是肯定的：倘若有一天Bianca Sforza的面容作为真正的Leonardo真迹挂进博物馆，每个人都会驻足凝视。”

sentences.en: (A) While there had been a long tradition of giving rings as a commitment to marry, the custom of giving diamond engagement rings was in large part manufactured by one of the most effective marketing campaigns in history.
sentences.zh: 尽管用赠送戒指作为结婚承诺的做法由来已久，但赠送钻石订婚戒指这一习俗在很大程度上是由历史上最有效的营销活动之一打造出来的。

sentences.en: In the early 1900s, diamond sales were declining, posing a serious problem for the company that essentially had control over the diamond market.
sentences.zh: 20世纪初，钻石销量不断下滑，这对那家实际上掌控着钻石市场的公司来说是一个严重的问题。

sentences.en: In 1938, this company hired an advertising agency, which proposed reshaping social attitudes toward diamonds.
sentences.zh: 1938年，这家公司聘请了一家广告公司，后者提出要重塑社会对钻石的态度。

sentences.en: As well as magazines showing film stars draped in diamonds, the agency arranged for movies to incorporate diamond engagement rings into their plots.
sentences.zh: 除了让杂志展示满身钻石的电影明星之外，这家广告公司还安排电影将钻石订婚戒指融入剧情。

sentences.en: The campaign culminated with the slogan: ‘A diamond is forever.’
sentences.zh: 这场营销活动最终以一句口号达到高潮：“钻石恒久远”。

sentences.en: (B) At the time, the approach was unique.
sentences.zh: 在当时，这种做法是独一无二的。

sentences.en: Rather than pushing a brand, the objective was to promote diamonds as the symbol of everlasting love.
sentences.zh: 其目的不是推广某个品牌，而是要把钻石宣传成永恒爱情的象征。

sentences.en: This was achieved by exploiting the associative nature of the brain: associating neurons¹ activated by the concept of ‘love’ with neurons that encoded the concept of ‘diamonds’.
sentences.zh: 这是通过利用大脑的联想特性实现的：把被“爱”这一概念激活的神经元¹与编码“钻石”概念的神经元关联起来。

sentences.en: By 1941, diamond sales had increased by 55%.
sentences.zh: 到1941年，钻石销量已增长了55%。

sentences.en: (C) Advertising comes in many forms, from blatant neon signs to subtly embedded products in movies.
sentences.zh: 广告的形式多种多样，从刺眼的霓虹灯招牌到电影中巧妙植入的产品。

sentences.en: In each case, the goal is to mould our habits, desires and opinions.
sentences.zh: 无论哪种形式，其目标都是塑造我们的习惯、欲望和观点。

sentences.en: Our visual system is targeted by an avalanche of information on the internet, street posters, billboards and in movie theatres.
sentences.zh: 互联网、街头海报、广告牌以及电影院里铺天盖地的信息都在瞄准我们的视觉系统。

sentences.en: Our auditory system submits to catchy radio jingles and telemarketers.
sentences.zh: 我们的听觉系统则屈服于朗朗上口的电台广告歌和电话推销员。

sentences.en: More surreptitiously, our olfactory system is targeted by variations of vanilla and citrus perfumes aimed at enticing us to linger in a retail outlet.
sentences.zh: 更为隐蔽的是，我们的嗅觉系统成了各种香草味和柑橘味香氛的目标，这些香氛旨在诱使我们在零售店里驻足流连。

sentences.en: (D) It is difficult to measure how effective these campaigns are, but as in the ‘A diamond is forever’ campaign, they can be so successful that they change the fabric of our culture.
sentences.zh: 这些营销活动的效果很难衡量，但正如“钻石恒久远”那场营销活动一样，它们可以成功到改变我们文化结构的程度。

sentences.en: In the case of bottled water, we are swayed by advertising into paying for something that we can obtain for free.
sentences.zh: 以瓶装水为例，我们被广告左右，为原本可以免费获得的东西付钱。

sentences.en: Most people cannot distinguish bottled from tap water, much less between brands of bottled water, which is why you rarely hear of a bottled water company proposing a blind taste test.
sentences.zh: 大多数人分不清瓶装水和自来水，更分不清瓶装水的各个品牌，这就是为什么你很少听说有瓶装水公司提议进行盲品测试。

sentences.en: (E) So why is marketing such an effective mind-control technique?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么营销是一种如此有效的心智控制手段呢？

sentences.en: It is interesting to consider whether other animals exhibit anything analogous to humans’ susceptibility to advertising.
sentences.zh: 有意思的是，可以想一想其他动物是否也会表现出某种类似于人类易受广告影响的情况。

sentences.en: If we provide a lab rat with two types of cereal, it will consume approximately the same amount of each.
sentences.zh: 如果我们给一只实验鼠提供两种谷类食物，它对每一种的进食量会大致相同。

sentences.en: However, if we put that rat with another rat that spent its day eating just one type, when faced with a choice, our rat will now show a preference for the same type as the other rat was eating.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果我们把这只实验鼠和另一只整天只吃其中一种的老鼠放在一起，那么当再次面临选择时，我们的这只老鼠就会表现出对那只老鼠所吃类型的偏好。

sentences.en: Psychologists call this ‘socially transmitted food preference’.
sentences.zh: 心理学家将这种现象称为“社会性传递的食物偏好”。

sentences.en: (F) What many regard as the first documented examples of cultural learning in primates started with a clever monkey that lived in a colony of Japanese monkeys on the island of Koshima.
sentences.zh: 许多人视为灵长类动物文化学习最早有记载的例证，始于一只聪明的猴子，它生活在Koshima岛上的一个日本猴群里。

sentences.en: She began taking her dirt-covered sweet potatoes to the river to wash them before eating them.
sentences.zh: 它开始把沾满泥土的红薯带到河边，洗干净后再吃。

sentences.en: Upon seeing this, a few other open-minded monkeys picked up on the idea.
sentences.zh: 看到这一幕后，另外几只思想开放的猴子也学会了这个做法。

sentences.en: Potato washing then spread from monkey to monkey and, over the course of a few years, most monkeys were eating clean potatoes.
sentences.zh: 洗红薯的做法随后在猴子之间传开，几年之后，大多数猴子都吃上了干净的红薯。

sentences.en: Humans are clearly not the only animals to engage in imitation and social learning.
sentences.zh: 显然，人类并不是唯一会进行模仿和社会学习的动物。

sentences.en: (G) Learning by observation can be an extraordinarily valuable brain feature.
sentences.zh: 通过观察来学习可以是一种极其宝贵的大脑功能。

sentences.en: This is how we learn to communicate and perform motor skills as well as deal with many everyday problems.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样学会交流、掌握动作技能并应对许多日常问题的。

sentences.en: For example, a newcomer struggling to purchase tickets and navigate the subway system in a foreign city may step back to learn from the people nearby.
sentences.zh: 例如，在一个陌生的城市里，为买票和乘坐地铁而犯难的新来者可能会退后一步，向身边的人学习。

sentences.en: Humans and other primates exhibit multiple forms of imitative learning and this is called cultural transmission.
sentences.zh: 人类和其他灵长类动物表现出多种形式的模仿学习，这被称为文化传递。

sentences.en: (H) A component of advertising relies on the marketer’s ability to tap into the brain’s propensity for imitation.
sentences.zh: 广告的一个组成部分依赖于营销者挖掘大脑模仿倾向的能力。

sentences.en: Anybody who has watched TV knows advertisements are disproportionately populated with attractive, successful-looking individuals.
sentences.zh: 任何看过电视的人都知道，广告中格外多的是魅力十足、看似成功的人士。

sentences.en: If we are going to imitate someone, we are more inclined to imitate those who appear to be popular and appealing.
sentences.zh: 如果我们要模仿某个人，我们会更倾向于模仿那些看起来受欢迎、有吸引力的人。

sentences.en: (I) Although not all researchers are convinced by the findings, a number of studies indicate that some animals also imitate dominant members of their group.
sentences.zh: 尽管并非所有研究者都信服这些发现，但多项研究表明，一些动物也会模仿自己群体中居于支配地位的成员。

sentences.en: Primatologist Frans de Waal provides anecdotal evidence of preferential imitation among chimpanzees.
sentences.zh: 灵长类动物学家Frans de Waal提供了黑猩猩之间偏好性模仿的轶事证据。

sentences.en: He noted that in one particular group the dominant male was hurt and was limping as a result.
sentences.zh: 他注意到，在一个特定的群体中，占据支配地位的雄性受了伤，结果走路一瘸一拐。

sentences.en: Soon juvenile males of the group started imitating his limp, a form of flattery that would have been unlikely if a non-dominant male had been injured.
sentences.zh: 很快，群体中的幼年雄性开始模仿它跛行的样子——这是一种讨好，如果受伤的是一只非支配地位的雄性，这种情形就不太可能出现。

sentences.en: (J) Imitation is undoubtedly an invaluable ability, but often our propensity to imitate generalises indiscriminately, leading to poor decisions.
sentences.zh: 模仿无疑是一种极为宝贵的能力，但我们的模仿倾向常常不加区分地泛化，从而导致糟糕的决定。

sentences.en: When athlete Dick Fosbury revolutionised the high jump by jumping over the bar backward in 1968, imitators obviously copied his jumping style, not his brand of sports shoes.
sentences.zh: 1968年，运动员Dick Fosbury以背越式越过横杆，彻底革新了跳高运动，模仿者显然仿效的是他的跳跃姿势，而不是他所穿品牌的运动鞋。

sentences.en: However, today, sportspeople appear in advertisements asking us to buy the laptops or sports drinks that they promote.
sentences.zh: 然而如今，运动员出现在广告中，让我们购买他们推广的笔记本电脑或运动饮料。

sentences.en: Rationally, we know these people’s success did not depend on these products, so it seems our propensity to purchase products relates more to neural programs that evolved to encourage imitation of those further up the social ladder.
sentences.zh: 理智地讲，我们知道这些人的成功并不依赖这些产品，因此，我们购买产品的倾向似乎更多地与那些为鼓励模仿社会层级更高者而演化出来的神经程序有关。

sentences.en: (K) Today, companies engage in stealth marketing campaigns in which people are paid to frequent bars or websites to covertly promote certain products.
sentences.zh: 如今，公司开展隐形营销活动，付钱让人们经常光顾酒吧或浏览网站，以暗中推广某些产品。

sentences.en: Companies also perform studies in which they track the eye movements of people viewing displays, and carefully craft names, packages and jingles associated with their products.
sentences.zh: 公司还会开展研究，追踪人们观看展示品时的眼球运动，并精心打造与其产品相关的名称、包装和广告歌。

sentences.en: (L) While we may like to believe that manipulation on a grand scale would not be possible, that’s not to say that advertising is innately harmful.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们可能愿意相信大规模的操纵不可能发生，但这并不是说广告天生就有害。

sentences.en: To the contrary, the marketing of products or ideas is essential to human culture.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，产品或观念的营销对人类文化至关重要。

sentences.en: The point is that we should ensure our choices reflect our actual goals and desires, and we must distinguish between the dissemination of information which is for our own good, and our manipulation for the benefit of companies.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，我们应当确保自己的选择反映我们真正的目标和愿望，并且必须区分为我们自身利益而进行的信息传播与为公司利益而对我们实施的操纵。

sentences.en: A Of all the human senses, the visual system – the network that turns light into neural signals that create the perception of sight – is the most studied and best understood.
sentences.zh: 在人类的所有感官中，视觉系统——也就是把光线转化为神经信号、从而产生视觉感知的网络——是研究得最多、理解得最透彻的。

sentences.en: Our intense curiosity about sight is no coincidence: we are animals who judge the world mostly by appearances rather than, say, by aromas.
sentences.zh: 我们对视觉的强烈好奇心并非巧合：我们是一种主要凭外表——而非比如说气味——来判断世界的动物。

sentences.en: But our eyes allow us only one view out of a multitude of possibilities.
sentences.zh: 但我们的眼睛只让我们看到无数种可能性中的一种景象。

sentences.en: In the depths of the ocean – a world we are beginning to learn about in detail – marine species have developed visual systems drastically different from our own.
sentences.zh: 在海洋深处——一个我们正开始详细了解的世界——海洋物种演化出了与我们截然不同的视觉系统。

sentences.en: The majority of eyes, whether on land or in the sea, share two basic components: something to focus light as it hits the eye (for humans, a cornea and lens), and something to absorb and detect the light (a retina).
sentences.zh: 无论是在陆地上还是在海洋里，大多数眼睛都有两个基本组成部分：一是在光线进入眼睛时将其聚焦的结构（对人类来说是角膜和晶状体），二是吸收并探测光线的结构（视网膜）。

sentences.en: Then the divergences begin.
sentences.zh: 再往后，差异就开始出现了。

sentences.en: B Ocean creatures’ eyes have evolved a bewildering array of structures suited to each animal’s place in the natural order and the depth at which it lives.
sentences.zh: 海洋生物的眼睛演化出了令人眼花缭乱的一系列结构，以适应每种动物在自然秩序中的位置以及它所生活的深度。

sentences.en: Some amphipods (deep-sea crustaceans) rely on biological fiber-optic cables to send light to their retina.
sentences.zh: 一些端足类动物（深海甲壳动物）依靠生物光纤缆线把光线传送到自己的视网膜。

sentences.en: Sight-dependent, nomadic predators have excellent vision, whereas many creatures that live at great depths can make only simple distinctions between light and dark.
sentences.zh: 依赖视觉、四处游走的捕食者拥有极佳的视力，而许多生活在极深水域的生物只能对明暗作简单的区分。

sentences.en: Light is abundant in the sunny shallows, but 50 feet below the surface, only the shorter wavelengths are able to penetrate, eliminating all discernable colors except blue.
sentences.zh: 在阳光照耀的浅水区，光线十分充足，但在海面以下50英尺处，只有波长较短的光才能穿透，除蓝色以外的所有可辨色彩都被滤除了。

sentences.en: By about one mile down, the last traces of sunlight disappear.
sentences.zh: 在大约1英里的深处，阳光的最后一点痕迹也消失了。

sentences.en: In this realm of perpetual night, the only illumination is manufactured, provided by the many creatures that generate their own light in a process known as bioluminescence.
sentences.zh: 在这片永夜的世界里，唯一的光亮是制造出来的，由许多通过一种名为生物发光的过程自行发光的生物提供。

sentences.en: C As they search for prey, swordfish swim through cold, deep water, occasionally diving as far as 3,000 feet below the surface.
sentences.zh: 剑鱼在搜寻猎物时游弋于寒冷的深水之中，偶尔会下潜到海面以下3000英尺处。

sentences.en: But even in the chilly depths, the swordfish keeps its eyes and brain 10 to 15 degrees Celsius warmer than the surrounding water by means of an unusual heat-generating muscle near the fish’s eye.
sentences.zh: 但即使在寒冷的深处，剑鱼也能凭借其眼部附近一种不同寻常的生热肌肉，使自己的眼睛和大脑比周围水域温暖10到15摄氏度。

sentences.en: Vision researcher Kerstin Fritsches, of the University of Queensland in Australia, along with colleagues there and in the United States and Sweden, found that keeping warm improves the swordfish’s vision.
sentences.zh: 来自Australia的University of Queensland的视觉研究员Kerstin Fritsches与该校以及United States和Sweden的同事发现，保持温暖能改善剑鱼的视力。

sentences.en: At 20°C, the scientists found, a swordfish retina can detect objects moving five times as quickly as the objects it can spot at 10°C.
sentences.zh: 科学家们发现，在20°C时，剑鱼的视网膜能够察觉移动速度比它在10°C时所能看到的物体快5倍的物体。

sentences.en: Since swordfish hunt speedy prey like squid, the ability to see fast-moving swimmers is crucial for finding dinner.
sentences.zh: 由于剑鱼捕食乌贼这类行动迅捷的猎物，能看见快速游动的动物对它找到晚餐至关重要。

sentences.en: D The box jellyfish has surprisingly sophisticated eyes.
sentences.zh: 箱形水母拥有出奇精密的眼睛。

sentences.en: It possesses a total of 24, divided among four eyestalks at the corners of its body.
sentences.zh: 它总共有24只眼睛，分布在身体四角的4个眼柄上。

sentences.en: Four of the eyes on each stalk are simply groups of light-sensing cells that help it distinguish between bright and dark.
sentences.zh: 每个眼柄上的眼睛当中，有4只只是感光细胞群，帮助它区分明暗。

sentences.en: The other two are complex, with lenses that produce high-quality images – but those lenses focus light well below the retina, meaning that the images are out of focus when they hit the light receptors.
sentences.zh: 另外两只则结构复杂，带有能生成高质量图像的晶状体——但这些晶状体把光线聚焦在远低于视网膜的位置，也就是说，图像到达感光细胞时是模糊的。

sentences.en: ‘They’re not really interested in fine details,’ says biologist Dan Nilsson, of the University of Lund in Sweden.
sentences.zh: “它们其实对细节并不感兴趣。”Sweden的University of Lund的生物学家Dan Nilsson说。

sentences.en: Once the jellyfish can see the outlines of its environment, signals from its four simple brains (one in each eyestalk) steer it home to the shallow coastal waters of Australia, all the way from Puerto Rico on the other side of the world.
sentences.zh: 一旦这只水母能看清周围环境的轮廓，来自它4个简单大脑（每个眼柄中有一个）的信号便会为它指引回家的路——从世界另一端的Puerto Rico一路回到Australia沿岸的浅水水域。

sentences.en: E The mantis shrimp, an inhabitant of tropical waters, leads a particularly vibrant life.
sentences.zh: 栖息在热带水域的螳螂虾过着一种格外绚丽多彩的生活。

sentences.en: University of Queensland neurobiologist Justin Marshall found that this crustacean has 12 different color receptors – cells in the retina that are sensitive to different wavelengths of light – whereas humans have only three.
sentences.zh: University of Queensland的神经生物学家Justin Marshall发现，这种甲壳动物拥有12种不同的颜色感受器——即视网膜中对不同波长的光敏感的细胞——而人类只有3种。

sentences.en: These shrimp behold a world we cannot begin to imagine: in addition to seeing a much richer light spectrum, they perceive linear and circular polarized light.
sentences.zh: 这些虾所看到的世界是我们根本无法想象的：除了能看到丰富得多的光谱之外，它们还能感知线偏振光和圆偏振光。

sentences.en: Marshall suspects the ability to see polarized light ‘probably has something to do with reproduction’.
sentences.zh: Marshall怀疑，看见偏振光的能力“可能与繁殖有关”。

sentences.en: A flash of polarized light reflected off a female shrimp, for example, could catch the eye of a potential mate without drawing unwanted attention from predators.
sentences.zh: 例如，从雌虾身上反射出的一道偏振光闪光，可以吸引潜在配偶的目光，又不会招来捕食者不必要的注意。

sentences.en: F In the deep-sea darkness, beyond the reach of the sun’s rays, some creatures make their own light.
sentences.zh: 在阳光无法企及的深海黑暗之中，一些生物会自己制造光。

sentences.en: Organically created light, or bioluminescence, is so useful that it has evolved independently about 40 times across a range of creatures during the course of life on Earth, says bioluminescence expert Edith Widder, founder and CEO of the Ocean Research and Conservation Association in Fort Pierce, Florida, in the United States.
sentences.zh: 生物发光专家、位于United States Florida州Fort Pierce的Ocean Research and Conservation Association的创始人兼CEO Edith Widder表示，有机产生的光，也就是生物发光，非常有用，以至于在地球生命的历程中，它已在一系列生物中独立演化了大约40次。

sentences.en: Female anglerfish let someone else do the work, relying on colonies of light-emitting bacteria to give their lure its distinctive glow.
sentences.zh: 雌性鮟鱇鱼让别的生物代劳，依靠发光细菌群落来使自己的诱饵发出独特的光。

sentences.en: The visual systems of male anglerfish are attuned to this light source; they can tell whether a female belongs to their species just by the silhouette of her lure, thus making it easy to find a mate in the dark.
sentences.zh: 雄性鮟鱇鱼的视觉系统与这种光源相适配；仅凭雌鱼诱饵的轮廓，它们就能判断对方是否属于同一物种，这使得在黑暗中寻找配偶变得容易。

sentences.en: G The atolla jellyfish, found in oceans across the globe, is high on beauty but low on brains.
sentences.zh: 分布于全球各大洋的atolla水母极具美感，却没什么脑子。

sentences.en: Looking beyond the scarlet tentacles will reveal that the creature has no central nervous system.
sentences.zh: 把目光越过它猩红色的触手，就会发现这种生物没有中枢神经系统。

sentences.en: Since it lacks the neural architecture to interpret complex visual information, the jellyfish must rely on its simple but numerous pigment cups.
sentences.zh: 由于缺少解读复杂视觉信息的神经结构，这种水母只能依靠它那些构造简单但数量众多的色素杯。

sentences.en: When attacked, as part of its defence the atolla launches a stunning blue bioluminescent display visible for hundreds of feet through the dusky mid-depth waters where it lives.
sentences.zh: 受到攻击时，作为防御手段的一部分，atolla水母会施放出令人惊叹的蓝色生物发光表演，在它所栖息的昏暗中层水域中，数百英尺之外都能看见。

sentences.en: Blue hues are the only colors of light able to penetrate that far below the surface, so the atolla’s red pigmentation normally makes it largely invisible.
sentences.zh: 蓝色色调是唯一能够穿透到海面下如此深处的光色，因此atolla水母的红色素通常使它几乎隐形。

records.title: American Businesses Aim to Support Employees and Their Families
records.titleZh: 美国企业致力于支持员工及其家庭

sentences.en: A Companies of all sizes in the US recognize the importance of family-friendly policies, thanks in large part to the increasing number of people-centered entrepreneurs and company CEOs.
sentences.zh: 美国各种规模的公司都认识到了家庭友好政策的重要性，这在很大程度上要归功于越来越多以人为本的企业家和公司首席执行官。

sentences.en: Many of these go into business themselves as a result of negative experiences they have had in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人是因为在职场上有过负面经历，才自己创业的。

sentences.en: So says Jennifer West, Managing Director of the Ohio-based Business Research Center, a non-profit organization dedicated to studying work-life balance.
sentences.zh: 这番话出自Jennifer West，她是总部位于俄亥俄州的Business Research Center的总经理，该中心是一家致力于研究工作与生活平衡的非营利组织。

sentences.en: 'Taking a people-centered view is a good recruitment and retention strategy,' says West.
sentences.zh: “采取以人为本的视角是一种很好的招聘和留人策略，”West说。

sentences.en: 'Employers who care about their employees and help them grow take into account the full range of issues and the external pressures that employees have and arrange things so that people can manage their lives.
sentences.zh: “关心员工并帮助他们成长的雇主，会全面考虑员工面临的各种问题和外部压力，并做出相应的安排，让大家能够打理好自己的生活。

sentences.en: These considerations are a conscious part of how people-centered bosses organize their practices and strategies.'
sentences.zh: 这些考虑是以人为本的老板在安排经营做法和策略时有意识纳入的一部分。”

sentences.en: B One employer who exemplifies this philosophy is Stephen Harper, co-owner and CEO of Plastic Solutions in California.
sentences.zh: Stephen Harper就是体现这一理念的雇主之一，他是加利福尼亚州Plastic Solutions公司的共同所有人兼首席执行官。

sentences.en: His company manufactures custom plastics, mainly for medical devices, and offers engineering solutions for other plastics needs.
sentences.zh: 他的公司主要为医疗器械生产定制塑料制品，同时也针对其他塑料需求提供工程解决方案。

sentences.en: Harper believes in having employees who understand the business.
sentences.zh: Harper坚信，员工应当了解公司的业务。

sentences.en: That's why every two weeks, when his employees receive their salary, they also get an update about the company, including who their new customers are, what successes they've had, and what challenges they are facing.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，每隔两周员工领工资时，还会收到一份公司近况通报，内容包括新客户是谁、取得了哪些成绩以及正面临哪些挑战。

sentences.en: Harper also includes a 'coaching' section.
sentences.zh: Harper还加入了一个“辅导”栏目。

sentences.en: This addresses issues like gossip, which employees sometimes indulge in around the water cooler or the rest rooms, and which can negatively impact on the morale of staff.
sentences.zh: 这一栏目针对的是流言蜚语之类的问题，员工有时会在饮水机旁或洗手间里闲聊八卦，这可能对员工士气产生负面影响。

sentences.en: He encourages people to work their way up in the company, and pays, at least partially, for educational opportunities and textbooks.
sentences.zh: 他鼓励员工在公司内部一步步晋升，并且至少承担一部分学习机会和教材的费用。

sentences.en: His employees line up to attend his monthly invitation-only Business Pragmatics seminar, in which communication and other vital skills are taught, along with ethics and workplace morals and philosophy.
sentences.zh: 他的员工争相参加他每月举办、仅限受邀者参加的Business Pragmatics研讨会，研讨会传授沟通及其他重要技能，同时也讲授伦理以及职场道德和理念。

sentences.en: The structure of his company is very family-friendly, and includes a regular Open House day for employees' families where, among other things, kids can experiment with the company's machines that manufacture their products and so on.
sentences.zh: 他的公司架构对家庭十分友好，其中包括定期为员工家属举办开放日，这一天孩子们可以试着摆弄公司用来生产产品的机器，此外还有其他活动。

sentences.en: The Harper philosophy pays off.
sentences.zh: Harper的理念带来了回报。

sentences.en: Attrition at the company is low, and many employees remain with the company for much of their career.
sentences.zh: 公司的人员流失率很低，许多员工职业生涯的大部分时间都留在这家公司。

sentences.en: C In Vermont, the Margaret Mills Corporation also strives to be people-centered.
sentences.zh: 在佛蒙特州，Margaret Mills Corporation同样努力做到以人为本。

sentences.en: It is a third generation, family-run business that sells children's wooden toys internationally, and the company's founder (Margaret Mills) understood all too well the challenges of raising a family while running a business.
sentences.zh: 这是一家传到第三代的家族企业，向世界各地销售儿童木制玩具，公司创始人（Margaret Mills）深知一边经营企业一边养育家庭有多么不易。

sentences.en: Like many other like-minded companies, the Margaret Mills Corporation offers liberal leave, flexi-time, good health and retirement packages, and other benefits.
sentences.zh: 和许多理念相近的公司一样，Margaret Mills Corporation提供宽松的休假、弹性工作时间、优厚的医疗和退休保障以及其他福利。

sentences.en: The corporation also allows workers to have their children dropped off when school is over, or to spend time with them during the vacations.
sentences.zh: 公司还允许员工在放学后让人把孩子送到公司，或者在假期陪伴孩子。

sentences.en: Annual Christmas and summer parties are standard, and this year, to celebrate an especially strong performance, the company took all employees and their families on a 2-day trip to Montreal, Canada.
sentences.zh: 一年一度的圣诞派对和夏季派对已是惯例，今年为了庆祝业绩尤为出色，公司还带着全体员工及其家属去加拿大蒙特利尔进行了为期两天的旅行。

sentences.en: Says Victor Davies, Human Resources Director, 'We enable employees to maintain equilibrium between work and home, a policy which ultimately results in a more productive and stable workforce.'
sentences.zh: 人力资源总监Victor Davies说：“我们让员工能够在工作与家庭之间保持平衡，这项政策最终会造就一支效率更高、更稳定的员工队伍。”

sentences.en: It works – this year the company will celebrate six 5-year anniversaries, and one 25-year anniversary among its employees.
sentences.zh: 这种做法确实奏效：今年公司将有六名员工迎来入职5周年纪念，还有一名员工迎来入职25周年纪念。

sentences.en: D For Hazel Gibbs, CEO of Disposal Systems Inc. in Houston, Texas, a waste disposal and environmental cleanup and consultancy firm, the bottom line is keeping her business going.
sentences.zh: Disposal Systems Inc.是得克萨斯州休斯敦的一家废弃物处理、环境清理及咨询公司，对其首席执行官Hazel Gibbs来说，最重要的是让公司持续经营下去。

sentences.en: But she realizes that it takes a certain kind of mutuality to do that.
sentences.zh: 但她意识到，要做到这一点需要某种互惠关系。

sentences.en: 'I'm not altruistic,' she says, 'but if everyone understands what it takes to be in business, that's good for all of us.'
sentences.zh: “我并不是什么无私的人，”她说，“但如果每个人都明白做生意需要付出什么，那对我们所有人都有好处。”

sentences.en: That's why she works hard to ensure that everyone, from managers to workers, realizes that they count.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，她努力确保从管理者到普通员工的每一个人都意识到自己很重要。

sentences.en: 'It's not about "us" and "them", we are a team,' Gibbs says.
sentences.zh: “这不是‘我们’和‘他们’的问题，我们是一个团队，”Gibbs说。

sentences.en: 'When our employees understand what it takes to keep a business going, then it works and we can accommodate each other's needs.'
sentences.zh: “当员工明白维持企业运转需要付出什么时，事情就行得通了，我们也能兼顾彼此的需求。”

sentences.en: Despite her success, Gibbs sometimes struggles with being taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 尽管事业有成，Gibbs有时仍难以被人认真对待。

sentences.en: She sees this as a long-term challenge.
sentences.zh: 她认为这是一项长期的挑战。

sentences.en: 'Working mothers still need to be taken more seriously, and so do mothers who are business owners.'
sentences.zh: “职场妈妈仍需要得到更多的认真对待，身为企业主的妈妈们也是如此。”

sentences.en: She has two children of her own to think about.
sentences.zh: 她自己也有两个孩子要操心。

sentences.en: E Family-friendly entrepreneurs are becoming more commonplace internationally, and they clearly influence those companies which have so far been slow to accommodate employee needs.
sentences.zh: 在国际上，家庭友好型企业家正变得越来越常见，他们显然也在影响那些至今仍迟迟未能满足员工需求的公司。

sentences.en: According to West, it is already possible to document the dwindling workforces of these latter businesses, or the migration of labor to more family-friendly ones.
sentences.zh: West表示，后一类企业员工队伍不断缩减，或者劳动力流向更家庭友好的企业，这些现象如今已经可以用记录证实。

sentences.en: What is more, parents are important consumers and investors who can change buying practices.
sentences.zh: 此外，家长也是重要的消费者和投资者，他们能够改变购买行为。

sentences.en: Further, in the public policy arena, multinational corporations and aid agencies are beginning to recognize the need to integrate social and economic policy and practice.
sentences.zh: 再者，在公共政策领域，跨国公司和援助机构也开始认识到，有必要将社会与经济方面的政策和实践结合起来。

sentences.en: Family-friendly employers are creating a groundswell of awareness that can only result in changing business practices.
sentences.zh: 家庭友好型雇主正在掀起一股日益高涨的意识浪潮，而这必将带来商业做法的改变。

sentences.en: And as Hazel Gibbs says, when that happens, 'you've got it working.'
sentences.zh: 正如Hazel Gibbs所说，到那时，“一切就都运转起来了”。
